gzungs 'dus/ sgroslo (98 )0958 'phags pa rdo rje ri rab chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs/ 3rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang /dz+nyā na sirnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(71) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(77)0959 'phags pa stobs po che zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 78rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(103) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(106)

0960 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 107rgya gar gyi mkhan po dri paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges dpal na len dra'i sgo 'gram du bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(110) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(111)0961 rdo rjes rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 112rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(116) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(117)0962 'phags pa lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgyad pa gsang sngags dang bcas pa/ 118bsdur mchan/(121) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(122)0963 'phags pa lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po/ 123rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(126) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(127)0964 mi lam mthong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 128bsdur mchan/(129) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(129)

bsdur mchan/(295) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(296)0987 'phags pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 297rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo rnyi dang / pradz+nyā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(305) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(306)0988 'phags pa bu mang po rton pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 307rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(309) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(310)0989 'phags pa gdon mi za ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 311bsdur mchan/(312) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(313)0990 gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rig pa chen mo/ 314bsdur mchan/(315) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(315)0991 'phags pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga'i gzungs/ 316bsdur mchan/(322) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(323)7

0992 'phags pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 324bsdur mchan/(326) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(327)0992 rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po/ 328bsdur mchan/(329) bsdur 'brasare'u mig(329)0994 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs/ 330rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sidha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de dpal gyi lhun po'i sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ jo bo a ti sha dang dge bshes 'brom ston pas sngags rnams dag par bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(354) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(357)0995 kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang dam tshig la rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 358rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len+d+ra bo rnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ṭī ༷gos sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la bsdur mchan/(380) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(383)8

0996 'phags pa ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 384rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(395) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(397)0997 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir zlog pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo'o( 398bsdur mchan/(417) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(420)0998 'phags ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 421bsdur mchan/(433) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(435)0999 dpal lha mo gtsug tor rol pa'i tan+t+ra/ 436bsdur mchan/(444) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(445)9

sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(751) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(753)1075 'phags pa sprin chen po/ 754rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(785) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(790)1076 'phags pa sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 791rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(802) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(804)1077 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs / 805bsdur mchan/(807) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(807)1078 'phags pa sdong po rgyan gyi mchog ces bya ba'i gzungs/ 808bsdur mchan/(810) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(810)23

1085 su rū pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 834bsdur mchan/(835) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(836)1086 yi dgas mo kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i gtor ma'i ཿdza ba/ 837bsdur mchan/(841) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(842)1087 yi dgas kha nas me 'bar ba la skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs/ 843bsdur mchan/(849) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(850)1088 'jur 'gegs zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 851zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(856) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(857)108( lus kyi zag pa sbyin par btang ba'i gzungs/ 858bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdo rgyud nas phyung ste/ba ri lots+tsha bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(859) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(859)1090 'phags pa ro langs bdun pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 860rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha sibha dang / ban+de ye shes snying po'i sdes bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi 25

mkhan po bibyā ka ra sidha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(869) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(871)1091 'phags pa 31gas kyi bdag po'i snying po/ 872bsdur mchan/(874) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(875)1092 dpal mgon po nag po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 876bsdur mchan/(878) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(878)1093 'phags pa nag po chen po'i gzungs rims nad thams —cad las thar bar byed pa/ 879rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(880) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(881)1094 lha mo nag mo chen mo'i gzungs/ 882bsdur mchan/(883) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(884)1095 dpal lha mo nag mo'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 885bsdur mchan/(889) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(889)26

1096 lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bstod pa/ 890bsdur mchan/(891) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(891)1097 nad kyi bdag mo la bstod pa/ 892bsdur mchan/(894) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(895)1098 lha mo nam gru la bstod pa/ 896bsdur mchan/(897) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(897)1099 dpal lha mo sgra dbyangs la bstod pa/ 898bsdur mchan/(900) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(901)1100 'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo chen po/ 902paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo rnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(911) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(913)1101 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rtog pa las smon lam 'byung ba/ 914bsdur mchan/(919) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(920)27

1102 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/ 921bsdur mchan/(929) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(930)1103 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam/ 931bsdur mchan/(934) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(934)1104 mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam/ 935rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā wasmra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(938) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(938)1105 stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa las gsungs pa'i smon lam/ 939bsdur mchan/(942) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(943)1106 rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las gsungs pa'i smon lam dang bden tshig 944bsdur mchan/(945) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(946)1107 lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 947bsdur mchan/(949) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(949)28

1108 bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 950bsdur mchan/(954) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(955)1109 bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ 956bsdur mchan/(958) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(958)1110 bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 959rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(962) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(963)1111 sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ 964bsdur mchan/(966) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(966)1112 de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ 967bsdur mchan/(968) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(968)1113 rigs gsum gyi bkra shis/ 969bsdur mchan/(970) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(970)1114 'phags pa rgya cher rol pa'i mdo'i tshong dpon ga gon 29

dang bzang po'i le'u las 'byung ba shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ 971bsdur mchan/(976) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(977)1115 dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 978rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(979) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(980)yod/: dkar chag gi zur ma na/ chos tshan (0995)(0997)pa'i mtshan byang rgyas drags pas thod yig tu bsdus te bkod

dzo /'phags pa rdo rje ri rab chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs/nyanya ༄༅sga /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ma hā badz+ra me ru shi kha ra thi ṭa gā (snyer dhā ra 〉(gu/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rdo rje ri rab chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig ④na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i lhun po chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa rdo rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sa'i gnas/ rdo rje chen po'i dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pas legs par brgyan pa/ rdo rje chen po'i rdzing gi rin po che'i pad+ma'i 'od kyis snang bar byas pa / sa phyogs rdo rje chen po'i bye ma bdal ba/ rdo rje chen por byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'khor gyi khyams rdo rje chen po las byas pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi rdo rje chen po'i seng ge'i khri bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag stong gis rnam par mdzes pa/ chos bstan pa dang cho 'phrul can/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin 98—3

gyi (1〉rlabs kyis nyan byin gyis brlabs pa/ chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis nges par 'byung ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgyad cu (8)rtsa bzhi thams cad kyang skye ba gcig gis thogs pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa/ mthu chen po thob pa/ rdo rje chen po'i rnam par thar pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing du rnam par 'phrul pa( sta/ cho 'phrul chen po kun du ston pa/ sems kyi skad cig thang cig yud tsam gcig la sems can thams cad kyi sems dang / spyod pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i chos bstan pa sna tshogs mnyam pa nyid snyan cing rgya che la zab pa dang / spobs pa dang / cho 'phrul dang ldan pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa chen po'i sprin gyis mchod pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin dang dbang dang / mngon par shes pa dang ma 'dres pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang sa bcu dang / pha rol du phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po dang / byams pa dang snying rje dang / dga' ba dang btang snyoms dang / byams pa'i stobs dang dben pa dang / yongs su byang ba'i sems kyi rgyun dang ldan pa sha stag la 'di lta ste / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba dang /rdo rje mig dang rdo rje'i lus dang / rdo rje'i blo gros dang lag na rdo rje dang / rdo rje 'dus pa dang rdo rje mthu bo che dang / rdo rje rnam par 'phrul pa dang / rdo rje brtsegs pa dang rdo rje'i phung po dang / rdo rje'i nga ro dang rdo rje bzang po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i tog ces bya ba dang / de 98—4

dag la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgyad cu ②rtsa bzhi dang / nyan thos chen po rab tu mang po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ srid par kun du sbyor ba chad pa/yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs dang / cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas rnam par 'phrul pa'i mthu chen po thob pa / lta ba chags pa med pa/ thams cad kyang dri ma dang bral ba/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi sa bon nges par sreg (2pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/tshe dang ldan pa sha char dwa ti'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ka pi na dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa skul byed dang / tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed dang / tshe dang ldan pa ga yā rgya'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung dang / de dag la sogs pa nyan thos chen po rab tu mang po dang / lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu grangs med dpag tu med gzhal du med pa dag dang / mi mjed (7kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / lha'i bu tshangs pa bzang po la sogs pa tshangs 4)ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang / lha'i bu rab 'thab bral g.yog 'thab bral gyi lha'i ris kyi lha'i bu dang bcas pa dang /yongs su dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang ske/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin lha'i bu thams cad kyi 'khor can dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs (7ris dang / stobs can dang / rab sim dang / sgra gcan dang rnam par snang byed dang / de dag (8)la sogs pa lha ma 98—5

yin gyi dbang po tshad med/ grangs med dpag tu med pa rnams dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang / ma dros pa dang / 'jog po dang / nor rgyas kyi bu dang / dung skyong dang / stobs kyi rgyu dang / pad+ma dang / pad+ma chen po dang /mtha' yas dang / de dag la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa 07dag dang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa mi 'am ci'i rgyal po'i g.yog du ma can dang / dri za'i rgyal po gtsug phud lnga pa dri za'i rgyal po'i g.yog du ma can dang / rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po don thams cad grub pa rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po'i g.yog du ma can dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po'i g.yog du ma can dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu dang / nor bu bzang dang gang ba bzang dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po lngas na rtsen gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po g.yog du ma can dang / 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya'i ji rigayog can dang / 'jig rten gyi ma bdun dang / sring mo bdun dang / drang srong chen po bdun dang / bar snang la rgyu ba'i rgyu skar dang /gza'i lha thams cad dang / phyogs kyi lha rnams dang / phyogs mtshams kyi lha rnams dang / sa'i lha dang dbyangs can dang / 'byung po rnams dang /bgegs rnams dang / log 'dren rnams dang / yi dgas rnams dang /'byung po rdzu 'phrul chen po rnams dang / ri'i rgyal po thams cad dang /'jig rten skyong ba chu lha 4)g.yog rgya mtsho'i lha thams cad dang bcas pa dang /'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / lag na be con dang / bden bral dang / me'i lha dang / rlung gi lha chen po bdun dang / dbang bdag chung ma dang bcas pa'i tshogs bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma'i 'khor can dang /98—6

sred med kyi bu g.yog dang bcas pa dang / byin pa po dang / phreng ba can dang / lcags can dang / tshogs kyi bdag po chen po dang / sprin ta la la dang / log 'dren gyi tunyedabang po bgegs log 'dren gyi g.yog du ma can dang /shing gseb kyi lha drug cu (snyedang / sring mo bzhi ming po dang bcas pa dang / ma bdun dang rdo rje lcags kyu can dang / rdo rje lu gu rgyud dang / rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu (snyem bzhi dang / rdo rje'i sde dang / lag bzangs dang / gtsug gis 'gro dang ④/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi 'khor du ma dang bcas pa dang / de ma yin pa gzhan (snyeyang sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la mngon par dad pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / 'byung po dang / yi dgas dang / sha za dang / smyo byed dang / brjed (6)byed dang /sgrub pa dang / sbrul 'dzin bcas dang gnon po tshad med dpag tu med grangs med pa rnams dang / lha'i bu nyi ma dang / lha'i bu zla ba dang / dus tshigs kyi lha dang / nub ku'i lha dang / dus kyi lha thams cad dang / gnam sa'i lha rnams dang yang thabs cig (7)go/ /de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das de chos kyi 'khor lo ni shin tu bskor sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ni shin tu yongs su mthar phyin/bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ni shin tu yongs su rdzogs thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / byang chub chen po dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sa brnyes (8)pas ni shin tu yongs su bzung (9)skyes bu chen po'i mtshan 'bar ba sum cu 7rtsa gnyis kyis ni sku brgyan/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus 37ni yan lag dang /nying lag thams cad rnam par spras/ spyi gtsug ni sems can thams cad kyis 98—7

bltar mi mthong / bdud kyi tsher ma thams cad ni dkrugs/ de kho na nyid mkhyen pa nyid ni rim par thugs su chud/ spyan rnam pa ⑨lnga ni mnga'/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ni ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ni ldan/sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang ni ldan/ bdud dang phas kyis ⑤rgol ba dang / ngan pa'i tshogs can gyi tshogs thams cad ni bcom/ brjod pa'i sgra dang / tshigs su bcad pa ni 'phags/ khyu mchog dang seng ge'i sgra ni sgrogs/ma rig pa'i mun pa ni kun tu bsal②/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag grangs med dpag tu med par sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan ④dang / shes rab dang / thabs dang / stobs dang / smon lam dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /dka' ri5rab spyad pas mngon par grub pa'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu 6)rtsa gnyis dang / dpe (7byad bzang po brgyad cus 6)sku brgyan pas ni mdzes shing rin po che rdo rje'i (9)pad+ma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri la ni bzhugs te/ gdan rin po che dang / rdo rje'i pad+ma'i seng ge'i khri ri rab tsam rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / mu tig dang ldan pa'i dril bu g.yer ma'i dra ba du ma sil sil sgra 'byung ba / rdo rje dang rin po che du ma'i stegs bu la rtsa ba legs par brtan ⑩pa/ rdo rje dang rin po che du ma'i chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba dang ldan pa'i snam rten dang bcas pa/ rin po che du ma'i pad+ma'i snying po la chags pa'i rin po che ke ke ru dang / ke ke ru chen po dang / an+da rnyil dang /mthon ka chen po dang / dun las du ma'i 'od zer 'bar bas snang bar gyur pas kun du mdzes pa/ rin po che dang / rdo rje'i thur mas brgyan pa'i 98—8

gdugs yu bas bstod pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas grib mar bsgribs shing bskyabs pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing du mas mdzes par byas pa rgya che ba la bzhugs te/ gser gyi ri bo ltar dpal gyis 'bar ba/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'byor pas sa phyogs mdzes par gyur pa/ zla ba nya ba ltar 'jig rten kun gyis mthong na dga' ba/ dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa chen po ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyis yang dag par rgyas par chos ston te/tshangs par spyod pa thog mar dge ba bar du dge ba tha mar dge ba don bzang po tshig 'bru bzang po ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa yongs su dag pa yongs su dkar ba yang dag par ston to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyi gtsug gi mtshams kyi mdzod 6)spu nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kun du ston pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer gyi dra ba chen po byung ste/ 'od zer gyi dra ba des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang bas gsal bar byas par gyur to/ /gang gā'i klung gi bye ma ji snyed pa dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad kyang snang ba des gsal bar snang bar gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs pa de dag kyang seng ge'i khri du ma bkod pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzhal med khang rnams na chos ston to / /nyan thos chen po de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag dang thabs cig (gyego/ /dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen (gyedang / dge bsnyen ma dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams dang yang thabs cig ligo/ /de dag thams cad kyang rdo rje 98—9

lhun po chen po'i rtse mo khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs yang dag par rab tu ston to / /de dag thams cad kyang kun tu snang ngo / /skad cig de la sems can de dag thams cad bde ba thams cad kyis tshim par gyur to/ /'on pa rnams ni sgra thos so/ /long ba rnams ni mig thob bo/ /smyon pa rnams ni dran pa rnyed do/ /nad pa rnams ni sos par gyur to/ /sbrum ma rnams ni bde bar btsas so/ /sems can dmyal ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rnams ni med par gyur to/ /yud tsam de la dud 'gro'i skye gnas/ dang / yi dgas kyi skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten rnams kyi ming yang mi grags 3)par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi bar gang dag mun pa mun nag dang / mun pa mun nag chen por 'dug pa de dag thams cad kyang gsal bar snang bar gyur to/ /der sems can gang dag skyes pa de dag thams cad dang / sems can gzhan 'dir skyes pa rnams kyang gcig gis gcig shes so/ /de nas sems can de dag thams cad kyis (mingo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi dga' ba thob ste/ bde ba mchog gis tshim par gyur nas kun du bltas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mthong ste(ge/ de dag gis gser gyi mchod sdong ltar dpal gyis 'bar zhing rang gi gzi brjid kyis mngon par 'phags pa de mthong nas de nyid la skyabs su dong ngo / /skyabs su dong ma thag tu de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de nyid du bdag son pa snyam du shes so/ /snang ba des bdud kyi khyim thams cad kun du 'bar rab tu 'bar kun tu rab tu mched cing 'bar te/ me lce gcig tu gyur par kun du snang ngo / /bdud kyi ris kyi lha de dag kyang skad cig de la nyam thag pa'i sgrar ngu zhing skrag 98—10

nas byer ro/ /bdud sdig can yang bzhin bzang po rnyi rnyi por gyur cing lus rngul nas bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu thams cad la smras pa/ grogs po dag bdud kyi khyim thams cad kun du 'bar/ rab tu 'bar kun du rab tu mched cing 'bar te me lce gcig 6)tu gyur pa dang / dge sbyong gi ②ta ma ri rab kyi rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa na chos ston pa 'di la ltos/ des bdag cag phung ngo / / tho btsams 6)so/ /phyogs gang du gnas gtol med do/ /longs la dge sbyong gi ta ma ④de'i gan du song ste (5)bdud kyi yul 'di thal bar ma gyur gyi bar du gzhom mo / /de skad ces smras pa dang / bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu de dag thams cad kyis rje bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes smras nas/ rang rang gi gnas su dong ste/lag na mtshon cha sna tshogs can go cha yisna tshogs bgos (7)pa/ cha byad 3)dang rgyan sna tshogs can mche ba mi bzad par 'jigs su rung ba bzhin mi sdug par bsgyur ba mig dang bzhin dang skra kun du 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba dag skad cig de nyid la gcig tu 'dus nas bdud sdig can ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas bdud sdig can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bzhengs bzhengs thog mar bzhud la ji tsam du dge sbyong gi ta ma nyan thos dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa de ci nas kyang phyis bdag cag gi yul du gnod pa cung zad kyang mi bskyed pa dang / bdag cag gi yul gnod par mi 'gyur ba deng ①nyid du phye mar brlag go/ /rnam par gzhom mo/ /de nas bdud sdig can dga' zhing mgu ste/ shin tu dga' bas spu'i khung bu khyab nas skad cig de nyid la bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu thams cad dang lhan cig tu bdud kyi rnam par 'phrul pa chen po dang bdud kyi sde chen pos bar snang dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad cu yirtsa bzhir 98—11

khyab par byas te dung dang rnga dang / rdza rnga dang / 'khar 0)rnga dang / rgyud gcig pa dang / lcags kyi sil dkrol dang / rnga bo che brdung ②zhing hu hu ③zhes bya ba dang / bi tsi zhes bya ba dang / zung ④shig zung (9shig /sod cig sod cig ces bya ba'i sgra 'byin cing gshol (6)dang / gtun shing dang / gtun rked (penyag dang / phur bu dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / mda' bo che dang /mdung thung dang / rtse gsum pa dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / gzhu dang mda' la sogs pa'i mtshon cha lag na thogs shing bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste skad cig de nyid la a la la zhes bya ba'i sgra phyung nas bcom ldan 'das la mtshon cha thams cad kyi char phab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mthus mtshon cha de dag thams cad me tog gi gdugs kyi sprin chen por gyur par snang ngo / /bdud kyi sgra de dag thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang / chos kyi sgra dang / dge 'dun gyi sgra dang / yang dag par bgro ba'i sgra rnams su grag go/ /bdud sdig can ni zhags pa lnga'i bcings pas bdag nyid bcings par mthong ngo / /de nas bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu de dag thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul ngo mtshar chen po de mthong nas ( ngo mtshar du gyur cing dga' ba thob ste bcom ldan 'das de nyid la skyabs su dong ngo / /bdud sdig can ni bdag nyid dgrol bar 'dod na 'grol ma nus te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi khyams su bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar shing rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du rdo rje'i 'khor gyi (9)khyams chen por 'gyel to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe byams pa chen po'i thugs dang thugs rje chen pos brlan pa'i spyan gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi khyams thams cad du gzigs nas 98—12

gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje bdud sdig can 'khor gyi khyams 'di nas slong la stan la zhog ste/ rdo rje'i ①rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting (kyenge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul ⑧pa'i byin gyi rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba gang gis/ bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu 'di dag dang / bdud sdig can 'di sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'dong ba rgyadang /gzhan yang gang dag sdang ba bgegs dang / log 'dren dang / yi dgas dang / brjed (nyabyed dang / 'byung po dang / gdon dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang —/ sgrub pa dang / sbrul 'dzin bcas dang / gnon po dang / zas su btsas pa za ba la sogs pa sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ rab tu sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan ⑥pa la ma gus pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid khong du ma chud pa/ de dag thams cad gang gis 'dzud pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar byed pa yang ston cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ des ngan 'gro log par ltung bar 'gro ba'i phyir ro / /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes / bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' mnyan nas rin po che'i pad+ma'i rdo rje'i stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la btsugs ⑦te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad 2pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /sems can kun gyi nyon mongs pa/ /gzhig pa'i slad du 'dren pa byung 6)/ /khyod ni bdud rnams 98—13

kun las rgyal/ /'jig rten rtsa lag gcig pu khyod/ /thar pa'i grong khyer 'jug pa'i lam/ /ye shes ma lus khyod gcig pus/ /yang dag brnyes nas thugs rje yis/ /brlan pa'i thugs kyis 6)bstan pa mdzad/ /khyod sngon sbyin dang tshul khrims dang / /bzod dang brtson 'grus bsam gtan dang / /shes rab la sogs yon tan gyis/ /bdag mdzad slad kyis sems can btsud/ /khyod kyis chos rnams skye med par/ /bshad cing de bzhin rnam phye yang / /'bras bur dogs pa ma mchis pa/ /kye ma mgon po khyod kyis bshad/ /'khor lo yan lag bcu gnyis pa/ /khyod nyid mkhyen nas rab tu bskor/ /mu stegs can dang bdud btul te/ /chos kyi snang ba gsal bar mdzad/ /nyon mongs brag chen rnam kun du/ /ye shes rdo rjes rab bcom nas/ /sus kyang thob par ma gyur pa'i/ /byang chub bla na med pa brnyes/ /gang gi mtshan yang rdzogs pa yi / /byang chub sa bon nyid 'gyur ba/ /khyod ni 'jig rten mchog gcig pu/ /dam pa rab sbyin bdag po lags/ /khyod ni mgon po khyod ni pha/ /khyod skyabs khyod ni dpung gnyen lags/ /thugs rje chen po ye shes nyid/ /mya ngan 'das gnas (nagacig pu khyod/ /khyod nyid gshegs nas sems can rnams/ /sems can dmyal las rnam par grol/ /rang gi sku yang yongs btang nas/ /khyod kyis (5 srog chags rnams kyang bsrungs/ /lus can kun gyis ma thob pa'i ye shes khyod kyis brnyes gyur nas/ /grol te 'jig rten rnams kyang 'grol/ /kye ma khyod ni rtsa nga)lag bzang / /mgon po khyod kyi 'od zer gyi/ /dra bas 'jig rten khams rnams khyab/ /mya ngan 'das las lhag pa bde/ /lus can kun gyis thob par mdzad/ /khyod kyi 'od kyi (5)gzis bcom pas/ /gza' rnams 98—14

kun dang dgung zla dang / /gdugs rnams dang ni zhugs rnams dang / /nor bu lham mer ma gyur to/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas/ yang rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug ste/ bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol nas/ rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba 'di la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de nas de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ kun du rab tu g.yos te/ shar phyogs mtho na nub phyogs dma'/ nub phyogs mtho na shar phyogs dma'/ lho phyogs mtho na byang phyogs dma'/ byang phyogs mtho na lho phyogs dma'/ mtha' mtho na dbus dma'/ dbus mtho na ni mtha' dma' bar gyur to/ /phyogs thams cad dang phyogs mtshams thams cad kyang dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes par gyur nas/ lham me/ lhan ne0)/ lhang nge'o / /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i yan lag dang nying lag gi mtshams thams cad nas rdo rje kun du 'bar ba/ rab tu 'bar ba kun du rab tu mched cing 'bar ba me lce gcig tu gyur pa dag byung bar kun du snang ngo rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang ba des phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa ji snyed pa dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes sal chos kyang ston te/ tshangs par spyod pa 98—15

thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/yongs su byang ba/ yang dag par ston pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa de dag 'khor gyi khyams rgya che zhing rgya che ba dag (1)kun du snang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad rdzun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi spyan snga na / rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang ba rgya chen po des snang bar gyur nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la so sor zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba rgya chen po kun du gda' ba 'di su'i lags / de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis so so'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba (gemi mjed (5)kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na ri rab kyi steng na chos ston te56) / bcom ldan 'das des bdud sdig can zhags pa'i bcing ba lngas bcings te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'gyel ba gzigs nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje zhes bya ba la 'di skad du/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje khyod kyis rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi ④rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul ston cig ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag 'di ni rdo rjes (8)rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de'i rdo rje'i rnam par 'phrul pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs 6)so /de skad ces bka' stsal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis gnang nas/ rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad 98wa 16

kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la phyag 'tshal te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rnam par 'phrul ba'i cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed yonye'adir lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la mchod pa'i sprin dang / gdugs kyi sprin dang / rgyan phreng gi sprin dang /dbu ②rgyan gyi sprin dang / me tog gi sprin dang / na bza'i sprin chen pos mchod pa chen po byas nas/ nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod bzhin du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la lan bdun bskor ba byas te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga rin po che'i pad+ma'i rdo rje'i stan zhu)la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das la logs su blta ④zhing / bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pas gnang nas/ rang rang gi rin po che'i pad+ma'i rdo rje'i stan ⑧de dag la 'khod par gyur to/ /de'i tshe shar phyogs logs na 'jig rten gyi khams rdo rje'i tog yices bya ba de na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i snying pos rab tu 'joms pa zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes ⑦te/ 'di ltar rdo rje'i ri rab chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs 'di nyid la (kyebartsams te chos kyang ston to/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang ba des kyang 'jig rten gyi khams ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kun nas snang bar gyur to/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa de'i 'khor gyi khyams su 'dus te 'dug par gyur pa des ngo mtshar de mthong nas/98—17

de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i snying pos rab tu 'joms pa zhes bya ba de la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang ba 'di lta bu gang gis 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad 6)snang bar gyur te/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad cing sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / yi dgas (midang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal thams cad mi gda' bar gyur/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa 'jig rten na rdzu 'phrul che zhing dbang che bar grags pa thams cad kyang kun nas mchod pa'i sprin chen pos dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes te/ nub phyogs su mchi bar gda' ba 'di su yi gulags/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i snying pos rab tu 'joms pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu nub phyogs kyi logs na mi mjed (gekyi 'jig rten gyi khams na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba rdo rje chen po'i ri rab kyi rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa na rdo rje chen po'i ri rab kyi rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs zhes (5)bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs ston to/ /bcom ldan 'das des spyi gtsug gi mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas 'od zer gyi dra ba chen po phyung ste/ 'od zer gyi dra ba chen po des 'jig rten gyi khams der bdud sdig can bskul ma thag tu kun du khros nas lha'i bu thams cad dang / gzhan yang bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang / dpung gi tshogs 98—18

chen po dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das de la gtse ba'i phyir lhags pa dang /de yang 6)sangs rgyas kyi mthus de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i 'khor gyi khyams de nyid du zhags pa lnga'i bcing bas bcings pas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'gyel te/ de la thugs brtse (geba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la ston cig par bka' lung byin nas/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje des rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po zhes ( bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/yan lag dang nying lag gi mtshams thams cad nas rdo rje rnams bstan te(ge/'di ni rdo rje de dag nyid kyi rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang ba des kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa rnams su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i (5)klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa ji snyed pa snang bar byas te/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang bskul/byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag kyang bskul bas ngo mtshar thob par gyur pa dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la yang so sor zhus so rigs kyi bu de nyid kyi mthus / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de'i spyan snga na 'dug (4)cing bsnyen bkur byed pa (7)yang mthong ngo / /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i snying pos rab tu 'joms pa de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying 98—19

pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 0)der de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la blta ba dang / phyag bgyi ba dang / bsnyen bkur bgyi ba dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje de yang blta (mibar bgyi ba'i slad du mchi'o / /de skad ces gsol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i snying pos rab tu 'joms pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu de'i dus la bab par shes na song shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par 55rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i snying pos rab tu 'joms pa de la lan bdun bskor ba byas te 'jig rten gyi khams de nas mi snang bar gyur nas/nam mkha'i dkyil gyi lam nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang lhan cig tu byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen pos 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ge'adi ga la ba der song ste phyin nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad dang lhan cig smra ba na/ bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po (5)bsags pa las grub pas byin pa'i rin po che de dag las 'od zer 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang sngon dang / ljang ser (6)dang / btsod ka dang / shel dang / dngul dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / gser dang / pad+ma rā ga dang / rdo'i snying po dang / ke ke ru dang / ke ke ru chen 98wa 20

po dang / an+da rnyil dang / mthon ka chen po dang / dun las dang / go mu ta ra ka dang / mu tig dmar po'i kha dog lta bu rnams byung ste/ de dag gis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams la lan 'bum phrag du mar bskor ba byas te steng gi bar snang khyab par byas nas lha'i snang bas snang bar byas te 'dus nas 'ja' 0)lta bur gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya (mithub pa'i zhabs mtshan thams cad phun sum tshogs pa/ 'jam pa mnyen ③pa/ rab tu gzhon pa sha rgyas pa/ snum pa/ long bu gnyis kyi rtsa mi mngon pa/ pad+ma gsar du kha bye ba lta bu dang / dung dang nya dang / rdo rje dang / rgyal mtshan dang / lcags kyu dang ske/ pad+ma dang / chu srin ma ka ra'i mtshan dang ldan pa gnyis la lan 'bum phrag du ma rtsibaskor ba byas nas nub par gyur to/ /nam mkha'i dkyil na 'od zer re re'i rtse mo las pad+ma bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgyad cu (5tshad shing rta'i phang lo tsam pa rin po che sna bdun gyi rgyu las byung ba 'di lta ste/ gser gyi rgyu las byung ba dang ⑥/ an+da rnyil dang / dngul dang / byi ru dang / shel dang /ke ke ru dang / ⑦dun las kyi rgyu las byung ba dag 'thon to/ /de la gser gyi rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab (nyam ni an+da rnyil gyi rgyu las byung ba dag go/ /snying po ni dngul gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni byi ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /chu ba ni shel gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni ke ke ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /an+da rnyil gyi rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab 6)ma ni dngul gyi rgyu las byung ba dag go / /snying po ni byi ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni shel gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /chu ba ni ke ke ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni dun las kyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /98—21

dngul gyi rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab 0)ma ni byi ru'i rgyu las byung ba dag go / /snying po ni shel gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni ke ke ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o / /chu ba ni dun las kyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni gser gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /byi ru'i rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab (tsam ni shel gyi rgyu las byung ba dag go/ /snying po ni ke ke ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni dun las kyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /chu ba ni gser gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni an+da rnyil gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /shel gyi rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab ( rim ni ke ke ru'i rgyu las byung ba dag go/ /snying po ni dun las kyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni gser gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /chu ba ni an+da rnyil gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni dngul gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ke ke ru'i rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab ri ma ni dun las kyi rgyu las byung ba dag go/ /snying po ni gser gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni an+da rnyil gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /chu ba ni dngul gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni byi ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /dun las kyi rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab 5rim ni gser gyi rgyu las byung ba dag go/ /snying po ni an+da rnyil gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze ba ni dngul gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /chu ba ni byi ru'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /ze 'bru ni shel gyi rgyu las byung ba'o/ /de bzhin du sbyar te6/ de ltar rin po che rnam pa 7du ma'i rgyu las byung ba'i pad+ma dag go/ /rin po che'i pad+ma re re la yang sa bcu la rab tu gnas pa'i 87byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du mdzes pa'i spyod lam phun sum tshogs pa dag ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' re re'i lte ba nas kyang 'od zer 'bum 'bum 'byung ngo / /'od zer gyi rtse mo re re las kyang 98—22

rin po che thams cad kyi rgyu las byung ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa nor bu dang / rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyi stegs bus bskor ba/ shel gyi rgyu las byung ba'i zla bas spras pa'i khang bran gyi rtse mo la seng ge'i rna ba'i steng na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan dpyangs 91)pas nam mkha' kun du khebs pas pad+ma rā ga dang / an+da rnyil dang / margad (yidang / bai ḍūr+ya ri nodang / rdo'i snying po dang / spug dang / ke ke ru las byas pa'i ka ba chen po'i klad 6)la 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi shing sa la gcod pa lta bu'i tshogs bkod pas rnam par spras te/ mdzes par byas pa dngul las byas pa'i phug ron gyi phreng gi mtha' mthar mu tig dmar po dang ldan pa dril bu g.yer ku'i 55)dra ba dpyangs (7pa'i sgras sad par gyur nas rab tu dga' zhing dregs pa'i phug ron dang / bya bang dang / ne tso dang / ri skegs dang / rma bya'i nga ro dag gis nyams dga' ba/ khyams dang 'dun khang chen po'i nyen 'khor stegs bur bskor bas mdzes ri7)par byas pa/ rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs pa las byas pa'i sgo khang can shel gyi rgyu las byas pa'i stegs bu dang ldan pa bkra shis kyi gser gyi bum pa du ma nas spos chu dri zhim pos chag chag btab pa/ rdzing chen po'i 'gram gyi ne'u gsing margad kyi rgyu las byung ba/ ka tsa yin da'i gos ltar reg na bde bas mdzes pa'i phyogs na bde bar nyal ba'i ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang /ngur pa dang / ka lan da ku'i khyu gnas pa gser gyi bye ma bdal (8)ba'i gtos ( 9)chen po rin po che sna bdun gyi them skas kyi phreng bas brgyan pa/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus yongs su gang ba/ grangs 'bum phrag du mas kun nas yongs su bskor ba dag byung ngo / rdzing bu re re nas kyang rin po che'i pad+ma bye ba khrag 98—23

khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu rtsa dgu byung ngo / /rin po che'i pad+ma re re'i snying po la yang sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang / glu dbyangs rnams kyi sgra phyung bas lha'i bu mo dag glu len gar byed cing yongs su spyod do/ /sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang / glu 6)dbyangs kyi sgra byung ba de dag las kyang tshigs su bcad pa ge'adi dag byung ngo / /sbyin dang tshul khrims kyis ni gang zhig dpag med cing / /de bzhin bzod dang brtson 'grus dag gi stobs ldan pa/ /bsam gtan gyis ni zhi zhing dbang gis kun 'byor pa/ /ye shes sgron ma de la skyabs su 'dong bar gyis/ /bsam gyis mi khyab stobs dang smon lam rnams dang ldan / /thabs dang byang chub yan lag ting 'dzin rnams kyis dag /rnam par grol ba'i lam dang stobs bcur ldan pa yi/ /thub pa gang yin de la mchod phyir 'dong bar gyis/ /'dam rdzab nas ni pad+ma rgyas pa ji bzhin du/ /gang zhig nyon mongs 'dam gyis rtag par mi gos pa/ /'chi (kyedang skye ba'i sdug bsngal rnam par bsal 4)ba yi/ /rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon po de la lta phyir dang / /gcig kyang mi ldan min par gyur pa gang zhig gis/ /skye dgu rnams kyi gti mug sgo glegs rnams bshig cing / /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi spyod pa (snyerab zhi ba//shākya'i tog ldan de la skyabs su 'dong bar gyis/ /de ltar khang pa brtsegs pa dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pas legs par brgyan pa rnam pa sna tshogs bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma nam mkha'i dkyil na kun du snang ste/ kha cig tu ni rin po che'i sprin gyi char 'bab par kun du snang ngo / /kha cig tu ni me tog gi gdugs kyi sprin gyi char/ kha cig tu ni go shir ṣa'i 6)tsan+dan dang / spos dang / byug ⑦pa dang / phye ma'i sprin gyi char/ kha cig tu ni gos kyi phreng ba'i sprin gyi char/98—24

kha cig tu ni ka shi ma'i ras dang / du gu la'i ras dang / za 'og 6)gi sprin gyi char / kha cig tu ni dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa'i sprin gyi char/ kha cig tu ni me tog pad+ma dang / ut+pa la dang / ku mu da dang / pad+ma dkar po dang /dri mchog dang / a ti mug ta ka dang / ka tsa lin da dang / ma hā ka (9tsa lin da dang / btang bzung 5)dang / btang bzung rtsichen po dang / mañdzu ṣa (snyeka dang / mañdzu ṣa 6)ka chen po dang / man dā ra ba dang / man dā ra ba chen po'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /me tog gi char de dag las dri gang byung ba des sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med grangs med pa dag gang gā'i gaklung gi bye ma'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams rgyas par khyab bo/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sems can gang dag 'gro ba drug tu skyes pa de dag thams cad dri des mchog tu bde bas tshim zhing sems dga' bar gyur te/sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral nas phan tshun 'dri ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed (8)de na byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po byang chub sems dpa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /de dag gis de (9)mthong nas kyang phyag 'tshal lo/ skyes bu dam pa de la phyag btsal ma thag tu sems can gang dag ngan 'gro log par ltung bar dong bob de dag kyang mchog tu bde ba dang / dga' ba dang / rangs pa dang / dad pa thob nas skad cig de nyid la ngan 'gro log par ltung ba las grol te sum cu (nyartsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes nas bar snang la 'khod de/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' 98wa 25

sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po la mchod pa'i sprin chen pos mchod nas lan 'bum phrag du ma mtha' yas mu med par bskor ba byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i 'khor gyi khyams 1chen po thams cad dang ldan pa (5)la lan bdun bskor ba byas nas lha rnams bar snang las babs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rang rang gi rin po che'i gzhal med khang gi khang pa brtsegs pa dag na lha'i bu mo bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang / glu dbyangs kyi sgra 'byin cing tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /gang slad ngan 'gro mchog tu sdug bsngal 'khrugs pa yi/ /ming yang bde gshegs stobs kyis deng du med mdzad dang / /bsod nams mi ldan sems can rnams la'ang rgyal ba mchog /byams par mdzad pa kye ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung / /bdag cag rnams kyi rmongs pa'i snying gis bsgrubs pa yi/ /sdig pa'i las gang shin tu bgyid dka' sna tshogs pa/ /de dag thub pa'i bya dga'as tshon)de ring glo ④bur du/ /skad cig tu ni ji ltar rnam par zhig par gyur/ /ji ltar gdugs kyis mun pa mun nag kun bcom dang / /ji ltar zhugs 'bar bas ni ras 95)rnams sreg pa dang / /bser mas shing bal ltar yang sprin 'thor 56)ji bzhin du/ /de ltar 'gro ba'i sdig pa bde bar gshegs kyis bcom/ /bde gshegs sras po mthong ngam thos sam dran gyur na/ /lhan cig skyes dbang 'od zer dra bas sdig 'phrogs pa/ /'gro ba yongs kyi srid pa'i spros pa gzhig pa yi/ /thugs dang rtag tu ldan zhing skyo bar 'gyur mi mnga'/ /mig dang mgo dang snying dang sha khrag tshil rnams dang / /srog dang sdug dang bu rnams rtswa (7)ltar bor nas ni/ /mi 98—26

mtshungs sems can don phyir thugs rjes thugs brlan pa/ /'jig rten mgon sras de dag rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi dgas 0)ltogs la chu dang ro brgya'i (mizas rnams dang / /de bzhin skye bo'i nor 'dod snying dang ldan pa la/ /thugs rje spyod cing rnam pa sna tshogs tshim mdzad pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchog de la skyabs su mchi/ /gang dag mnar med pa yang rab tu bsil mdzad po dpas/ /mchog tu tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba'ang ④bsil bar 'gyur/ /rang bde mi gzigs sems can don (5rabartson thugs ldan pa/ /'jig rten mgon 0sras mnyam ①med de 3)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang dag srid par 'khor ba'i srid pa'i skyon las grol/ / stong pa 79)gsung yang las kyi 'bras bu mi 'dor zhing / /ye shes me yis rnyog pa bsregs (7kyang thugs rjes brlan/ /spyod pa brtag med dbang ldan de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye ma dpal ldan rdo rje'i snying po bde gshegs sras / /mtshan gyis mtshan btab sku las 'od stong mang byung ba'i/ /dri ba rnams dang sna tshogs glu yis bdag cag sim/ /skad cig gis ni dmyal bas naskyesum cu'i 8lha dbang gyur/ /bdag cag rnams kyis rgyal dang de bzhin rgyal sras dang / /de dag rnams kyis gsungs pa mchog tu zhi chos chal/ /gus bstod dge ba rgya chen de ring gang thob pa/ /de myur 'jig rten thams cad bde gshegs thob par shog /de ltar tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la bstod nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ste/ de dag rang rang gi rin po che'i gzhal med khang gi khang pa brtsegs pa rnams su 'khod de chos nyan pa'i phyir phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying pos byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 98—27

'phrul gyi cho 'phrul chen po 'di lta bu 'di bstan nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i 'khor gyi khyams chen po thams cad dang ldan pa la mchod pa'i sprin chen po rnams kyis mchod nas ting nge 'dzin de las langs te bar snang las babs nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang lhan cig tu lan 'bum phrag du ma 1mtha' yas mu med par bskor ba byas nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la btsugs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das la blta'o(nas/ /rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang dga' ba dang mgu ba skyes nas de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das la blta'o(27/ /bltas nas kyang sgra skad kyi nga ro gcig tu bcom ldan 'das la tshul dang 'dra (4)ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /dran pa'i gzhus 'phangs pa yi shes rab mda' mang gis/ /ma 'phangs mthur ldan bdud bzhi pham mdzad cing / /'jig rten nyon mongs nyen pa'i mun pa bsal (3)mdzad nas/ /bla ma sprin med zla ba bzhin du lhang (6nge'o/ /dam chos 'od mang gti mug bcom pa dra ba yis/ /'dul ba'i pad+ma'i gnas rnams kha phye nas/ /ye shes nam mkha' che la dri med 'bar ba'i gzugs/ /nyi ma ji bzhin gdung bar bgyi ba'i bdud sde gdungs / /mu stegs can gyi nga rgyal mtha' dag pham mdzad cing / /'gro ba'i 'dod chags rab gdung ma lus rab zhi mdzad/ /dge ba'i lo tog rtsi chen yang dag 'phel mdzad pa/ /dge ba'i char pa phab cing 'brug ltar bsgrag ⑦tu gsol / /mgon po mu stegs can gyi wa brgya pham mdzad cing / /bdud rnams 98—28

bcom ste byang hu)chub dam pa rab brnyes nas/ /ma 'dres bsags pa'i bden pa'i stobs kyis mthu mnga' ba/ /skye ba'i 'jigs las rab grol seng ge ji bzhin sgrogs②/ /spyod pa zab cing brtan la rtag tu mi dpogs pa/ /sems can gnas gyur stobs dang ting 'dzin nor bu bkram/ /dri med chos lhun 'dul ba'i ri bos rnam 'dzin pa/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog khyod skye dgu mchog gtso ba(ge//tshul khrims bzang po'i rtsa ba sbyin pa'i chus btab 'phel/ /byams dang bzod pa'i me tog yal ga 'khrungs pas mdzes/ /byang chub yan lag lam gyi 'bru chags 'dod byas bsten/ /bsod nams dpag bsam shing khyod de ring ga las byung / /sum cu lirtsa gnyis 'bar ba'i mtshan gyis yan lag brgyan/ /dpe byad ⑤bzang mchog rin chen man shel gyis bskor cing / /sa dang dbang dang dam mchog ①phur pa brtan btab pa/ /lhun po bzhin du mi g.yo khyod ni 'gro bar mdzes / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying pos byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das la tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ste/ rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod do/ /de bzhin du sbyar te( nye/de ltar lho phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal gyi snying po brtsegs pa rnam par bsgrags pa'i rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams dpal 'byung ba nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i 58)tog ces bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag 98—29

khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun 6)du bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir 'ongs te(5sku/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rigs kyi bu de dag dang lhan cig tu rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du nub phyogs na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can zhes bya ba de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob pa byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun du bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 3)'dir 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing / rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du byang phyogs na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos mchog rang bzhin gyis rnam par nges pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba thams cad 'byung ba nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin po che'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun du bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ④'dir 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du byang shar 98—30

gyi phyogs na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas rab gsal dbang phyug gi rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams dpal brtsegs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros brtan pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun du bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed (1)'dir 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o / /de bzhin du shar lho'i phyogs na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams the tshom dang bral ba nas / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros bzang po zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun (bdu bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed rina'adir 'ongs te/bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du lho nub kyi phyogs na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che brtsegs pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin po che blo gros zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' ( dbye ba khrag khrig 98—31

'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun du bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed (1)'dir 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas chos nyan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ②chen po de dag dang lhan cig tu rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ / ride bzhin du 'og gi phyogs na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen ④pad+ma la rab tu gnas pa'i ri dbang gi rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams pad+ma bkod pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ( chen po nam mkha'i blo gros zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun (6du bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ⑦'dir 'ongs te / bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du steng gi phyogs na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal gyi nisangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bdud kyi tsher ma dkrugs pa nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bdud kyi sgrib pa las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor te mdun 6)du bdar ba nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug cing / rigs kyi bu de dag 98—32

thams cad kyang chos nyan pa'i phyir de bzhin du rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /de nas de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 0)'dir byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa du ma bstan pas gzhal med khang dang / me tog gi sprin dang / rin po che'i sprin dang / phye ma'i sprin dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan gyi sprin dang /rin po che spug dang / rdo'i snying po dang / bai ḍūr+ya (snyedang / an+da rnyil dang /byi ru dang / margad dang / mu tig dmar po dang 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi sprin dang / dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa dang / rin po che'i pad+ma du mas khebs pa'i rdzing gis legs par brgyan par gyur to/ /'jig ①rten gyi khams 'di ji lta ba bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab cing dpag tu med pa gzhal du med cing brjod du med par gtogs pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las shin tu 'das pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge (ge'adzin rnam par 'phrul ba'i byin gyi rlabs (9kyis de bzhin du legs par brgyan 4)par kun du snang ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams de dag na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang dag bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes (77pa de dag thams cad de na bzhugs bzhin du phyag g.yas pa gser gyi kha dog lta bu brkyang ste/ 'jam zhing mnyen la rab tu gzhon zhing pad+ma dang yal ga gzhon sha chags shing 'jam pa'i sor mo'i ngos can gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / lcags kyu dang / bum pa dang / nya dang sgo khang dang /98—33

gzhal med khang dang / dung dang / rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang / dpal be'u dang / 'khor lo'i mtshan gyis brgyan pa/ tshe rabs bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa'i rgyu mthun 6) pas mngon par grub pa'i dpe byad bzang pos rnam par spras pa/ sen mo zangs 'dra zhing rgyas la snum zhing srab pa'i nor bu'i mdangs (0kyi me tog gi 'od zer gyis mkhrig /rim mdzes par gyur pa sems can thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang yang dag par mthun 45pa'i phyag rnams kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la yang dag par gzengs 55)bstod pa dang / yang dag par dga' bar bya ba'i phyir spyi bo la byugs nas dus gcig (6)tu sgra skad kyi nga ro gcig gis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad go bar mdzad cing 'di skad ces/ kye rigs kyi bu gang gi phyir bdud sdig can dang gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la ma dad cing sdang ba'i bgegs dang log 'dren drag shul can drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gcod pa'i phyir zhugs pa thams cad tshar gcad ri7)pa dang / rnam par gzhig pa dang / de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed pa sems zhum pa brtson 'grus brtan po ma yin pa'i go cha bgos pa rnams kyang yang dag par gzengs bstod 58pa dang / rab tu dga' bar bya ba nas khams gsum par gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi bar dag kyang mya ngan las 'das pa thob par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas dang chos dang / dge 'dun gyi rigs mi gcad (7)pa'i phyir khyod rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par bsags pa yongs su rdzogs 98—34

pas grub pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos spras pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang /dbang dang / gzungs dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i mthus grub pa/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa nye bar zhi ba/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / yi dgas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du ltung ba'i 'jigs pa'i bdud kyi tsher ma ma lus par 'don par lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po nya1)dang / dge slong dang /dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma la sogs pa'i 'khor mngon par dga' ba can dag la ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i dga' ba du ma kun du bskyed (7pa la snyoms par zhugs pa ni legs so legs so zhes bka' stsal to(ge/ /de ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje gzengs (0bstod do/ /rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas rang rang gi phyag bskum ste/ rang rang gi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos nyan du gzud pa'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir ri bkye'o/ /de dag gis gnang bas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la phyag 'tshal nas byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyi rlabs (6)chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen pos ji tsam du skyes bu stobs dang ldan pas lag pa bskum pa las brkyang ba dang /brkyang ba las bskum pa tsam gyi skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la 'jig rten gyi 98—35

khams mi mjed der phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ste rin po che'i pad+ma'i snying po dag la phyogs gcig tu 'khod pa'i bar du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas de'i tshe gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje bdud sdig can 'di rdo rje'i zhags (1pas bcings pa 'di las khrol la ji nas kyang sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang / chos la skyabs su 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang / dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang / gzhan (gyiyang gang dag lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa gang dag ji tsam du de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la gnas par 'gyur ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la zhugs nas kyang ji nas khong du chud par 'gyur ba de ltar gyis shig /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas bcom ldan 'das la legs so legs so zhes gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas yang rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs so / /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de nas de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos te 'gul rab tu 98—36

'gul / kun du rab tu 'gul to/ /chem chem rab tu chem chem0)/ kun du rab tu chem chem mo/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje yang me lce 'bar ba gcig tu gyur te/ 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu mched cing 'bar te/'jigs ②su rung ba'i mche ba rnon po drag po gzengs gcan 'jigs pa chen po skyed pa gtsigs te/ mche ba mnan nas me lce chen po ltar sma ra ser zhing 'jigs 'jigs ltar 'dug ste/ mi bzad pa rna ba las 'phyang ba'i sbrul dug 'thor ba ④dang / ba lang rna lta bu dang / gzar bu lta bu dang / sbrul chen po kha gdangs pa'i kha nas byung ba'i mche ba'i rtse mo nas dug drag po 'bar ba 'byung ba'i chatshogs kyi phreng bas bzhin du me 6)'bar ba/ lag pa stong phrag du ma la rdo rje dang zhags pa dang / gtun shing dang / gtun shing rked nyag 9)dang /ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / lcags sgrog la sogs pa thogs pa'i mtshon cha'i rtse mo la me stag rab tu 'phro ba'i snang bas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /yi dgas dang / sha za dang / ma mo dang / 'byung po'i gdon dang /bgegs dang / log 'dren la sogs pa sdang ba rab tu sdang ba'i sems can skrag par byed pa ri dgas kyi dbang po'i pags zhu)pa khrag dang bcas pa sham thabs su bgos 6)pa/ sprul chen po'i lus kyis rgya gram du dam du bcings pa/'jigs pa bas kyang 'jigs par byed pa/ 'chi bdag kyang skrag par byed pa/khams gsum pa thams cad kyis bsdus pa lta bu'i lus dang ldan pa'i khro bor gyur nas lus kyi tshigs thams cad las kyang khro bo kha dog du ma 'di lta ste/ kha dog sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / nag po ste/98—37

thams cad kyang rdo rje'i rang bzhin can khro gnyer mi mnyam pas rnam par spras pa'i gnyer ma'i khro 17gnyer can gyi dpral ba'i dbyes nas me stag lta bu'i rngul gyi thigs pa rtsub po 'dzag pa las dug 'chang rnam pa sna tshogs kun du byung bas yan lag dang nying lag kun du dkris 92 pa'i mngon rtags can du gyur cing rdo rje drag shul can du snang ste/ mche bas mi bzad par 'dug pa'i kha gdangs pa las ha ha zhes gad mo rta gad 'byung zhing / 'jig dpa'i dus kyi rlung gis 94)char pa dang bcas pa'i sprin dkrugs pa las char gyi rgyun rags pa 'bab pas yongs su gang bas rgya mtsho dkrugs nas rlabs chen po g.yo ba dang / rta rgod ma'i kha nas me 'byung ba lta bu'i hūm̐ zhes bya ba zab cing brtan pas rgyu ba'i (5)'byung po'i tshogs 'jigs skrag ste 'byer zhing 'thor nas dngangs (6)te skyabs su dong zhing 'dud pas nyi ma stong bas 'bar ba'i lus rnams mthong ba na/ sna sgar skur can zhom pa lta bu'i bu ga zab mo'i sbubs kyi nang nas sbrul sna tshogs 'khyil pa'i gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od kyis 'gram pa rnam par mdzes pa/ glog stong 'dus pa ltar ser zhing dmar ba'i mig gi 7'bras bu'i 'od zer gyis skra'i tshogs rtsub cing bshor la gyen du 'greng ba'i rtse mo brgyan cing 'dres te gsal bar gyur pa/ sbrul gyi gdengs 8ka stong gis gdugs byas shing sbrul rnam pa sna tshogs kyi do shal dang /ska rags dang / dpung rgyan 9dang / gdu bu dang / rna chas lus brgyan pa/rdo rje 'bar ba dri ma med cing drag shul can mi bzad pa lag na thogs pa mdzub tsho )mo rnams las hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i seng ge'i sgra chen po dag gis bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kun du bsdigs 11pa dag 'thon te/ gang de dag gi mig dang kha rnams nas gnam 12grum pa lta bu'i sgra chen po'i tshogs las me lce chen po 'bar 98—38

ba'i tshogs kyi snang ba byung ste/ des sdang ba'i bgegs dang log 'dren la sogs pa drag shul can drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ sdig pa can sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sdang ba can sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams tshig par byed/rmongs par byed 'tshog par byed de/ mi bzad pa drag pa rtsub pa sdug bsngal ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba myong bar byed do/ /de dag tshor bas nyen pas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su dong ngo / /de'i tshe bdud sdig can gyis bgegs dang log 'dren de dag tshor ba chen pos nyen te dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su dong ba mthong nas 'jigs dngangs 6)skrag ste skyabs ma rnyed nas rlung drag pos bskyod pa'i shing bzhin du 'dar rab tu 'dar te/ ngu bar 'dod na yang ngu ma nus nas ri mo bzhin du lus thams cad g.yo ba med par gyur to/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje sangs rgyas kyi mthus bdud sdig can 'dul bar byed de / sdang ba dang / gdon dang / bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad dang /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de lta bu'i gzugs su 'dug pa'i rkang pa gnyis las khro bo 'bar zhing 'jigs 'jigs ltar 'dug pa drag shul gyi gzugs can/ seng ge'i sgra chen po hūm̐ zhes bya ba 'di gnyis phyung ste/de gnyis skar mda' bzhin du nam mkha'i dkyil du rgyang ring du 'phur te/ nam mkha' la gnas pa'i shugs kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la lan 'bum phrag du ma mtha' yas mu med par bskor ba byas te/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs (5)kyi bu ci bgyi bka' stsol cig /de nas 98—39

gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje cang 0)mi smra bar 'dug ste/ yang dpral ba'i dkyil nas rdo rje khro bo 'jigs pa chen po'i gzugs can mche ba mi bzad pa drag pas 'jigs su rung ba'i kha gdangs te/ mchu ma rungs par bsgyur ba'i kha nas dus kyi tha ma 'jig pa'i tshe rnam par 'thor ba'i rlung drag po'i shugs kyis rab tu bskyod pa'i sprin nag po'i tshogs rab tu sgrogs ②pas rnam par dkrugs gepa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i sgra drag po lta bu'i hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i seng ge'i sgras gang ba/bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad 'jigs nas 'bros shing skyid lug nas phyogs bslad ( par byed pa/ lag pa dang rkang pa dang / sen mo dang / mig dang / ag tshom dang skra thams cad rdo rje 'bar bar snang bas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa/ gzi brjid thams cad kyi gzi brjid rnams rang gi gzi brjid kyis zil du rlag par byed cing rgyang ring du byed pa'i rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang ba des rgyu skar dang /gza' dang skar ma dang / nor bu rnams kyi (5)'od lham 6)mer ma yin/ lhan ner ma yin/ lhang nger ma yin par byed pa/ gang nyi ma dang zla ba rdzu 'phrul che ba / dbang che bar grags pa/ mthu che ba yang lham mer ma yin/ lhan ner ma yin / lhang nger ma yin par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa bcu la rab tu gnas pa rnams kyi 'od ma gtogs par 'od gzhan thams cad mog mog por byed pa gzhan phyung ngo //de nas rdo rje khro bo des bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la lan 'bum phrag du ma mtha' yas mu med par bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas gsang ba pa'i 98—40

bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu ci bgyi bka' stsol cig /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes khro bo chen po rdo rje khro bo de dag la 'di skad ces 6)smras so/ /kye skyes bu dam pa dag deng la bdud sdig can dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dzin du chug shig② /'di dam tshig la gnas par gyis shig /gzhan yang gang dag snang ba gdon dang / bgegs dang log 'dren la sogs pa drag shul can drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/sdig pa can sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sdang ba can sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa dag dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la mi 'jug pa dang / mi rtogs pa dang yid mi ches pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la gnas par gyis shig dang / des sems can thams cad kyi yun ring po'i don dang / phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / khro bo chen po rdo rje khro bo de dag gis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag (min rdo rje'i tshig mnyan nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yang bzung ste/ dus gcig tu sgra skad kyi nga ro gcig tu seng ge'i sgra chen po hūm̐ zhes bya bas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgyas par 'gengs shing gsang sngags kyi gzhi skyidag smras so / /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa bdun po dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje'i lcags kyu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i gnam lcags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /98—41

rdo rje'i shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje be con la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje yan lag dmar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rjes rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 1)'tshal lo/ /'gro lding ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu nam bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i skyikhro bo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo / /tar+ya thā/ o tra ṭa tra ṭa/ tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya/ sgu ṭa sku ṭa/ sgu ṭa ya/sku ṭa ya/ spo ṭa ya/ sbo ṭa ya/ mo ṭa mo ṭa/ mo ṭa ya mo ṭa ya/ muṇ+ḍi byuṇ+ḍi/gyurje 4pa ya gyurje 5pa ya/ sarba satā ni/ tra sa tra sa/ tā sa ya tā sa ya/ bh+ra ma bh+ra ma/ saṃ bhā ma ya saṃ bhā ma ya/ sarba bhū tā (6)ni/ ku ṭa ya ku ṭa ya/ saṃ ku ṭa ya saṃ ku ṭa ya/ sarba sha hūṃ rdeg / gha ṭa gha ṭa/ sogha ṭa ya/ saṃ gha ṭa (nyaya/sarba bibyā 9badz+ra badz+ra/ sbo ṭa ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ utsā ṭa 1 ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ha na badz+ra badz+ra/ da ha badz+ra badz+ra/ pa tsa badz+ra badz+ra/mā tha 11badz+ra badz+ra/ ur+sā da 12ya ma hā badz+ra badz+ra/ dhā ra badz+ra bā ṇi bri ya/ ka ha ka ha/ ha sa ha sa/ ma hā ṭas nyu ha sa/ kha cig tu rgya ma35re rlabs 'khrugs pa lta bur zab cing 'jigs su rung ba'i hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i seng ge'i sgras sdang ba rab tu snang ba bgegs dang log 'dren kun du skrag par byed pa dang /sdang ba thams cad gzhom du gsol/ 'joms su stsal du gsol/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/badz+ra pa 1 ra pra da sbo ṭa/ bsgrub par bya ba lha dang / lha ma yin dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dgas dang / sha za dang / ma mo dang / 'byung po dang / gdon gyi tshogs mthar 'byin pa/'byer bar mdzad pa/ hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa he he maphaṭa/ a mo gha phaṭa/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha khang khyim dang bcas pal/ bu dang chung ma dang / phyugs dang 98—42

rtsa lag dang bcas pa g.yo bar bgyid du stsal du gsol/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa 'byer bar bgyid du stsal du gsol/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sum cu hu)rtsa gsum gyi lha khang khyim dang bcas pa/ bu dang chung ma dang / phyugs dang / rtsa lag dang bcas pa g.yo bar bgyid du stsal du gsol/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'byer par bgyid du stsal (midu gsol / hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin khang khyim dang bcas pa/ bu dang chung ma dang / phyugs dang rtsa lag dang bcas pa g.yo bar bgyid du stsal (kyidu gsol/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'thab bral gyi lha khang khyim dang bcas pa/ bu dang chung ma dang / phyugs dang rtsa lag dang bcas pa g.yo bar bgyid du stsal du gsol / hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dga' ldan gyi lha khang khyim dang bcas pa/ bu dang chung ma dang / phyugs dang rtsa lag dang bcas pa g.yo bar bgyid du stsal du gsol/hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'phrul dga'i lha khang khyim dang bcas pa/ bu 4)dang chung ma dang /phyugs dang rtsa lag (5)dang bcas pa g.yo bar bgyid du stsal du gsol/ t+t+waṃ hūm̐ phaṭa / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha khang khyim dang bcas pa/ bu dang chung ma dang / phyugs dang / rtsa lag dang bcas pa g.yo bar bgyid du stsal du gsol/hūm̐ tsū phaṭa/ de bzhin du 'od gsal dang / tshangs ris nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris 'og min gyi bar gyi lha khang khyim dang bcas pa/ bu dang chung ma dang /phyugs dang rtsa lag dang bcas pa g.yo bar bgyid du stsal du gsol/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/'byer bar bgyid du stsal du gsol/ rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams rengs par mdzad du gsol/ rmugs par mdzad du gsol/ rmongs par mdzad du gsol / gcu bar gsol gcad du gsol/ gzhig tu gsol rnam par gzhig tu gsol / mnan 96)du gsol/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ o khro bo khro bo chen po rnam par bkra 98—43

ba / ser skya bo nag po/ dmar po ser po/ mi pham pa/ rtag tu 'bar 6)ba'i khro bo/ su ru su ru su ru(snye/ mu ru mu ru mu ru/ tu ru tu ru tu ru/ ghu ru ghu ru ghu ru/ dhu ru dhu ru dhu ru/ tha ra tha ra tha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ha ra ha ra/ya ra ya ra/ ma ra ma ra/ ku hu ku hu/ tsi li tsi li/ mi li mi li/ lu ṭu lu ṭu / sarba ṭā lā ma ma hūm̐/ pu lu pu lu len tam/ lo ha si len tam(gyi/ mu lu lang khā se/ tsu lu tsu len tam/ ma lu bu len tam/ ma lu ru bi/ kurbi purba/le rtu spu ri ra gha rgyu spu bi (5)ri tsu/ su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru/ su mu su mu ru a (7ka ṭi bi ka 7she/ ni ka (8)she/ ka ṭa bi ka 6)she/ ⑩ni tunyeka ṭi/ ka ṭang tsoka shetshon / dza ye bi dza ye'/ dza yan ti/ bi dza yan ti/ ti ming gi si/ ma hā ti ming gi si/ ghu tang ga me/ ghu ta ba rā tsoya rteyi/ sdang ba rnams la rjes su 'doms pa/ ma dul ba rnams 'dul ba/ drag shul can rnams 'byer bar mdzad pa/ dpa' bo rnams kyi nang na dpa' ba/ des pa rnams kyi nang na des pa/ ma grub pa rnams grub par mdzad pa/ grub pa rnams chud mi za bar mdzad pa/ sems can thams cad la phan pa mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mnas bsgags pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad la bsnyen bkur mdzad pa/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi rig sngags thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/tshur gshegs tshur gshegs/ rdo rje ri rab kyi rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa na bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa thams cad kyi mdun du dam tshig gang bcas pa de rjes su bskyang du gsol/ rjes su bskyang sna du gsol/ gshegs su gsol/ myur du 98wa 44

gshegs su gsol/ bdag gi las rnams myur ba myur bar bsgrub tu gsol/skrag par byed pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa lag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hu ru hu ru/grub pa drag po lag na rdo rje bka' stsol cig swā hā/ shin tu grub par byed pa la swā hā/ rdo rje chen po la swā hā/ rdo rje phur ba la swā hā/ rdo rje 'joms pa la swā hā / rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs 67pa la swā hā/ rdo rje tī (geli tī (5)la ④la swā hā/drag po tī (7yi tī 6)la (7)la swā hā/ dmar po tī (8)li tī dzi)la kyil swā hā/ byis pa tī tunyeli tī tshul tunyel swā hā/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa la swā hā / bdag gi gnod pa dang / nad 'go yib thams cad dang / rims thams cad med par mdzod cig swā hā/ de nas rdo rje khro bo chen pos 'di skad smras pa dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos te/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad dang de bzhin du bar snang la rdo rje'i skar mda' chen po'i be con 'bab par snang ngo / /gnam grum pa'i sgra chen po yang grag go/ /kun nas sa chen po 'di grum par kun du snang ngo //sa chen po'i ser ka de dag nas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu'i rgyun gyen du byung ngo / /chu'i rgyun de dag gis rnam par 'jig pa'i dus kyi chu bzhin du sa chen po thams cad kun du gang bar snang ngo / /gang dag sa'i 'og na gnas pa'i klu chen po dang / lha chen po dang lha ma yin chen po de dag thams cad kyang sa'i 'og nas 'thon cing ri rab kyi drung du 'thon te gyen du byung nas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su dong ngo / /de nas drag shul can drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa / sdang ba can sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa'i 'byung po dang / bgegs dang log 'dren gang dag 'khod pa de dag kyang kun du 'bar rab tu 'bar zhing /98—45
