kun du rab tu 'bar te/ me lce gcig tu gyur pa dag gis rang rang gi lus kun du rnam par 'joms par shes te/ de dag sdug bsngal mi bzad cing drag la rtsub pas nyen nas ha ha zhes bya ba'i —1dngu skad 'thon te tshig khu'adi skad ces kyang smras so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po bdag cag skad cig gis srog kyang ma mchis par 'gyur du bgyid na 'jigs pa chen por lhung ba 'di las yongs su bskyab (getu gsol/ bgegs dang log 'dren rnams ji lta ba de bzhin du gzhan 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan thams cad na gnas pa dang / ri dang / chu bo dang /lteng ka dang / rdzing dang / dur khrod dang / shing dang / thibs po dang /khron pa rnying ba dang / btung chu dang / lam gyi bzhi (3)mdo dang / sum mdo dang / gtsug lag khang zhigs 5pa dang / gnas dang / lha khang na gnas pa dag thams cad kyis kyang gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje 'jigs pa chen por ltung ba 'di las yongs su bskyab tu gsol/ yongs su bskyab sgyu tu gsol/zhes ched du brjod pa ched du brjod do/ /de bzhin du lha'i khang pa thams cad g.yos / rab tu g.yos kun du rab tu g.yos te/ mog mog por (7gyur cing 'od 8med par kun du snang ngo / /bdud kyi khyim thams cad kyang kun du 'bar/rab tu 'bar zhing / kun du rab tu mched cing 'bar te/ me lce 〈rigacig tu gyur par snang ngo / /gang dag bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu de dag thams cad kyang rdo rje khro bo chen pos dngangs 7skrag ste rang rang gi mgo rdo rje rnams kyis rnam par 'joms pa mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la skyabs su dong ngo / /bdud sdig can yang shin tu sdug bsngal 98—46

ba'i tshor bas nyam thag cing skrag la zhum ste gnod pas dngangs 3)nas sangs rgyas la skyabs su song / chos la skyabs su song / dge 'dun la skyabs su song ngo / /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal te/ khro bo chen po rdo rje khro bo de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu dag yongs su skyobs shig /yongs su skyobs shig /bdag nam byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug gi bar du sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro'o/ /chos la skyabs su 'gro'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi (5)don gyi phyir pha lta bu dang / ma lta bu dang / spun lta bu dang / gnyen lta bu dang / snag gi gnyen mtshams lta bur 'gyur bar 55)byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /bdag deng phyin chad sems can thams cad kyi pha dang / ma dang / spun dang / gnyen dang / snag gi gnyen mtshams su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /lus dang ngag dang / yid kyi las cung zad gang ci byed pa de sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /bdag dbugs phyung nas gzhan yang dbugs dbyung ngo / /bdag grol nas gzhan yang dgrol lo/ /bdag mya ngan las 'das nas gzhan yang mya ngan las bzla'o/ /rus pa dang / rkang dang / khrag dang / sha dang / nyams mthu dang / srog gis kyang sems can thams cad la rim gror bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /rjed 57par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang /slob dpon dang / bla ma'i gnas thams cad la yang bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /bsti (5cistang bya'o/ /rim gror bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bzung (6)ste/ byang chub kyi sems rin po 98—47

che bskyed pa dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de ngo mtshar du gyur nye/dga' ba thob nas 1)sgra skad kyi nga ro gcig tu 'di skad ces smras so/ /gang gi phyir na bdud khyod kyis/ /sems can kun la bde ba'i phyir/ /bla med byang chub sems bskyed pa/ /bdag cag rjes su yi rang ngo / /rin chen sems 'dis mi ring bar/ /rnam 'dren sangs rgyas gyur nas ni/ /sems can shin tu sdug bsngal kun/ /mya ngan las ni bzla bar gyis/ /rgyal ba'i mchog 'di ji bzhin du/ /skye dgu thams cad gdul bar byos/ /stobs po che dang ldan pa yi//bdud bzhi po dag gdul bar gyis/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor chen po de sangs rgyas kyi mthus rang rang gi lag gi snyim pa na me tog gi phur ma thogs par shes te/ me tog gi phur ma de dag gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya nathub pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje dang / khro bo chen po rdo rje'i khro bo de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la gtor ba dang de yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus me tog gi gzhal med khang chen por gyur to/ /bdud sdig can ni mchog tu bde bas tshim par gyur nas sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa sgom zhing rang gi bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu dang nunye/ de bzhin gshegs pa rjes su sems pas mdun du rin po che'i gzhal med khang chen po dpag bsam gyi shing ④du mas mig mangs ris brgyad du bres pa/ rin po che dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi ru 98—48

dang ske/ margad dang / be+e ḍūr+ya 6)dang / an+da rnyil dang / mthon ka chen po dang —/ ke ke ru dang / ke ke ru chen po dang / rdo rje dang / rdo rje chen po dang / dun las dang / dun las chen po dang / 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi dra bas rnam par spras pa/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan bsgreng ②bas legs par brgyan pa/ me tog gi phreng bas bklubs (7pa/ pog snod du ma nas bdug pa dri zhim po'i ngad kyi dri zhim par byas pa/ phye ma'i dri zhim po'i gi)bsgo bas bsgos pas/ lha'i bu mo 'bum phrag du ma sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang glu len cing gar byed pa/rdzing dhibu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu can 'bum phrag du ma'i dbus nas rin po che sna tshogs kyi pad+ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / ut+pa la dang / dri mchog byung bas mdzes par byas pa'i phyogs dang ldan pa byung nas/de mchog tu dga' ba dang / rangs pa dang / yid bde ba skyes te gus pa thams cad kyis de blangs nas bdud kyi mthu chen po dang / bdud kyi rnam par 'phrul pa chen po dang / bdud kyi (7rdzu 'phrul chen pos lag pa gnyis ka 4)spyi bo la blangs (8)te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la dga' ba dang / mchod pa'i phyir phul te/ tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /'jig rten dag la dbang byed dbang gis 'byor gyur pa/ /stobs bcu'i sras rab mchog ldan khyod la brten lho)nas su / /byang chub phyir ni chags bral dri med byang chub sems/ /sems can bde sgrub gter dang 'dra ba bdag gis thob/ /bdag mig gti mug mun pas dri can dri med gyur0/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags rab tu zhi zhing spros dang bral/ /98—49

mya ngan las 'das drang po'i lam ni bdag la bstan/ /sems dmyal mi bzad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur/ /sdig bral 'jig rten mgon la skyabs su ma song ba/ /kye ma dman pa yun ring ji lta bslus shig gu/ /de ring thub dbang sras po rnams la bsod nams dang / /dad dang snying rje ting 'dzin thob nas ngo mtshar gyur/ /sa mdog 1gcig pur sangs rgyas myur du grub par shog /gcig pus 'gro ba ma lus mya ngan bzla bar bya/ /srid pa gzhan na kun du rgyu rtse (mibadag gi yid/ /rang phan 'jug dang dge bshes bral bar ma gyur cig /de nas bdud sdig can gyis tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la mngon par bstod nas cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas gsang ba dpa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes khro bo chen po rdo rje khro bo de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu dag sdang ba dang / gdon dang bgegs dang / log 'dren de dag thams cad gang gis sems can thams cad las rnam par rtsom pa la rnam par mi 'tshe ba dang / bgegs mi byed pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar 'gyur bar de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig 'dzin du chug shig /rigs kyi bu dag 'di dag la mi 'jigs pa yang byin cig dang / de sems can thams cad kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa bla na 50med pa yang thob par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / khro bo chen po rdo rje khro bo de dag gis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la legs so/ /zhes te tshig la mngon par dga' nas yang lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa de dag 98—50

thams cad dang / sdang ba nyu)bgegs dang / log 'dren dang / ma mo dang /yi dgas dang / sha za dang / 'byung po dang / gdon dang / brjed (5)byed dang / srul po dang / lus srul po dang / ro langs dang / mkha' 'gro dang / sgrub pa dang / sbrul 'dzin bcas pa la sogs pa de dag thams cad dang / gdon gyi tshogs de dag thams cad kyis rdo rje chen po mang po 'bab pas dkrugs zhi)pa'i mtsho gisachen po zab mo klong 'khyil pa/ 'ur 'ur sgra 'byung tshorab lta bur drag cing rgyun ring ba'i skad gsang mthon (6)pos 'di skad ces smras so/ /sdang ba 'byung po dang / gdon dang / bgegs dang / log 'dren la sogs pa drag shul can drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ sdig pa can sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sdang ba can sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa khyed thams cad nyon cig /khyed kyis deng phan chad 57༄sems can gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la zhugs pa dag dang / de la sogs pa gang dag gsang sngags sgrub bam(8ste / klog pa de dag la bgegs 'byung bar mi bya zhing 'tshe bar mi bya ste/sgrub pa dang rjes su mthun ri9)par stobs sbyin par bya'o/ /sems can gang dag dam tshig la ma zhugs pa de dag la bsrung bar bya/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur tu )ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / dug gzhil ba dang / dug gsad /nyapa dang / rig sngags 'grub pa sbyin par bya'o/ /sbrang rtsi dang / tshigs ma dang / sgog pa dang / ki'u dang / gtor ma dang / 'byung po dang / mi bgrungs /nyapa rnams kyi sha dang zas zos kyang skyon du mi bzung 3gezhing nyes par mi brtsi'o / /de nas sdang ba 'byung po dang / bgegs dang / log 'dren la sogs pa thams cad ces bya ba nas sgra skad kyi nga ro gcig gis 'di skad ces 98—51

smras so/ /zhes bya ba'i bar du sbyar ro/ /rigs kyi bu dag bka' lung ci stsal pa de bzhin du sbyar bar bgyi'o/ /deng slan chad sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes khro bo chen po rdo rje khro bo de dag dang /snang ba bgegs dang / log 'dren dang / 'byung po dang / gdon gyi tshogs de dag thams cad la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rig sngags kyi las dang dam tshig dang / phyag rgya ༄1)thams cad 'dzin du bcug ②go/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje yang rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po'i ting nge 'dzin de las langs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ( skur dwa ti'i bus gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu gang la gnas nas khyod kyis rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul 'di lta bu 'di bstan pa dang / bdud sdig can yang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / gzhan yang sdang ba gdon dang / 'byung po dang / bgegs dang / log 'dren thams cad kyang dam tshig la bkod cing byang chub kyi sems 'dzin du bcug pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di'i ming ci zhes bya de skad ces smras pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes tshe dang ldan pa sha (4ster dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa sha (per dwa ti'i bu ting nge 'dzin 'di ni ming dang yi ge dang sgra skad kyis rtogs par bya ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang ming ngam gzugs sam/ dbyibs sam/ gnas sam/mnyam par bzhag pa'am/ g.yengs pa yang rung ste/ ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba'i chos de gang yang med do/ /gang la ming med pa dang / gzugs med pa 98—52

dang ske/ dbyibs med pa dang / gnas med pa dang / mnyam par bzhag 3)pa med pa dang / g.yeng ba med pa 'di btsun pa sha (nyar dwa ti'i bu ting nge 'dzin 'di ming ci zhig bya zhes de la ji snyam du sems/ yang btsun pa sha ( )ra dwa ti'i bu gsal bar byed pa 'di ni bdag la gsal bar byed pa ma yin gzhan la gsal bar byed pa ma yin/ gnyis ka la ④yang gsal bar byed pa ma yin no/ /'on kyang gsal bar byed par btags pa yod do/ /de la gsal bar byed pa ni gsal bar byed pa'i bdag nyid kyis stong pa dag ni bdag gis stong / gzhan yang gzhan gyi bdag nyid kyis stong / gnyis ka (snyeyang gnyis ku'i yibadag nyid kyis stong ste/ yang dag pa ma yin pa kun du brtags pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ci zhes bya ba'i yi ge gnyis kyi tshig de yang tshig gi bdag nyid kyis stong ste ⑦yi ge yang yi ge ma yin no/ /de ltar na rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i don rtogs par byed pa yin no/ /don de brjod pa na yang gang nas kyang mi 'ong gang du yang mi 'gro mod kyi gzhan gyi dbang la rten pa'i phyir yi ger btags (8)pa yang yod do/ /yongs su btags pa yin pa'i phyir btags pa yang stong pa'o/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i phyir gzhan gyi dbang nyid stong pa'o/ /rgyu dang rkyen las byung ba'i phyir rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yang stong pa'o/ /glo 6)bur du rgyu dang rkyen gyis bskyed pa'i phyir 'byung ba yang 'byung ba'i bdag nyid kyis stong ngo / /de la rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ni rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong ngo / /rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa gang yin pa de mtshan nyid med pa'o/ /mtshan nyid med pa gang yin pa de de yobazhin nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de ma nor ba de bzhin nyid do/ /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de 98—53

gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid do/ /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de ting nge 'dzin to/ /ting nge 'dzin gang yin pa de rtogs pa'o/ /rtogs pa gang yin pa de stong pa nyid do/ /stong pa nyid gang yin pa de lhag mthong ngo / /lhag mthong gang yin pa de zhi gnas so/ /zhi gnas gang yin pa de rnam par thar pa'o / /rnam par thar pa gang yin pa de dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /dbu ma'i lam gang yin pa de la mtha' gcig med/ mtha' gnyis med/ gzung ba med/'dzin pa po med/ 'dzin pa med/ chad pa med/ rtag pa med/ skye ba med/'gag pa med/ rtog pa med/ rnam par rtog pa med/ rang dbang med/gzhan gyi dbang med/ 'gro ba med/ 'ong ba med/ kun nas nyon mongs pa med / rnam par byang ba med/ 'du ba med/ 'bral ba med de1)/ de ni lhag mthong yin no/ /lhag mthong gang yin pa de la phung po rnams med/ khams rnams med/ dbang po rnams med/ skye mched rnams med/ yul rnams med/yul du gdags pa med/ las med las kyi 'bras bu med do/ /gang la las med cing las kyi 'bras bu med pa de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub gang yin pa de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par rinasangs rgyas so/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang yin pa de chos so/ /chos gang yin pa de mi skye mi 'chi'o/ri / /mi skye mi 'chi 4rib gang yin pa de nam mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid du khong du chud par bya'o/ /btsun pa sha (5ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis ting nge 'dzin bstan pa bshad pa 'di ni shin tu zab ste(5)/ 'di la nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'gro ba yang med na/ 'jig 98—54

rten pa'i mu stegs can dang / pas kyi rgol ba thams cad lta smos kyang ci dgos chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa dang / mos pa chung ba thams cad kyis shes par dka' ba ste/ gzhan du na 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan gyi yul du gyur pa ni ma gtogs so/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan ni dmigs pa med pa gnas pa med pa'o/ /de skad ces smras (1)pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes tshe dang ldan pa sha (sher dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa sha /skur dwa ti'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba de ni de bzhin nyid kyi mtshan nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid kyi mtshan nyid gang yin pa de ni stong pa nyid do/ /stong pa nyid gang yin pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan nyid med do/ /sha bor dwa ti'i bus smras pa/rigs kyi bu gal te de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan nyid med pa yin na(5)/ de la ji ltar skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu (6)rtsa gnyis dang ldan zhing de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bstan cing dpe (75byad bzang po brgyad cus (8)sku legs par brgyan/ ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsum rnam par gzhag par blta/ ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes smras pa/btsun pa sha /9)ra dwa ti'i bu skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu 3 )rtsa gnyis zhes 17bya ba de ni kun rdzob kyi brda'i tshig go/ /brgyan ces bya ba de ni spros pa'i yi ge dang sgra'onyuge / /dpe byad bzang po zhes bya ba de ni sgyu ma dang rmi lam gyi ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid do/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ces bya ba de ni nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid do/ /sku gsum rnam par gzhag pa zhes bya ba de ni 98—55

tshogs gnyis kyis sprul pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /btsun pa sha ①ra dwa ti'i bu yang ②'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i gsang ba'i yul te/ de la sku'i gsang ba zhes bya ba de ni bsod nams chen po'i rgyu mthun (7pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /bsod nams kyi rgyu mthun (4)pa gang yin pa de de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzogs par longs ⑤spyod pa'i sku ste/ 'di yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i phrin las dang sku'i gsang ba'o / /btsun pa sha 6)ra dwa ti'i bu gsung zhes bya ba de ni kun rdzob dang don dam pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid do/ /kun rdzob dang don dam pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid gang yin pa de de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'i sku'o/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba chad pa med pa dang / rtag pa 7med par 'jug pa thugs su chud pa / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i lam gyis 'jug pa/ bsam gtan goms par bya bar shes ri par bya ba ste/ dmigs pa med pa/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang bas stong pa/ lus kyi yul ma yin pa/ ngag gi spyod yul ma yin pa/ yid kyi rang gi ngo bo'i yul ma yin pa gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku nam mkha'i khams su yang dag par 'du ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsum rnam par gzhag pa ni de ltar blta bar bya'o/ /btsun pa sha 9rir dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i gsang ba gang yin pa de ni chos kyi sku'o/ /chos kyi sku gang yin pa de ni chos rnams kyi dbu ma'i lam du blta'o/ /dbu ma'i lam gang yin pa de ni mi skye mi 'chi ⑩ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung ma byung yang rung tumachos kyi sku 'di ni gnas pa nyid do/rte/ /btsun pa sha (ger dwa ti'i bu bsod nams kyi rgyu mthun 8pa zhes bya ba de ni pha rol du phyin pa dag gi rnam grangs su gtogs pa'o/ /de la pha 98—56

rol du phyin pa zhes bya ba de yang bsod nams kyi rgyu mthun 6)pa nyid du blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ btsun pa sha char dwa ti'i bu sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni phyi nang gi dngos po rnam pa gnyis yongs su gtang ②bar bya ba'o/ /de la phyi zhes bya ba de ni kun rdzob kyi tshig go/ /nang zhes bya ba de ni don dam pa'i tshig go/④ /de la phyi zhes bya ba de ni gang zas 'dod pa rnams la zas dang /skom 'dod pa rnams dang / de bzhin du bran pho dang / bran (9mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho 6)ba dang / glang po che dang / rta dang / shing rta dang / sa dang / mgo dang / lag pa dang ⑦/ rkang pa dang / mig dang /sha dang / khrag dang / rkang dang / tshil dang / rus pa'i bar du sbyin pa ste/de yang thabs kyi pha rol du phyin pas yongs su zin pas yongs su bsngos pa rnam par smin pa la mi re ba dang / gya rnam pa dang / rgya (sheche ba dang / rang gi bsti po)stang du byas te rnam pa thams cad sems can thams cad la sbyin pa 'di ni phyi'i 'o/ /nang gi ni chos sbyin pa'o/ /de yang rnam pa gnyis te/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la 'jug par yang dag par gzhol ba dang / sbyin pa'i gtam dang / tshul khrims kyi gtam dang / bzod pa'i gtam dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / thabs dang / stobs dang / smon lam dang / ye shes kyi gtam dang / snying rjes yongs su zin pa thabs kyi pha rol du phyin pa yang dag par 'du ba'o/ /gzhan yang nang gi sbyin pa ni gang 'di mthar 'dzin pa dang / skye ba dang 'gag par yongs su rtog pa dang /rnam par rtog pa dang / shes pa dang shes bya rnam par 7spangs pa dga' bas yongs su zin pa stobs kyi pha rol du phyin pa yang dag par 'du ba ste/ 'di ni 98—57

chos kyi sbyin pa'o/ /gang 'di nyid la lus dang ngag dang / yid rgod pa med pa dang / khengs pa med pa dang / lus rnam par g.yeng ba med pa dang / ngag rnam par g.yeng ba med pa dang / yid rnam par g.yeng ba med par shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pas yongs su zin pa/ gcig tu nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa btang tsho1snyoms kyis yongs su zin pa/ thabs kyi pha rol du phyin pa yang dag par 'du ba 'di ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /gang 'di nyid la rang gi lus dang / srog la mi lta bar bsod nams dang / bsod nams ma yin pa dang / chos dang / chos ma yin pa dang / bden pa dang / bden pa ma yin pa dang / g.yo ba dang / mi g.yo ba'i dngos po rnam par spong zhing byams pas yongs su zin pa shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yang dag par 'du ba 'di ni 'dir bzod pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /gang sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang /bzod pa dang / ting nge 'dzin thob par bya ba'i phyir sems spro zhing rtsom pa dang /yongs su mi skyo bar rtag tu gnas pa med pa dang / de dmigs pa med pa dang /byams pas yongs su zin pa ye shes kyi pha rol du phyin pa yang dag par 'du ba 'di ni 'dir brtson 'grus kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /btsun 9kyepa sha 3)ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni bsod nams kyi tshogs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzogs par longs (4)spyod pa'i sku'i gsang ba grub par byed pa'o/ /btsun pa sha (per dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang ye shes kyi tshogs ni gang pha rol du phyin pa bzhi po 'di dag nyid rtogs pa ste/pha rol du phyin pa rnams 'byed pa dang / 'brel pa dang gsal bar byed pa dang /de la gzhol zhing mi rtag pa dang / bdag med pa dang / stong pa dang /gsob dang / gsog 6chodang / dngos po med pa dang / dngos po thams cad 98—58

dngos po med par yang dag par ston to/ /mdor bsdu na 'dod chags dang /zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa sel cing chos kyi dbyings nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang mnyam par yang dag par 0)ston te(ge/ dmigs pa dang bral ba 'di ni 'dir bsam gtan gyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /de bzhin nyid dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / phyi ma'i mtha' stong pa nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi rang gi ngo bo nyid gang yin pa 'di ni 'dir shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /btsun pa sha zhirar dwa ti'i bu 'di ni ye shes kyi tshogs so/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs dang / tshogs 'di gnyis ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dang shes pa dang / shes bya mtha' dag dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par rtogs par byed pa ste/ btsun pa sha stir dwa ti'i bu 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i gsang ba mdor bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /rgya cher rnam par dbye ba ni gal te de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis sku tshe'i tshad bskal par bzhugs te bstan cing bshad (gekyang mthar phyin par mi 'gyur ro/ /sku'i gsang ba ji lta ba bzhin du gsung gi gsang ba yang de bzhin no / /thugs kyi gsang ba ni de bzhin gshegs pas rnam pa dang / so so'i rnam pa dang / kha dog dang / rtags dang / dbyibs dang / ngag gi rnam par rtog pa'i spyod yul dang / bya ba tha dad pa'i sbyor ba rnams kyis kyang bstan par mi spyod mod kyi/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i so so rang gis (zherig pa ni thugs kyi gsang ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /btsun pa sha (per dwa ti'i bu de ni de'i phyir rnam grangs 'dis kyang de ltar rig par bya ste/ bdag cag lta bu byang 98—59

chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas pa rnams kyis bstan pa lta smos kyang ci dgos / 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis hu)brlabs kyis sems can gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa'i bsam pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa dang /mos pa dang / blo gros dang / blo dang / rtogs pa dang / mngon par 'dod pa mtha' yas mu med pa dang / sems kyi rgyun rnam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i spyod yul dang / skye gnas sna tshogs dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i las sna tshogs dang / mi shes pa dang ma rig pa'i mun pa dang / mi snang ba dang / mun nag dang / 'gro ba lnga dang / 'gro ba drug dang / khams gsum pa thog ma dang / dbus dang / 'jig par gnas pa sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' yongs su ma chad par gnas par (bdus gsum dang /phyogs la mgo rmongs pa/ skye ba dang rga ba la sogs pa na ba dang / nad dang mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa la sogs pas nyin gcig ①bzhin du bcom pa'i sems can rnams kyi sems can gyi khams ma rgal ba bsgral ba dang / ma grol ba dgrol ba dang / dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba dang / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la gzud pa dang / gnas pa thams cad gyur pa'i lam la dgod pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa shin du bde ba/ don dam pa/ zhi ba 'khrug pa med pa/ dge ba nad med pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi so so rang gi ④rig pa'i ye shes kyi dbyings 55tshomanyam pa nyid kyis mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la sbyar ba 98—60

dang ske/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa dang / yang dag par gzengs bstod ①pa dang / yang dag par rab tu dga' bar bya ba dang / dga' ba dang /dad pa dang / mgu ba'i sa la yang dag par gzud pa dang / chos rtogs ②pa'i khyad par brjod pa dang / rgya mtsho chen po ltar 'dul ba'i sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i dus dang / tshod las mi 'da' bar bya ba dang / de dag la rgyu de'i dbang du byas te skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i don dang / phan pa dang bde ba dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang / theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i chos kyi tshul gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de gnas par bya ba dang / gcig nas gcig tu lung byin pas thos pa dang / bsam pa dang bsgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab dang / ye shes goms pa rnal 'byor du gyur pa'i rgyud kyi rgyun mi gcad phyipa dang / skal ba yod la yongs su ma smin pa yongs su smin par bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa'i don gyi phyir phyogs tsam gyi sgo gcig mdun du byas te 'jug par byed pa cung gozad cig bshad par bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa sha ⑤ra dwa ti'i bu mchog tu ngo mtshar du gyur cing rmad du byung bar gyur te dga' ba thob nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /gang gi phyir kho bo cag lta bu nyi tshe ba'i shes pa dang ldan pa gzhan gyis sgra bsgrags (7pa'i rjes su 'gro ba'i nyan thos rnams la chos zab mo'i tshig gi don 'di lta bu gsal bar byas pa ni rigs kyi bu khyod yang legs so/ /lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ btsun pa sha (per dwa ti'i bu de de bzhin te/ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /btsun pa sha (snyer dwa ti'i bu ting nge 'dzin 'di'i ming ci zhes bya zhes de skad zer ba ni ting nge 'dzin 'di'i ming rdo rje'i rnam par thar 98—61

pa'i sgo chen po zhes bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag g.yas pa gser gyi kha dog lta bu 1brkyang (5ste/ phyag g.yas pa 'jam zhing mnyen la shin du gzhon sha chags pa gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i mgo la bzhag (kyeste/ched du bka' stsal pa 'di dag kyang ched du bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje khyod kyis gang mdo sde zab mo 'di lta bu 'di gsang ba pa'i tshig gi don bzhin du sems can thams cad la lung bstan cing bshad de dkrol rilazhing rnam par phye ba legs so legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas lag na rdo rje la ji ltar legs so zhes bya ba byin pa de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i mgo la phyag bzhag 5)ste/ ched du bka' stsal pa 'di dag kyang ched du bka' stsal cing legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'jig rten gyi khams mang po dag na ming 'dzin pa yang dkon na rab tu gsal bar byed pa lta ci smos/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na lha'i bu gang gā'i klung tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa'i bye ma'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul las shin tu 'das pa snyed chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so/ /dge slong dang /dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen 6ma dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa rab tu mang po dag ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /de bas kyang 98—62

ches mang ba'i sems can rnams ni phyir mi ldog pa nyid du bya ba'i phyir bla na med pa yang dag par (1)rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skyes so/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dang / de ma yin pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dpag tu med cing grangs med la brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dag kyang rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la yang chos kyi dgab pa dzonanodang / mchod pa'i phyir nam mkha'i dkyil na rnga rnams ma brdungs ( par kun nas sgra byung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi gzhal med khang gi khang pa brtsegs pa rnams su kun nas sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang / glu dbyangs blangs pas lha'i bu mo rnams gar byed do/ /spos dang / byug pa dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal bumatshan dang / ba dan dang / dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa dang /rin po che dang / mu tig gi rgyan (5)phreng dang / me tog pad+ma dang / ku mu da dang / ut+pa la dang / dri mchog dang / sna (6)ma'i me tog dang / pa ri ṣa (7rika dang / pa ri ṣa suka chen po dang / btang bzung (9)dang / btang 0bzung chen po dang / man dā ra ba dang / man dā ra ba chen po dang / mañdzu ṣa 37ka dang / mañdzu ṣa 12ka chen po dang / kun nas skyes dang / kun nas skyes chen po'i me tog gi char gyi sprin kun nas mngon par bab bo/ /spos chu'i char gyi sprin yang mngon par bab po/ /de nas tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / brgya byin dang / 'jig rten skyong /tshab dang / gnod sbyin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / ma mo'i gdon gyi tshogs dang / 'byung po dang / brjed 7byed dang / skem byed 98—63

dang / sgrub pa dang / sprul 'dzin bcas dang / gnon po dang / ma mo dang / yi dgas dang / sha za dang / bram ze'i srin po dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dang / mkhar dang ri dang / sa'i lha la 6)sogs pa sdang ba gdon bgegs dang / log 'dren thams cad dang / de ma yin pa gzhan yang lha dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa dag bla gos rnams phrag pa gcig tu gzar te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gis bdag cag gzir cing nye bar gzir bas rig tshogesngags 'chang thams cad dngos grub ①stsol ba dang / dam tshig thams cad du 'jug pa la yang dag par gnang ④bar bgyid par 'gyur ba rang gi snying po 'di bdag cag la bstan du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshangs pa la sogs pa lha'i tshogs de dag la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/grogs po dag gang gi phyir khyed cag 'di ltar sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir zhugs pa ni legs so legs so/ /de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung 55shig dang / ngas khyed rang gi snying po bstan par bya'o/ /de dag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das la legs so legs so zhes gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i rnga bo che dang / rgya mtsho dang / sprin chen po'i sgra lta bu'i gsung (6༄tshangs pa chen po'i sgra bas lhag pa sna tshogs snyan ⑦cing rgya che la zab pa thog ma dang / bar dang tha mar dge ba/ sems can thams cad kyi snying du 'thad pa/ gsal ba/ 'jebs pa dag pa/ mnyen pa snyan pa/ brjod pa'i tshig khams gsum pa thams cad la go bar byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i seng 98—64

ge'i sgra bla na med pa des grub pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshigazhi 'di (snyedag gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ dza ya dza ya/ dza ya chab ha/ tsi li tsi li/mi li mi li/ lu ṭu lu ṭu/ dza ye bi dza yebya/ dza yan+ti/ bi dza yarnyi/ a dzi te/a pa rā phyidzi te/ tar+ya 4)te/ sarba duṣ+ṭa pra duṣ+ṭa sta ma bha ni/ dzam bha ni/ mo ha ni/ shwe te ka rā le/ ke yu 9)re/ sarba budha a dhiṣ+ṭha te(kye/ bad+dha rā bā si ni / par+ṇa sha ba ri/ shri 6)ye ma hā shi ⑩le sarba ad+dha ⑩ta ya shri te/ pad+ma ba 7he/pad+ma mā li ni/ badz+ra i ku ḍa/rteshi/ badz+ra mā ④te/ badz+ra pā tā li/ shu li ni/badz+ra dha tsore/ hi hi hi hi/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ he he he he/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ badz+ra shu li ṇi/ tsakra yidha re(rte/ hi hi badz+ra pā ṇi/ he he badz+ra pā ṇi/ hi hi hi hi/ he he he he/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ ka la ka la/ ba la ba la/ ra la ra la/ dha ma dha ma/sa ra sa ra/ hā hā hā hā hā/ tsi li me 8le/ tshi le/ di le7/ di di la/ di mi le/ dz+wa le/ ma hā dz+wa le/ dz+wa 4 )li ti/ pra dz+wa li ti/ tha (nyer thag ge tha so re/mu ku tidu/ k+ṣa me/ k+ṣa ma me/ grub pa'i tshogs kyis phyag byas ma/ lha thams cad kyi snying kun du 'jug par byed ma/ sems can thams cad kyi snying 'bigs ma / sdang ba rab tu sdang ba thams cad kyi snying 'joms ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po rjes su skyong ma/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi snying po la 'jug ma tshur shog /dam tshig rjes su skyongs shig /sems can thams cad kyi snying rnams khug la dam tshig la khod cig /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo swā hā/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo swā hā/tra ṭa tra ṭa/ sbo ṭa ya swā hā/ gyen du lta la swā hā/ rnam par lta la swā hā/98—65

chu srin la swā hā/ me la swā hā/ tshangs pa la swā hā/ khyab 'jug la swā hā/drag po rnams la swā hā/ brgya byin la swā hā/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams 0)la swā hā / thams cad la swā hā/ lha rnams la swā hā/ nor rnams la swā hā/ ma mo rnams la swā hā/ mtshun rnams la swā hā/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad la swā hā/ sa la swā hā/ dbyangs can la swā hā/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po thams cad dang / srin po la sogs pa khams gsum thams cad du gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la swā hā/ tshur shog tshur shog /dam tshig rjes su skyongs shig /ku ru ku ru/ sa ra sa ra/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ hūm̐ s+t+waṃ hūṃ/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ ma tang gi/ḍom+bi ni/ puk+ka si/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag la gsang sngags gzhi rnams grub par gyur cig swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pas rang gi snying po dang / lha thams cad kyi snying po 'di gsungs pa na thams cad dang ldan pa'i lha'i 'khor de 'jigs/ dngangs skrag par gyur nas/ chu shing gi tshal rlung drag po chen pos bskyod de rtsa ba bcad pa bzhin du g.yo zhing 'gul la snying tshig ste/ rdo rje'i phur bus btab pa bzhin du zug cing zhig sa la 'gre nazhing skyabs btsal ba'i phyir 'du shes tsam gyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la 'bod pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu lha'i 'khor 'di slong (gyishig /ngas dam tshig 'di yongs su 'dzin du gzhug go/ /rig sngags grub pa 'byor bar byed pa'i snying po la gzhol ba bsgrags so/ /de skad ces bka' stsal 98—66

pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje 0)gsang ba pa'i snying po 'dis lha'i 'khor de dag thams chad bslang ngo / /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo'i/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo /oṃ ki li ki la/ bā la kyi li ki lā (8)ya swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gi snying po mchog tu gsang ba lags te/ rig sngags thams cad 'grub par bgyid pa lags so/ /des ni bdag kyang drangs nas gzhan gyis ma btang (dkobar mchi'orgya/ /dbang du mchi'o/ /dngos grub stsal bar bgyi'o/ /lung bzhin bgyi'ol/ /bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /dpal bskyed par bgyi'o/ /bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rnam par bshig go/ /sems can thams cad gdul bar bgyi'o / /'byung po thams cad rnam par bshig par bgyi'o nad thams cad bsal (5)bar bgyi'o/ /sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ni ma gtogs so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po mchog tu gsang ba 'di ni 'di nas bskal pa grangs (67ma mchis pa gsum du dka' ba spyod pa chen po bgyid pa na gnod pa bgyid pa bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyis rnam par gtses pa'i tshe/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mchog 'dzin me ltar blos rnam par bsgyings shing rnam par rol pa mngon shes dri zhim 57)snang dpal gyis bdag la bsrung ba'i slad du stsal to//gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes snying po mchog tu gsang ba 'di smras ma thag tu 'khor de thams cad bsam gtan gyi dga' ba dang bde bas tshim par gyur te/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i dam tshig gi bstan pa la gnas so / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal 98—67

theg pa chen po'i mdo/11)༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ma hā ba la nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa stobs po che zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das ri btang bzung tsho chen po na chos ston te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstod cing bsngags te bkur nas mngon par dga' bar byas pa yang de nyid du 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 4)phyag gis sems can rnams dbugs 'byin cing shar phyogs na me lce kun du 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs so//bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas logs na stobs po che lag pa bzhi pa/ lag pa gcig na ni rnga yab thogs lag pa gcig gis ni phyag 'tshal/ g.yas pa na ni be 5ri98—78

con thogs/ g.yon pa na ni zhags pa thogs pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/mig dmar ba'o/ /de'i 'og na ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /g.yas na ni rig sngags kyi rgyal po gnod mdzes so/ /g.yon na ni bdud rtsi thab (1)sbyor ro/ /de nas snying po rnams ni zla ba kham pa lta bur gzhag go/ /snying po ni ki li ki la dang / 'gro lding ba'i gzungs dang lus dmar po dang / rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa dang / rdo rje rgya ②chen te/ snying po'i mchog go/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po drag po chen po dang nye ba na ni 'phags pa 58)mā ma (4)khri'o/ /'phags pa bdud rtsi thab ⑧sbyor gyi 'og na ni rdo rje'i lcags kyu dang / rdo rje nelu gu rgyud do/ /sgo'i nang logs su ni khro bo rdo rje'i tho ba dang /rdo rje'i be con gnyis mngon du phyogs par gzhag go/ /g.yon logs su ni bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas logs su ni gos dkar mo'o/ /de'i 'og tu ni sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can no/ /g.yon du ni rig sngags kyi rgyal po rta mgrin dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brgya phrag stong dang ngo / /de bzhin du shar phyogs su ni zla ba dang / nyi ma dang /yul 'khor srung dang dbang po'o/ /me'i phyogs na ni me'i drang srong chen po rnams kyis bskor ba'o/ /lho phyogs su ni gshin rje dang khyab 'jug go/ /bden bral gyi phyogs su ni srin po'i bdag po ma mo rnams kyis bskor ba'o/ /nub phyogs su ni klu'i bdag po klu la sogs pas bskor ba'o/ /rlung gi phyogs su ni rlung lha 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /byang phyogs su ni lus ngan po 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /dbang bdag gi phyogs su ni dbang bdag tshogs kyis bskor ba'o//98—79

lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / khyab 'jug dang / tshangs pa chen po dang /de la sogs pa gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa dag dang ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas te snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje mdo sde 'di sgrub pa po 'di la gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di rgya cher yang dag par bshad par bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ ki li ki la 1stebadz+ra/ ki li ki la (mil swā hā/ spyi gtsug la swā hā/ dpral ba la swā hā/mig la swā hā/ drag shul can la swā hā/ shin tu drag shul can la swā hā/ rdo rje zhags pa la swā hā/ lus dmar po la swā hā/ lag na rdo rje la swā hā/ lag na zhags pa la swā hā/ lag na ral gri la swā hā/ lag na dgra sta la swā hā/ gzhu 'dzin la swā hā/ gtun shing 'dzin la swā hā/ lag na 'khor lo la swā hā/lag na mdung rtse gsum pa la swā hā/ snying po la swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po la swā hā/drag po ki li ki la la (5)swā hā/ gyis pa ki li ki la 9)la swā hā/ dmar po ki li ki la la swā hā/ stobs po che la swā hā/ ral pa can la swā hā/ gsus 'phyang (snyepo la swā hā/ khro bo chol pa la swā hā/ gshin rje la swā hā/ srin po la swā hā/srin po ya mun la swā hā/ drag po chen po la swā hā/ sprin la swā hā/ ri 'dzin la swā hā/ ri btang bzung 'dzin la swā hā/ rdo rje be con la swā hā/ 'jigs byed chen po la swā hā/ lus 'jigs ⑨byed la swā hā/ sdigs 6)byed la swā hā/rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud la swā hā/ rdo rje'i gtan pa la swā hā/ rdo rje'i lus la swā hā/'gro lding ba la swā hā/ bdud rtsi la swā hā/ dka' thub 'dzin la swā hā/98—80

lcags kyu la swā hā/ don yod pa la swā hā/ gtsug tor rgyal po ①la swā hā/mdog dkar la swā hā/ sngo bsangs mdog la swā hā/ 'phyang po la swā hā/ glang po che la swā hā/ ba lang ②'phel gyi lag la swā hā/ bdud kyi rnam par 'phrul pa la swā hā/ sbrul gyi ska rags can la swā hā/ rdo rje'i phur pa la swā hā/ lag pa gnyis ka ①la swā hā/ ā rdo rje la swā hā/ 'bar ba'i 'od byed la swā hā/ blo gros brtan pa'i rdo rje la swā hā/ myu gu la swā hā/ 'od byed pa la swā hā/ rdo rjes rnam par 'joms pa la swā hā/ rdo rje'i dra ba la swā hā/ rdo rje ④'jigs byed la swā hā/ rdo rje khu tshur la swā hā/ sprin rnam par 'thor ba la swā hā/ char pa rton la swā hā/ rdo rje'i lcags kyu la swā hā/ rdo rje'i snying po la swā hā/ rdo rje'i nye ba'i snying po la swā hā/ mthe bo'i rgyal po la swā hā/ be con rgyal po la swā hā / go cha'i rgyal po la swā hā/ oṃ khyi(snye/ i/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo / /o hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭhazhu/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ ⑦te hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ (8)te hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ yul 'khor srung ⑨la swā hā/ mig mi bzang la swā hā/ 'phags skyes po la swā hā/ lus ngan po la swā hā/ dbang po la swā hā/ me la swā hā/ drang srong chen po thams cad la swā hā/ nyi ma la swā hā/zla ba la swā hā/ gshin rje la swā hā/ khyab 'jug la swā hā/ srin po'i bdag po la swā hā/ klu'i bdag po la swā hā/ rlung la swā hā/ dbang bdag la swā hā/dbang bdag gi chung ma la swā hā/ brgya bibyin la swā hā/ nor lha'i bu la swā hā/rdo rje chen po la swā hā/ tshangs pa chen po la swā hā/ sa la swā hā/ dbyangs can la swā hā/ lha mo dpal la swā hā/ lha mo dka' thub zlog la swā hā/ rig sngags 98—81

chen po stobs po che'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su 'chang zhing yid la byed na srung 67ba dang / skyob pa dang / sbed pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dang /chos dang / dge 'dun dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas brtan blo gros chen po sha (gyir dwa ti'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa la sogs pa'i gebyang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par song ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ mu ne mu ne/ ma hā mu ne(47/ki li ki la ri/ ma hā ki li ki la dhi ke/ ka ṭa ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma hā ka ṭa/ sha ma sha ma sha ma/ ma hā sha ma / shā tri shā tri shā tri/ shān+ta shān+ta shān+ta/ dan+ta dan+ta dan+tasi / dhī ra dhī ra dhī ra/ ma hā me gha/ du ra du ra(7)/ ha ri ha ri ha ri/ kurtsi kurtsi kuṭin/ tshin+dha tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha bhin+dha/ sarba duṣ+ṭan59)/ gu mu gu mu gu mu/ ha ra ha ra ha ra/ pā ṇan/ da ma ni da ma ni/ ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭha ṭha ṭha / ḍā ḍā ḍā ḍā ḍā ḍā/ tsa tsa tsa tsa tsa tsa/ pa tsa pa tsa pa tsa/ da ha da ha da ha / hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ he he he/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sha ba ri sha ba ri sha ba ri/ mā rta gi / tsaṇ+ḍa tsho )li/ hu hu hu/ dzu hu dzu hu dzu hu/ ha tā pra tarbi 37na/ tsi li tsi li tsi li/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ tiṣ+ṭha thi tiṣ+ṭha thi tiṣ+ṭha /2thi/ mā /rteti kra ma tharis/ ma rta gi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ he he he/ gal te mi 'dug na lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / kha dang / mid pa dang / mig dang / snying dang ngag thams cad bcing ngo / /dbrog go/ /dz+wa la dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dus dukhyu dubyu/98—82

ban+dha ban+dha brgyu/ nī la zhi)ni la ( nī lāng ga badz+ra dhā ra/ stobs po che zhes bya ba'i snying po dran par gyis shig /ko ṭi ko ṭi ko ṭi (0ni/ sarba (4)byu tā ni/ badz+ra mā li badz+ra dhā ra/ badz+ra aṣ+ṭa (nyahā sa4)/ tsartu nartu/ martul/ ku ru ku ru/ hu ru hu ru hu ru/ sems can chen po dran par gyis shig /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ he he he/phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa/ durtu durtu hutwa/ mu ru mu ru mu ru/ grot+na grot+na grosna(nya/ badz+ra pā ṇi ha na ha na/ ma ma sarba sha tū (9)'on/ mūrti ni tā ḍa 7ya phaṭa/ ku ru ku ru ku ru/ lag na rdo rje'i las dang 'gal bar ma byed cig /dam tshig las 'gal bar byas na dam tshig dral ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa la yang bslus par 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags kyi gzhi ni 'di rnams yin no/ /tsu tsu tsu/ ha ra ha ra ha ra/ phu ṭu phu ṭu phu ṭu/ ta pa ni ta pa ni ta pa ni/ pa tsa ni pa tsa ni pa tsa ni/ lag na rdo rje'i snying po de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa dran par gyis shig /tsi li tsi li tsi li/phu lu phu lu phu lu/ phu phu phu/ bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag snying po 'di dang 'gal bar bgyis na de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu gsungs pa'i mtshams med pa lnga dang ldan par gyur cig /dar phu/ tsar phu/ nar phu/ rdo rje 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag la gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di rnams grub par gyur cig swā hā/ nyurtardo rje 'dzin gzi brjid chen po la phyag 'tshal lo swā hā/ oṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i 'od zer kun du 'bar ba'i snang bas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams las 'das nas bdud kyi khyim thams cad kun du 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/98—83

kun du rab tu mched cing 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur par kun du snang ngo / /de ltar gyur pa dang / bdud sdig can ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / gzhu dang / mda' la sogs pa dang / mtshon cha rnams lag na thogs te bgegs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa du ma byed do/ /de nas skad cig de nyid la bdud sdig can bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu thams cad dang lhan cig tu bdud kyi rnam par 'phrul pa chen pos bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo / /de nas de ltar gyur pa dang / khro bo chol pa/ mdog dmar ba/ sbrang rtsi ltar mig dmar ser po / mche ba gtsigs pa/ mi bzad 6)pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ lag pa g.yas pa na be con thogs pa/ lag pa g.yon pa na rdo rje thogs pa sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs bgos pa/ shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bye ma snyed 'das shing / de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang gi phyogs su yang kun du snang ngo / /de nas bdud sdig can dang / bgegs bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag brgya khro bo chol pas 'dar bar gyur to/ /bdud sdig can ni myos shing gzir te 'phangs (minas srog la mi lta ba dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes zhags pa'i bcing ba lngas bcings so/ /de ltar gyur pa dang / de'i tshe 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyis spos dang / me tog dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sna tshogs la sogs pas bcom ldan 'das la ci nus kyis mchod nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstod cing bsngags te mngon par dga' bar 98—84

byas nas ①bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su thugs rangs pa (gyimadzad pas sems can thams cad kyi don dang / lha dang / mi rnams la phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir rig sngags mchog gi rgyud chen po'i nang nas don 'dod pa thams cad sbyin pa zhes bya ba stobs dpag tu med pas pha rol gnon pa stobs po che'i stobs chen po'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyi zhi)gzhi 'di dag smras (geso / /gang la la zhig 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston tam/ bsti (bstang du byed dam/ bla mar byed dam/ rim gror byed dam/ri mchod pa byed na dkyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /pha rol gyis byas pa'i gsang sngags thams cad bshig pa dang —/ bcom pa dang / bskyel bar yang 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin gyis rig sngags mchog gi rgyud chen po'i nang nas 'byung ba smras so/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su thugs rangs pa 96)mdzad pas don 'dod pa thams cad sbyin pa zhes bya ba stobs dpag tu med pas pha rol gnon pa stobs po che'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi 6)'di smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha ma (guhā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+wan ya/ dza ṭi lam bo dha ⑩ra/ u tsuṣ+ṭha kro dha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam / klog gam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston tam/ rim gror bgyid dam/ mchod par tunyebagyid na dkyil 'khor thams cad du dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag 98—85

na rdo rjes yang gsol pa/ stobs po che'i snying po 'dzin pa la ni gnod sbyin nam/gnod sbyin gyi bu'am/ srin po'am/ srin po'i bu'am/ grul bum mam0)/grul bum gyi bu'am/ nam mkha' lding ngam/ nam mkha' lding gi bu'am/klu'am / klu'i bu'am/ dri za'am/ dri za'i bu'am/ sha za'am/ sha za'i bu'am / smyo byed dam/ smyo byed kyi bu'am/ mkha' 'gro ma'am/ mkha' 'gro ma'i bu'am/ sgrub pa'am/ sbrul 'dzin bcas la sogs pa dang / brjed dzobyed dam/ lus srul po'am/ ro langs la sogs pa dang / gcod pa'i gdon thams cad dang / brjed da byed la sogs pas mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje legs so legs so/ /stong pa nyid do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid do/ /phyi ma'i mtha' stong pa nyid do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid do/ /chen po stong pa nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid stong pa nyid do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang mdo sde 'di rab tu ston pa de mchod par bgyi ba dang / phyag bgyi ba dang / rim gror bgyi ba dang / bskor bar bgyi ba'i 'os su 'gyur ba lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rje stobs dpag tu med pas pha rol gnon pa stobs po che'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi smras pa/oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ lag na mdung rtse gsum thogs pa drag shul can hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ byo tiṅgā cad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa / stobs po che la swā hā/ oṃ rdo rje khro bo stobs po che ha na da ha snye/ pa tsa ma tha phyi/ bi ki ra57/ bi dh+wan ya/ dza ṭi (shel yaṃ bo da (9)ra u tsuṣ+ṭha kro dha hūm̐ ⑩98—86

phaṭa / oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ sarba duṣ+ṭa na/ stam+bha ya/ stam+bha ya/ du rā tsa rān ①duṣ+ṭa na ni bā (mir ya/ bdag la srungs ( nishig srungs shig swā hā/ oṃ a nan+ta bi dza ya/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ o sgri ka (4)rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ shi ri shi ro(5)/ mā (6)li ni(3)/ si ni si (8)ni/ shi shi ni shi shi ni/ oṃ sarba ād+ma 5)dza/ ma hā te dzo/badz+ra a sha ni badz+ra pā shagabo /a nu pra bi sha sarba (7duṣ+ṭan/ stam+bha ya stam+bha ya hūm̐ phaṭa / oṃ hūm̐ brnya ban+dha hūm̐/ oṃ a nan+ta bi dza ya/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍi yi/ phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra gro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra garta ri/ ka ra ka ra/ tshin+dha tshirnya/hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la dha ka dha ka dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bi pur yo rak+ṣa badz+ra pañtsa ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki la yibadz+ra badz+rer bhūr brta brnya hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ā kur+sha ya/ ā /khyo ya/ ā zhikar+ṣa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la da ra da ra/ dhā ra ya dhā tsor ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la 1)ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/1snye da ra da ra/ dā ra ya dā ra ya/ pa ṭa ya pa zhi ṭa ya/ mo ṭa ya mo ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ta ḍa zu tshota ḍa(sto/ tā ḍa ( ci ya tā ḍa sa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la dz+wa la dz+wa la/pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la/ dī pya dī pya/ dī pa ya dī pa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru/ u tsuṣ+ṭha kro dha shi kha/ ha ra ha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo o badz+ra gro dha ma hā ba la tsaṇ+ḍa ( — )ha na/ da ha pa tsa/ ma tha( snye/ bi ka ri/ bi dh+wan ya/bcom ldan 'das tshur gshegs tshur gshegs/ ha na ha na/ ha ra ha ra/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bi dh+wan tsho 7ya/ bi dh+wan ya/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi dbang pos mchod pa/ thams cad kyi bdag nyid las skyes pa gzi brjid chen po/98wa 87

su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru/ ku ru ku ru/ ghu 6)ru ghu phyin/ kurba kurba/ ma hā kurba / bi kurba/ ku nas (5)ku nartsig/ na ṭi na ṭi/ shi ni shi ni/ khi ni khi ni/kha kha khā hi khā hi(ge/ khu ru khu ru/ tu ṭa tu ṭa/ tus tus/ tras trabasti/tu ru tu ru/ 'byung po'i bdag po/ klu'i bdag po/ lha ma yin gyi grong khyer rnam par 'joms par byed pa khro bo chol pa stobs po che/ dha ma dha ma/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ su ru su ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ da ha da ha rtsu phaṭa / pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ hrī/ rtsu hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ tsu lu tsu lu ru swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la sarba duṣ+ṭan stam+bha ya stam+bha ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya rtsu phaṭa/ o ha ha/ sa ra sa ra/ bi (7)sa ra bi sa ra/ ghā ta ya bhā ta ya / o bi sa ra/ san+t+ra ya rtsu/ o badz+ra gro dha ma hā ba la ha ra ha ra/ kha kha khā (shehi khā 59)gyi/ nā 7sha ya nā tsho sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūm̐/ mā ma mā ma phaṭa/ o badz+ra kro dha ni bdag la srungs shig srungs shig swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba la badz+ra dha (ger/ ka ra ka ra/ bhan+dha bhan+ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+wa la gra sa/ u tsuṣ+ṭha sā 3geg ra hūm̐/ rdo rje'i pho nya mo drug cu 51 rtsa bzhi po de dag kyang bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sbed pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ gang gzungs 'di 'chang ba ni dge bar 'gyur/ dug gnon par 'gyur shi ba sos par byed par 'gyur/dgra rnams kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur/ bu mang bar 'gyur ro/ /sa phyogs kyang gsal bebar 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags thams cad kyang grub par 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad kyang nus par 'gyur ro/ /gdug pas zin pa rnams la skyor chus 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /dug thams cad kyang dug ma yin par byed par 'gyur ro/ /mngal tson gnas pa'i khye'u dang bu mo yang bde bar btsas par 98—88

'gyur ro/ /mdo sde 'di zhag gsum bcangs na rgyas par 'gyur ro6)/ /zhag phyibadun bcangs na zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'byung po'i bdag po dbang bdag rig sngags 'chang bye ba (miphrag du mas bskor ba 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de nas langs te(4)/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /stobs po che'i bstan pa thogs pa med pa/ stobs dpag tu med pas pha rol gnon pa ⑤lag na rdo rje dga' ba/ lha dang / lha ma yin dang / tshangs pa dang —/ dbang pos phyag byas pa/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / ro langs dang / srul po dang / lus srul po 'jigs par byed pa/ smyo byed dang / skrod pa dang / gsod pa dang / skem byed dang / sgo glegs dang /'khrul (6)'khor dang / gtan pa dang / rdo rjes rnam par 'joms pa las thams cad byed pa/ dkyil 'khor gsang ba dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bshad du gsol/ de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyis 'byung po'i bdag po dbang bdag la legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje spar te rdo rje la bzhugs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la rnam par gzigs te/ rdo rje mi bzad pa khro bo chen po bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad la cher snying rje ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'od zer 'bar zhing snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad (7kyi 98—89

dga' ba kun du ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bdud thams cad kyi yul 'joms 91)zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad kyi yul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyi sku zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyi sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / stobs po che zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin tordzun)/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rje sdom bag can du rdo rje spar te/ de nas rdo rje pad+ma la gnas pa'i tshul gyis gnas nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la rnam par bltas te / rdo rje mi bzad sgyu pa'i khro bo chol pa lus sbrul gyi ska rags kyis brgyan pa dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu khro bo chol pas bgegs bye ba brgya (5)stong phrag du ma 'dar te gzir ba bdag nyid kyis mthong ngo / /de dag tshig nas smre zhing srog btang ste sreg pa'i bskal pa snyam du sems shing nyam (6)thag pa'i skad kyis ngus te/ byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje'i gan du song nas bcom ldan 'das yongs su bskyab tu gsol/ byang chub sems dpa' yongs su bskyab tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi khro bo chol pas gzir cing myos te phongs nas srog la mi lta'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po ri skulag na rdo rje ting nge 'dzin de las langs te bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la smras pa/ kye nasama'o khro bo chen po 'di ni rdzu 'phrul che ba'o mthu che ba'o / /de dag gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das de de bzhin te/kye ma'o khro bo chen po 'di ni rdzu 'phrul che ba'o mthu che ba'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 98—90

'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes seng ge'i lta stangs kyis bltas nas 'byung 91)po'i bdag po dbang ldan la khro bo chol pa'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba (snyedang bcas pa smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha/pa tsa/ bi dh+wan ya/ dza ṭi 95)lam bo dha go)ra u tsuṣ+ṭha kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ a 〉(snye/ma ṭ+wāṃ (yeswā hā/ grogs po dag gang la la zhig khro bo stobs po che 'di'i dkyil 'khor du gzhugs na de'i las thams cad grub par 'gyur ro/ /dus ma yin par 'chi bas 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i lus la drag po'i las dang nad thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /de la mi dang bgegs dang /log 'dren gyis glags mi rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /dgra thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /'dir zhugs na gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /khro bo thams cad kyi cho ga yang lhun gyis grub pa nyid du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'dir dbang bskur na bkra mi shis pa thams cad las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /dpal gyis byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas khro bo chen po la lan khris sngar spyad pa byas te/ khro bo chen po'i dkyil 'khor byed pa byas pa 78)gzo ba/ rgyud shes pa/ gso sbyong gi yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ gsum la skyabs su song ba/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ snying rje can du gyur pa/dkyil 'khor mthong ba/ dbang bskur ba/ bla ma rnams kyis lung byin pa/cho ga gang bdud thams cad dang sdang ba'i sems rnam par 'jig par byed pa/rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che zhes bya ba 'di 'chang ba dang / klog pa de bdud dang dgra thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin dang /98—91

srin po dang / yi dgas 0)dang / sha za dang / srul po dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / brjed (mibyed dang / sgrub pa dang / sbrul 'dzin bcas la sogs pa thams cad dang / 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /gsad pa dang /bcing ba thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /gcad pa thams cad tshulas thar bar 'gyur ro/ /rmugs (gebyed dang / rengs byed dang / rmongs byed la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /klu'i 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /bkra mi shis pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dbul po gang la la zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dus gsum du 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ yid la byed dam/ rjes su dran par byed na / dbul pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /lo nyes byung ba'i tshe stobs po che lan bdun bklags (5)na sprin chen po las char 'bab bo/ /gal te char mi 'bab na sprin gyi lha rnams kyi srog skam par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i rgyal po nag po dang / klu'i rgyal po 'khor lo dang / klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis sprin chen po las char 'bebs so/ /gal te mi 'bebs na srog skam par 'gyur ro/ /gong du smas (6nyepa'i cho ga bzhin du phyogs kyi cha'am/ klung gi ngos sam/ rgya mchosare 'gram mam4)/ mtsho 'gram mam(8)/mchod rten gyi gnas su byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la mchod pa chen po byas te/ tsan+dan dkar po dang / ka ra bī ra'i 6)me tog dang / pad+ma dmar po dang / a ti muka ⑩ta ku'i me tog dang / tsam pa ku'i me tog dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dmar po la sogs pa dang / bum pa spos chus 98—92

bkang ba la sogs pas mchod pa byas nas gang mdo sde 'di 'chang ba dang /klog pa de g.yul ngo thams cad du zhugs kyang pha rol gyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro / /sems can thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /bkra mi shis pa thams cad las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs po che rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te g.yul ngor song na pha rol gyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags gro ga la bris te spyi bor btags na g.yul ngor mtshon cha rnams me tog bzhin du ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bdud des bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas stobs po che zhes bgyi ba ci lags zhes 6)gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stobs po che zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /stobs po che zhes bya ba ni chos so/ /stobs po che zhes bya ba ni chos kyi phung po'o/ /stobs po che zhes bya ba ni chos kyi tshul lo/ /stobs po che zhes bya ba ni theg pa chen po'o/ /stobs po che zhes bya ba ni lag na rdo rje'o/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis smras pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje legs so legs so/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /dge bsnyen gyi yan lag gzung (snyebar bgyi'o/ /bde dang thar dang mtho ris dang / /mkhas pa dag dang sems can ni/ /dam pa kun dang phan pa'i phyir/ /stobs po che ni gzung bar bgyi/ /de nas bdud sdig can chos la dga' zhing yid bde ba dang rangs par gzigs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che'i mdo sde 'di ni sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dang /98—93

gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal las thar bar byed pa'o/ /de bskal pa stong phrag nyi shur lha'i rgyal po byed par 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa mtha' yas 0)par gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'jog par byed do/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che'i snying po 'di ni gtsang sbra can nam/ gtsang sbra med pa'am/ smyung ba (gubyas pa'am/ smyung ba hūṃ rim byas pa'am/ 'khrig pa'i chos la sten (4)pa la yang 'grub par byed pa'o/ /de la bar chad du mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas rab 'byor 'khor de nyid na 'dug par gyur pas bcom ldan 'das rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ dam pa ci zhig stsol ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje la dri ba dris shig /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ lag na rdo rje rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che ji ltar gzung sgrubar bgyi/ dam pa ni ci zhig sbyin par byed/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/'bru sbyin par byed do/ /gos sbyin par byed do/ /dngul sbyin par byed do/ /gser sbyin par byed do/ /ba lang (6 sbyin par byed do/ /dam pa gang 'dod pa'i dam pa de sbyin par byed do/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ spyi'i ri7)'bras bu zhes bya ba'am/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin te/ sems can nyon mongs pas bsgribs pa rnams ni 'bras bu'i dus su gnas so/ /'bras bu'i dus kyis yon tan gyi don du gnas so/ /yon tan gyi don gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam la 'jog par byed do/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ lag na rdo rje legs so legs53)/ /gsang ba'i mtshan nyid ldan pa ste/ /stobs po che ni shes rab ldan/ /gsang ba'i mtshan nyid phun sum 98—94

tshogs / /spyi nas dbang bskur yid kyang gzhungs(1)/ /mtshan dang yang dag ldan pa ste/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims shes rab che/ /rdzu 'phrul che zhing stobs kyang che / /dbang cher grags shing bsod nams che/ /yon tan rtse mo stobs po che /mdo sde 'di la dbang bskur phyir/ /sangs rgyas brgyad stong der gshegs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes mdo sde 'di nyid kyis mi 'jigs pa'i lag pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ dge bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /gang gis gsang sngags 'di sa'am/ ri'am/ klung gi ngogs (gyisam/ rgya mtsho'i drung du bcangs na 'jigs pa thams cad kyis 'jigs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' (gulag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /su mdo sde 'di 'chang ngam/ klog pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa de bro nad ma mchis par lo brgyar 'tsho (4)bar 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rjes yang gsol pa/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar bzung rir bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdo sde 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bya bar zung (6)shig /(7chos kyi nyi ma zhes bya bar yang zung (8༄shig /chos kyi zla ba zhes bya bar yang zung (9shig /don thams cad grub pa zhes bya bar yang zung boshig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sprin ces bya bar yang zung 37shig /sdig pa thams cad 'byang skobar byed pa'i gzungs sngags zhes 12bya bar yang zung 'ashig /rig sngags 'chang thams cad 'grub pa'i rgyal po zhes bya bar yang zung boshig /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya bar yang zung 7shig /chos kyi dbyings de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba zhes bya bar yang zung 7shig /rig sngags kyi 98—95

rgyal po stobs po che zhes bya bar yang zung 1)shig /gsang ba ( pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje su mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang geb dang / klog pa dang / yi ger 'drir (4)'jug pa dang / bsti (5)stang du byed pa dang / bla mar byed pa dang / rim gror byed pa dang / mchod pa byed pa des 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang /da ltar byung ba rnams kyi mchod rten sku gdung dang bcas pa rnams la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /shin tu zab pa'i chos bstan pa dang / cho 'phrul gyi yon tan gyi rgyan gyi chos bstan pa gzung (7bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / lag na rdo rje rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang mdo sde 'di 'chang ba de la sdang ba'i sems can rnams chu 'gram gyi shing lta bur ma rung bar rtso)'gyur ro/ /spos dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sna tshogs la sogs pas mchod pa byas na bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de la bar chad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /mdo sde 'di gnas gang yang rung ba na 'chang na lha dang / mir bcas pas mchod pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /rig nasasngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad 'ching ba yid la byed na sangs rgyas brgyad stong dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang drang srong chen po rnams dang /lha dang / klu dang / dri zar bcas pa rnams dgyes dga'o/ /stobs po che'i gzungs sngags 'di la dgyes pa'i dus kyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas 98—96

'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje su mdo sde 'di la gus par mi byed pa de dag sems can dmyal ba chen po brgyad po dag tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje su mdo sde 'di la gus par byed pa dang / rim gror byed pa dang / mchod pa byed pa de bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /yi ge 'dri hu)'am/ tshig mnyan na phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub kyi lam 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ thub pa'i chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa shin tu zab pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sems can rnams kyi nang nas gang log par sems pa ②de myos par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir mdo sde 'di bshad par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa bsal ba dang / zhi bar bya ba dang / rgyas par bya ba dang / dbang bskur ba dang / bkra mi shis pa thams cad las thar bar bya ba dang / dpal gyis byin gyis brlab par ⑧bya ba dang / sdig pa thams cad byang bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub par bya ba'i phyir bshad par bya'o/ /de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa brgya stong dong gi)bar mdzad nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la lan gsum bskor ba mdzad de thal mo sbyar nas legs par rab tu bshad pa legs so legs so zhes mngon par dgyes pa mdzad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas sangs rgyas de dag la slar gsungs pa/ bcom ldan 'das dag legs par rab tu gsungs pa legs so legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stobs po che gsang ba'i chos bstan pa 'di'i mthus 98—97

byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes sdang ba'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyi snying 'dar zhing 'gul (11bar mthong ngo / /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo / /tar+ya thā/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra ma tha (gem tha rin badz+ra/ dz+wa la pra dz+wa 4)la/ su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru/ ka ṭang (5)ka ye / dza ye bi dza ye/ a dzi te(6)/ a pa rā (7)dzi te(8)/ mā 6nyer se n+ya 7sra marda nā ye swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad sdigs shig sdigs shig /chings shig chings shig /rnam par chings shig /ma grub pa rnams grub par gyis shig /grub pa rnams dul bar gyis shig /dul ba rnams chud mi za bar gyis shig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'bab par gyis shig /lha dang klu thams cad tshur shog tshur shog /ngas stobs po che khro bo'i mthus dge bar bya'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa 6nyal btsugs te / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'du byed thams cad kyi mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa nyon cig /'du byed thams cad ni dri za'i grong khyer dang 'dra'o/spya/ /'du byed thams cad ni glog dang / sprin dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed thams cad ni khyim dang dbu ba dang 'dra'o / /'du byed thams cad ni mar me dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed thams cad 98—98

ni chu bur dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed thams cad ni chu shing dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed thams cad ni ri 6)mo'i rnam pa dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed thams cad ni me tog dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed thams cad ni rmi lam dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed 'di dag ni bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyi 'khor lo dang 'dra'o/ /'du byed 'di dag ni bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyi klung dang 'dra'o/ /'khrug par 'gyur bas rgya mtsho dang 'dra'o/ /skar ma dang 'dra'o/ /sems can rnams ni 'du byed 'di dag skye bar mi sems/ mi mthong / mi shes/ mi mjal (gegyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis gzigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mjal ( )lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mkhyen to/ /'du byed thams cad stong pa nyid du mtshan nyid gcig par mkhyen to/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to/ /de bzhin nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to//'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa mtshan nyid 'di nyid mthong zhing / mtshan nyid 'di nyid shes te spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /de bzhin du tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /mtshan nyid 'di nyid shes pa ni byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug ste / 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mdo sde 'di mtshan nyid gang 98wa 99

gis na ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bgyi0ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i las rnams mdo sde 'dis byed par 'gyur te/ mtshan nyid des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bya'o/ /mdo sde 'di yongs su nub pa'i dus kyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yongs su nub par 'gyur te/ mtshan nyid des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bya'o/ /mdo sde 'di 'tsho zhing sdod na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan (gepa yang 'tsho zhing sdod de/ mtshan nyid des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang mdo sde 'di la phyag 'tshal te/ mtshan nyid des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das la rjes su yi rangs (5)nas bka' lung bzhin du bgyi zhing su mdo sde 'di 'chang ba'i gan du mchi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdo sde 'di nyid kyi mthus sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang lha thams cad kyang 'ong ngo / /lha thams cad kyis kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /legs so legs so bdag cag kyang dam pa 465 bar mngon par dga' ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang dam pa 'di nyid stsol bar mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje stobs po che'i gsang ba'i snying po ni sems can thams cad la bde ba thams cad sbyin par byed pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad 98—100
