sngag /'phags pa rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed ces bya ba'i gzungs/6)༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya badz+ra a dzi ta (5)a na la pra mo ha nī nā ma dhā ra tī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rdo rje mi pham (kyepa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed ces bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig lin/ bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa can (5)gyi ri/ gangs ri sul gyi mchog /ri rab kyi smad dang rked ltar gser gyi rdo sna tshogs kyis gang zhing re'ur bres pa 'bar ba/ rin po che'i rdo du ma'i 'od sna tshogs 'ja' lta bu byung ba'i rdo leb yangs pa/ me tog dri zhim po bkram zhing phye ma dang / bdug ⑥pa dri zhim pa mang pos phug gi nang dang nags bsgos pa/ gdugs dang / a ga ru dang / phye ma dang / dril bu dang / bla res mdzes par byas pa'i ri bo mchog la bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das lha rnams dang / lha'i bu 98—134

rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi bu rnams dang / rlung lha rnams dang / rlung lha'i bu rnams dang /6) nam mkha' lding rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / srin po rnams dang / dri za rnams dang / rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams dang /'byung po rnams dang / log 'dren rnams dang / sha za rnams dang / snang ba dang mi snang ba'i ma mo'i tshogs khyab par byed pa rgya chen po dag gis dpag tshad lnga brgyar 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur par 'dus te/ de na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bdun khri lnga stong dang / dge slong khri nyi (kyestong lnga brgya dang thabs cig ②go/ /bcom ldan 'das ni chos ston te/ gnas par bde ba/mnyan na bde ba/ 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ba'i chos ston to/ /de na ④lha rnams dang / lha'i bu rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi bu rnams dang / rlung lha rnams dang / rlung lha'i bu rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / srin po rnams dang / srin po'i bu rnams dang / dri za rnams dang / rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams dang / 'byung po rnams dang / log 'dren rnams dang / sha za rnams dang / snang ba dang / mi snang ba'i ma mo'i tshogs rnams dang / 'byung po'i tshogs rnams dang / 'byung po'i tshogs rnams rnam par rgyu zhing ku co dang / 'jigs pa dang / nyam 'a)thag pa'i sgra 'byin to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas sgra de dag gsan nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye bzhin bzangs dag ci'i phyir ku co dang / 'jigs pa dang / nyam thag pa 98—135

dang / 'khrug pa'i sgra 'byin/ de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni dbang du bgyis te/ gnod pa dang drang bas bkug cing drangs te tho btsams 1)na/ bcom ldan 'das bskyab tu gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad kyi steng gi dkyil 'khor yangs pa ston pa'i mchog gi blo gros dang / blo dang / las dang / las kyi mtha' dang ldan pa/ sa chen po las sa gzhan thob pa rgyal tshab (gyitu nye ste/ chos kyi rgyal srid la nadabang bskur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' (shesems dpa' chen po rjes su dgongs par mdzad pa tsam gyis 'ongs te/ rdo rje'i zom ltar dpung mgo yangs pa / rdo rje ltar mkhregs pa'i cod (5dpan 'od zer 'tsher ba can/ rdo rje'i dpung rgyan dang ldan pa/ lus mkhregs shing sra ba/ lag na rdo rje dang /zhags pa dang / lag cha brtan po 'bar ba thogs pa/ rdo rje phur bu sra bas rab tu 'joms par byed pa/ mthu chen po g.yog bzhi 'bum lnga khri dang ldan pa/'jig rten gyi khams 'di kun du snang bar byed cing rdo rje'i rigs kyi gzhon nu dang / rdo rje'i sde dang / rdo rje'i be con dang / rdo rje'i snying po dang / rdo rje'i tog dang / rdo rje'i snang ba dang / rdo rje sngon po dang / rin po che'i rdo rje dang / gsang ba'i rdo rje dang / 'khor lo rdo rje la sogs pa dang / rdo rje'i dmag ri nodapon chen po rnams dang / dmag skyong rnams dang / sa skyong rnams dang / rdo rje rig pa'i 57rgyal po yang dag pa dang / yang dag pa ma yin pa yang dag par rtogs pa rnams dang / rdo rje'i yum rnams dang / rdo rje rnam par 'dren rnams dang lhan cig tu rdo rje gzhon nu'i gdon rnams dang / rdo rje gnon po rnams dang / rdo rje rmi lam ngan byed rnams yang dag par skul/98—136

rnam hu)par skul zhing 'khor gyi khyams chen por 'dus pa thams cad la kun du snang bar byed/ rnam par snang bar byed/ gsal bar byed/ rnam par gsal bar byed/ rab tu dga' bar byed/ yang dag par skul/ so sor skul zhing bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste/ bla gos phud nas zhabs la cod pan gyis gtugs te/ lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas thal mo sbyar te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su yi rang ba mdzad de/ rdo rje 'chang khyod song la lha rnams dang / lha'i bu rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi bu rnams dang / rlung lha rnams dang / rlung lha'i bu rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang (gu/ nam mkha' lding gi bu rnams dang / 'dus pa chen po'i bar dag sgra 'byin cing nyam thag pa myong ba rnams kyi bsam pa rdzogs par gyis shig /de nas rdo rje 'chang stan las langs te/ lha dang / lha ma yin dang / rlung lha dang / nam mkha' lding dang / 'byung po'i tshogs kyi nang du song nas rjes su ston cing rdo rje mtshon cha'i me sgron zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis ( stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su me lce 'bar ba'i 'od 'phro ba dang / me stag rnam par 'phro ba dang / lce 'bebs pa'i glog rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams rnams gzir to/ /de nas bskal pa chen po (47lngar rmi (5 lam dang / chu dang / gang gā'i 6)klung gi bye ma'i grangs kyi tshad tsam dag gis mdangs dang / gzi brjid dang / tshangs par spyod pa dang / gtsang ma dang / bzod pa dang / tshul khrims dang / brtul zhugs dang / dka' thub dang / rang gi longs spyod thams cad las byung ba'i las grub pa'i rdo rje de byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo 98—137

rje de'i lag tu byin no 1)/ /de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gsung rab kyi chos ston par gyur pa dgra bcom pa rnams kyi chos dang / tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / snying rje byed pa/ rang gi rdo rje dang / rigs 5kyi rig pa dang / dkyil 'khor dang / bklags (mipa'i tshul du gyur pa drag po dang / dbang po dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang /lus ngan dang / rlung lha dang / nam mkha' lding gdul dka' ba rnams 'dul ba ste/ de ltar de las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das khro bo drag po rnams rmongs par byed pa/ sgyu dang ldan pa rnams rmugs par byed pa/ sdang ba rnams skyod ④ pa / rmongs pa rnams 'jig pa/ dam po rnams rtsad nas 'don pa/ rgyas pa rnams spur mar rlog (5 pa/ yon po rnams srong ba/ gcod pa rnams snying rjes byed pa/ 'byung po rnams skrag par byed pa/ srin po rnams dngangs ⑥par byed pa/ rang gi gsang sngags rnams rdzogs par byed pa/ gzhan gyi gsang sngags rnams phur bus 'debs pa/ nub pa rnams ston par byed pa/ gsod par byed pa/ gsod pa/ gnod par byed pa/ phung bar byed pa de der song nas lha rnams dang / lha'i bu rnams dbang du byed de/ de ltar drag po pa drag po grub pa dang / khyab 'jug pa khyab 'jug grub pa dang / lha ma yin pa lha ma yin grub pa dang / de dag spyir skul 57༄zhing dkyil 'khor du 'jug /skyod ⑧par byed/ mthu ston par byed/ rjed par byed/ rnam par skrag par byed do/ /stobs bcus dgongs pa bka' stsal pa'i rdo rje 'chang gis rdo rje mi pham pa 5)me ltar rab tu rmongs byed ces bya ba'i gzungs gsung ba dang / gzungs 'di'i 98—138

stobs dang / bden pa'i byin gyi brlabs 6)kyis 'od kyi 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor chen po las byung ba'i 'od zer rnams kyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag na rdo rje bskul nas/ 'od des de rab tu dga' ste rdo rje las snang ba bkye ba rnams kyis sa gsum gyi ston gyi skar ma dang / zla ba'i 'od zil du brlag par byas nas snang ba gcig pur byed cing rgya mtsho chen po ni skems/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab ni g.yo bar byed/ glog (9gi 'khor lo dang / lce 'bebs pa'i 'brug ni bsgrags / sgra drag po ni phyung / bsgyings pa'i sgra ni bsgrags/ skrag ①par ni byas so/ /de na rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed ces bya ba'i gzungs me lce 'od 'phro chen po khong na 'dug pa/ skra tshogs gser dang rin po che 'dra ba/rdo rje 'chang ba rdo rje'i bu mo zhes bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma des lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ yid pas ches mgyogs pa'i shugs 'od 'phro zhing 'bar ba lta bur drag pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdzu 'phrul chen po la skyabs su song ngo / /de 'ongs pa dang / 'phags pa rdo rje 'chang gis smras pa/skal ba chen po dge ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ④sems dang ldan ma / 'di dag la lag cha dang mthun 95)par bya ba'i stobs byin cig /de nas gzungs kyis smras pa/ 'di dag bka' stsal pa de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes lan gsum tshig tu smras so/ /thor tshugs gsum ma/ sa gsum dang / dus gsum dang / drag po rtse gsum dang / khyab 'jug gi 'khor lo dang / gshin rje'i be con dang / lus ngan gyi dbyug tho dang / dbang po'i rdo rje dang / chu lha'i zhags pa dang / log 'dren rnams kyi bgegs dang / lha ma yin rnams kyi sgyu dang ske/ rlung lha rnams kyi gzi dang / shugs dang grub pa rnams kyi rmongs byed 98—139

dang / ma mo'i tshogs rnams kyi gcod pa dang / klu rnams kyi dam tshig dang /dug dang / khro bo dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / mi 'am ci dang /sha za dang / 'byung po dang / tshangs pa'i srin po dang / grul bum dang /bden bral dang / gnon po dang / ro langs kyi skabs su rgol ba rnams dang /de bzhin du thams cad kyang sbyongs shig /mig gi 'dzums (1)pa tsam gyis yud tsam la thams cad mchod nas lag na rdo rje la snying po 'di phul te smras pa/dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ ta thā ga ta sa mā dhi ( ṅgā ra khrig/ma hā a brta yi byā 4mi/ a hi badz+re/5 ku 6shi li/ ko ṭi pā ba kā ku la shi khi / ka bi la ke shi/ ta ṭi tsi ṭa tsi ṭa mi ṭa ri ni/ garka ṭa /shesu ṭi brtsi 5)badz+re/ma hā bi julko 1 lo le/ pu gu pu lu/ su mu su mu/ sa ra sa ra/ s+pha ṭa s+pha ṭa/su byo te/ dzi ga le tsi ṭi/ bi tsa ṭi/ dz+wa la dzi ga le/ sarba de bag na/ pra ha ra ṇa mā yā/ sid+dha 11rā yi ge/ su ru sna ke/ su /lharu ke/ badz+ra gho ṇisko/ badz+ra 615 / sā ra pra ha ra khes/ raṇ+ḍa 1 tra ya/ di kra la burnye te/ badz+ra dha ra bi shwa sa ni ka /a pra ti ha ta pra marda ni swā hā/ gang gsang sngags 'di rjes su dran nas klog 1shegam/ sgom mam519/ 'dzin pa de thos na ngan 'gro log par ltung bar 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig dang phyag rgya 2 la zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /bsam pa dang rjes su yi rang bas 'gugs nga stopar byed do/ /dug dang / gsang sngags dang / mdud pa dang / rdeg pa dang / 'ching ba'i 'jigs pa la sogs pas rnam par skrag par byed do/ /de 98wa 140

nas lha dang / lha'i bu de dag gis de'i mthus bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang de'i rnam par rol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa rnam pa mang po du ma yang myong nas steng gi gnas gtsang ma dang / 'og min gyi lha dang /'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na gnas pa dag gis 'od dang ldan pa'i me tog dang /bdug pa'i sprin dang / rin po che mang 0)po'i char rgya chen pos mchod nas bstod pa snyan pas bstod de snyan cing zab la rnga sgra lta bu dang / bsil ba dang /bsod nams kyi tshigs su bcad 90pa dag kyang smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag chadang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag yi 9perangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa rdo rje mi pham tshogapa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed ces bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so96ri// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ri ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad 27kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa99na// //98—141

bya ba'i gzungs/6)༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ma hā daṇ+ḍa nā ma dhā (gyir tsā/ bod skad du/'phags pa be con chen po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la/dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig (gyitu bzhugs te/ de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zhi)zin rgyal po'i khab kyi dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i gnas na/ bud shing chen po lta bu'i phyogs na 'dug go/ /der 'di lta ste/ lha'i gdon rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang /klu'i gdon rnams dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang / srin po'i gdon rnams dang / mi 'am ci'i gdon rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gdon rnams dang / dri za'i gdon rnams dang / mi'i gdon rnams dang / rlung lha'i 98—160

gdon rnams dang / yi dgas kyi gdon rnams dang / 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang / sha za'i gdon rnams dang / grul bum gyi gdon rnams dang /gzig rnams dang / bya rog rnams dang / lug pa rnams dang / grog sbur rnams 6)dang / sdig sbrul rnams dang / gzhan yang mi dang / mi ma yin pa'i sems can rnams kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin la shin tu gtses rin so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin bya rgod phung po'i ri ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ngus te mchi ma blags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan dazin la bka' stsal pa/ sgra gcan zin khyod ci'i phyir nga'i mdun na 'dug nas mchi ma glogaca /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan 5zin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag rgyal po'i khab kyi dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i gnas na/ bud shing chen po lta bu'i phyogs na mchis mchis na/der lha'i gdon rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang / klu'i gdon rnams dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang / srin po'i gdon rnams dang /mi 'am ci'i gdon rnams dang / dri za'i gdon rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gdon rnams dang / mi'i gdon rnams dang / rlung lha'i gdon rnams dang ske/ yi dgas kyi gdon rnams dang / 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang / sha za'i gdon rnams dang / grul bum gyi gdon rnams dang / gzig rnams dang /bya rog rnams dang / 'ug pa rnams dang / grog sbur rnams dang / sdig sprul 98—161

dpag tshad bcu khor yug tu be con rnams dang / me tog rnams dang / phyag rgya 51)rnams kyis de bsrung ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /de la mi dang / mi ma yin pa rnams kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /mtshon dang / dug dang / nad dang /rims nad dang / rims drag po dang / rig sngags dang / ro langs dang /khro gdug dang / me dang / chus 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags dang / gsang sngags sbyor ba rnams legs par sbyor ba thams cad kyi ma grub pa rnams kyang grub par byed pa'o/ /grub pa rnams chud mi za bar byed pa'o//pha rol gyi sbyor ba 'ching ba'o/ /pha rol gyis bcings pa las grol bar byed pa'o//nad dang / mya ngan dang / bgegs rnam par 'jig par byed pa'o/ /'thab pa'i rnyog pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa'o/ /gdon thams cad zlog par byed pa'o/ /gdon gang gis rdo gtong ba de'i mgo ardza ma'i dog pa bzhin mgo tshal pa bdun du 'gas dariso/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje yang rdo rje 'bar ba / kun du 'bar ba/ kun du rab tu 'bar ba/ me lce gcig tu gyur pas/de'i mgo ardza ri ka'i dog pa bzhin du tshal pa bdun du 'gas (5)so/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi yang lcags kyi 'khor lo spu gri'i so lta bu'i mtshon gyis phung bar byed do / /gnod sbyin gyi 'jig rten 6de nas shi 'phos nas/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang 'khor du gnas pa mi 'thob bo/ /sgra gcan 57)zin rgyal po dang / mi rgod dang / me dang / chu dang / mtshon dang / 'brog dang / dgon pa dang /ri dang / mya ngam du song ba gang gis be con chen po'i gzungs kyi rig sngags 'di lan cig 8brjod na/ sdig pa thams cad las rab tu thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sgra gcan 9zin be con chen po'i gzungs sngags 'di sangs rgyas bcom ldan 98—164
