rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/6)༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya (midzam+bha la nā ③ma aṣ+ṭa sha ta ka /bod skad du/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya bsti/'phags pa gnod 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gnod sbyin 'brog gnas posle / /gser dag gis ni legs par brgyan/ /rin chen gyis ni rab mdzes shing ske/ /me ni shin tu 'bar 'dra ba/ /lcang lo can du bzhugs nas kyang / /gsang bdag rdo rje 'chang ba yi/ /zhabs gnyis la ni rab 'jus nas/ shin tu mnyam bzhag dris pa ni/ /bcom ldan gnod 'dzin rgyal dbang po/ /gsang sngags tshogs ni kun gyi bdag /rig sngags 'chang rnams kun gyis mchod/ /lha dang lha min phyag byas pa/ /ma rungs 'dul la brtson pa po/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan ldan/ /mgon po sems can kun don mdzad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba 'dzin/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dogs pas/ /snying 98—277

rjes non pa'i yid kyis su/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir/ /bdag gis kyang ni sems bskyed de/ /mi rnams nor ni nyung ba dang / /bsod nams chung zhing dbang chung ba/ /mthong nas sdug bsngal chen po yis/ /rab tu gzir to gsang ba'i bdag /de skad gnod 'dzin gyis smras nas/ /bcom ldan gsang ba gsang ba'i bdag /snying rjes non te smras pa ni/ /legs par nyon cig gsang ba pa/ /mgon po gnod 'dzin dpal dang ldan/ /sems can kun gyi don byed pa/ /dbul ba'i nyon mongs sel ba po/ /nor ro cog gi dbang phyug gi/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad bsod nams ldan/ /dbul ba'i nyes sdig sel byed pa/ /gang gā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed kyi/ /rgyal mchog rnams kyis ①sngon gsungs pa/ /'od zer brgya pa zhes pa yi/ /zhing na sangs rgyas nyi ma'i zhal / /chos ston pa na bdag gis kyang / /de ni rang gi ⑤sngon thos te/ /dbul ba sel cing bsod nams ldan/ /de ni bdag gi shes rab kyis/ /sems can kun don brtson pa po/ / khyod la legs par bstan par bya/ /nikhyod ni mnyam bzhag ④rab tu nyon/ /'phags pa lha dang lha min bla/ /shes rab ldan zhing chos la gus/ /snying brtse'i bdag nyid bzod ldan brtan⑤/ /dbang po zhi ba dbang po thul/ /dge ba sdig 'joms shes nyen can/ /des shing don kun sgrub pa po/ /mi gnod mi slu dpal dang ldan/ /mdzod bdag gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs gcig pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gzigs pa po/ /gter rnams skyong ba gzi brjid can/ /rtag sbyin nor ni 'phel byed pa/ /rin chen 'byung gnas skye bo 'dul/ /chu yi bdag po chu 'bebs pa/ /gnod sbyin chu spyod bdag nyid can/ /gter don nye bar 98—278

ston pa po/ /gser gyi ri bo lhun po ste/ /dbul ba'i gdon las thar byed pa/ /dbang po nye dbang 'gro ba'i mgon/ /chu yi dbang po sprin mdog can/ /'jig rten mig dang 'jig rten bla/ /nyi ma zla ba ther zug pa/ /nor chen rgyal po chen po ste/ /lag na ne'u le rab gnas pa/ /gzhon yo)nu seng ge tog can te / /gnod sbyin chen po rdzu 'phrul che/ /tshig gi bdag po bzhin 'dzum pa/ /gsong por snyan par smra ba po/ /bram ze 'dod pa'i lcags kyu ste/ /che ba don 'grub lagrub pas mchod/ /rig sngags 'chang ba 'khor los sgyural/ /ku be ra dang mi la zhon/ /bum pa'i lto ducan mig yangs pa/ /lha yi dri ldan yid ltar mgyogs / /khyab bdag bde 'byung nor bzang phyisras/ /sems can rnams ni skyong la dga'/ /'dod dgur sgyur gzugs yid kyi lha/ /cod pan can de rigs dga' ba/ /g.yon phyogs cod 0pan lag na dbyug /lag pa brgya pa stobs po che/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug lha yul ba/ /zla ba nya ba'i zhal mdog can / /ded dpon tshogs kyi bdag po ste/ /gnas brtan tshong pa skal rtsibazang ba / /yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang / /dpag bsam ljon shing mi yi bdag /mchog don 'os pa gtso bo ste/ /mchog sbyin mi'u (nyethung khyab 'jug pa/ /skyabs 'os bkra shis sung yo)ba po/ /rin chen phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /lha yi seng ge'i khri la bzhugs/ /byang chub sems dpa' yidapal gyi bdag /rab tu ngar ba nor mi zad/ /seng ge'i rtsal gyi mthu rtsal can/ /ston pa 'jig rten gsum las rgyal/ /gtso bo tshong pa rigs kyi mchog /pad+ma'i lte ba thub med rgyal/ /tshangs par spyod pa rgya mtsho che/ /gnod 'dzin bdag nyid che ba yi/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad ngas ⑩bshad 'di/ /sdig pa thams cad 'joms byed cing / /dbul 98—279

ba'i nyon mongs sel byed pa/ /'byor dang skal bzang skyed pa po/ /glang po rta nor 'phel byed pa/ /gza' 6)dang rgyu skar rmi lam ngan/ /ltas ngan sel bar byed pa ste/ /nags sam gal te grong dang ni/ /dur khrod yang na ri yang rung / /mkhas pa gang na klog pa der/ /g.yul dang dgra ni nyam nga ba/ /sbrul dang me chu chom rkun sogs/ /stag dang dom dang 'jig ②pa che/ /rgya mtsho bgrod dka' mi bzad las/ /mi ni rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /dbang po me dang chu lha dang / /gshin rje srin bdag rlung lha dang / /nor sbyin dpal ldan ku 〈be ra/ /nor bu bzang sras lngas ④sten dang / /rtsed mo can dang 'brog gnas dang / /lha dang gnod sbyin gzhan dag kyang / /g.yel ba med par nyin mtshan du/ /rab tu dga' bzhin srung bar byed/ /gang na ming 'di klog pa der/ /glang chen rta dang ba lang dang / /lo tog rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /'bras bu me tog rnams kyang 'phel/ /mi nad dang ni 'go ba'i nad/ /gnod pa kun las byung ba rnams / /thams cad du ni bde legs 'gyur/ /lhag par byis pa rnams la shis / /de la yi dgas klu rnams dang / /ma mo dang ni gdon drag dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang mi 'am ci/ /srin po rnams kyang 'tshe mi byed/ /nad do cog las rnam par grol/ /de bzhin bde zhing nor dang ldan/ /bu dag dang ni tsha bo dang / /dpal dang gtong ba rnams kyis rgyas/ /rigs mchog rgyal ba 'byung ba dang / /longs spyod chen po'i nang du skye/ /tshe dang dpal dang ldan pa dang / /nad med gdon dang bral bar 'gyur/ /tshe rabs kun du skye ba dran/ /lobs skyen thos pa 'dzin pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan ldan/ / skal ba phyibazang po nyid du 'gyur/ /phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal gnod sbyin rje/ /gsang 98—280

bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal te/ /ma rungs 'dul la brtson pa po/ /lag na rdo rje khyod la 'dud/ /sems can dad la mnyes 6)gshin pa/ /nor bzangs phyisras kyi grags pa 'di/ /dbul ba'i nad ni zhi byed pa/ /rab tu bshad pa legs par gsungs/ /don kun grub pa gsang ba'i sngags/ /bdag gis kyang ni 'dir 'bul te/ /de ni legs par dran tsam gyis/ /mi ni dbul las grol 'gyur zhing / /gzhan gyis ①mi tshugs sung bar 'gyur/ /dgra rnams kyis kyang mi choms shing / /skal ba bzang dang skal dang ldan/ /lo brgya yang ni 'tsho bar 'gyur / /lha yi glang po rin chen dang / /rgyal dang rgyal srid 'os rnams kyang —/ /nges par myur du thob 'gyur te/ /rgyal srid kyang ni the tshom ④med/ /na mo rat+na etra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha drwa ⑥ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta na⑦/ o dz+rī ṭ+wāṃ k+ṣu dz+rī trī 〉du/ dī pya raskyu 6)ga pa ri sha na a ta bā ka ⑩de ⑨ba yak+ṣa sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hrīḥ.aḥ phaṭa swā hā/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa rdzogs so8// //98—281

sngag /'phags pa gnod 'dzin dpal zhes bya ba'i gzungs/6)༄phri /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dzam+bha la shrī nā ma dhā ra tī/ bod skad du/'phags pa gnod 'dzin dpal zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po gnod 'dzin dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na / bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje lcang lo can gyi gnas dam pa na 'khor gnod sbyin du mas bskor te bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po gnod 'dzin dpal la gsang ba pa'i bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ sems can dbul zhing sdug bsngal ba de dag zhi ba'i phyir rang gi srog gi snying po dang / rig (misngags khyod kyis ston cig /ngas nasakyang byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas gnod 'dzin dpal gyis gsol pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das/ /sems can sdug bsngal zhi ba'i phyir/ /rig sngags bdag gis bstan par bgyi/ /sdug bsngal spong zhing bde ba thob/ /tshogs chen gnyis ni rdzogs 'dod pas/ /98—284

rang lus bsrung phyir rig 6)sngags 'di/ /bzlas shing yongs su gzung (57bar bya/ /na ma la.ār+ya dzam+bha la/ ma hā dzam+bha la/ tabya thā/ ra ra ra ra/ ku nu/ ku nu/khu nu/ khu nu/ gu nu gu nu/ sa pa sa ④pa/ ka ra ka ra/ ma hā bi ra ram/ma hā ka ra do/ ma ra ga⑤/ ha ra g.yi/ du ma sarba satā nān (75tsa swā hā/bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po sngags 'di 'don pas skud pa sngon po la lan bdun du sngags kyis btab ⑧ste lan re mdud pa re bor nas dpung pa la bcings ⑨na gnod pa med cing dgos pa 'grub 7par 'gyur lags so/ /gu gul tsan dan tu ruska0/ /ka ta ra dang sbyar ba'i sman/ /de yis mchod pa dbul bar bya'o/ /na ma ༷ār+ya dzam+bha la/ na mo dan+ta tunyeya/ darnyi shwa rā 8ya/ā kur+sha ya/ a ka ra mi ta/ dan ti shwa rā 8ya/ ba ra ma kurdu sani ya/ sarba satwa hi ta dzi ⑩ta/ ma ma dan ta/ na maḥ8pa ri ya 07sha /sa ma ya ā 2 )kar sha swā hā/ rig 0sngags 'di lan bdun tshang bar bzlas te de'i 'og tu gsang khrinaba'i snying po gdon par bgyi'o/ /de yang sngar 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum dang gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la mchod nas de'i 'og tu bdag gi ming nas brjod par bgyid na nor rdzas dang / ci 'dod pa dag 'grub par bgyid cing bde ba stsol bar bgyid do/ /de nas bdag gis gsang sngags yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di 'don cing yi dam du bgyid na de'i dgos pa ci smos pa thams cad sgrub par bgyid lags so/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po gnod 'dzin dpal gyis nyid kyi snying po yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu dpal phyag na rdo rje la phul ba/ na ma 0ār+ya dzam+bha la/ ma hā dzam+bha la/ tar+ya thā/ si mi si mi/ su mu su mu/ ñtsaṇ+ḍa byuṇ+ḍasoste/ tsa ra tsa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ka 'dir ka ra/ 3)kyi ri 98—285

ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ sa da ya da ma/ ma ma ni da ma a nan ta/ rādhe swā hāyo)/ ār+ya dzam+bha la ②swā hā/ dan+ta ②ya swā hā/ ma no ra tha pa ri pū ④ra kā ⑤ya swā hā/ de nas gnod sbyin 6)gnod 'dzin dpal gyi 'khor rnams kyis de'i tshe rang rang gi snying po smras pa/ oṃ dzam+bha la ma ṇi ⑩bha drwa ⑧ya swā hā/ oṃ dzam+bha la pūr+ṇa yo)rta drwa ⑩ya swā hā/ oṃ dzam+bha la da na dā ta bha dā ⑩ya swā hā / oṃ dzam+bha la ma hā da na dā ta ⑩bha dā tsoya swā hā/ oṃ dzam+bha la tsi bi kuṇ+ḍa 0li swā hā / oṃ dzam+bha la ki snyili mā li ni 8swā hā/ oṃ dzam+bha la mu khen+d+ra bha drwa ⑩ya swā hā/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra bha drwa (nyeya swā hā/ de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag pos bka' stsal pa/nor gyi bdag po khyod kyis gang gzungs 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang /'dri ba dang / klog pa de dag thams cad la yid bzhin du bde ba stsal bar gyis shig /de nas gnod 'dzin gyis gsang ba'i bdag po de ltar bgyi'o zhes gsol te/ lan gsum du bskor ba chos bzhin du byas te 'khod par gyur to / /'phags pa gnod 'dzin dpal zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs soyi// //98—286

zhes bya ba'i mdo/(1)༄lda /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bha dra rā tī ②nā ma sru tra/ bod skad du/'phags pa mtshan mo bzang po zhes bya ba'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems ①dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ④ka gnas pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe dge slong zhig rgyal po'i khab kyi chu ta la po ta'i 'gram na 'dug go/ /de nas lha kha dog mchog dang ldan pa zhig nam sros nas dge slong de ga la ba der song ste phyin nas chu ta la po ta'i 'gram thams cad snang bar byas te dge slong de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge slong khyod kyis mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde shes sam/ des 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha bdag gis ni mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde ma 'tshal na/ lha khyod kyis mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde mkhyen tam mi mkhyen/ des 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge slong bdag 98—289

gis kyang mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde mi shes so/ /lha 'o na mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde 'tshal ba de lta bu su mchis/ des 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ①ka gnas pa 'di na bcom ldan 'das bzhugs kyis/ khyod bcom ②ldan 'das kyi thad du song la zhus te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de khyod la ji ltar lung bstan pa de bzhin du zung la brtson par gyis shig ces smras nas lha de de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas dge slong de nang par langs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi ①zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug gol/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas dge slong des bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa mdang dgung rmongs ④nas bdag gi der lha kha dog mchog dang ldan pa zhig bdag ga la ba der mchis te/ chab ta la po ta'i 'gram thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos khyab pas snang bar bgyis ⑤nas bdag la 'di skad ces mchi'o/ /dge slong khyod kyis mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde shes sam/bdag gis de la 'di skad ces bgyis so/ /lha bdag gis ni mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde ma 'tshal na/ lha khyod kyis mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde mkhyen tam mi mkhyen/ de bdag la 'di skad ces mchi'o/ /dge slong bdag gis kyang mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde mi shes so/ /lha 'o na mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde 'tshal ba de lta bu su mchis/ des 'di skad ces mchi'o/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da stika gnas pa 'di na bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song la zhus te bcom ldan 'das kyis de khyed tshul ji ltar lung bstan pa de bzhin du 'di zung la brtson par gyis shig ces smras nas lha de de nyid du mi gda' bar 98—290

gyur to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das de'i slad du bdag 'di yongs su zhu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong khyod kyis lha de shes sam/dge slong des gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag gis lha de ma 'tshal to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i bu de ni sum cu ①ma gsum gyi lha rnams kyi ded ②dpon te tsan+dan zhes bya'o/ /dge slong des gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag kyang mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde thos par 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong khyod de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung ⑧shig dang / ngas khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /dge slong chos gsum dang ldan na dge slong mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /gsum gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ 'das pa la rjes su phrad par mi byed pa dang / ma 'ongs pa la re ba med pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i chos rnams kyis mi phrogs par gnas pa'i chos can te/ chos gsum po de dag dang ldan na dge slong mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas / bde bar gshegs pas de skad ces gsungs nas/ ston pas bugazhan yang 'di skad du gsung ngo ⑤/ /'das pa rjes su phrad mi byed/ /ma 'ongs pa la re ba med/ /'das pa gang yin de 'gags te/ /ma 'ongs de ni ma phyin pa'o/ /gang dag da ltar byung ba'i chos/ /de dang de la rab yibaltas nas/ /rnam par rtogs ⑦pas mi phrogs par/ /de dag mkhas pas khong du chud/ /sang tsam 'chi'am sus (8)shes kyis6)/ /de ring nyid du rtun ⑩de bya/ /'chi bdag sde chen de dang ni/ /bdag tu shes pa ma yin no/ /sems can kun dang srog chags kun / /'byung po kun dang thams cad kyang / /bde ba 'ba' zhig 'grub 98—291

'gyur te/ /thams cad nyon mongs med par shog /thams cad bzang por mthong gyur te/ /gang dag sdig par ma gyur cig① /de ltar gnas shing rab brtson la/ /nyin mtshan snyom las med pas na/ /de phyir mtshan mo bzang po yi//mdo sde thub pas rtag tu gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can thams cad rjes su bsrung ba'i phyir mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sde 'di bshad nas/'gro lding pa'i gsang sngags kyi (snyegazhi 'di dag gsungs so/ /tar+ya thā/ bi ni bi ra ṇi/ pa ①ni pū ra ni/ bud+dha mate④/ ma ni ni/ ṇi ṇi ṇi ṇi/ ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi/pa ra ṭi/ gi ri/ garnya ri/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ ma haṃ gi/ puk+ka ⑤si/ bha ma yini/dra mi dri/ dra mi dri/ sha ba ri/ sa ra laste/ tī na ma dha ma dha tra ra ni/ ma ho la na/ da la ba ni/ da la ba ni/ da la bte⑦/ ma hā da li ni/ tsa li ni/muṣ+ṭi tsakra pā ti/ ma hā tsakra pā ti/ sha ba ri sha ba ri/ ma hā sha ba ri/ bhū tsitho ni/ bhū tsi rang gi ni/ ni mi/ ni mong gi ri/ ni min dhi ri/ bhū dudha ni swā hā/ tar+ya thā/ e ṭu ṭu ṭu ṭu/ na ṭu mi'i/ kiṇi/ ed+ku/ sid da ta ri / tsa la lu/ rna tu6)/ nar lam lu/ gal lu/ ā ba tra no ne/ she ku nir ba rad sa le/ ta ra ke( )/ ta re/ ta rod tu/ nor tu/ ti la la lu/bhū (nyuta ba ti ya'/ ba ta yi ye swā hā/ tar+ya thā/ a ra garjetso/ na ra garje / baṃ su ka /pā yi ye/ ka po ta ka pa yi ye ye ta bo dha ne swā hā/ dge slong rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis sems can thams cad rjes su bsrung ba'i phyir mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo dang / tshig dang /tshigs su bcad pa dang / 'gro lding ba'i gsang sngags gzhi 'chang ngam/'dzin tam/ klog gam/ yid la byed dam/ kun chub par byed dam/98—292

gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston na/ de'i lus la mes mi tshugs par 'gyur/ dug gis ma yin/ mtshon gyis ma yin/ chus ma yin/ rgyal po'i chad pas ma yin/ rkun po'i chad pas ma yin te/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par yang mi 'gyur zhing / nges par mya ngan las 'das par nye bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang du skyes par yang / /mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo bklags ①na/ /skye ba dran dang dgra bcom dang / /dbang phyug tu yang nges par 'gyur/ /lan cig gis ni gnas kun du/ /dus min 'chi dang bar ma dor/ /bdag gis bdag la mi sbyor bar/ /dus min 'chi dang chos ma yin / /sems can thams cad sung ②zhing sel/ /nad dang mya ngan 'jigs skye ①dang ske/ /rmi lam mi shes mya ngan du/ /brjod na dpal du byed par 'gyur/ /gang gis bris te skyes pa dang / /bud med lus la btags na ni/ / skal ba ④ bzang dang gzi brjid dang / /de yi dpal yang skye bar 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis su/ /mi dge cung zad gang byas pa/ /de dag thams cad bzang po'i mdos/ /dus ma yin par 'chi las skyob/ /rgyal po chu dang me dang glog⑤ /chom po nad dang dgra dag dang / /g.yul sprod pa yidang 'thab par yang ske/ /bzang po dran na skyob par byed/ /rig pa bzang po 'di dang ni/ /gsang sngags 'di dag rtag brjod na/ /mi dag mi zhum gnas kun du/ /de bas 'di ni yid kyis brjod/ /'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ⑦ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal nas rig sngags 'di dag brjod par bya ste/ rig sngags 'dis bdag 'byor par gyur cig /tar+ya thā/ ni mi ni 98—293

min dhi re/ ti mi ti ming gi li/ tre+e phyilo ki ni/ a lo ki ni/ tri shu la dha ra ṇi / a ku pi ṇi ②kyi mi kri ti/ ko li ko li/ kud to kud to ku to ki nisi/ ku til / ku pi ti/ bdag dang sems can thams cad lag na rdo rje dang lhan cig tu 'jigs pa thams cad dang / nad thams cad dang / dug thams cad dang / rims thams cad dang / gdon thams cad dang / gdug ⑤pas zin pa thams cad dang / chom ⑥kun thams cad dang / mi dang mi ⑦ma yin pa thams cad dang / 'jigs (nyapa dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba thams cad dang / 'thab pa dang / rnyog pa dang / sdig pa dang / rtsod pa dang /'gyed pa dang / mtshang 'dru lhonyeb thams cad dang / lus dang / ngag dang /yid kyis ngan par spyad pa thams cad dang / thams cad du 'jigs pa thams cad las srungs shig srungs shig /tabya thā/ hi li mi yi tsi li mi li mi li/bi shrī tsa na/ par+ṇa sha ba ri/ tsi li tsi li swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ⑩ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / dri za dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dgas dang / sha zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi (skyerangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa mtshan mo bzang po zhes bya ba'i mdo rdzogs so(nye// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de nyurten shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad skigasar chad 8kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa //98—294

bsdur 'bras re'u migagazungs 'dus/ (6༷2)

bya ba'i gzungs/①༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dharma sā ga ra nā ma dhā phyir tsāni/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 0dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das bā rā chaṇa sī na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na dge slong lnga brgya tham pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig ⑥ku bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la nyan pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dge slong dag ngas ni chos zab mo mthong bar dka' ba/ rtogs par dka' ba / cha phra ba/brtags pa mkhas shing shes pas rig par bya ba rtogs so/ /ngas ni skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye ⑦bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba 98—297

dang / skye bo phal po che'i don dang / lha dang mi rnams la phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor to/ /ngas thogs pa med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir nges pa kho nar bsgrub par bya'o/ /dge slong dag chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gzungs zhes zhi)bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dran pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ blo gros kyi blo dang ldan pa/ rtogs pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ brtan pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ shes rab kyi blo dang ldan pa/ gsung gi mchog dang ldan pa/ spobs pa mchog dang ldan pa/ mkhyen cing gzigs pa dag gis bstan cing bshad pa yod de/ gang dag de shes pa dang / gang dag de 'dzin pa de dag gis ni myur ba kho nar chos lnga thob par 'gyur ro/ /lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ thos pa 'dzin pa'i dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / brjed ngas (mipa med pa'i dran pa dang ldan zhing chos bzung ba rnams chud za bar mi 'gyur ba'i blo gros dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / rnon po thob pa'i rtogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / yi ge dang / don dang tshig la 'jug pa'i spobs pa thogs pa med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / sems can rnams kyi rgyu'i lam mngon par shes nas sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa la mkhas par 'gyur ba ste/ chos lnga po 'di dag ni sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bzhag go/ /da ①ltar nga yang 'jog go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo chos thams cad kyi sdom gyi gzhi bsdu ba khyod la bstan par bya ste/ des na khyod kyis ma thos pa'i chos rnams thos par 'gyur ro/ /thos pa'i chos rnams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /98—298

bzung ①pa'i chos rnams ni nyams su len par 'gyur ro/ /nyams su blangs pa'i chos rnams ni gzhan dag la khong du chud par byed do/ /tshig gi rab tu dbye ba lnga ni 'di lta ste/ 'du byed kyi tshig gi rab tu dbye ba dang / de bzhin du ma thos pa'i chos kyi tshig gi rab tu dbye ba dang / bla na med pa'i tshig gi rab tu dbye ba dang / sa nas sa brtags pa'i yi ge'i tshig gi rab tu dbye ba dang /nges pa'i tshig dang brda 〈sna tshogs kyi tshig gi rab tu dbye ba'o/ /de la 'di dag ni gzi byin brtan par byed pa'i tshig rig sngags dang ldan pa ste/ gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / grul bum dang /yi dgas dang / sha za 'dzam bu'i gling du lhags pa thams cad kyis gang zag de la zas kyi sna grangs rnams dang sman rnams sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig chos las byung ba gzhan dag la mi gnod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za rnams kyis mnos pa bstan pa yongs su 'dzin pa ni 'di dag yin te kun dga' bo gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag nyon cig /khyod phyis 'gyod ta re/ stod ya the da na①/kurma ke ta ma nu:sti/ ra ti ru ta gran dra ma/ thu ma na/ ne+e la ta/ a saṃ ku la s+thā/ bu mi a nusma ri/ i shaṃ ga ma i sha'i/ kle na a nu ga te/ yā dumu la gum te/ pa bhe ma gurba ya ba/ a su bā kya su bi 6)lo ga ⑦de la ma tha shrī ba ba rī ⑧ pañtsa 16) /pra sa te/ a ba be la/ a gra 0be la/ ni shi khu u tse dzu me/u dze dzu me/ kun dga' bo 'di dag ni gnod sbyin gyi dbab pa grub pa dang /gnod sbyin gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung mthong ba (nyal bsnyen bkur yang byed byed/ rim gro 98—299

yang byed byed pa rnams 'ching ba ste/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis gnod sbyin dbab pa grub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ①rnams zung ②shig /kun dga' bo gang la la gsang sngags kyi tshig skyon med pa'i tshig 'di dag 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / kun chub par byed pa de la ni rgyal po chen po bzhi sems bzhin du gnas so/ /kun dga' bo gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag gzung ③bas ni dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang bral ④bar mi 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo shar gyi lus 'phags kyi gling na ni gnod sbyin srid pa snang byed ces bya ba gnas so/ /kun dga' bo nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi gling na ni gnod sbyin cher spyod ces bya ba gnas so/ /kun dga' bo byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling na ni gnod sbyin (5༄rnam grags zhes bya ba gnas so/ /kun dga' bo 'dzam bu'i gling na ni gnod sbyin grags thob ces bya ba gnas te/ kun dga' bo gnod sbyin de dag gis kyang rjes su dran par yi'agyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gnod sbyin gzhan gzi brjid za ba gang yin pa de dag kyang dad pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /dad pa thob par gyur nas kyang dad pa mi phyed par thob par bya ba'i phyir 'gro bar byed do/ /kun dga' bo de la 'di dag ni shes bzhin gyi tshig drang srong gis bstan pa dag 77yin te/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa drang srong gi mchog gi tshig gi mchog srog chags 'byung po thams cad la rnam par mi 'tshe ba'i tshig rnams zung (7shig dang ngas bshad do/ /kun dga' bo de la nga'i phyi na 'brang ba'i gnod sbyin gang yin pa de dag gis kyang bar chad byed mi nus so/ /stad ya the dan/ dan dha ra ma hā ha kyi ra/ ha ra ma ba ra na/ rud dra tra/ ku ma ti dri tra/ in+d+ra mas ke/ a ba te/ sa ha yirā/ sa dhu ma ti/98—300

i la la ba ma ti/ a ba ti/ ta ra ba ra/ yi biṣ+ṭa stis da biṣ+ṭa/ a ba tiṭi(mi/pa ri brta/ i sha chabarta/ sa da brta/ kra ma kra ma ti ran/ a si pa tsa ma la bi na ha thi/ bra ④ka su re/ dhu dhu/ uk+ka mutha/ uk+ka ⑤ba ti/ bi sa ra gra ma ti/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i gling bzhi pa yichen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gnod sbyin dang / 'byung po dang / grul bum dang / yi dgas dang —/ srul po dang / klu dang / dri za dang / sha za gnas pa gang yang rung ba de dag gis khyim gyi nang na gnas pa dang / lam du zhugs pa rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i ⑦tshig 'di dag thos nas dga' bar 'gyur ro//kun doga' bo khyod kyis gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag zung ⑧shig /phyis 'gyod ta re/ de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /gnod sbyin grub pa 'di dag ni/ /gling bzhi dag na gtso zhes bya/ /gsang sngags 'di dag su 'chang ba/ /de yi dran pa 'phel bar 'gyurab/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa yi/ /gnod sbyin de dag lhags nas ni/ /chos rgyal rnams kyis bstan pa dag /nyams par gyur pa de la ston/ /dpag tshad brgya phrag mang por yang / /mthar gyis su ni song nas kyang / /zab (9)cing don dang ldan pa yi/ /tshig 'di dag ni mnyan par bya/ /'di dag chos kun rtsa ba ste/ /de dag mkhas rnams nyan par gyis/ /drag po dag gis thos na yang ske/ /phyi ⑩nas mchog tu dga' ba ste/ /gang la bde dang sdug bsngal med/ /de la de ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /sa 'di chags pa med pa ste/ /sangs rgyas sa ni bsam mi khyab/ /chags pa med par bstan pa yi/ /bsam yas sa de thob gyur nas/ /nyi ma sprin las byung ba ltar/ /de ni sa steng de bzhin snang / /98—301

'di la skye mched phung po rnams/ /bden dang byang chub yan lag dbang / /dge ba'i chos ni zab mo rnams/ /sangs rgyas gsungs pa ci yang yod/ /de yi thos pa'i tshogs rnams gang / / nams kyang chud ②zar mi 'gyur te/ /ma thos chos rnams de dag thos/ /nyes dang nyes min rnams la mkhas/ /rtogs par khong du chud pa'i mchog /mig bzangs ②rnams kyang dag par 'gyur/ /'chang ba dang ni ston byed pa/ /de ni rtag tu sangs rgyas bsngags/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni chos rnams la/ /the tshom mi mnga' bden pa gang / /bden des bdag la lung mnos pa/ /ci yod thams cad gnas gyur cig /sangs rgyas rnams ni 'byung rnams la/ /byams pas gnas pa'i bden pa des/ /rang gi sems 50dang gzhan sems la/ /ston pa rab tu gnas gyur cig /gling bzhi'i gnas kyi gnod sbyin dag /ma dad pa dang dad par bstan/ /gang la rtogs pa mi gnang ba/ /de la de kun don ston 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin skar gdong gang yin dang / /glang chen sna dang khyad par stobs/ /drag po dga' byed gsod byed dang / /zla ba mgo med lug gsod pa/ /dpa' sde dang ni lag dpa' dang / /srin po dang ni sa 'dzin pa/ /ljang khu kha dang rna bzang khyidang / /ral gri'i spu can bong bu rnams/ /thams cad grub par byed par shog /gsang sngags 'di dag su 'dzin la/ /gnod sbyin srin po de dag ni/ /spro bar gyur nas 'dzud par byed/ /rtag tu de ni spobs pa dang / /tshig rnams dang ni lung bstan dang / /nges pa'i tshig dang chos kun dang / /yi ge rnams la mkhas par 'gyur / /lung mnos pa yang chud mi za/ /rtogs pa mtha' yas 'phel bar 'gyur / /rtag tu don dang yi ge la/ /de yi shes pa 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sum 98—302

gyur na/ /sems can rnams ni 'khor bar 'gro 'gyur la/ /las dang nyon mongs med na 'khor ba las kyang ldog /bden pa 'di yis bdag gi bsam pa grub gyur cig /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bzhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtul zhugs grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can gyi sman pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di lta ste/ na mo rat+na 6)tra yā ya/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he tun te ṭ+wāṃ ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e baṃ bā dī ②ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ swā hā/ las rnams kun gyi cho ga la/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag brjod/ /bsam rgyud rang gi lag mthil la/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan gyis brgyan/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus laspras/ /me yi khams la bzhugs par bsgom/ /da (snyeni lha dag rjes su dran/ /da ni sbyor ba'i las bshad de/ /rim pa bzhin du so sor bstan/ /rims kyis btab nas na ba dang / /klad 6)pa na dang mig nad dang / /khong nad la sogs nad rnams la/ /tshigs bcad 'di dang snying po 'di/ /mang por bzlas shing langs nas ni/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis/ / dbyung ba'i ⑨thabs su byab par bya'o/ /nad rnams thams cad sos par 'gyur/ /98—317

nyin gcig nyin gnyis nyin gsum dang / /nyin bzhi rtag pa'i rims rnams la/ /bu mo gzhon nus bkal ba yi/ /skud pa dkar po sum 0)sgril la/ /bzlas brjod nyi shu brgyad bzlas nas/ /mgul du btags na bde bar 'tsho/ /nad la phan pa'i sman rnams la/ /gzungs ri sngags 'di dag bzlas shing btang / /snying nad rtsib logs 8)na ba dang / /khong na nad rnams ci yod la/ /chu la sngags 'di mang bzlas nas/ /blud na phan zhing bde bar 'gyur/ /nad la phan pa'i sman rnams la/ /bzlas shing btang na 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /g.yan ④pa dang ni 'brum 5)bu dang / /phol mig dang ni rma red la/ /grog tshang sa la snying po 'di/ /mang du bzlas shing btab na 'tsho/ /gzhang 'brum gzhang nad za khu dang / /pho mtshan spangs shing na ba la/ /skyer pa'i khaṇ+ḍa'i ril bu (6)'am/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ril bu 7)la/ /nyi shu bzlas shing bskus na phan/ /nad kyi rnam pa gang na yang / /na tshabs che chung tshod brtags nas/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i bzlas brjod la/ /mang nyung nad dang sbyar nas kyang / /lus la byab 8)cing bzlas na phan/ /'khru bag nad kyis btab pa la/ /sman nam ril bu 5)kha zas la/ /bdun nam nyi shu bzlas nas kyang / /khong du btang na phan par 'gyur/ /de yi bzlas brjod snga ma ste/ /'di dag rab tu bzlas par bya/ /na mo rat+na mutra yā ya/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he kun te ṭ+wāṃ ta thā ga to h+ya ba data / te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e baṃ yonya'i dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥyiswā hā/ de dag bzlas na nad rnams 'tsho/ /de ni nad rnams 'tsho ba'o/ /de nas yang ni bka' stsal pa//nas dang gro dang sran ma dang / /'bras dang sran chung mon sran dang / /shing tog rgun tso'abrum a ru ra/ /de dag kun la za ba yi/ /srin bu sbur bu phye ma 98—318

leb / /byi'u dang byi ba ne tso dang / /lo tog za ba kha bcing na/ /zhing gi khyon dang sbyar nas kyang / /bye ma sa dang thal ba la/ /bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa brgyad bzlas/ /zhing dang shing tog gtor byas na/ /de dag kun kyang kha bcings ①'gyur/ /ha cang char pa ches pa na/ /bcom ldan 'das la phul ba yi / /me tog sman ②ma re re la/ /bzlas brjod nyi shu rtsa gcig bya/ /gtsang zhing bde ba'i gnas dag tu/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus dag tu/ /bum pa gang ba'i steng dag tu/ /kham phor zhugatsang ma'i nang du yang / /me tog gtsang ma bzlas pa de/ /bsregs na char pa 'chad par 'gyur/ /ser ba drag po 'ong ba na/ /se ba nya mig lcug ma la/ /bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa brgyad bzlas / /ser ba gang nas yong ④ngos su/ /klad ⑤la bskor zhing byabs na 'chad / /yang na thal chen yungs kur (6)la/ /bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa brgyad bya / /thum po byas te lcug ma la/ /btags te btsugs na ser ba chad(pe/ /'byung po sha za yi dgas dang / /brjed byed gdon gyis zin pa la/ /dkyil 'khor 'dom gang gru bzhi la/ /bum pa gtsang ma lnga bzhag ste/ /gu gul dud pas bdugs nas kyang / /yungs kur (8)ga pur tsan+dan dang / /gla rtsi la sogs sman sbyar te/ /bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa brgyad bzlas/ /gos dang zas ni dkar po sbyar/ /dkyil 'khor de yi nang du gzhug /bum pa'i chu yis bkru bar bya/ /sangs rgyas sku bsil byas pa'i chus/ /bkrus shing blud na rab tu phan / /nad dang gnod pa kun las thar/ /'byung po brjed byed sha za yis/ /glags kyang rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /byis pa gdon gyis 'jigs pa la/ / gi wang (9)la ni sngags yibazlas nas/ /snying po stobs chen 'di bris gdags/ /oṃ 98—319

badz+ra gro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+wan ya dza ṭi lo bho dha ra utsuṣ+ṭha ①yo dha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gtsang sbra byas te mgul par gdags/ /de bzhin yungs kur ②dag la yang / /bzlas brjod byas te btums ①la gdags/ /mkha' 'gro'i gdon gyis zin pa na/ /yungs kur ④dang ni gu gul la/ /sngags gnyis lan ni bdun bdun bzlas/ /dud pas bdugs na 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /de la the tshom mi za'o/ /byis pa gdon dang nad las thar/ /bud med bu ni thogs gyur na / /chu la bzlas brjod lnga bdun byas/ /blud na legs par btsas par 'gyur / /bud med mo sham (5)bu med la/ /sangs rgyas sku bsil byas pa'i chu/ /de la bzlas brjod nyi shu bya/ /khrus byas lus ni gtsang ma la/ /chu de blud na bu tsha 'phan56)/ /rigs rgyud dag ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /lam du zhugs te 'gro ba na / /skud pa dang ni gos kyi grwar/ /bzlas brjod bdun bzlas mdud pa bdun / /mdud cing bzlas te song ba na/ /bde bar 'gro zhing don yang 'grub / /dgra dang nye zho med par 'gro/ /yid ni gzhungs par 'dod pa na/ /shu dag tshon gang tsam pa dang / /mar srang sum brgya drug cu (3)la/ /bzlas brjod byas te bsres nas kyang / /bum pa gcig (3)tu blugs la dkrugs5)/ /nyi ma re re lo gcig tu/ /shu dag dag ni dum re dang / /mar srang dag ni re re la / /bzlas brjod re re bya zhing bza'/ /des ni yid gzhungs blo ldan 'gyur/ /de bzhin pa ni ser skya ma'i/ /mar dang 'o ma dag la yang / /bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa brgyad du/ /bzlas te 'o thug dkrug cing bza'/ /yid gzhungs pa yi mchog tu 'gyur/ /mi dang 'grogs shing mdza' 'dod na/ /gang dag yid dang 'thad pa la/ /me tog dang ni rtswa skrushing la/ /'bras bu 'am ni 'jim pa 98—320

dag /lag pa g.yas pa'i chang par bcug6) /bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa gcig gdab②la/ /gang gi lag tu byin pa na/ /de dang ①rtag tu mdza' bar 'gyur/ /rta la sogs pa'i phyugs rnams kun/ /'chi bar nye bar gnas pa na/ /chu dang yungs kur ④bcas pa la/ /bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa brgyad bya/ /de la gtor na sos par 'gyur/ /yang na yungs kur ⑤brgya brgyad la/ /bzlas pa'i thum po mgul du gdags/ /des ni nad med bde bar 'gyur/ /mi rnams 'chi bas 'jigs gyur na/ /yungs kur chu)la ni bzlas brjod bya/ /thum po byas te sgo ⑦la gdags / /bzlas brjod brgya stong 'bum yang bzlas/ /mi nad dang ni phyugs nad kun/ /ming yang med cing bde bar 'gyur/ /de dag kun gyi bzlas brjod ni/ /'di dag kun du rgya cher gsungs/ /na mo rat+na (mitra yā ya/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he turnye ṭ+wāṃ ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ /te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e baṃ bā dri ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ6)swā hā/ rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na ni/ /bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /gnod pa cis kyang tshugs mi 'gyur/ /dam chos yongs su bzung bar 'gyur/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag ni/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /cho ga 'di dag thams cad ni/ /gang la dad pas yid ches na / /'grub par the tshom med par 'gyur/ /bzlas brjod 'bum ni byas gyur na / /dgos pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /ston pa shākya'i thugs rje 'di/ /dge slong ner ⑩ban rak+ṣi tas/ /tho gar yul nas rnyed pa ste/ /'gro ba kun gyi dpal du shar/ /'phags pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga'i gzungs rdzogs sto4ste// //98—321

khug /'phags pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/yonye༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya pra tī t+ya sa muṅgā ②da nā ma ma hā yā na smu tra / bod skad du/ 'phags pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das sum cu (brtsa gsum lha'i gnas na ar mo nig lta bu'i rdo leb la/ tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la sogs pa nyan thos chen po rnams dang / 'phags pa byams pa dang /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yon tan rin po che dpag tu med pas brgyan pa rnams dang / mi mjed 6)kyi bdag po tshangs pa chen po dang / sred med kyi bu dang / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha rnams dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa la sogs pa dang thabs cig ⑤tu 98—324

bzhugs ①te/ de nas byang chub se mas dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga ri rab kyi rtse mo la btsugs ②te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das lha 'di dag ni mchod rten bgyid par 'tshal ba sha stag ste/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir mchis na/ ci nas tshangs pa'i ⑧bsod nams 'phel ba dang / lha dang bcas pa/ bdud dang bcas pa/tshangs pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu las dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dag bsod nams shin tu mang du 'phel bar 'gyur ba de lta de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la chos bstan du gsol zhes zhus pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pa bka' stsal pa/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he turnye ṭ+wāṃ ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e bam̐ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ/ chos gang rgyus 'byung de dag gis/ /rgyu dang de 'gog gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal te/ /dge sbyong chen pos de skad gsungs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'di lta ste/rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi sku yin te/ sus rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba mthong ba des de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ngo / /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa can gang la la zhig gis mi gnas pa'i sa phyogs su mchod rten ni skyu ru ra'i 'bru tsam/ srog shing ni khab tsam/ gdugs ni bsku (shela'i me tog tsam 98—325

zhig byas la/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i chos kyi dbyings kyi tshigs su bcad pa nang du bcug na des tshangs pa'i bsod nams skyed par 'gyur te/'di nas shi 'phos shing 'chi ba'i dus byas nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ nyan thos de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi 1)rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo :rdogs ༄ste(mi// //bsdur mchan/324 51rimatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ (5)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉mud pā/ 95)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bcu/ tsho45〈〈g.yung 〉〉ming med/ 〈〈li 〉〉mi 'jed/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gcig325 47〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gzhugs/ rin〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gtsugs/ (0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉pa ri/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ba gu/326 (1)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉yid/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉spyo/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉so/98wa 326
