brgya la tunyenam zhig mir skyes par gyur na yang der de dbul por 'gyur zhing dmus long du 'gyur ro zhes des thos so/ /de nas lha'i bu des sgra de thos nas 'jigs skrag dngangs (9te spu zing zhes byed par gyur nas/ de rings pa rings par lha'i dbang po brgya byin ga la ba der song ste phyin nas de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te/ brtabs par smra zhing de kyi hud kyi hud ces smre sngags 'don bzhin du lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha'i dbang po gsan du gsol/ lha'i dbang po bdag deng lha'i bu mo'i tshogs kyis bskor te/ lha'i longs spyod kyi (gyidaga' bas rtse zhing bde ba myong ba las sgra zhig thos pa/ lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa zhag bdun na 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur te 'dzam bu'i gling du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der yang 'gro ba bdun myong nas sems can dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /brgya la nam zhig mir skyes par gyur na yang der de dbul por 'gyur zhing dmus long du 'gyur ro zhes thos na/lha'i dbang po de la bdag gis ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa'i tshig de thos nas shin tu ngo mtshar du 'dzin par 'gyur (gte/ lha'i bu 'dis 'gro ba bdun po gang dag myong bar 'gyur snyam du sems shing cang mi smra bar 'dug pa dang / 'gro ba bdun ni phag gi skye gnas dang / khyi dang / wa dang / spre'u dang / sprul gdug pa dang /bya rgod dang / bya khwa ste/ 'gro ba bdun po de dag shin tu mi gtsang ba za ba myong bar 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'gro ba bdun po de dag mthong nas 'di snyam du e ma lha'i bu 'di sdug bsngal mi bzad pa chen po myong bar 'gyur na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag 98—385

par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma gtogs par de'i skyabs dang / rten dang /dpung gnyen du 'gyur ba su yod snyam du bsams so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin nub mo de'i srod la spos dang / me tog dang / bdug pa sna tshogs dang ske/ gos dang / rgyan sna tshogs la sogs pa khyer nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te lan bdun bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa'i 'gro ba bdun po dag bcom ldan 'das la zhib tu gsol to/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'gro ba bdun po de dag gsol ma thag tu / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor nas 'od zer sna tshogs byung ste/des phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gnas thams cad kun nas snang bar byas te slar log nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 0)zhal gyi sgor zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lha'i dbang po gtsug gtor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs de bzhin gshegs pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba/ ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba/ sgrib pa dang / sdug bsngal bar skye ba thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad yongs su sbyong ba/ bde 'gro'i lam du 'jog pa yod de/ lha'i dbang po de lta bas na gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba thos ma thag tu sgrib par 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin sna tshogs shin tu mang po 'jig par byed do/ /skye ba yongs su dag pa'i rgyud thob par 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs thams cad du yang tshe 98—386

rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i 'jig rten nas lha'i 'jig rten du 'gro bar 'gyur te6)/lha'i gnas sum cu ②rtsa gnyis kyi bar du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po de brjod ma thag tu tshe zad pa yang tshe phyir nur bar 'gyur ba'i las thob par 'gyur ro / /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las yongs su dag pa bsags pa bde bar reg pa la gnas pas gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang de la gzigs so/ /de dag de la rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsrung ba dang /bskyab pa dang / sba ba mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang de la sems par 'gyur/ brjod pa tsam gyis sems can dmyal ba dang ske/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang yi dgas kyi yul thams cad skems par 'gyur/ rnam par 'jig par 'gyur rnam par 'thor bar 'gyur/ rnam par sel bar 'gyur/ stongs par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar de la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang / lha'i gnas thams cad dang /byang chub sems dpa'i gnas thams cad kyi sgo rnams phye bar 'gyur ro/ /de gang 'dod pa der 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs de bka' stsal du gsol/ ①sems can thams cad kyi srog la sman gdags pa bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis gsol ba btab pa mkhyen nas gzungs 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba tre+e lo kya pra ti bi gnyi ④ya bud+dhā ya te na maḥtabya thā/ oṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya/ a sa ma sa man+ta/ a ba bhā (gyes s+pha 98—387

sarba ta thā ga ༅tā skṛ ②da ya a dhiṣ+ṭha srin a dhiṣ+ṭha ①te/ mu dre mu dre/ ma hā mu dre ma hā mu drwa man+t+ra ⑤pa deḥdhiswā hā/ lha'i dbang po gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba/ sdig pa dang / las dang ske/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba/ bde 'gro'i lam thams cad du 'gro ba dang / ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par 'jig par byed pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung 'bum phrag bye ba phrag brgyad cu gartsa brgyad kyi bye ma snyed dag gis gsungs pa/ byin gyis brlabs ⑧pa rjes su yi rang bar mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgyas btab pa ste6nye / sems can thams cad bde 'gror 'gro bar bya ba dang / ngan 'gror lhung ba rnams bzlog pa dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten la sogs pa 0sdug bsngal gyi gnas thams cad du sdug bsngal zhing nyam nga bar gyur pa rnams dang / sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung ba'i sems can rnams rnam par grol bar bya ba'i phyir gsungs pa'o/ /de bzhin du sems can tshe thung zhing skal ba chung ba/ smad ⑩pa dang / bsam pa nyams pa dang / sems can lam las nyams pa rnams kyi don du gzungs 'di 'dzam bu'i gling du gzhag go/ /lha'i dbang po khyod kyis gzungs 'di zung la lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa la sgrogs 6)shig /bsgrags nas kyang gdon pa dang /kha ton du bya ba dang / bsam pa dang / bsgom pa dang / dran par bya ba dang ske/ mchod pa dang / gzung ba dang / kun chub par bya ba la de sbyor bar gyis shig dang / de ltar lha'i gnas thams cad na 'khod pa'i lha'i bu rnams dang ske/ 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i sems can rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang /98—389

bde ba'i phyir gzungs kyi phyag rgya dang / gsang 6)sngags 'di dag khyod la gtad ②do / /de'i phyir lha'i dbang po khyod kyis gzung bar bya'o/ /lha'i dbang po gzungs 'di thos ma thag tu bskal pa brgya (5)stong du bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /skye bar skye ba rnam pa sna tshogs sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas kyi yul dang / lha ma yin gyi ris dang / 'di lta ste gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / srul po dang / lus srul po dang / brjed byed dang /(4) khyi dang / rus (5)sbal dang / sbrul dang / gcan gzan (7)khro bo dang / bya dang / sbrang bu dang / sbrang ma dang / sdig sbrul dang / grog spur la sogs pa'i srog (7)chags kyi rigs su phyis mi skye bar shes par bya'o/ /gzhan du na de bzhin gshegs pa dang phrad (8)pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rigs su skye ba ni ma gtogs so/ /de rigs chen po 'di lta ste/bram ze'i rigs shing sā (9)la chen po lta bu'am/ rgyal rigs shing sā bil chen po lta bu'am/ tshong dpon gyi rigs shing sā /skyel chen po lta bur skye'o zhes nga smra'o/ /lha'i dbang po de ltar na gzungs 'di'i mthus byang chub kyi snying po la mthar (nyethug gi bar du skye ba yongs su dag pa chen po 'thob ste/ lha'i dbang po gzungs ⑫'di ni de ltar mthu che ste/ lha'i dbang po gzungs 'di ni de ltar mthu che ba/phan yon che ba/ mthu stobs che ba/ dge zhing shis yipa yin te/ lha'i dbang po sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba 'di bzhag go/ /'di lta ste/dper na nor bu rin po che nyi ma'i snying po shin tu dri ma med pa nam mkha' ltar 98wa 390

yongs su dag pa 'od gsal ba ni 'od zer gyi snang bas 'bar zhing 'dug go/ /lha'i dbang po de bzhin du sems can de yang gos pa med par shes par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ dper na 'dzam bu 6)chu bo'i gser ni dri ma med pa shin ②tu yongs su dag pa shin tu mnyen ②pa shin tu sdug pa'o/ /lha'i dbang po de bzhin du sems can de yang shin tu yongs su dag par rig par bya ste/ tshe rabs gzhan du yang de bzhin du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po gang na gzungs 'di rab tu ston pa dang / bye brag tu na ④yi ger 'drir (nya'ajug pa dang / 'dzin pa dang —/ klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / kha ton du byed pa dang / mchod pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / nyan pa dang / 'dzin par 'gyur ba der 'gro ba thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur/ sems can dmyal ba thams cad rgyun chad par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po gzungs 'di yi ger bris te rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor gzhag par bya/ ri mthon po'am/ khang pa mthon po'am/mchod rten gyi srog shing gi steng du gzhag par bya'o/ /lha'i dbang po dge slong ngam / dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ de las gzhan pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor gzhag ⑥pa mthong ngam/ de dang de nye bar gnas par gyur na/ tha na de'i grib mas phog gam/ de'i rdul rlung gis btab pas rdzog na yang lha'i dbang po sems can de la sdig pa thams cad dang / ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas dang / lha ma yin gyi ris thams cad du mi skye bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po sems can de ni de bzhin gshegs pa 98—391

thams cad kyis lung bstan cing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par rig par bya'o/ /lha'i dbang po mchod pa dang /rim gro byed cing me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / me tog phreng ①dang ske/ byug pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang /spos dang / rgyan rnams kyis brgyan par byed pa dang / lam gyi bzhi mdor mchod rten byas te/ gzungs 'di bzhag pa la thal mo sbyor ba'am phyag 'tshal ba'am / bskor (snyeb byed pa lta ci smos te/ lha'i dbang po sems can de ni sems can chen por rig par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras su rig par bya'ol/ /chos kyi gnas su rig par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten du rig par bya'o/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje nub mo nam langs dunas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste/ bcom ldan 'das la lha'i me tog dang /gos dang / rgyan la sogs pas mchod pa dang / bste stang ④byas nas/ des bcom ldan 'das la lan bdun bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs 'di ni mthu che zhing phan yon che ba lags te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par sems can de'i slad bzhin du 'brang zhing kun du bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa'i slad du gnas par bgyi'o/ /sems can dmyal ba thams cad las de bzlog par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni byas pa gzo bar bgyid cing / byas pa mi gzo bar mi bgyid do/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs 'di'i cho ga zhib 98—392

mo dang / bgyi ba'i cho ga'i tshul rgyas par bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nyon cig dang gzungs 'di'i bya ba'i tshul bshad par bya'o/ /sems can tshe thung ba'i don gyi phyir rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mos tshes bcwa 6)lnga zla ba nya ba la khrus byas te lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas na/ des sems can tshe zad pa de'i tshe phyir nur nas nad thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa ngan 'gro thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba'i srog chags bya'i rna lam du gzungs 'di'i sgra bsgrag ②par bya ste/ des ni de'i ngan 'gro'i tha ma yin par rig par bya'o/ /gang zhig nad chen pos btab ste sman pa rnams kyis ③bye brag phye ba de yang nad de las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i ngan 'gror skye ba thams cad kyang rgyun chad par 'gyur ro/ /shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nyid de'i mngal gyi gnas kyi tha ma yin par rig par bya'o/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der pad+ma'i snying po kho na las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs thams cad du yang tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /sems can sdig pa byed pa gang dag shi ba'i dus byas pa de skyidag gi don du gzungs yungs kur ⑤dag la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su brjod de de dag gi ⑥rus gong rnams kyi steng du gtor na de dag dmyal ba'am/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas sam / gshin rje'i 'jig rten nam/ yi dgas sam/ de las gzhan ngan 'gro rnams su skyes par gyur kyang rung ste/ de dag gzungs 'di'i mthus ngan 'gro de 98—393

dag las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag las thar nas kyang lhar skye bar 'gyur ro//su zhig 'di nyin gcig bzhin du lan nyi shu rtsa re re yongs su brjod pa de 'jig rten mang po'i mchod pa'i 'os su 'gyur ro/ /tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /bde ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu spro ba dang ldan pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa sna tshogs su 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /der yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang phrad par 'gyur(1༄/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang dbugs 'byin par 'gyur / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du yang 'jig rten la snang bar byed par 'gyur ro//lha'i dbang po thabs 'dis ni 'gro ba thams cad kyang sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag gi 'gro ba thams cad kyang yongs su dag cing tshe ring bar yang 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po song la lha'i bu blo gros shin tu brtan pa la gzungs 'di rjes su ston la sgrogs shig /lha'i dbang po des (min zhag bdun na lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa'i 'gro ba thams cad yongs su dag cing tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs che bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis de bzhin gshegs pa las rjes su bstan pa 'di blangs te/ de'i gnas su phyin nas lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa la gzungs 'di byin no/ /de nas lha'i bu des nyi ma bdun pa'i bar du nyin drug mtshan drug tu gzungs 'di la brtson par byas pa na de'i bsam pa thams cad phun sum tshogs pa (kyi'adi lta ste/ ngan 'gro las ni yongs su thar/ bde 'gro'i 98—394

khukhuzu/ la yang gnas byedro :rdong bar yang sdomazang nas/ phag la 95 sangs rgyas/ 65 la 95 chos / a la la gzungs 'di lta bu 'jig rten du 6)byung ste/ des bdag 'jigs pa chen po las yongs su thar bar gyur to zhes ched du brjod pa ched du brjod do/ /'phags pa ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs sophyi// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi dun mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ④ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la ①phab pa// //bsdur mchan/284 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos tshog /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir zlog pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo'o//6)༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sarba ta thā ga to: ṣa si tā ta pa tā (minā ma a pa rā dzi ri ritā pra traṃ gi ra lam hā bit+yā 5rā rnyi56/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can (7)zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub ma 8)phyir zlog pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo'o6)//dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis tsothos pa dus gcig (nyan/bcom ldan 'das lha'i yul sum cu 12rtsa gsum gyi gnas chos bzangs tunyelha'i 'dun khas na/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang thabs cig 7tu bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs nas/gtsug tor la rnam par gzigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 98wa 398

gshegs pa'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das nor bu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das las kyi gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhon nu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das glang po'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo /bcom ldan 'das gti mug gi gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das chags pa'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa rgya mtsho 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i dhi'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sridagra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sā (snyela'i dbang po'i rgyal po me tog shin tu rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 98—400

sangs rgyas pad+ma mchog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas log par dad sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser thub la phyag 'tshal 6)lo bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen zla ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun du bzang ①po la phyag 'tshal lo /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa dang ut+pa la'i dri'i tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/98—401

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba gdugs dkar po can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub ma 6)phyir zlog ②pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di rab tu brjod par bya'o/ /'thab pa dang 'thab mo dang rtsod pa dang 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu 'joms par byed pa/ 'byung po dang gdon thams cad zlog par byed pa/ pha rol gyi rig sngags thams cad gcod ③par byed pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba las yongs su skyob pa/ sems can bcings pa thams cad thar bar byed pa/ sdang ba dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gdon thams cad rnam par rlag (4)par byed pa/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu (nyertsa bzhi po rnams rnam par 'joms par byed pa/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad rab tu sgrub par byed pa/ dgra thams cad zlog par byed pa/ gza' chen po brgyad rnam par rlag ⑥par byed pa/sdang ba dang drag po dang rmi lam ngan pa rnams rnam par 'joms par byed pa/dug dang mtshon dang me dang chu las skyob par byed pa/ ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa thams cad las sgrol ba/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba brgyad kyi bar du yongs su skyob par byed pa ste/ gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che/ /stobs chen gzi brjid chen mo ste/ /gtum po ri chen mo dkar mo che/ /gsal ba chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ba chen mo phreng ba che/ /gos dkar mo ni chen mo ste/ /'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ /rdo rje phreng ba rnam bsgyings ma/ /pad+ma'i snang ba rdo rje'i mtshan/ /gzhan gyis (8)mi thub phreng ba can/ /rdo rje khar bsnams 'joms pa mo/ /zhi ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod pa/ /gzugs zhi dkar mo chen mo ste/ /'bar ba dang ni gos dkar mo/ /'phags ma sgrol ma stobs 98—402

chen mo/ /'chi ①med rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /rdo rje gzhon nu rigs 'dzin ma/ /lag na rdo rje'i rdo rje dang / /rig sngags gser gyi phreng ba can/ / le brgan ②rtsi dang rin chen modu/ /rnam par snang mdzad rigs kyi 'od/ /de bzhin gshegs rigs gtsug tor ma/ /rnam par bsgyings ma'i phreng ba dang / /rdo rje gser 'od lta bu'i spyan/ /rdo rje sgros dang dkar mo dang / /pad+ma'i spyan dpal sangs rgyas spyan/ /de bzhin rdo rje zla ④ba'i 'od/ /de bzhin rdo rje 'dzin ma (snyedang —/ /rdo rje phreng ba sgyu 'phrul che'i/ /lha mo dang ni gser 'od can/ /spyan mdzes ma dang dkar mo dang / /pad+ma yi ni spyan can dang / /rnam dul zhi ba'i sems dang ni/ /zla 'od bdag gi yon tan shes/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs de dag dang ske/ ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang sems can thams cad la bsrung yib mdzad du gsol/ oṃ ṛ ⑦ta ga ṇa pra shāsta dusarba ta thā ga to: 6)ga si tā ta pa tre 0rtsu rdu hrīḥyis(3/ dzam+bha nyunyani hūm̐ phroṃ hrīḥ868—/ stam+bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥtso46)/ mo ha na ka tunye'i hūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥ()(( kye/pa ra bit+yā 0sa ma bha k+ṣa ṇa 6)ka rī tsū phroṃ hrīḥsorte4du ste/ sarba duṣ+ṭa stam+bha na ka rī tsū hūm̐ hrīḥbyasatso / sarba ba ra bibyā cad na ka rī ju hūm̐ hrīḥ( me46nya/ sarba duṣ+ṭa ( )dzā stam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ phroṃ hrīḥ66)/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa gra hā tsā bi dh+wan sgron ka rī hūm̐ phroṃ hrīḥ4du / tsa tu rā shī tī (34 gra ha (stes ha sru tsā 69bi dh+wan na ka rī tsū phroṃ hrīḥsne'u / aṣ+ṭa dzi sha tī ()shā nak+ṣa tā 〉spra sā da na ka rī tsū rdu hrīḥ44)/ aṣ+ṭa nu)rna ma 0hā gra hā ṇakhri dh+wan na ka rī hūm̐ phroṃ hrīḥ)(me/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba sarta ()byu/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba gdugs dkar mo can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mo phyag stong mnga' ba 98wa 403

chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ spyan bye ba brgya phrag stong mnga' ba chen mo / mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags 0)can/ rdo rje lto ba yangs pa chen mo can/sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ swa stir+bha ②bskyo ma ma sa pa ri bā ra su sarba sa (gyis: swā hā/ rgyal po yis 'jigs pa dang chom rkun ④gyis 'jigs pa dang / me yis 'jigs pa dang / chu yis 'jigs pa dang / dug gis 'jigs pa dang / mtshon gyis 'jigs pa dang / dgra yis 'jigs pa dang / pha rol gyi 'khrul 'khor gyis 'jigs pa dang / mu ge yis 'jigs pa dang / dgra bo yis 'jigs pa dang / thog gis 'jigs pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba yis 'jigs pa dang / sa g.yo bas 'jigs pa dang / skar mda' ltung ba'i (5)'jigs pa dang / rgyal po'i chad pas 'jigs pa dang / gcan gzan (6)gtum pos 'jigs pa dang / klu yis 'jigs pa dang / glog (7)gis 'jigs pa dang / bye ma tsha mo'i ⑧'jigs pa dang / nam mkha' lding gis 'jigs pa dang / yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa dang / 'go ba'i nad dang / 'khrug pa thams cad kyis 'jigs pa dang /gdon gyis 'jigs pa 6stedang / lha'i gdon dang / klu'i gdon dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon dang / srin po'i gdon dang / dri za'i gdon dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdon dang / rlung lha'i gdon dang /mi 'am ci'i gdon dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gdon dang / mi'i gdon dang /mi ma yin pa'i gdon dang / 'byung po'i gdon dang / yi dgas kyi gdon dang —/ sha za'i gdon dang / grul kyibum gyi gdon dang / srul po'i gdon dang / lus srul po'i gdon dang / skem byed kyi gdon dang / smyo byed kyi 98—404

gdon dang / grib gnon gyi gdon dang / brjed 6)byed kyi gdon dang /gnon po'i gdon dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang / lus chags ma'i gdon dang / nam gru'i gdon dang / tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon dang / re lde 'don pa'i gdon dang / bya'i gdon dang / ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon dang ske/ kun du 'phreng ②bar byed pa'i gdon dang / 'phyang ba'i gdon dang /mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang / lus mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang / ka ṭang ka ṭa'i tshogs can gyi gdon dang / gdon thams cad dang / mdangs 'phrog pa dang ske/ mngal za ba dang / khrag 'thung ba chadang / zhag za ba dang / sha za ba dang / tshil za ba dang / rkang za ba dang / btsas pa za ba dang / srog 'phrog pa dang / gtor ma za ba dang / phreng ba za ba dang / dri za ba dang /me tog za ba dang / bdug pa za ba dang / 'bras bu za ba dang / lo tog za ba dang / bsreg bya za ba dang / rnag 'thung ba dang / bshang ba za ba dang /gcin 'thung ba dang / mchil ma za ba dang / snabs za ba dang / ngar snabs za ba dang / skyugs pa za ba dang / rnam bu za ba dang / mi gtsang ba za ba dang / stor ༷khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba dang / nor 'phrog pa dang /sems 'phrog pa rnams dang / de dag thams cad dang gdon thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po//kun du rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po//mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /tshangs pas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /brgya byin gyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad ⑤98wa 405

do / /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /sred med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /phyugs bdag chen po dang drag pos byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /nag po chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad ①do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad (kyedo/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /ri khrod pas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad (kyedo/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /g.yung pos byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad 54)do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /skar mda' gdong gis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /rdo rje gzhon nu mas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /gshin rje gshed kyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /gshin rje'i pho nyas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad (5)do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /klu ma rungs pas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /me'i las kyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /log 'dren gyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /gzhon nus byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po//rgyal po chen po bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /sring mo bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /nam mkha' lding yang dag pas byas pa'i rig sngags 98—406

ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /rgyal bar byed pa dang sbrang rtsir byed pa dang grub par byed pa dang don kun sgrub pas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /byung 6)gi ri ti dang /dga' byed dbang phyug dang smin drug gi bu dang zla ba dang nyi ma dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do / /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /gang dang gang du byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /gang gis byed du bcug pa des byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /dge sbyong mgo reg (gegis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab po/ /pho nya dang pho nya mo dang bran pho chadang bran mos byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /drang srong gi mchog thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /mi phan par 'dod pa thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /oṃ 98—407

mā ru tī ye phaṭa/ ma hā mā ru tī ye phaṭa/ sau kyai ①phaṭa/ e sā rgya'i ye phaṭa/pok+ka cha'i ye phaṭa/ a tharba tī ye phaṭa/ sha pa rī ④ye phaṭa/ kṛ sna sha ⑤pa rī ye phaṭa/ ya ma dru (6)hrī (7)ye phaṭa/ ni sa di (8)bā tsa re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ tri san dh+yā rtse ⑨bh+yaḥphaṭa / dha ra tī ye phaṭa/ a dhi musti gas yir ma hā sma shā na ni bā yisi nī 8ye phaṭa / i ti yo:bh+yaḥsarba bha ye bh+yaḥsarba do ṣe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ oṃ ṣ+ṭṛ brta ④brnya sarba duṣ+ṭa na borak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba sarwa sh+tsa swā hā/ gang su dag bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / sems can thams cad la sdang ba sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdig pa sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / 'khrug pa 'khrug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / mi mdza' ba mi mdza' ba'i sems dang ldan pa de rnams las bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / sems can thams cad la bsrung ba mdzad du gsol / lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shigatso /gang su dag gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang / mdangs 'phrog pa rnams dang /mngal za ba rnams dang / khrag 'thung ba rnams dang / zhag za ba rnams dang /sha za ba rnams dang / tshil za ba rnams dang / rkang za ba rnams dang /btsas pa za ba yinams dang / srog 'phrog pa rnams dang / gtor ma za ba rnams dang / phreng ba za ba rnams dang / dri za ba rnams dang / me tog za ba rnams dang / bdug pa za ba rnams dang / 'bras bu za ba rnams dang / lo tog za ba rnams dang / bsreg bya za ba rnams dang / nor 'phrog pa rnams dang ske/ sems 'phrog pa rnams dang / rnag za ba rnams dang / bshang ba za ba rnams dang / gcin 'thung ba rnams dang / mchil ma 'thung 8ba rnams 98—410

dang ske/ snabs za ba rnams dang / ngar snabs za ba rnams dang / skyugs pa za ba rnams dang / rnam bu za ba rnams dang / mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang /stor lakhung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba rnams dang / sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams ②dang / lha'i gdon rnams dang / klu'i gdon rnams dang /gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang / srin po'i gdon rnams dang / dri za'i gdon rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdon rnams dang / mi'am ci'i gdon rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gdon rnams dang / mi'i gdon rnams dang / mi ma yin pa'i gdon rnams dang /rlung lha'i gdon rnams dang / yi dgas ①kyi gdon rnams dang / sha za'i gdon rnams dang / 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang / grul bum gyi gdon ( swārnams dang / srul po'i gdon rnams dang / lus srul po'i gdon rnams dang /skem byed kyi gdon rnams dang / smyo byed kyi gdon rnams dang / grib (5)gnon gyi gdon rnams dang / brjed yibyed kyi gdon rnams dang / gnon po'i gdon rnams dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon rnams dang / nam gru'i gdon rnams dang / kun du bre ⑦ba'i gdon rnams dang / tsher ma 'don pa'i (8)gdon rnams dang / bya'i gdon rnams dang / ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon rnams dang / bum pa lta bu'i gdon rnams dang / 'phyang 6)ba'i gdon rnams dang / lus mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon rnams dang / ka ṭang ka ṭa'i tshogs can gyi gdon rnams dang gdon thams cad ⑩bsal du gsol/ rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang / nyin gnyis pa rnams dang / nyin gsum pa rnams 98—411

dang / nyin bzhi pa rnams dang / nyin bdun pa rnams dang / zla ba phyed pa rnams dang / zla ba gcig pa rnams dang / nyin mo pa 6)rnams dang / nyi ma phyed pa rnams dang / yud tsam pa rnams dang / rtag pa'i rims rnams dang /rims ldang dub pa rnams dang / 'byung po'i rims rnams ②dang / yi dgas ③kyi rims rnams dang / sha za'i rims rnams dang / mi'i rims rnams dang /mi ma yin pa'i rims rnams dang / rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rims rnams dang /rlung las gyur pa rnams dang / mkhris ④pa las gyur pa rnams dang / bad kun las gyur pa rnams dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa rnams dang / rims thams cad dang / klad (5)pa na ba bdag dang sems can thams cad la bsal du gsol / bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi gzhogs phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mig nad dang / sna nad dang / kha nad dang / mgul nad dang / snying nad dang / lkog ma'i (0lha gor na ba dang / rna ba na ba dang /so na ba dang / brang na ba dang / snying na ba dang / gnad ⑦na ba dang /rtsib (gyilogs na ba dang / rgyab na ba dang / lto dzi)na ba dang / rked pa na ba dang / mdoms na ba dang / gzhang na ba dang / skye gnas na ba dang /rab tu skye gnas na ba dang / brla na ba dang / byin pa na ba dang / lag pa na ba dang / rkang pa na ba dang / yan lag na ba dang / nying lag na ba bsal du gsol/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad la 'byung po dang / yi dgas dang / ro langs dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / rims dang / shu ba dang ske/ mig ser dang / g.ya' ba dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / mdze dang /phol mig dang / bas bldags dang / mchin nad dang / mtshan bar rdol ba 98—412

dang ske/ g.yan pa dang / gzhang 'brum dang / me dbal dang / lhog pa dang /skem pa dang / dbugs ①mi bde ba dang / skrag pa dang / lud pa dang /brgyal ba dang / dbyig dug ②dang / dug sbyar ma dang / dug dang / byad dang —/ me rdeng / ②chu dang / mi ngas dang 'thab mo dang / 'khon ( kyidang gnod pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / sbrang bus (5)bu ka yidang /tre+e lā ṭa ka ⑦dang / sdig pa dang / sbrul dang / sre mo dang / seng ge dang /stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / gnag dang / chu srin dang / spyang ki (8ridang ske/ chom po dang / de dag la sogs pa srog 'phrog par byed pa gzhan thams cad kyang bsal du gsol/ gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mo'i rig sngags kyi mthus dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi nang tshun chad dam / dpag tshad lnga brgya'i nang tshun chad du rig sngags bcing bar bgyi'o/ /gzi brjid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /rig sngags thams cad bcing bar bgyi'o/ / gzhan gyi rig sngags bcing bar bgyi'o/ /mtshams gcad po)par bgyi'o/ /sa bcing bar bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu bcing bar bgyi'o/ /nam mkha' bcing bar bgyi'o / /gzhan gyi sde rab tu rengs par bgyi'o/ /tar+ya thā/ o a na le a na le / a tsa le a tsa le/ kha kha me kha kha me/ bi ṣa de bi ṣa de/ bī re bī ra⑩/be+e ⑩ra be+e tsor/ sau me sau me/ shādhe shārnye/ rādhe brnye/ badz+ra dha ra brnya bad+dha ni badz+ra pā ṇi 'phaṭa/ oṃ t+t+waṃ sbyo phaṭa phaṭa 8swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi brnya bad+dha badz+ra bla'i se na sarba duṣ+ṭa birgyu tsotha nā ya kā na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ phroṃ brnya phaṭa/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba sa/ 0byu swā hā/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba gdugs dkar po 8can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub ma 98—413

phyir zlog pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo 'di gro ga'am/ ras sam/ shing shun la bris te/ lus sam/ mgul du thogs pa byas nas bcang tu)bar bya/ bklag par (gubya ste/ de dag la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dug gis mi tshugs/mtshon gyis mi tshugs/ rims kyis mi tshugs/ nad kyis mi tshugs/ tshad pas mi tshugs/ me dang chus mi tshugs/ bsgyur ba'i las thams cad kyis mi tshugs/dbyig dug gis mi tshugs/ dug sbyar mas mi tshugs/ byad kyis ①mi tshugs/dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /gdon thams cad dang /bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyi yid du 'ong zhing dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /bskal ri pa bye ba stong phrag brgyad cu (57rtsa bzhir skye ba dang skye bar tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i rigs bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgyad cu nyam bzhi'i rig sngags kyi lhas kyang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par mnyam par bzhag nas de la rtag par srung (7 ba dang skyob 58pa dang / sbed par byed do/ /rdo rje pho nya mo mngag gzhug brgyad cu smyo rtsa bzhis kyang rtag par yongs su skyong bar byed de de rnams kyi yid du 'ong ba dang dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /nam du yang gnod sbyin nyid dang / srin po nyid dang / 'byung po nyid dang / yi dgas nyid dang /sha za nyid dang / srul po nyid dang / lus yisal po nyid dang / mi dbul por mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug 37tor nas byung ba gdugs dkar po can zhes bya ba/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir zlog pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo 'di 'chang na/ tshangs par mi spyod pa yang / tshangs par spyod par 'gyur 98—414

rol/ /thub par ma byas pa yang thub par ①byas par 'gyur ro/ /mi gtsang ba yang gtsang bar byas par 'gyur ro/ /bsnyen gnas byas pa can ma yin pa yang bsnyen gnas byas pa can du 'gyur ro/ /gang dag mtshams med pa lnga byas pa de yang sdig pa ma lus par 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa yang ma lus par zad par 'gyur ro/ /bud med gang la las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir zlog pa chen mo'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo 'di 'chang na bu 'dod pa des kyang bu rnyed ②de/ tshe dang bsod nams dang stobs dang /rab tu ldan no/ /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye ste/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / nga rgyal dang ske/ rgyags pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig gis mi ngas dang / ba lang gi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / yams kyi nad dang /gnod pa dang / 'go ba'i nad dang / 'khrug pa thams cad dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba la bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi pham pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug (mitor nas byung ba gdugs dkar po can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir zlog pa ①chen mo 'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te rim gro cher mchod pa chen po byas nas grong khyer thams cad kyi sgo'am gtsug lag khang ngam/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ljongs sam/ grong rdal lam/ dur khrod dam/ ri'am/ dgon pa'i gnas su gzugs so/ /gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir zlog pa chen mo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di rim gro cher byas te/ btsugs pa tsam gyis g.yul zhi bar byas par 'gyur 98—415

ro / /yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa dang / 'go ba'i nad dang / 'khrug pa thams cad dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs rnams rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang / klu'i rgyal po dung skyong dang / klu'i rgyal po nag po chen po dang / klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo dang / de dag dang gzhan yang klu'i rgyal po thams cad kyis kyang dus dus su char 'bebs so /dus dus su glog 'byin to/ /dus dus su 'brug sgrogs so/ /nad dang gnod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ hūṃ ā+oṃ brnya brnya sarba duṣ+ṭa na rak+ṣa ma ma sa pa 6)ri bā khur su sarba saX 6)byu swā hā/ oṃ ཿ ā+oṃ brnya brnya sarba duṣ+ṭa dun rak+ṣa (5)rak+ṣa ma ma sa pa ri bā ra su sarba (5nyesarwa (74 badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tosmi ṣa a (deb lo ki te mūrta ni te 5༄dzo rā ⑩shi/ oṃ dz+wa (nyel dz+wa til/khā da khā da/ dha ka dha ka /dha ra dha ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ tshin+da tshin+da'/bhin+da bhin+da hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ma ma sa pa ri bā ra su sarba sarwa 8rtso swā hā/oṃ sarba ta thā ga to: ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ju rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ma ma sa pa ri bā ra su sarba sa spyo: hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ a na le/ a na le/ a tsa le/a tsa le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bī re bī re/ be+e ra bai ra/ sau me sau me sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha tson a dhiṣ+ṭha 7te sarba ta thā ga tosmi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sarba duṣ+ṭa tsit+ta na ཿ phaṭa swā hā/ sangs rgyas kyi rnal 'byor gyis shig pa thams cad la lan gsum bzlas par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / lha dang / mi dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / dri zar ⑩bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi 7 rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon 98—416

tshog /'phags ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/6)༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ta thā ga to: ṣa si tā ta pa tra (ges pa rā ①dzi ta nā ma dhā ④ra tsā/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma (5)de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po (6)can gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ⑦ba'i gzungs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo(8)/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo / /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten na dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten na yang dag par song ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la phyag 98—421

'tshal lo/ /lha'i drang srong dmod pa 'dor 0)ba dang phan 'dogs nus pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan drag po dka' thub zlog pa'i bdag po dang lhan cig pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan sred med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan nag po chen po grong khyer sum brtsegs (gyi'ajig par byed pa dur khrod na gnas par mos pa ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /glang po'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ②sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i ④'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sā (snyela'i dbang po'i rgyal po me tog kun du rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub 98—422

pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun du bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan rgyas pa ut+pa la'i bsung 6)gi tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba phyir zlog pa chen mo 'dis 'byung po'i gdon thams cad tshar gcod pa/ gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad gcod pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba las zlog pa/ sems can bcings pa thams cad grol ba/ snang ba dang /rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa thams cad zlog pa/ gdon brgyad khri bzhi stong 'jig par (gebyed pa/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dga' bar byed pa/ gza' chen po brgyad 'jig par byed pa/ dgra thams cad zlog pa/ ma rungs pa dang ske/ sdang ba dang / rmi lam ngan pa thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ dug dang mtshon dang / me dang chu las sgrol ba ste/ gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che / /gtum pa chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ba chen mo gzi brjid che/ /dkar mo chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba gos dkar mo/ /'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ /rgyal ba'i rdo rje phreng zhes grags/ /pad+ma'i mngon mtshan rdo rje'i mtshan/ /gzhan gyis mi thub phreng ba can/ /rdo rje mkhar 98—423

rnams 'joms pa mo/ /zhi ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod pa/ /gzugs zhi gzi brjid chen mo can/ /'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mo/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan dang / /rdo rje gzhon nu rigs 'dzin ma/ /lag na rdo rje rigs gser phreng / /le brgan rtsi dang rin chen ma/ /snang mdzad rdo rje gtsug tor grags/ /rnam par bsgyings 6)ma'i rdo rje dang / /gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ba rdo rje sgros dang dkar mo dang / /pad+ma'i spyan dang zla 'od dang / /phyag rgya'i tshogs de dag thams cad kyis bdag la bsrung du gsol bsrung ba mdzad du gsol/oṃ ṛ ṣi (mig ṇa pra shasta ya sarba (bta thā ga to: ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ rdu/ dzam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ rdu/ stastan ka rī hūm̐ hūm̐/ ma hā bibyā sam bhak+ṣa ṇa ka rī ju phroṃ/ pa ra bit+yā sam bhak+ṣa ṇa ka rī 4)rtsu hūm̐/ sarba duṣ+ṭa tsā ①stam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ rdzu/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa ⑥sa gra hā ṇ+ḍaṃ ༷bi dh+wan (kyen ka rī hūm̐ hūm̐/ tsa tu rā shi 6)khri ṭ+wāṃ gra ha sa ha sru shā tibi dh+wan tshonyen ka rī hūṃ hūm̐/ aṣ+ṭa dzi zhe sha tī māṃ na k+ṣa tā oṃ pra sā tsod na ka rī hūṃ rdu/aṣ+ṭa tsā ma hā gra ha tsā bebe dh+wan 8na yika rī hūm̐ hūm̐/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ/ bcom ldan 'das ma tunyede bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mo/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ spyan bye ba brgya 4)phrag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen mos sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad ma/ kun nas bdag la bsrung du gsol bsrung du gsol/o rgyal pos 'jigs pa dang / chom rkun tu)gyis 'jigs pa dang / me yis 'jigs pa dang / chu yis 'jigs pa dang / dug gis 'jigs pa dang /mtshon gyis 'jigs pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis tso'ajigs pa dang /98—424

mu ges 'jigs pa dang / dgra yis 'jigs pa dang / lce 'bab pas 'jigs pa dang / dus ma yin par ①'chi bas 'jigs pa dang / sa g.yo bas ②'jigs pa dang / skar mda' ltung bas 'jigs pa dang / rgyal po'i chad pas 'jigs pa dang / lha yis 'jigs pa dang / klu yis 'jigs pa dang / glog gis 'jigs pa dang / nam mkha' lding gis 'jigs pa dang / gcan gzan ①khro bos 'jigs pa dang / lha'i gdon dang / klu'i gdon dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon dang / rlung lha'i gdon dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdon dang / dri za'i gdon dang / mi'am ci'i gdon dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gdon dang /gnod sbyin gyi gdon dang / srin po'i gdon dang / yi dgas kyi gdon dang /sha za'i gdon dang / 'byung po'i gdon dang / grul bul gyi gdon dang /srul po'i gdon dang / lus srul po'i gdon dang / skem byed kyi gdon dang /brjed ⑨byed kyi gdon dang / smyo byed kyi gdon dang / grib gnon gyi gdon dang / gnon po'i gdon dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang /(5) nam gru'i gdon dang / gdon de dag thams cad las bdag bde legs su gyur cig6) /mdangs 'phrog pa dang / zas su mngal za ba dang / zas su khrag 'thung ba dang ske/ zas su zhag za ba dang / zas su sha za ba dang / zas su tshil za ba dang ske/ zas su rkang za ba dang / zas su btsas ⑦pa za ba dang / srog 'phrog pa dang / zas su skyugs pa za ba dang / zas su mi gtsang ba za ba dang /zas su gcin 'thung ba dang / zas su stor 6)khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba dang /zas su lhag ma za ba dang / zas su mchil ma 'thung ba dang / zas su snabs za ba dang / zas su ngar snabs za ba dang / zas su rnag za ba dang / zas 98—425

su gtor ma za ba dang / zas su phreng ba za ba dang / zas su dri za ba dang /zas su bdug pa za ba dang / sems 'phrog pa dang / zas su me tog za ba dang / zas su 'bras bu za ba dang / zas su lo tog za ba dang / zas su sbyin sreg 6)za ba las bdag bde legs su gyur cig /de dag thams cad dang gdon thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab ①po/ /kun du rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab ①bo / /phyugs (pebadag chen pos (5)byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /sred med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /nam mkha' lding yang dag pa dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /nag po chen po dang ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /rgyal bar byed pa dang sbrang rtsir byed pa dang / don kun sgrub ⑥pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do / /phur bus gdab bo/ /sring mo bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad ⑦do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /blang (kyegi ri 5)ti dang / dga' byed dbang phyug dang /tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad kyido/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes byas pa'i rig 98—426

phaṭa / asnri hu)ye phaṭa/ ma hā kā lī ye phaṭa/ kā la ②daṇ+ḍi ye phaṭa/ irnyi ①ye phaṭa / ro dz+rī ④ye phaṭa/ kau ma rī ye phaṭa/ bā rā gā ⑤yi phaṭa/ tsa murnyi 0ye phaṭa / rā 4)spyi ye phaṭa/ kā la rā ṭī ye phaṭa/ ya ma daṇ+ḍi ye phaṭa/ ka ⑧bla lī ye phaṭa/ a dhi musti po)sma sā na bā si tsanī ye phaṭa/ sems can gang su dag bdag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / mdangs 'phrog pa rnams dang / zas su mngal za ba rnams dang / zas su khrag 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su zhag za ba rnams dang / zas su sha za ba rnams dang / zas su tshil za ba rnams dang / zas su rkang za ba rnams dang / zas su btsas 7pa za ba rnams dang / srog 'phrog pa rnams dang / zas su skyugs pa za ba rnams dang / zas su mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang / zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su stor ⑩khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su lhag ma za ba rnams dang / zas su mchil yi ma 'thung cib rnams dang / zas su snabs za ba rnams dang / zas su ngar snabs za ba rnams dang / zas su rnag za ba rnams dang / zas su gtor ma za ba rnams dang / zas su phreng ba za ba rnams tsodang / zas su dri za ba rnams dang / zas su bdug yipa za ba rnams dang / sems 'phrog pa rnams dang —/ zas su me tog za ba rnams dang / zas su 'bras bu za ba rnams dang /zas su lo tog za ba rnams dang / zas su sbyin sreg za ba rnams dang / sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang /drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang /srin po'i gdon rnams dang / yi dgas yo)kyi gdon rnams dang / sha za'i 98—428

gdon rnams dang / 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang / grul bum gyi gdon rnams dang / srul po'i gdon rnams dang / lus srul po'i gdon rnams dang /skem byed kyi gdon rnams dang / smyo byed kyi gdon rnams dang / grib gnon gyi gdon rnams dang / brjed byed kyi gdon rnams dang /0) gnon po'i gdon rnams dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon rnams dang / nam gru'i gdon rnams dang / gshin rje'i gdon rnams dang / bya'i gdon rnams dang / ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon rnams dang / kun du bre (geba'i gdon rnams dang ske/ tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon rnams dang / rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang —/ nyin gnyis pa rnams dang / nyin gsum pa rnams dang / nyin bzhi pa rnams dang / nyin bdun pa rnams dang / rtag pa'i rims rnams dang /rims mi bzad pa rnams dang / rims ldang dub ②pa rnams dang / 'byung po'i rims rnams dang / rlung las gyur pa rnams dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams dang / bad kun las gyur pa rnams dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa rnams dang / rims nad thams cad dang / klad (pepa na ba bsal du gsol/gzhogs phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mig nad dang / sna nad dang ske/ kha nad dang / mgul nad dang / snying nad dang / lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang / rna ba na ba dang / so na ba dang / snying na ba dang / klad pa na ba dang /⑤ skye na ba dang / rtsib logs na ba dang / rgyab na ba dang / lto ba yin ba dang / rked pa na ba dang / chu so na ba dang / brla na ba dang /rje ⑦ngar na ba dang / lag pa na ba dang / rkang pa na ba dang / yan lag na ba dang / nying lag na ba bsal du gsol/ gdugs dkar po (0can gzhan 98—429

gyis mi thub ma rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mo 'dis/ dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi nang tshun chad du 'byung po dang / ro langs dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / rims dang / shu ba dang / g.yan pa dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang /mdze dang / phol mig dang / bas bldags 4)dang / me dbal dang / g.ya' ba dang / lhog pa dang / skem pa dang / skrag pa dang / dbyig dug dang /dug sbyar ma dang / byad stems na dang / me dang / chu dang / mi ngas dang /dgra dang / gnod pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / sbrang bu ṣ+ṭṛ ①bu ka dang / tre+e lā ṭa sbyoraka dang / sdig pa dang / sbrul dang / sre mo dang /seng ge dang / stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / chu srin dang / bung ba lta bus gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa de dag thams cad kyi rig sngags bcing bar bgyi'o / /gzi brjid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan gyi rig sngags bcing bar bgyi'o / /tar+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi ṣa de bi ṣa de/ bai ra be+e ra/badz+ra dha ri baṃ dha baṃ ri dha ni badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ban dha phaṭa ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ sus de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thubahrīpa phyir zlog ma (6)'di gro ga'am/ras sam/ shing shun la bris te/ lus sam mgul du thogs na/ de ji srid 'cho3re bar du dug gis mi tshugs/ mtshon gyis mi tshugs/ me yis mi tshugs/ chu yis (7)mi tshugs/ dbyig dug gis mi tshugs/ dug sbyar mas mi tshugs/⑧byad kyis mi tshugs/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /gdon thams cad dang / bgegs dang / log 'dren thams cad kyi yid du 'ong ba dang dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i rigs bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag 98—430

brgyad cu ①ma bzhis kyang de la bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sbed par byed de/ de rnams kyi yid du 'ong ba dang / dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa chen po brgyad khri bzhi stong du tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /nam du yang gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /(mi yi dgas ①dang / srul po dang / lus srul po nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ /mi dbul por mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog (4)ma chen mo 'di 'chang na tshangs par mi spyod pa yang tshangs par spyod par 'gyur ro/ /thub par ma byas pa yang thub par byas par 'gyur ro/ /mi gtsang ba yang gtsang bar 'gyur ro/ /bsnyen gnas ma byas pa yang bsnyen gnas byas par 'gyur ro/ /smyang (geb ma byas pa yang smyung 56)ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang sdig pa byang bar 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa yang ma lus par byang bar 'gyur ro/ /bud med bu 'dod pa gang la la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma chen po rdzi'adi 'chang na bu 'dod pa des bu rnyed de/ tshe dang bsod nams dang stobs rnams kyang rab tu rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / gnag nad dang / yams kyi nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / nad 'go ba dang / gnod pa 9shedang / 'khrug pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar 98—431

gcig ma'i gdon dang / nam gru chen mo bong zhon ma'i gdon nyid yin pas sprul pa bcwa brgyad ①ma nyid do/ /yang sprul gur bdag bcu gsum ni thugs kyi sprul pa chen mo ni gur gcig la dbang byed pa'i gdon dang / gur gnyis la dbang byed pa'i gdon dang / gur gsum (snyel ②byed pa'i gdon dang / gur bzhi la dbang byed pa'i gdon dang / gur lnga la dbang byed pa'i gdon dang /gur drug la dbang byed pa'i gdon dang / gur bdun la dbang byed pa'i gdon dang / gur brgyad la dbang byed pa'i gdon dang / gur dgu la dbang byed pa'i gdon dang / gur bcu la dbang byed pa'i gdon dang / gur bcu gcig la dbang byed pa'i gdon dang / gur chubacu gnyis la dbang byed pa'i gdon dang / gur bcu gsum la dbang byed pa'i gdon no/ /yang sprul thugs kyi sprul pa yis rims nad la dbang byed pa dang / 'khrug pa la dbang byed pa dang ske/ bdud kyi dmag dpung thams cad la dbang byed pa dang / nad dang rims kyi ⑤dbang sgyur ma/ mgo nad la dbang byed pa dang / kha nad la dbang byed pa dang / khrag nad dang mgul pa'i nad la dbang byed pa dang / snying nad la dbang byed pa dang / lkog nad la dbang byed pa dang / lha gor na ba'i nad la dbang byed pa dang / brla na ba'i nad la dbang byed pa dang / rje ngar na ba'i nad la dbang byed pa dang / lhog pa'i nad la dbang byed pa dang /skem pa'i nad la dbang byed pa dang / chu so'i nad la dbang byed pa dang / shu ba'i nad la dbang byed pa dang / yan lag na ba'i nad la dbang byed pa dang /'brum bu phra mo la dbang byed pa dang / bas 6)bldags la dbang byed pa dang /me dbal la dbang byed pa dang / lhog pa la dbang byed pa dang / dbyig (798—437

dug la dbang byed pa dang / dug nad la dbang byed pa dang / rgyu gzer la dbang byed pa dang / pho log la dbang byed pa dang / gnyan po la dbang byed pa dang / skya rims klad 91)gzer gyi nad la sogs te/ nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dag la dbang byed pa ni e ka (nanodza ṭī'i (5)sprul pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /de dag thams cad la ni rig sngags bden pa'i byin gyi brlabs ④kyi rig sngags kyis gcad do/ /drag po zlog pa'i phur (5)bus gdab po/ /gnod byed kyi gdon du gyur pa ni ro langs ma srin mo nag mos grong khyer sum brtsegs 6)'jig par byed pa'i rig sngags kyis gcad do/ /phur 57)bus gdab po/ /gnod byed kyi gdon dang / smyo byed rnga zhon gyi gdon dang / grong rgyun la sogs pa'i gdon rnams ni smyo byed gdon du za ba yin pas na shugs sgrol ma'i rig sngags kyis gcad do/ /rig sngags 'chang gi 58)phur bus gdab po/ /oṃ a ka ra pra ma ni bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sha tu ma ki li ki la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bud med nag mor mngon pa dang / /rnal 'byor spyan rtul byed pa ni/ /sgrol byed nag mo'i gdon yin pas/ /legs ldan dka' thub kyi rig sngags kyis gcad do/ /shugs sgrol ma dbang phyug gtso mo'i phur bus gdab po/ /sarba pra ma ni bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ro ti baṃ ki li ki la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/skya rims klad 9)pa na ba dang / /rkang lag 'khol ba'i nad byung na 'byung po nag po'i gdon yin pas dpal chen dbang gi skurig sngags kyis gcad do/ /shugs sgrol chen mo'i phur bus gdab po11/ /dza lar ye mabh+yaḥphaṭa/ pra ma ki (nyali ki la ya hūm̐ hūm̐/ lci zhing nad byung 'jibs pa dang / /gnyid bro zhing sems la mi dran pa'i nad byung na bud med nag mo'i gdon yin pas/ rgyal bar byed pa'i rig sngags kyis gcad/ /sbrang rtsir byed pa'i phur bus gdabatso/ /ru tra ya na byi 8sha 98—438

bh+yaḥphaṭa / ka pa la ki li ki la ya phaṭa/ byas dgur ye nas mi btub cing / /las byas bsam pa mi 'grub pa ni drang srong 0)gzi can gyi gdon yin pas/thod pa can gyi rig sngags kyis gcad/ dge sbyong gcer bu'i phur bus gdab(9/tsa ya ma me bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ro ti pa ma ki li ki la ya hūṃ rdu/ rnal 'byor sems la yeng yeng po seng seng phya phya byed pa'i nad byung na srin mo nag mo'i gdon yin pas/phyag na rdo rje'i rig sngags kyis gcad/ dbang ldan mgon po'i phur bus gdab ske/ rak+ṣa ④ya ni bh+yaḥphaṭa/ du ni (༄rāk+ṣa 6)kyi li ki la ya hūm̐ phroṃ/ sems la mi dga' phya phya'o/ /rlung 'phyo'i thabs su na ba ni rlung lha nag mo'i gdon yin pas / ma mo bdun gyi 9)rig sngags kyis gcad/ sring mo bzhi'i phur bus gdabaske/ ha sa ya ni ra re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ du ya ka sa ya ni ki li ki la ya t+t+waṃ rdzu/ khro ba dang ni 'tshig pa dang / /smra 'dod dang ni 'tshig 'dre dang / /rkang lag bya btsag mang po'i nad byung na dbang ldan nag po'i (shegadon yin pas/ dbang ldan gtso bo'i rig sngags kyis gcad/ rigs kyi khro bo'i phur bus gdab/ /de ba lo yā bh+yaḥphaṭa/ de ba ki li ki la ya hūm̐ phroṃ/ nam phyed gung la gnyid med dang / /cho 'phrul chen po 'byung ba dang / /bung bu phag gi gzugs ston pa ni nam gru nag mo'i gdon yin pas/ dpal chen gtso bo'i rig sngags kyis gcad(9) / rigs kyi khro bo'i phur bus gdab/ /de ba ki li ki la yā abh+yaḥphaṭa/de ba dra (1ti ki li ki la ya hūm̐ hūm̐/ rkang lag khol ⑩zhing na ba dang / /yi ga bcings nas skyug bro ba'i nad byung na ya ma nag mo'i gdon yin pas/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i rig sngags kyis gcad/ /mi pham mdzes pa'i phur bus gdab//ya ma rā dza hriḥ6)nyi bi kri kri nad ma hā rgyu hūm̐/ tsa ya ro ba ni ki li ki la ya bh+yaḥ98—439

phaṭa / gzhogs skams pa dang rengs pa dang / /zha grum sha lus sngo la 'jam/ /mig mdog gnag cing rkong ba ni/ /shu ba marje'i cho 'phrul ni klu mo nag mo'i gdon yin pas/ bya khyung te'i rig sngags kyis gcad/ /drang srong rgad ①po'i phur bus gdab/ /nā ga le ya hūm̐ hūm̐/ tsa ya ka bh+yaḥtshuphaṭa/ sems la yeng yeng seng seng po ro stod mnan pa snyam byed pa dang / snyang stong ②byed pa'i nad byung na / /kha so 'brul ba snyam byed na gnod sbyin skyinag po'i gdon yin pas/ rnam thos sras kyi rig sngags kyis gcad/ /sprul byed ma'i phur bus gdab/ /ti ti ma ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ku ku rā dza ( ye rtsu rdzu/ shu ba 'brum bu na ba dang / /sha lus g.ya' ba'i nad byung na nam gru skyong byed ro langs nag mo'i gdon yin pas/gshin rje thogs med kyi rig sngags kyis gcad/ /'dod pa dmar mo'i phur bus gdab / /ba ren he ya rtsu hūm̐/ ku ma la gur dang bh+yaḥphaṭa/ khrag tu na zhing lci ba dang / /mig rgyang ring du mi mthong (6)ba dang / sems la yeng yeng seng seng po'i nad byung na nam gru khyung gshog ma'i gdon yin pas/ dpal chen dbang gi rig sngags kyis gcad/ /khro bo hūm̐ chen 'bar ba'i phur ⑦bus gdab/ /du ya ku la rdzu phaṭa/ ma ma kha du ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ g.yas kyi lag pa zha ba dang / rtsib mar gzer zhing na ba ni lag gcig (8)nyab pa'i gdon yin pas/ dbyings kyi khro bo'i rig sngags kyis gcad/ /dbang mo dmar mo'i phur ①bus gdab/ /ma ma ri ha ya hūm̐ phroṃ/ ka pa la ya he bh+yaḥphaṭa/ myos shing khrag tu bshal ba dang / /mig sngar sna tshogs gzugs 'ong ba ni so gcig mig gcig ma'i gdon yin pas/legs ldan phyir zlog pa'i rig sngags kyis gcad/ /dka' thub gtso bo'i phur bus gdab/ /rāk+ṣa se hūṃ rdu/ rāk+ṣa lo ki la ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ma bdud kyi gdon ⑩98—440

bcu gnyis la/ /dar dkar gur gyi nang shed na/ /bud med mnga' bdag cho 'phrul ni①/ /mi bzang dkar mo byung ba ni/ /gser dang g.yus phyibargyan ②dbang mo che/ /ye shes kun du bzang mo'i gdon/ /dus ngan char pa 'khrug pa dang ske/ /sad dang ser ba'i cho 'phrul te/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rig sngags kyis gcad / /ting nge 'dzin gyi phur bus gdab/ ni dharma dhā tu rgyas ma ya tsū hūm̐/ku ma la tsa ga ye sa ma ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ g.yu gur gnyis la dbang byed ma/ /mthing (geka chen mo dbang mo che/ /ba lang dre yirta zhon pa dang / /'jig rten yo ga phung bar byed/ /dbang byed chen mo'i rig sngags kyis gcad/ /khyab pa chen mo'i phur bus gdab/ a ra stimi bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ra du hūm̐ rdu/ byi ru'i gur gsum ⑧dbang byed ma/ /gur nang snying gi mnga' bdag ste/ /gser gur mchod pa'i rig sngags kyis gcad/ /dka' thub gtso bo'i phur bus gdab/ /tiṣ+ṭa tiṣ+ṭa ni bh+yaḥphaṭa / ba pā 6)ma hūm̐ hūm̐/ gser gur bzhi la dbang byed ma/ /lha gor ba dang lhog nad kun gyi bdag /'jam dpal ro tan gyi rig sngags kyis gcad/ /mi pham mdzes pa'i phur bus gdab/ /ro ro bam̐ ju rdu/ ku ku ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/mthing yinag gi gur lnga la dbang byed ma/ /gzer ma kha ral bud med yin/ /chu so'i nad dang lkog nad dang / /khrag nad dang ni shu ba'i nad/ /ya ma rol pa'i rig sngags kyis gcad/ /mi pham rol pa'i phur bus gdab/ ya go le t+t+waṃ rdul/ phra do ⑩phya ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ bsam med zhing chen gyi gur drug la dbang byed ma//lha mo nyid kyi nad lags te/ /kha nas khrag tu skyug 8pa dang / /lus la tsha ba skyes pa dang / /yan lag 'khongs par byed pa'o/ /ya ma thugs rje'i rig sngags kyis gcad/ /ya ma chags byed kyi phur bus gdab/ /tsa ga ya baṃ bh+yaḥphaṭa/98—441

gur la de hunyes hūm̐/ re lde'i gur bdun pa'i nang shed na/ /khram la 'debs pa'i ma mo ste/ /kha nas khrag nad 'bebs pa dang / /lus la tsha ②ba'i me chen sbar (0ba dang / /zangs gri thogs (4)pa'i las byed de/ /khyung chen 'bar ba'i rig sngags kyis gcad/ /dug chen tshar gcod kyi phur bus gdab/ /da he ya ya hūm̐ phroṃ/ me tsa ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ glang po che'i gur brgyad pa'i nang shed na/ /bong bu dre'u zhon pa'i bud med de/ /lhog pa glo dang rkang ⑤pa nad kyi bdag /gshin rje thugs kyi rig sngags kyis gcad/ /'bar ma dbang gi phur bus gdab / /tsa kra ki li ki la ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ā ko lo hūm̐ phroṃ/ bse gur khra ⑥bo dgu'i nang shed na/ /rda bran sman gyi gtso mo chadagus/ /ser ba sad dang 'gong nad dang / /phung byed khang pa rdib pa dang / /sbo zhing sna thabs sun pa ni nag po dgu'i nad yin pas/ dbyings kyi gtso mo'i rig sngags kyis gcad/ /'khor ba rab 'joms kyi phur bus gdab/ /ku ma la ya hūṃ hūm̐/ sha ma ma ye bh+yaḥphaṭa / mthing 54)nag gi gur bcu phub pa'i nang shed na/ /gur la dbang ba bcu gnas pa/ /mdze dang shu ba g.yan pa dang / /dug sbyor ma dang 'khrug byed dang / /gri thabs su gsod par byed pa ni khro bo grags 'dzin gyi lngarig sngags kyis gcad/ khyab pa ma'i ⑩phur bus gdab/ /a ko sha me ra ra hūm̐ phroṃ/ pra du le (tebh+yaḥphaṭa/ gsang ba pad+ma gur bcu gcig pa'i nang shed na/ /bcu gcig dbang gi gur bdag mo/ /khyab bdal chen mo dbang gi sku/ /'jig rten du char sgo gza' tsoyis 'gegs shing / char pa 'bebs su mi ster ba ni dpal chen dbyings kyi rig sngags kyis gcad/ /mdzes ma sa 'dzin ma'i phur ces gdab / /a ko mun bh+yaḥphaṭa/ tsa ye ma hūm̐ rdu/ ga phur (3shel gyi gur bcu 98—442

gnyis pa'i nang shed na/ /mu kha le ma cig dbyings kyi yum/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi khyod la rdzogs/ /'gro ba yongs la sman slad du/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi nang na bzhugs/ /phyag na rig pa thugs kyi sdong bu bsnams/ /srid pa thams cad dus gcig gsal/ /gsal 'bar thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /bdud bzhi sharnyi ku ru swā hā/ ri tshe 'gong g.yag shan+ti ku ru swā hā/ pho bdud bcu gnyis shan+ti ku ru swā hā/ mo bdud bcu gsum shan+ti ku ru swā hā/ skos rje drang dkar sharnyi ku ru swā hā/ gnam the dkar po shas ku ru swā hā/ bar the khra bo sharnyi ku ru swā hā/ sa the nag po sharnyi ku ru swā hā/ byang shar mtshams kyi gdon btsan 'gong dmar po sharnyi ku ru swā hā/ yams dang nad kyi bdag mo sharnyi ku ru swā hā/ sman dang yul sa sharnyi ku ru swā hā/ dpal lha mo nag mo'i gtsug tor phan yon rtsa ba dang bcas pa gdon zlog pa'i mdo'i gzungs 'di ni lan gsum du dag par bklags 0)te/ las dka' ba la dmod ②btsugs na ji ltar bsams pa ltar 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bse por gyi nang du gtor ma lnga byas la/cho ga gzhung bzhin du byas na/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dpal lha mo gtsug tor gyis gdon zlog pa 'di ni mtshan mar bzung ste/ yang dang yang du bton ②zhing cho ga gzhung bzhin du byas te/ gtor ma chu chen po 'am / ri mthon po la bskyal na/ 'khrug pa chen po byed na g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /drag po'i las byed na dgra bo'i snying la gtad de gur bcu gnyis kyi bdag mo la gtad na dgra phung zhing rlag par 'gyur ro/ /dpal lha mo gtsug tor rol pa'i tan+t+ra rdzogs so9par// //98—443

bya ba'i gzungs/①༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+sā ②ga ha mā tro kā ninā ma dhā ra tsā/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags ma bcom ldan 'das ma gza' rnams kyi yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'brog gnas kyi grong khyer chen po na / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto du'aphye chen po dang ske/ bdud dang / gshin rje dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / mig dmar dang / gza' lhag dang / phur bu dang / pa ba sangs dang / spen pa dang —/ sgra gcan dudang / mjug burings dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa du mas bstod cing / rdo rje chen po dam tshig gi rgyan gyis ༷byin gyis brlabs pa'i seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te byang chub sems dpa' du ma dang thabs 98—485

cig tsho)pa la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje gtum po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sde dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje gzhu dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i bdag po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje rgyan dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 'od dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du gzigs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i tog dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhal ras rgyas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i spyan dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun brgya phrag du ma rnams kyis yongs su bskor zhing mdun du bdar ba la chos ston te/ bkod pa chen po'i rgyan yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba / thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ du tha (cimar dge ba/ don bzang po/tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba'i chos ston par mdzad do/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis phyag na rdo rjes 'khor de rnams la bltas nas langs te/ bdag gi 0rdzu 'phrul gyi byin gyis brlabs kyis bcom ldan 'das la lan stong phrag du mar bskor ba byas te 98—486

phyag 'tshal nas spyan sngar 'dug ste/ snyems pa dang bcas pas skyil mo krung 6)legs par bcas pas 'khor de rnams la bltas te/ rdo rje thal mo rang gi snying gar ②sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gza' rnams ni gtum zhing gtum pa'i gzugs can drag cing drag pa'i gzugs can khro zhing khro ba'i sems kyis sems can rnams la rnam par 'tshe zhing gnod par bgyid la mdangs 'phrog par bgyid de/ kha cig ni nor rdzas 'phrog par bgyid/ kha cig ni srog 'phrog par bgyid/ sems can tshe ring po kha cig ni tshe thung bar bgyid/ de ltar sems can rnams la gnod pas 'tshe bar bgyid pas na/ de'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs gang gis sems can rnams la srung bar 'gyur ba bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje gang khyod kyis sems can rnams la phan par bya ba'i don du snying rje bskyed nas gsang ba chen po shin tu gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa la zhu bar byed pa legs so legs so/ /de dag ngas bshad kyis nyon la legs par rab tu zung la yid la gyis shig /gza' rnams gtum pa'i gzugs la shin tu khro zhing 'jigs pa rnams la mchod pa bzang po mchod yon dang bzlas brjod bzang po gsang ba las ches gsang ba ngas bshad par bya'o/ /de dag mchod pas mchod 'gyur zhing / /gnod pa byas na gnod byed pa/ /gza' de kun gyi kha dog dang / /ji ltar dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / /lha rnams dang ni lha min dang / /mi 'am ci dang klu dag dang / /gnod sbyin rnams dang srin po dang / /srul po dang ni mi rnams dang / /drag po gzi brjid chen po dag /khros pa zhi bar byed pa yi/ /gsang sngags dang ni mchod 98—487

pa dag /rim pa bzhin du bshad par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa nyid kyi thugs ka hunyenas snying rje rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer 'bar ba phyung nas gza' rnams kyi spyi bor zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas de nyid kyi skad cig nyid ②la nyi ma la sogs pa'i gza' rnams langs nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bdag cag rnams la sman yon btags par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs bstan du gsol / bcom ldan 'das gang gis bdag cag rnams tshogs nas yo byad du gyur par byed pa'i chos smra ba rnams la bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang /zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / rim gro dang chad pa bzlog ①pa dang /mtshon cha spang ba ④dang / dug (snyegazhil ba dang / dug gsad pa dang /mtshams gcad pa dang / sa bcing bar 'gyur ba rnams bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas gza' rnams kyi mchod pa dang gsang sngags bka' stsal pa/ ji lta ba'i rim pa'i kha dog gi dbye bas phyogs rnams su dri'i dkyil 'khor byas la pad+ma sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad du byas pa'i 'dab ma bris te/ lte ba yang sor bcu gnyis pa la sgo bzhis mdzes pa rim pa bzhin du byas pa la pad+ma rgyas pa'i steng du lha nyi ma bsam par bya ba ni lus gzi brjid kyi phung po li khri nye bar 'bar ba lta bu nyi ma stong dang mtshungs pa'i 'od zer can no/ /oṃ mi ༷sgo'i ⑦ya swā hā/ shar du zla ba dkar po/ oṃ shi tsā 6)sha be 0swā hā/ me'i mtshams su mig dmar 0po/ oṃ raX yig ku mā rā ⑩ya swā hā0/ gshin rje'i phyogs su rgyal 98—488

rigs gza' lhag mdog ser po/ oṃ bu dhā ①ya swā hā/ bden bral du phur bu dmar ser/ oṃ bṛ ha spa ta ②ye swā hā/ nub kyi phyogs su pa ②ba sangs dkar po / oṃ a su rot+ta mā duya swā hā/ rlung du spen pa mig sman ltar shin tu gnag pa / oṃ kṛt+ta wa: ⑤ya duswā hā/ lus ngan po'i phyogs su sgra gcan dmar nag /oṃ a mṛ ⑦ta pri yā ya swā hā/ dbang ldan gyi mtshams su ⑧dud sprin gyi mdog lta bu'i mjug ⑨rings/ oṃ byo ⑩ti ke ta be yiswā hā/ shar gyi sgor rje btsun sangs rgyas / lho sgor phyag na rdo rje/ nub sgor 'jig rten mgon po0/ byang gi 8sgor 'jam dpal lo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi byang shar du gza' thams cad do//shar lho'i mtshams su khyim rnams dang rgyu skar rnams so/ /lho nub tu gnod pa thams cad do/ /nub byang du rje btsun ④rig pa chen mo'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sgo'i phyi rol gyi shar du yul 'khor srung / lhor 'phags skyes po/ nub tu mig mi bzang / byang du lus ngan po'o/ /nyi ma'i 'o thug dang / zla ba'i zho zan dang ske/ mig dmar gyi sran ma/ ma sha'i bza' 8ba dang / lhag pa'i mar gyi khur ⑩ba dang / phur bu'i 'o ma dang / pa ba sangs kyi khur ⑩ba dang / spen pa'i sran ma/ ma sha dang / mud ga tsobasres pa dang / sgra gcan gyi til gyi thug pa dang / mjug yirings kyi til gyi thug pa dang / bu ram gyi tshod ma'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma ni yul 'khor srung 0gi zho zan no/ /'phags skyes po'i zho dang sran ma/ ma sha'i bza' ⑥ba'o/ /mig mi bzang dugi 'o thug gi bza' duba'o / /lus ngan po'i zho dang sran ma/ ma sha'i bza' ba dang bu ram chang dang sbyar ba'o/ /ji lta ba'i rim pa'i kha dog gi me tog dbul lo/ /ji lta ba'i rim pa'i kha dog gi bdug 0spos dbul lo/ /ji lta ba'i rim pa'i kha dog gi ba dan 98—489

dbul lo/ /so so la mar me dbul lo/ /ji lta ba'i rim pa'i mchod pa bya'o/ /mar dang sbrang rtsis dung phor bkang ste rin chen sna lnga bcug 6)la mchod yon dbul zhing gdong la yang dar bcing bar bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje gza' 'di rnams kyi snying po'i sngags bklags ②pas 'grub pa rnams yin te/ ji lta ba'i rim pa'i kha dog dang mthun (7pa'i spos kyi dkyil 'khor sor bcu gnyis pa byas pa'i dbus su mchod par bya'o/ /kham pa'am zangs la sogs pa'am/ gser ram dngul gyi snod du mchod yon phul nas/ re re la yang bzlas brjod lan brgya rtsa brgyad rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje de nas yang de'i 'og tu gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs ④kyi sngags kyi tshig rnams lan bdun brjod par bya'o/ /de nas gza' nyi ma la sogs 6)pa'i gza' thams cad kyis srung ⑥bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /dbul ba'i gdon las grol bar byed do/ /tshe zad pa rnams tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje yang gang zhig dge slong dang /dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams sam/ sems can gzhan sems can gyi skye bar gtogs pa gang dag gi rna lam du thos na de dag kyang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje yang gang zhig gza' rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mchod cing / nyin gcig bzhin du klog par byed pa'i chos smra bar byed pa de la gza' rnams thams cad kyis rnam pa thams cad du bdag nyid kyis bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /de'i rigs rgyud kyi dbul ba yang nyams par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs bka' stsal pa/ na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/98—490
