ba'i gzungs/6)༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ gra ha mā tre kā ②nā ma dhā ra 〉du/ bod skad du / gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'brog gnas kyi grong khyer chen po na/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / bdud dang /nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / mig dmar dang / pa ba sangs dang / phur bu dang —/ gza' lhag skyidang / spen pa dang / sgra gcan 'dzin dang / mjug ⑤rings rnams dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa mang po rnams kyis bstod pa/ rdo rje chen po'i dam tshig gis yibyin gyis brlabs kyis rdo rje'i khri la bzhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' du ma dang yang thabs cig ( )ste/ 'di 98wa 495

ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje gtum po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sde dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje gzhu can dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i bdag po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i rgyan dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du gzigs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i tog dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhal ras rgyas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i spyan dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nu dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ①byams pa la sogs ②pa byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis bskor cing mdun gyis bltas pa la chos ston tol/ /bkod pa chen po'i rgyan gyi nor bu zhes bya ba thog mar dge ba dang /bar du dge ba dang / tha mar dge ba dang / don bzang po dang / tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba'i chos ston to//de nas phyag na rdo rjes 'khor de dag la bltas te langs nas rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi byin gyis ①brlabs kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la lan brgya stong du mar bskor ba byas te phyag 'tshal nas spyan sngar 'dug ste 0stems pa dang bcas pas skyil mo 98—496

krung ①legs par bcas nas 'khor de dag la 'gying bag du bltas te/ rdo rje'i thal mo rang ②gi snying gar ①bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gza' mi bzad pa/ mi bzad pa'i gzugs can drag shul can drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa④/ khro ba khro ba'i gzugs can dag sems can thams cad la 'tshe bar bgyid pa tho ⑤'tsham par bgyid pa/mdangs kyang 'phrog par bgyid cing / kha cig nor zas 'phrog par bgyid/kha cig srog 'phrog par bgyid/ sems can tshe ring ba kha cig ni tshe thung ngur bgyid do/ /de ltar sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar bgyid pa de rnams kyi slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs gang gis sems can thams cad la bsrung bar 'gyur ba bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang yang khyod kyis snying rje bskyed pas sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir gsang chen pas yikyang ches ⑦gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa la zhu bar byed pa ⑧ni legs so legs so/ /de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung 0shig dang / gza' mi bzad pa'i gzugs can shin tu khro ba dang /shin tu 'jigs par byed pa rnams kyis mchod pa dang / mchod yon dang /bzlas brjod bzang po gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba ngas ⑩bshad do/ /de dag mchod pas mchod gyur cing / /gnod pa byas na gnod byed pa/ /gza' de kun gyi kha dog dang / /ji lta bur ni 'gyur ba dang / /lha rnams dang ni lha min dang / /mi 'am ci dang klu dag dang / /gnod sbyin rnams dang srin po dang ske/ /mi rnams dang ni mi ma yin/ /drag po gzi brjid chen po dang / /khros pa zhi bar byed pa de'i/ /gsang sngags rnams dang mchod pa dang / /rim 98—497

pa bzhin du bshad par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa nyid kyi thugs ka nas snying rje rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer bkye ste/ gza' 0)rnams kyi spyi bor zhugs so/ /de nas de'i mod la nyi ma la sogs pa'i gza' thams cad langs te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la lha rdzas kyi mchod pa byas te phyag 'tshal nas pus mo btsugs nas thal mo sbyar ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bdag cag la sman yon btags par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rinasachos kyi rnam grangs gang gis bdag cag rnams la sogs pas chos smra ba rnams la srung ri stebar 'gyur ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / zhi ④ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / mtshon cha spang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang /dug gzhil ba dang / dug gsad pa dang / mtshams gcad pa dang / sa bcing ba rnams bgyid par 'gyur ba bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas gza' rnams mchod pa dang gsang sngags bka' stsal to/ /oṃ mi stoṅgā (5)ya swā hā/ oṃ shi tsā (nyasha be rtsis hā/ oṃ ras+t+ri ga (8)ku 1)mā rā ya swā hā/ oṃ bu dhā 7ya swā hā/ oṃ bṛ ha 7spa ta yiye swā hā/oṃ a su rot+ta (nyamā ya swā hā/ oṃ kroṇ+ḍa ski brje ya geswā hā/ oṃ a mṛ yin pri yā ya swā hā / oṃ byo ⑩ti ke ta be /sheswā hā/ lag na rdo rje 'di dag ni gza' dgu'i gsang sngags kyi snying po bklags 4tshepas grub pa yin te/ kha dog dang mthun 6)par spos kyis ri tshospedakyil 'khor sor bcu gnyis pa byas pa'i dbus su mchod par bya'o/ /kham pa'am zangs la sogs pa'am/ gser dang dngul gyi snod du mchod yon 98—498

phul nas re re la yang bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje de'i 'og tu gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig lan bdun brjod par bya'o/ /de nas gza' rnams thams cad srung ba ①byed par 'gyur ro / /dbul ba'i gdon las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe zad pa las tshe ring por byed par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / gzhan yang sems can gyi rigs gang yin pa dang / gang dag gi rna lam du grag (mipa de dag kyang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje gza' rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mchod par bya ste/ nyin gcig bzhin du klog par byed pa'i chos smra ba gang yin pa de la gza' thams cad bdag nyid kun gyis bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /de dang rigs gcig pa rnams kyi dbul ba yang sel bar byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo//bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i gza' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo / /rgyu skar rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gza' tshukhyim bcu gnyis po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ burnye budhe/ badz+re badz+re/ pad+me pad+me/ sa ra sa ra/pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sma ra sma ra/ k+to ḍa ④ya shrī ḍa (snyeya/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/mārta yiya mān+ta ༷ya/ bhā niṭa ya bhā 6)( ya/ sarba bi kyi/ ku ru ku ru tshirnya tshin+ta7 / k+ṣu pa ya k+ṣu pa ya/ shādhe shārnye/ rādhe dān+ti/ dā ma ya dā ma ⑩ya/bcom ldan 'das ma bdag nyid myur du bstan du gsol/ bdag 'khor dang 98—499

ṇi dha ba ni ra ma ṇi nyamā ②rta gi ge swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma ye shes chen por dbang bskur ldan pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ a ma ri/ a ma ri/ ta ṭa/ bhañdza bhañdzal/ dzha dzha / mi tsi mi tsi/ sbo chaṭa ya sbo chaṭa ya/ ma tha dum thasti/ dunān+ta dud ma ka swā hā / na maḥsarba ta thā posteg te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ he he/ ki na ⑩de / sarba ta thā ga ta bha ne ke/ bho dhi na dad/ tā ṭa tā ṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/gardza gardza/ pa ra ma ti/ bi hu ri ke swā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā yig te bh+yaḥ/ tsho8sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba btunye/ bha ga ba ti pradz+nyā pā tsor mi te a/ sarba pā pa k+ṣa yaṃ snyika ri dz+nyā na artsi s+pha ra ṇi / bhañdza bhañdza0/ ma tha ma tha/ da ma da ma/ ā na ya ā na ya/ sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sarba bud+dha dza ne tī yi 8swā hā/na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ gardza gardza/ ma tha yim tha0 ske/ dha ma dha ma/ bhañdza bhañdza0/ dus 39/ sarba nisgo gedu/ ha na ha na/bhi budhad+ma ya bi phyaṅgān ya/ mo ṭa ya mo ṭa ya/ da ha da ha/ bi phu la ni rmal nidzā 0te/ ā 0ha ra ā 6)ha ra/ gats+tsha ga60/ sarba bud+dha brgyu pa sa ti ma/mā bi las swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje'i dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ bha ga ba ti/ sarba ta thā ga ta dza ni 10 /pu ra ya pra ti dz+nyā na/ ta ṭa ta ṭa/marda marda/ ā ha ra 0ā ha ra/ hūṃ hūm̐ dza ti swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ba chen mo zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ hūṃ 29/ sarba bud+dha mā ti ri/ bhañdza bhañdzadu/ ma tha ④ma thaX/ da ma ni da ma ni/ gnā ri gnā ri trī tsos hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma 98—504

rdo rje mi pham ①ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ②te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ tā ṭa tā ṭa/ mu hu mu hu/ sarba pā pa bi sho dha ni swā hā/bcom ldan 'das ma sdig pa thams cad spong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ dha ka dha ka /mo ṭa mo ṭa/da ha da ha/ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na nidzā ②te stiswā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma gdul dka' ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ ha ha mi hu mi hu/ da ma da ma/ khā hi khā hi/ dhu na dhu na/mi tsi mi tsi/ dunān+ta dud ma ni swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdud thams cad rnam par 'joms ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/sarba mu khe bh+yaḥdu/ sarba thā/ mi tsi mi tsi/ gardza gardza/ sbo ⑦ṭa ⑧ya sbo dhiṭa ⑩ya/ma tha tsom tha'/ da ma da ma swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgo mtha' yas sgrub ⑫pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs so/ /'jam dpal ye shes chen por dbang bskur tsoba'i dkyil 'khor 'di gang gi lag na gnas pa de nyon mongs pa dang bral bar 'gyur/'jigs pa dang bral bar 'gyur/ de gal te chom rkun gyi tsonang na 'dug gam/srin po'i tsonang na 'dug gam/ dgra'i nang na 'dug gam/ 'thab pa'i nang na 'dug kyang rung ste/ de'i lus la mtshon gyis mi tshugs par 'gyur/ chom rkun gyis bcom par mi 'gyur/ srin po la sogs ⑩pas gtse bar mi 'gyur/de la dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung bar 'gyur/ rtag tu dpal dang ldan par 'gyur/ de'i sdig 8pa thams cad yongs su byang bar 'gyur / sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa yang de nyid spyil nyin gcig bzhin mngon du 'gyur/ 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe yang 98—505

tshog /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/①༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā rā ②bhasto nir ka nā ma aṣ+ṭa sha ta byarka⑤/bod skad du/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya bdu / rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la ①phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan yid 'ong po ṭa ⑧la/ /sna tshogs khams kyis rnam par spras/ /sna tshogs ljon pas bkram pa ste/ /skye gnyis du ma sgra 'byin pa/ /'bab chu sna tshogs ku co che/ /ri dgas ①sna tshogs 'khrugs pa ste/ /me tog sna tshogs rigs rnams kyis/ /kun du dri yis bkang ba ste/ /sna tshogs yid 'ong 'bras bur ldan/ /rkang pa drug pa glu yi sgra/ /mi 'am ci yi 0glu snyan len/ /glang chen smyon pas yang dag khengs7ske/ /rig 'dzin grub 8pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /dri za rnams kyang glu len pa/ /thub pa 'dod chags bral rnams dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs gzhan dang / /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams dang ni/ /'phags ma sgrol 98—509

sogs lha mo rnams/ /rig 0)pa'i rgyal mo stong rnams kyis/ /rtag tu legs par bsten (mipa'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po tshogs gzhan dang / /rta mgrin la sogs kyis bskor ba/ /sems can kun la phan par brtson/ /bcom ldan 'das ni spyan ras gzigs/ /bzhugs te de phyir dpal dang ldan/ /pad+ma'i snying po thub pa'i gdan / /dka' thub chen po dang ldan pa/ /byams pa dang ni snying rjer ldan/ / lha yi (gu'akhor ni chen po la/ /chos (gegasung ba ni yang dag bzhugs/ /de ru nyer 'dug yang dag langs/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /mchog tu snying rje dang ldan pas/ /spyan ras gzigs la zhus pa ste/ /rkun po sbrul dang seng ge me / /glang po stag dang chu 'jigs pas/ /zhi mdzad thub pas (5)sems can rnams / /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba rnams/ /'khor ba'i zhags pas bcings pa rnams/ /chags sdang gti mug dri ma las/ /gang gis sems can grol 'gyur ba/ /de gsungs bdag la thub chen po/ /'jig rten mgon pos 'di skad gsungs/ /dpal ldan de ni spyan ras gzigs/ /phyag na rdo rje rab rtogs byed/ /snyan pa'i tshig ni 'di skad gsungs/ /nyon cig gsang ba'i rgyal dbang po/ /skyob pa 'od dpag med pa yi/ /smon lam stobs kyis byung ba ste/ /nga yis 'jig rten ma ru (6)shes/ /snying rje che dang ldan pa yis/ /'gro ba 'don par brtson pa mo/ /nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra ba/ /zla ba nya 'dra byad kyi 'od/ /lha bcas mi dang lha min dang / /'di rnams thams cad gsal bar byed/ /'jig rten gsum po g.yo bar byed/ /gnod sbyin srin po 'jigs par byed/ /phyag na ut+pal (7)sngon po ste/ /ma 'jigs ma 'jigs zhes brjod ma/ /bar snang du ni 'phar bar gnas/ /'gro ba yang dag bsrung don du/ /mtshon gyi bskal 98—510

pa byung ba dang / /'jigs pa sna tshogs 'khrugs don du/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis ①bdag bskyed de/ /ming rnams dran pa nyid kyis ni/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis bsrung / /sna tshogs 'jigs pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis bsgral/ /des na bdag la 'jig rten du/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs kyis sgrol mar bsgrags/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni/ /spyan sngar 'dug ste ②'di skad gsol/ /gus dang bcas pas yang dag gnas/ /gang zhig rgyal bas sngon bsgrags pa/ /gsungs shig ②mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon rnams dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rab dga' ba'i/ /sdig pa spong ①byed bsod nams dang / /bkra shis grags pa 'phel bar byed/ /gter dang nor rnams 'phel byed nyid/ /nad rnams thams cad rlag par byed/ /dpal dang shis pa 'jog par byed/ /nad med tshe ni 'phel bar byed/ /sems can rnams la byams bsgoms la/ /de dag sgrogs shig thub chen po/ /'di skad zhus nas bcom ldan 'das/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rab tu bzhad//mchog rnams rab tu rnam gzigs nas/ /'di lta bu yi (5)byams pa spros(6)/ /phyag ni g.yas pas phyag thabs 6)mdzad/ /bsod nams mtshan nyid ldan pa yi/ /de gsungs shes rab shin tu che/ /legs so legs so dka' thub che/ /sems can kun la gcig tu brtse/ /skal ba chen po'i mi rnams nyon/ /mi rnams gang zhig 'di sgrogs pa/ /nor gyi dbang phyug yang dag 'gyur/ /nad rnams thams cad yang dag grol(8)/ /dbang phyug kun dang yang dag ldan/ /dus min 'chi ba nges par bsregs/ /'chi ba bde ba can 'gro ba/ /de rnams bdag gis bshad par bya/ / lha yi tsa)dge 'dun bdag la nyon/ /'di la rjes su yi rangs ⑩98—511

gyis / /legs par bsdams par gyur la bstod/ /oṃ dge ba can ni gzi brjid che/ /'jig rten gso byed snyan ①pa che/ /dbyangs can ma ni spyan yangs ma / /shes rab dpal dang blo 'phel ma/ /gso byed ma dang rgyas 'debs ma/ /swā hā/ oṃ gyis rnam pa 'dod gzugs ma/ /sems can kun la phan par brtson / /g.yul las sgrol ②byed rgyal ba mo/ /lha mo shes rab pha rol phyin/ /'phags ma sgrol ma yid 'ong ma/ /rdza rnga dung can rgyas pa mo/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo tshig snyan ma/ /zla ba'i gdong can dkar mo che/ /mi pham gos ni ser mo can / /sgyu ma chen mo dkar mo che/ /stobs po che la pha rol phyin/ /rtsub mo chen mo gtum chen mo/ /sdang ba'i sems kyis rlag byed ma/ /rab tu zhi ba zhi ba'i gzugs/ /rnam par rgyal ba 'bar ba'i 'od/ /glog gi phreng ba'i rgyal mtshan can/ /ral gri 'khor lo gzhu thogs mtshon/ /'chol byed rengs byed nag mo ni/ /mtshan mo nag mo mtshan spyod ma/ /srung byed rmongs byed zhi ba mo/ /mdzes ma dge ma 'dra ba'i lding / /tshangs pa mo dang rig byed mo/ /gsang ba mo ni brag phug gnas/ /bkra shis don byed zhi ba mo/ /skyes nas rig byed yid mgyogs ma/ /thod pa can ni shugs chen mo/ /tshangs ma bde ma gzhan mi rgyal//ded dpon chen mo snying rje gnas/ /chud zos pa la lam rab ston/ /mchog ster ster byed ston pa mo/ /bud med gzugs la dpag med gnon/ /ri khrod ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /grub ma gtum ma bdud rtsi ma/ /des ma nor can bsod nams ma/ /skal chen skal bzang nimadzes ston ma④/ /mthar byed skrag byed 'jigs byed ma/ /grags ⑤dang brtul zhugs chen mo ma/ /'gro la gcig tu phan par brtson/ /skyabs byed gus la gsong po ma/ /ngag gi dbang phyug zhi 98—512

༄ga /'phags ma rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can zhes bya ba/①༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dza ya ba tī ②nā ma ma hā bit+yā rā dzā/bod skad du/ 'phags ma rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can zhes bya ba/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das lus 'phags ri la bzhugs te/ de'i tshe 'byung po rnams 'khrugs par gyur nas/ ma dad pa'i lha dang ske/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / srul po dang /lus srul po dang / grul bum rnams 'khrugs shing khros te/ dge slong rnams dang —/ dge slong ma rnams dang / dge bsnyen rnams dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams gang dag sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la mngon par dad pa de dag la gnod par byed de de'i tshe ku co'i ①sgra chen po byung bar gyur to/ /98—521

de nas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po'i shugs kyis yang dag par zin nas phyogs bzhir rnam par gzigs te0)/ phyogs bzhi nas laglog chadang li/ ser ba dang / char chen 'bab pa dang / skar mda' ltung ba 'ong ba gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang rdo rje 'chang la brda mdzad do/ /de nas rdo rje 'chang gtum po khros te/ stan las langs nas shar phyogs su rdo rje 'bar ba stong mngon par sprul te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams nga la nyon cig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi spyan sngar bden pa'i byin gyi brlabs (ge'adi bya'o/ /da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'byung po gtum po mi rnams la rnam par 'tshe ba dang / lo tog dag kyang ma rungs par byed pa gang dag 'byung ba de dag gi don gyi phyir ngas rig pa'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams brjod par bya'o / /tar+ya thā/ gi ri gi ri badz+ra/ ha la ha la badz+ra/ dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra/ ha na ha na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ sarba khyu tā māṃ/ bhā stim ya bhā 9)ma ya/ bho bho badz+ra dha ra badz+re (8)kho/ pā ta stiya/ pā ta ⑩ya/ shī r+ghaṃ shī rgyu(spe / ma tha ma tha/ pra ma tha pra ma tha/ hūm̐ hūṃ tsū/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ dz+wa la 8ya/nā tunyeg bha bā 848/ brnya bad+dha/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ shar phyogs bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje snying po 'di byin gyis brlab ⑩par bya'o/ /su zhig gsang sngags kyi ⑩gzhi 'di dag las 'gal bar byed pa'i mgo bo 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /snying 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /snying 'grum par 'gyur ro/ /badzā tunyeya swā hā/ ma hā badzā ⑩ya swā hā/ badz+ra sum̐ )lha ra bā ya swā hā/ a pra ti ha ta ba la pa rā ( sgyekra mo badz+ra dha ra ā ⑫dz+nyā pa ya ti duswā hā/ de nas rdo rje khro bo stan las langs te lho phyogs su rnam par bltas nas khros te gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /98—522

gsang ba pa'i bdag po nged 6)nyid lho phyogs kyi klu thams cad thal bar brlag (migo / /lus sprul nipo thams cad kyi bar gyi gnas rnams 'bar bar bya'o/ /klu thams cad kyi gnas rnams dkrug par bya'o/ /yang smras pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po bdag gi rdo rje lha ma yin dang / klu thams cad nas lus srul po'i bar thams cad dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar thams cad rmugs par byed pa'i rdo rje/ rengs par byed pa'i rdo rje/ rmongs par byed pa'i rdo rje/ lce 'bab par byed pa'i rdo rje/ mgo 'gems par byed pa'i rdo rje/ snying 'gas par byed pa'i rdo rje 'di lho phyogs su gzhag par bya ste/ da ltar byung ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na klu gnod par sems pa rnams 'dul bar 'gyur ro/ /tar+ya thā/sa ra sa ra/ bi sa ra bi sa ra/ ā bablo ya/ saṃ stigo tsa la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dho na rnyo na dho na/ dhu na dhu na dhu na/ brnya brnya brnya/ sarba pā (geshe na(nya/ mo ha ya/dzam+bha ya/ stam+bha ya/ ha sa ha sa ha sa/ sar+sā sa yak+ṣa/ sarba duṣ+ṭa ⑧〈6)/ badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā ⑩pa ya ti swā hā/ de nas rdo rje tunyepho nya mos lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po da ltar dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na gang dag gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag las 'gal bar bgyid na bdag gis kyang nub phyogs kyi klu thams cad nas lus srul po'i bar thams cad kyi gnas rnams rnam par gtor ro/ /snying rnams dgum mo/ /tar+ya thā/ ki li ki li/ mi li mi li/ tra ṭa 8tra ṭa8/ bha ṭa bha ṭa/ sbo ṭa ④ya sbo ṭa 7ya/ dz+wa tsol ya dz+wa tu 7la ya/ dru ti da yaṃ/ sho ṣa ya/ gang zhig gsang sngags kyi tsogazhi 'di dag las 'gal bar byed (nyen/ kye mdung rtse gsum pa 'bar ba 'dis de'i snying la me lce 'bar bar byed do/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ badz+ra dha ri badz+re ṇa( kye / bhañdza bhañdza/ brnya 98—523

brnyahunye / tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ badz+ra dru dzubati/ rā dz+nyā ①pa ya ti swā hā/ de nas lha mo chen mo rdo rje lu gu rgyud g.yog nyi khri dang bcas pa ①stan las langs nas byang phyogs su rnam par bltas te/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po g.yog nyi khri dang ldan pa bdag gis kyang byang phyogs kyi klu gnod par sems pa nas lus srul po gnod par sems pa'i bar dag la bzlog par bgyid do(nya/ /da ltar dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na gang dag sems can rnams la rnam par 'tshe ba dang / lo tog kyang ma rungs par bgyid pa de dag gi don gyi slad du gsang sngags kyi ⑥gzhi mi bzad pa dag kyang brjod par bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi yi tsi li tsi li( bye dha ka (0dha ka /dhū postem dhū ⑩mayi/ dhu na dhu na/ ma tha ma tha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ nā 8sha ya nā sha ya/ ha ha ha ha ha/ badz+ra dru tu)ti ④mo ha 8ya / dzam+bha yiya/ stam+bha ⑩ya/ sarba nā gā dzā(nye/ sarba a hi te (7ga ṇi4)/ badz+ra ṇi 6sprebud+dha mi tridu/ dha rma satre na( nye/ in+d+ra sarkye na/ in+d+ra bā (stele na/ lo ka pā la / pra bhā be na/ dzam+bha yā mi/ sarba nā gā nā stam+bha yā tsomi/ sarba i ha 0te ṣi ṇi tshul/ ba ru na pā pa she na/ brnya phyi'i mi/ sarba nā gā nā 0in+d+ra tsi le 〉kyi /sarba a hi 0te ṣi ṇa tsha ga li ka ro mi/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/badz+ra shaṃ ka le swā hā/ ba'i lci bas dkyil 'khor bskus te/ me tog bkram la/a ga (nyeru dang / tsan+dan gyi bdug rdunyepas bdugs ④te/ kha shar phyogs su bltas la bzlas brjod brgyad stong bya'o/ /de ltar 'grub par 'gyur te/ de'i 'og tu las gang 'dod pa de bya'o/ /skud pa nag pos ni rims nad sel to/ /shing ka ra bī (nyera'i ⑩lhag mas ni sprin zlog go/ /chu'i nang du 'dug na ni dran 98wa 524

par bya'o/ /gcan gzan ①khro bo'i nang na ②'dug na ni gos kyi mtha' mar mdud pa bor ro/ /lto sbos ③na ni tshwa chus zhi bar byed do/ /so na ba la skud pas zhi bar byed do/ /sna duma'i me tog brgyad brgya me tog re re nas bcom ldan 'das kyi duzhabs la gtor ro/ /nyi ma bdun na de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na ③tra yā ya/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa duye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā ⑧pa ta ye/ a 0pra ti ha ta pa la pa bya'o kra tsom ye/ na maḥsarba badz+ra ku la bit+yā/ de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje rdo rje'i rigs lnga brgyas yongs su bskor zhing mdun du bdar nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste/ sems can thams cad la sman pa'i don dang /mi'i rgyal po rnams la sman pa dang / bde bar bgyi ba'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pas rig ⑩sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can zhes bgyi ba 'di bka' stsal du gsol / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba 8pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas gsungs shing byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ ngas kyang da 'thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung tsonas/ sems can thams cad kyi don dang phan pa dang bde bar bya ba'i phyir bshad kyis khyod kyis zung tunyeshig /tabya thā/ dza ye dza ye/ ma hā 0dza ye/ dza ya bā ha nī 8ye bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha te / dharma a ba bhā sa de8/ budha a dhi ga me dz+nyā na a ba bhā tsose swā hā/ lag 98—525

na rdo rje 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi zhi)rnams te/ lag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag gang gi lus la yod pa dang /glegs bam la yod par gyur pa de'i lus la phyir rgol ba rnams kyis dpag tshad brgya tshun chad gnod par byar mi chud do/ /mtshon dang / dug dang / dbyig dug dang / byad rin)kyis mi tshugs so/ /mi'i bdag po dbang po de'i yul der pha rol gyi dmag tshogs mi 'ong ngo / /yul 'khor der phyir rgol ba'i dpung ①gis mi chud (4)par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje rigs kyi bu gang la la zhig gis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di yi ger bris te/ 'chang ba de ji srid 'tsho'i ri5)bar du de'i lus la dug dang / mtshon dang / chu dang / dbyig dug dang / sbyar ba las byung ba'i dug gzhan gyis kyang mi tshugs so/ /dgra'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /de la rnam par 'tshe ba dang / tho (6)'tsham pa mi 'byung ngo / /rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang / chom rkun gyi 4)'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /g.yul ngor zhugs na yang lus la mtshon gyis mi phog go/ /thams cad du rgyal ba smra bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di'i gzi brjid dang / mthu dang byin gyi brlabs (kyikyis thogs pa med cing ma snad ma smas 6)par rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /tar+ya thā/ dza ye dza ye dza ye/ ma hā dza ye/dza yot+ta 7me/ dharma a ba bhā (17sa ni/ bud+dha budha/ dha ra dha ra/ bo dha ni bo dha ni / ta thā ga ta tsos dhikhyi te/ a ba ro ha ṇiyoge/ a ba ro ha ṇiñtsa/ a 8ba ro bya ni/ dza ya ku su me/ swa yire swa re yib ti/ dṛ nye dṛ nye dṛ nye/ dṛ hunyenye pā ⑪sha ni darte/ mo ( )ha ni/ mo ha ni/ dzam+bha ni/ dzam+bha ni/ stam+bha ni/ stam+bha ni/98—526

dzartsi ni dzasti ni①/ mo ha ②ni/ sablo hi ①te rtsi'i (5)nan/ na mo bha ga ba toyi/bud+dha su ma hā kā 3)ru ṇa/ bi hā ri ni/ sidh+yan+tu (8)me man+t+ra pā dā dzinani swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs tshudang / bdag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can gyi gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams brjod par bgyi'o/ /tar+ya thā/dza ya dza ya dza ya/ pa ṭa pa ṭa pa ṭa/ dz+wa la dz+wa la dz+wa la/ badz+re ṇi3nya/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ dha ra dha ra dha ra/ ha ra ha ra ha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ta ra ta ra/ dza ya ku su me/ ba la ba la/ tsakra tsakra/ bī ḍa 4)ya r+pā ḍa tunyeya/a kra ma a kra ma/ bi kra me/ a tsa le/ ma tsa le/ kha ga tsā ri ṇi/ nī tshul bha skyos ni/ badz+ra pra ha ra ṇitshe/ badz+ra sam+bha be(nya/ badz+ra ki thali/ bud+dha/ a dhiṣ+ṭha te/bud+dha rasmi/ ma hā pra bha be/ uts+tsha (6skan+dhe/ ma hā te dza ( )ba ti/ a le pa tsa le/dhu na dhu na dhu na/ gang ka zho stekang ka re/ ka si ni sa ma he te dharma a ba bhā (rtas ni/tsa ra tsa ra tsa ra/ ghu ghu te(ste/ badz+ra mā lā dha ri/ sa ra sa ra sa ra( )/ kā lā tsā tsor 69ṇ+ḍi swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi (1gzhi ( sredag ni sangs rgyas bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgus gsungs pa lags te/ gang dag rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di las 'gal bar bgyid pa de dag thams cad ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la 'khu ba lags so/ /'di lta ste/ lha'am/ klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'am/ yi dgas sam/sha za'am/ grul bum mamane// grib gnon nam/ brjed nu 7byed dam/ gshed byed dam/ byad dam/ ro langs sam/ bkra mi shis pa'am/ ma mo'i gdon 98—527

nam / gang 6)du yang gdon gzhan nam/ skem byed kyi gdon nam/ gshin rje'i gdon yang rung ste/ de dag thams cad rmugs pa dang / rengs pa dang /rmongs par ⑧gyur cig /tabya thā/ badz+re badz+re badz+re/ ha na badz+rel/ ni ༷ha na badz+re / khā da khā da(snye/ badz+re aṇal/ sī ṭa ya sī niṭa ya/ badz+re ṇa/ i rda ⑨ga ha na/ hūm̐ hūm̐ rtsu/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ gra sa gra sa gra sa/ pā ta ya pā ta ya pā ta ya / dha me/ dha dha me/ dhu dhu me/ 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa thams cad dang / g.yul 'gyed pa dang / khrag khrug dang / 'thab pa dang / 'thab ⑩mo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad las bdag la srungs shig srungs shig /rgyal bar mdzad ma rgyal bar mdzod cig /ta ra ta ra ta ra/ ma hā ba ta ra rtetunye/ ku ṭi tsoku she8/ mu ku ṭi tsobadz+ra ku ṭi byas hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la legs so zhes bya ba byin te lag na rdo rje legs so legs so/ /sems can thams cad kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde bar bya ba dang / snying brtse ba'i phyir zhugs te/rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di smras pa ni sems can chen po tsolag na rdo rje khyod yang legs so/ /lag na rdo rje rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di su'i lag na yod pa dang / lus la yod pa dang / glegs bam la yod pa dang / grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ rgyal po'i pho brang ngam/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ gnas khang ngam/ 'chag sa'am/dgon pa'i gnas na yod pa der rgyal po chen po rnam ⑩thos kyi bu tshogs kyi g.yog 'khor dang bcas te/ grong dang / grong khyer dang / yul de la srung 8ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /yul der pha rol gyi dmag tshogs mi 'ong ngo mi ngas mi 98—528

'ong ngo / /dgra mi 'byung ngo / /sa phyogs der rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu tshogs kyi g.yog dang bcas te/ grong dang / grong khyer dang / yul de la srung 6)ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /yul der pha rol gyi dmag tshogs mi 'ong ngo / /dgra mi 'byung ngo / /sa phyogs der rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig ②tu rgyu zhing der srung ba dang / yongs su skyob pa dang / yongs su 'dzin pa dang / yongs su skyong ba dang / zhi ba dang ske/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa spong ba dang / mtshon cha spong ba dang / dug gzhil ba dang / dug gsad pa dang / dug gzhig pa dang /mi mdza' ②ba bzlog pa dang / mtshams gcad pa dang / sa bcing ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /tabya thā/ ta pa ne/ ta pa ne/ ta pa ne/ pra ta pa ne/ pra ta pa ne/ pra ta pa ne/ dhu ru me/ dhu ru me/ dhu ru me/ ma hā dhu ru me/ bud+dha a rnyikhri ④te/ mu khe mu khe su mu khe/ swa la pra ti dus mā dhi sa mā dhi gar+bhe/ mā na sil/ phu ru phu dhu ru dhu ru/ bud+dha mā na si ke swā hā/ lag na rdo rje 'di dag ni de bzhin gsheg pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'o/ /gsang ba'i gnas so / /de bzhin gshegs thams cad kyi gsang chen no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis/brlabs pa'o/ /lag na rdo rje mi'i rgyal po gang la la zhig gis rig sngags kyi rgyas mo chen mo rgyal ba can zhes bya ba 'di 0glegs bam la legs par bris te 'tshung ngam/ lus la yod par byas te 'chang ngam/ spos dang ske/ phreng ba dang / )rgyug pa dang / me tog sna tshogs kyi rgyan rnams kyis de la bsti ④stang du byed/ bla ra sibyed/ ri mor byed cing mchod na/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu gnod sbyin bye chibacu khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig 5 98—529

tu mi'i (1)rgyal po de'i phyi ②bzhin du 'brang zhing / phyir rgol ba thams cad las srung ba (7byed par 'gyur ro/ /mi'i bdag po dbang po de la dgra dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis glags mi rnyed do④/ /yul der pha rol gyi dpung mi 'jug go/ /'jug na yang de dag la rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu bgegs byed par 'gyur te/ bgegs sna tshogs brgya dag dang / bgegs sna tshogs stong dag byed par 'gyur ro/ /mi'i rgyal po de dag gang dang gang du 'gro ba de dang der rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can zhes bya ba 'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse (5)mo la btags te mdun du gzhag (6)par bya'o/ /gang du g.yul 'gyed dam/dgra chen po dang 'thab pa der yang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can zhes bya ba 'di mgul du btags te g.yul ngor zhugs na/ der rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus pha rol gyi dmag tshogs de la gnod pa 'dis gnod par byed de/de pham par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can zhes bya ba 'di su'i mgul du thogs pa de ni rgyal bar (7)'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje grong ngam/grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ rgyal po'i pho brang ngam/gtsug lag khang gang du nad 'go (kyeb sna tshogs dang / mi ngas mi bzad pa chen po byung ba der rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo 6)rgyal ba can 'di la me tog sna tshogs kyi bla re bres la gtor ma'i cho ga gzhong ⑩khung bzhi ro bro ba sna tshogs kyis bkang ste phyogs bzhir bzhag la/ de rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di bklags na (rmider rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu tshogs kyi g.yog 'khor dang bcas te gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu nad 'go ba dang / mi ngas de rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 98—530

par 'gyur ba der rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i tshogs kyi g.yog dang bcas pas 7grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ yul de bsrung bar 'gyur ro / /yul de pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /sa phyogs der mi ngas mi 'byung ngo / /dgra mi 'byung ngo / /rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phyi bzhin 'brang ba dang lhan cig der sung ngo / /yongs su skyob bo/ /yongs su 'dzin to/ /zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba byed do/ /chad pa spong ngo ②/ /mtshon cha spong ngo / /dug gsod do/ — /mi mdza' ba 'gog go/ /mtshams gcod do/ /sa gcod do/ /tar+ya thā/ ta pa ni ( nita pa ni(pe/ pra ta pa nizhu)/ dhu ru me/ dhu ru me/ bud+dha a rnyikhri te/ mu khe/mu khe/ su mu khe/ su mu khe/ pra la pra la teyi/ sa mā dhi te/ sa mā dhi gar+bhe/ sa mā dhi gar+bhe/( ) mā na si/ phu ru phu ru phu ru dhu ru/ bud+dha mā na si ke swā hā/lag na rdo rje 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'o/ /gsang ba'i gnas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /lag na rdo rje mi'i rgyal po gang (8)la la zhig gis rig tho)sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di glegs bam la legs par bris te 'chang ngam/ lus la btags te 'chang zhing de la spos dang —/ phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / me tog sna tshogs kyi yilhab lhub kyis bsti stang yonyedu byed/ bla mar byed/ ri mor byed/ mchod par byed na/ mi'i rgyal po de la rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu gnod sbyin phyi bzhin 'brang ba bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /mi'i rgyal po de la phyir rgol ba dang / dgra dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad kyis 98—543

glags mi rnyed do/ /mthus yul der 'jug pa dang bgegs 'jug na yang rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu bgegs sna tshogs brgya dang / bgegs sna tshogs stong byed par 'gyur ro/ /mi'i rgyal po'i gang dang gang du 'gro ba de dang der rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te mdun du bkur bar bya'o/ /gang du g.yul ngor 'jug gam/ dgra chen po dang 'thab pa der rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di mgul ①du btags te / g.yul ngor zhugs na der rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus pha rol gyi dmag tshogs de pham par byed par 'gyur ro/ /de ni rgyal bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di su'i mgul du btags pa de rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ljongs sam/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor gang du gal te nad 'go ba sna tshogs dang /mi ngas mi bzad pa chen po byung na/ der rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di dang / me tog sna tshogs dang / cho ga dang / gtor ma dang /bum pa btung ba sna tshogs kyis bkang ba bzhi phyogs bzhir bzhag ste/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di bklags ②na de'i tshe rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu tshogs kyi g.yog dang bcas shing / gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu nad 'go ba dang / mi ngas de rab tu zhi bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba ②pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di las lhag pa'i rig sngags ches stobs dang ldan pa'am/ gzi brjid che ba'am/ rdzu 'phrul che ba'am/mthu che ba gang yang ma mchis so/ /rig sngags thams cad kyi mchog /rig 98—544

sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di yul gang dang gang du spyod par 'gyur ba'i gnas de dang de dag tu sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed ①par 'gyur ro/ /tabya thā/ badz+re badz+re badz+re/ a mṛ ②ta badz+re/ dz+wa li ta ①badz+ra/ hu tā sha ni/ bhañdza bhañdza bhañdza bhañdza/rgya dzam+bha/ stam+bha ya/ sarba gra hā tsā/ hūṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa / gra sa gra sa gra sa/ pa ṭa pa ṭa pa ṭa/ ta ṭa ta ṭa ta ṭa/ mu ru mu ru mu ru / dha ma dha ma dha ma/ dz+wa la dz+wa la dz+wa la/ khu khu me/ khu khu me/ gho ri gho ri gho ri/ badz+ra mā na si/ badz+ra hu ti/ hu ti ru/ phu ru phu ru/ gra sa gra sa/sarba a hi ti ṣi shā/ nā bu ru ṇirtsi/ mu mu le/ badz+ra pra dī pā ⑥ni/ tsi ⑦ma le phu swā hā/ ā (9yuḥ6)bā la ni tsu tsu re swā hā/ dza ye dza ye/ dza ya sam+bha be swā hā/dza yot+ta 7me swā hā/ dza ya ba re yide swā hā/ dza yad+dha re swā hā/ dza ya mā na si swā hā / dza ya badz+ra swā hā/ a dzi ta badzā ya swā hā/ ma hā badz+ra hu tā sha nā kyiya swā hā/a mo gha badz+ra hasta ya swā hā/ de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la bsrung ba stsal bar bgyi(ste/yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ④ba dang / chad pa spong tsob dang /mtshon cha spong ⑩ba dang / dug dgum pa dang / mi mdza' ba dgag pa dang /dus ma lags par 'gum pa dgag pa dang / 'thab pa dang / 'thab 7mo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / g.yul 'gyed pa dang / khrag khrug ⑫dang ske/ 'jigs pa thams cad dgag par bgyi'o/ /mtshams dgum par bgyi'o / /tar+ya thā/ dza ye dza ye dza ye/ ma hā dza ye/ mi li ma na si/ sna jo jo/98—545

༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ma hā lagli tī (misru tra/ bod skad du/'phags pa dpal chen mo'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das bde ba can na bzhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la bskor ba lan gsum byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal chen mo la gzigs nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dpal chen mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis po 'di dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ de ma yin pa gzhan yang rung ste/98—551

gang gis shes pa dang / gang la la 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / 'dri ①ba dang / 'drir ②'jug pa de ni dbul ba bor te phyug por 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyis de ltar gyur cig ces kun nas gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal chen mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis po bka' stsal pa 'di lta ste/ dpal ldan ma/ bkra shis ma/ pad+ma'i phreng ba can/ nor gyi bdag mo/ dkar mo/ grags pa chen mo/ pad+ma'i spyan/ byed pa mo/ 'od chen mo/ zas sbyin ma/ rin po che rab tu sbyin ma/ dpal chen mo/ sngad ①ya the dan/ dzi ni/ sgri ni/ sarba ar+sha sā dha ni/ sha shi ni a lagli ni/ me nā ④sha ya sidh+yan+tu ⑤man+t+ra pa dāḥyiswā hā/ oṃ ṣ+ṭṛ ⑦ku ṭī ba ra ma su bha ge swā hā/ lan gsum du brjod par bya ste/ gang la la dus gsum du 'don pa de'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /skal ba bzang po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /'byor pa zad mi shes par 'gyur 'o⑧/ /mi dang phrad du 'gro ba'i tshe bklags yonyenas phrad par byas na mi des de la bu'i 'du shes skyed par 'gyur te dga' bar 'gyur la ji skad ⑩bsgo ba bzhin byed do/ /rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bklags yin tshangs pa dang bram zes drag shul gyi las byas kyang mi tshugs par 'gyur la/ sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas par yang 'gyur rol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa dpal chen mo'i mdo rdzogs sotso// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi tson mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de 8ye shes 98—552

dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma 'am/sems can gang su yang rung bas dpal chen mo 'di'i 6)ming bcu gnyis shes te(ge/'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / sgrub par byed pa dang / rjod par yang byed na de dbul po spangs nas phyug po chen por 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad (7kyis kyang de bzhin du gyur cig ces smras so/ /dpal lha mo chen mo'i ming bcu gnyis ni 'di lta ste/ bkra shis ma/ dpal ldan ma/pad+ma'i phreng thogs ma/ nor bdag ma/ dkar sham ma/ grags chen ma/pad+ma spyan mnga' ma/ grags ma/ 'od chen ma/ zas sbyin ma/ rin chen 'od ldan ma/ dpal chen mo ma/ sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di lta ste/ dzi ni/ gh+ri ṇi/ dgos pa thams cad sgrub par mdzad pa/ si mi si mi/ ni mi ni mi/ bdag gi mi shes pa thams cad bsal bar mdzod (4)cig swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa la mngon par dga'o/ /dpal gyi lha mo chen mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis pa rdzogs so(ge// // rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa (6)98—555

tshog /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ba su dhā rā phyinā ma dhā ra tsā/ bod skad du / 'phags pa nor gyi rgyun ces bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das kau shāsbyi srin tsher ma can zhes bya ba'i nags mchog chen po na/ dge slong lnga brgya tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi ④yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa rab tu mang po dang thabs cig 0tu bzhugs te/ de'i tshe kau shāsbyi'i ⑥grong khyer chen po na khyim bdag zla ba bzang po zhes bya ba/ dbang po nye bar zhi ba / yid nye bar zhi ba/ bu pho dang / bu mo mang ba/ bza' ⑦mi mang po dang ldan pa/ dad cing cher dad pa zhig gnas pa de/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/98—557

lan 'bum phrag du mar (1)bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag zla ba bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyim bdag khyod 9geci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang / khyod kyis tsho noji skad dris pa'i dri ba lung bstan pas ngas khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos bcom ldan 'das 4༄legs so zhes gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dbul por gyur pa (snyelas ji ltar dbul ba ma mchis par 'gyur zhing / bro nad kyis (6)thebs na yang bro nad ma mchis par 'gyur ba lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen bzhin du khyim bdag zla ba bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyim bdag khyod ci'i phyir dbul po'i don du 'dri/ de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni dbul ba mang ba dang / gso ba mang ba/ bu pho dang /bu mo mang ba/ bza' 7mi mang po dang ldan pa lags te/ de'i slad du gang gi (8)sems can dbul po rnams kyi 9dbul ba ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / bro nad kyis thebs pa rnams bro nad ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / nor dang /98—558

'bru dang / mdzod dang / bang mdzod mang po dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang /sdug pa dang / yid du mchi ba dang / mthong na yid du 'thad pa dang /dbang phyug tu 'gyur ba dang / sbyin bdag mdzod pas mi 'tshal zhing / dbyig dang / gser dang / nor dang / 'bru'i mdzod dang / bang mdzod rnams dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / rdo rje dang / bai ḍūr+ya 6)dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi ru dang / sa le sbram dang / dbul bas ma 'tshal cing 'byor par 'gyur ba dang / khyim gyi bu smad dang / bza' zhi)mi rnams brtan par 'gyur ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs de bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ( snakhyim bdag zla ba bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyim bdag 'das pa'i dus bskal pa grangs med pa 'das par gyur pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ci)ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i dbyangs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ rigs kyi bu ngas de bzhin gshegs pa de las nor gyi rgyun ces bya ba'i gzungs 'di thos te bzung zhing bcangs/ bklags55)/kun chub par byas/ rjes su yi rang par 75)byas shing (7/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan te/ rigs kyi bu de 8)yang ngas de bshad par bya'o / /rigs kyi bu gzungs sngags 'di'i mthus mi rnams rnam par tho (97'tsham par mi byed do/ /mi ma yin pa rnams rnam par tho 1 'tsham par mi byed do/ /98wa 559

gnod sbyin rnams rnam par tho ①'tsham par mi byed do/ /srin po rnams rnam par tho (mi'atsham par mi byed do/ /yi dgas rnams rnam ①par tho ④'tsham par mi byed do/ /sha za rnams rnam par tho (nya'atsham par mi byed do/ /'byung po rnams rnam par tho nya'atsham par mi byed do/ /grul bum rnams rnam par tho ⑦'tsham par mi byed do/ /brjed nibyed rnams rnam par tho 6)'tsham par mi byed do/ /gnon po rnams rnam par tho yi'atsham par mi byed do/ /lus srul po rnams rnam par tho ⑩'tsham par mi byed do/ /lha ma yin rnams rnam par tho 8'tsham par mi byed do/ /zas su mi 8gtsang ba za ba rnams dang / zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang /zas su khrag 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su sha za ba rnams dang / zas su rnag 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su zhag za ba rnams dang / zas su rkang za ba rnams dang / zas su ngar snabs za ba rnams dang / zas su stor 8khung nas 'bab pa za ba rnams dang / zas su dbugs 8chub pa dang / 'byung ba za ba'i bar rnams rnam par 'tshe bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gi khyim na yod dam/ snying la yod dam/ lag na yod dam/ glegs bam du chud dam/ thos par gyur tamane/ kun chub par byas sam/ bklags tsosam/ bzung ngam/ rjes su yi rang ⑩bar byas sam/ gzhan dag la rgya cher rab tu bstan pa'i rigs kyi bu'amatunye / rigs kyi bu mo de la yun ring po'i don dang / phan pa dang / dge ba dang / grub pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs par 'gyur ro/ /su zhig de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod pa byas te/ nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di nam phyed na lan gnyis sam/ lan gsum mamatso/ lan bzhi bton na de'i lha 98—560

yi ①rangs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la dga' ba dang / chos gdags pa byas pas dga' ba dang / dge 'dun gdags pa byas pas dga' ba dang ske/ chos smra ba la dga' ba dang ②lhag pa'i bsam pas bdag nyid 'ongs te 'bru'i char 'bebs so/ /na mo badz+ra dudha ra sā gar ④nisgo eṣā ya/ ta thā ga tā yaX / tabya thā/ oṃ su rū 〈pe/ bha dre/ bha dā ba ti/ aṅga le/ maṅga le/maṅga la ba til/ a le/ a tsa le/ a tsa la ⑨ba le/ ut+ta ta ni/ yudhe ⑩da ni / bsu ba ti/ dā na pa ti/ dha n+ya pa ⑩ti/ shrī tsom ti/ pra bha ba 8ti/a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma ④le/ ru ru/ su rū tipe/ su rū ⑩pa ma le bi ma le/ tsa le/ artsa naste/ a na naste/ bi na naste/ bi shwa tshuke shi/ bi shwa ⑫ni shi/ asku re/ masku re/ pra bsku re/ bī char me/du bi dha me/ ri ri me/di di me/ du du me/ kha kha me/ ta ta re/ ta ra ta ra/ tā ra tā ra/ badz+re badz+re badz+re ba me0/ ṭa ke ṭa ke/ ṭha ke ṭha ke/ ༷ske()/ suk+kihū/ ṭha ke ṭha ra ke / a brta ni/ ba ra sha na/ ṣa da ni tsobadz+ra dhā phyir sā ga ra nisgo iṣān/ ta thā ga ta ma ⑦nu sma ra/ sma ra/ sma phyir/ sarba ta thā ga ta0/ sat+ya ma nu sma ra / dharma sat+ya 0ma nu sma ra/ sat+ta sat+ya ma nu sma ra/sgro da ṭa da ṭa/ pū ra pū ra / pu ra ya/ pu ra ya/6) pu ra ṇi0/ bha ra bha ra ṇiñtsa/ a ma le/ su maṅga le/ shān+ta ma ti/ shu bha tsom ti/ maṅga la bha ni/ ma hā ma ⑩ti/ bha dra ba ti / pra bha ba ti/ su tsan+d+ra ma ti/ ā gats+tsha ā gtsu'u/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra swā hā / ā tsob ra ṇi ⑥ma nu sma ra swā hā/ pra bha ba ma nu sma ra swā hā/ dri dī 0ma nu sma ra swā hā/ te dzo 0ma nu sma ra swā hā/ bi dza ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ skṛ 9da ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ sarba sa twa 9bi na ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ oṃ ba su dhā skyire swā 98—561

hā / oṃ ba su shri 0)ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī ba su swā hā/ oṃ ba su swā hā/ rigs kyi bu 'di ni nor (5)rgyun ces bya ba'i gzungs te/ gzungs sngags 'di'i mthus mu ge dang / nad dang / 'chi ngas (5)'byung bar mi 'gyur rong)/ /rigs kyi bu su zhig de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 5la mchod pa 6༄byas te/ nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs kyi ⑦gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag nub gcig bton na/ de nas dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /rgyas pa'i don du bdag gi khyim mam58)/ gzhan gyi khyim mamapo'e/ gnas gtsang ma bang mdzod dam/ gnas gang du layang rung bar de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / gsang sngags kyi lha'i phyir tsan+dan gyis /medakyil 'khor gru bzhir byas te nub gcig bton na/ rigs kyi bu de'i khyim nor dang / 'bru dang /gser dngul dang / yo byad thams cad kyi rgyun mi chen po'i mtshan tsam gyis gang bar 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa dang / gnod pa thams cad kyang med par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir khyod rab tu bsgrims 4snyel nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di zung tsho shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /ston cig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston cig dang / de khyod kyi yun ring po'i don dang / phan pa dang / bde bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te/ khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos bcom ldan 'das las nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di thos nas tshim zhing dga' la mgu zhing yi cirangs te rab tu dga' nas/ dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces 98—562

gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis nor gyi rgyun ces bgyi ba blangs lags/gzungs su zin lags bzung 0)lags/ bklags (gelags/ kun chub par bgyis lags/ rjes su yi rang bar bgyis lags te/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan par bgyi lags so/ /de'i skad cig tsam la khyim bdag zla ba bzang po'i bang mdzod rnams yongs su gang bar gyur to/ /de nas khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos bcom ldan 'das la lan 'bum phrag du mar bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod song la khyim bdag zla ba bzang po'i khyim nor dang (5)/ 'brus yongs su gang ba phun sum tshogs pa dang /mdzod chen po dang / bang mdzod yongs su gang ba rnams la (4)ltos/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas kau shāsbyi'i (5)grong khyer chen po ga la ba dang / khyim bdag zla ba bzang po'i khyim ga la ba der song ste phyin nas nang du zhugs pa dang / nor dang / 'brus yongs su gang ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / rin po che phun sum tshogs pa dang / yo byad thams cad kyi mdzod chen po dang / bang mdzod rnams kyang yongs su gang bar mthong ngo —/ /mthong nas kyang tshim zhing dga' la mgu (nerazhing yi (7)rangs te rab tu dga' nas dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ya mtshan du 'dzin cing /dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gis khyim bdag zla ba bzang po nor mang 98—563

zhing mdzod chen po dang / bang mdzod rnams kyang nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu khyim bdag zla ba bzang po dad cing mchog tu dad cing dge ba'i bsam pa can des nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di bzung zhing ①rab tu bton te/ blangs shing / bklags②/ kun chub par byas/ rjes su yi rang bar byas shing / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /kun dga' bo de'i phyir khyod kyis kyang nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs ①'di long ④shig /chongs shig /lhogs ⑤sheg /ston cig /zung ⑥shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston cig dang / de ni skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang /'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / skye bo phal po che dang / lha dang / mi rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo su zhig rig sngags 'di las gzhan du smra ba ni lha dang bcas pa dang / bdud dang bcas pa dang / tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang / dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa dang /lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten na ngas ma mthong ngo / /lan gnyis su bton 9)tam/ lan gsum du bton kyang 'gal bar byed pa de ni gnas med do/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ni mi phyed pa yin no/ /kun dga' bo 'di dag ni sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba zad pa rnams kyi rna lam du grags 6)par mi 'gyur na glegs bam la yi ger bri ba dang yid la gzung ba lta ci smos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bka' ste/ gzungs sngags 6)'di ni sems can dbul po dang /98—564

zhes bya ba'i rig sngags/①khug /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tsak+ṣur ③bi sho dha ni nā ma bit+yā man+t+ra②/bod skad du/ 'phags pa mig rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i rig sngags/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das shākya'i ④grong rdal bzang po zhig na shākya rnams kyi nang na bzhugs ①te/ de'i tshe sta tu sa zhes bya ba na shākya bde ba zhes bya ba sangs rgyas la mngon par dad pa/ chos dang / dge 'dun la mngon par dad pa/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song / chos la skyabs su song / dge 'dun la skyabs su song / sangs rgyas la gcig tu phyogs/chos la gcig tu phyogs/ dge 'dun la gcig tu phyogs/ sangs rgyas la nem nur med cing the tshom med/ chos dang dge 'dun dang / sdug bsngal ba dang /kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam la nem nur med cing the tshom med 98—569

la bden pa mthong ba/ 'bras bu thob pa/ mngon par rtogs par gyur pa/mtshon cha dang / dbyig 1pa bor ba zhig gnas pa de'i mig la snang ba dang /mi snang ba'i gzugs rnams snang bar ma gyur nas/ de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la dad pa skyes te yid la byed cing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das snang ba mdzad pa/ sgron ma 'dzin pa/ gsal ba 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ gsal na bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi mig rnam par sbyong ( nodu gsol zhes byas pa 94)dang / bcom ldan 'das lha'i gnas pa la bzhugs pa/ lha'i snyan rnam par dag pa mi las 'das pas shākya bde bas tshig de skad brjod pa gsan to/ /gsan nas kyang ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo (5skul bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod song la mig rnam par sbyong ba'i (6)rig sngags 'dis shākya bde ba la bsrung ba gyis shig /yongs su gzung ri 7)ba dang / yongs su bskyab (8)pa dang /yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde 9)legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / mtshon cha spang ba dang / dug gzhil ba dang / dug gsad pa dang / mtshams gcad pa dang / sa bcing ba gyis yishig /de dang de bzhin du 'khor bzhi po dge slong rnams dang / dge slong ma rnams dang /dge bsnyen rnams dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams dang / sems can gzhan gyi mig kyang rnam par sbyongs shig /mig gi sbubs rnam 11par sbyongs shig /mig gi skyon med par gyis shig /tar+ya thā/ hi li mi li/ ki li mi li/ hi li te mi li / hu yā hu yā hu yā ma ni/ hu lu hu lu hu lu hu du hu du hu du/ tsak+ṣur me bi 98—570

sho dha ya swā hā/ kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo mig rnam par sbyong ba (1)'di ni mig gi skyon dang / rlung gi skyon dang / mkhris ②pa'i skyon dang / bad kun gyi skyon dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa'i skyon sel te/ tshul khrims kyi bden pa dang ske/ brtul zhugs kyi bden pa dang / drang srong rnams kyi bden pa dang /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i bden pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang /kun 'byung gi chabaden pa dang / 'gog pa'i bden pa dang / lam gyi bden pa dang / dgra bcom pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ④kyi bden pas shākya bde ba'i mig na bar ma gyur cig /mchi ma 'dzag par ma gyur cig /kun du mchi ma 'dzag par ma gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mig rnam par dag par gyur cig swā hā/ kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo mig rnam par sbyong ba (ge'adi ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas drug gis gsungs pa'o/ / nga yang da lta 97'chad de/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / lha rnams kyi bdag po brgya byin dang / mi mjed 977kyi bdag po tshangs pa yang rjes su 'a༄yi rang ngo /kun dga' bo gang gis rig sngags 'di dus gsum du brjod (9non de la thibs por ci'agyur ba'am/ rab rib bam1lha/ ling tog gam/ mig nad sngon por mthong ba'am/ mig gi yul gyi skyon lha las gyur pa rnams sam/ klu las gyur pa rnams sam/ dri za las gyur pa rnams sam/ gnod sbyin las gyur pa rnams sam / srin po las gyur pa rnams sam/ 12sha za las gyur pa rnams sam/byad las gyur pa rnams sam/ ro langs las gyur pa rnams sam/ ro langs dang byad las gyur pa rnams sam/ kun du rgyu las gyur pa rnams sam/ kun 98—571

du rgyu dang ro langs las gyur pa rnams kyis tshugs par 'gyur ba ni lha dang bcas pa dang / bdud dang bcas pa dang / tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang / dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i skye dgu'i 'jig rten na ngas ma mthong ste/ de ni gnas med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin no zhes gsol nas/ gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di rnams bzung ste kun chub par byas nas shākya bde ba ga la ba der song ste/ bde ba mig rnam par sbyong ba'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag de bzhin gshegs pas khyod la bskur gyis nyin re zhing dus gsum du dran par gyis shig ces de la rgyas par smras so/ /shākya bde bas thos ma thag kho nar mig rnam par dag ste/ mig rnam par dag pas dri ma med pa'i mig gis thams cad mthong ngo / /6)bcom ldan 'das kyis de ②skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa ①kun dga' bo dang / shākya bde ba dang / lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi ④rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa mig rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i rig sngags rdzogs sto// //98—572

bsdur mchan/569 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 me/ ③〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 man+t+ra/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉shakya'i/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉nas zhugs/57 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉 ga 〈〈co 〉〉dbyug ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉gsas/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉sbyang / 〈〈pe 〉〉spyang / ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bya ba/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉dga'o/ 0〈〈li 〉〉sbyongs pa'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉spyod pa'i/ ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzung / ⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉skyab/ ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 bde/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉byas/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rnams/571 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sbyod pa/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉'khris/ ①〈〈co 〉〉gyi/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 rnams/0〈〈pe 〉〉spyod pa/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉de yang de ltar/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉mdzed/ ⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉suḥ/ ⑨〈〈li 〉〉rjod/⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉par/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉'am 0〈〈co 〉〉mam/572 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 de nas/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉'di/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉kun pa/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉yid/
bsdur 'bras re'u migagazungs 'dus/ (636)

khog /'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/(1)༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sarba kurma ā (0ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni nā (gyim dhā ra hāgo/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad 95)rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo(6)/ /na mo rat+na ⑦dra yā ya/ oṃ rka (8)ka ni kai 6)ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tā kyis ni tā 1mes ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba kurma (gepa raṃ pa rā ṇi me tiswā hā/ gzungs sngags tso'adi'i cho ga ni 'di yin te/ rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na las gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum du bzlas brjod byas na mtshams med pa lnga yang byang bar 'gyur ro/ /lan cig 8bzlas brjod byas na ltas ngan pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa rnams med par 'gyur ro/ /lus la 'chang ngam/98—575

glegs bam la bris nas mgul du thogs 0)te 'chang na/ de la dus ma yin par 'chi ba rnams gtan du 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig snying rjes non te/ri dgas dang / bya dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa rnams kyang rung ste/'chi ba'i tshe rna khung du brjod na de ngan song du 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yang na shi ste/ dus las 'das na shi 'phos pa'i ming nas smos te/ de'i phyir byams pa dang snying rjes lan brgya'am/ stong ngam/ 'bum du brjod na sems can de sems can dmyal bar skyes su zin kyang / de'i mod la thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sa'am / til ②lam/ yungs kur ram/ chu gang yang rung ba la bzlas brjod byas te/ shi ba'i lus la gtor ram/ khrus byas nas de'i 'og tu bsreg pa'am/yang na mchod rten gyi (kyenang du bcug ste bzhag ④la/ rig sngags kyang bris te mgo bo la btags na des ngan song du skyes pa yang zhag bdun gyis gdon mi za bar thar te/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi ⑤'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ba'am/yang na rang gi smon lam gyi dbang gis skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig zla ba nya ba'i tshe khrus byas la gtsang mar byas te/ dus gsum du gos brje zhing / kha zas mi za ba'amaskyo/ yang na kha zas dkar bag za zhing / sku gdung dang ldan pa'i mchod rten skor bzhin du gang gi ming dang ldan pas lan ⑦'bum bzlas brjod byas na de ngan song nas thar te/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i niris su skyes nas/ sgrub pa po'i thad du 'ongs te mchod pa byed cing lus kyang ston la/legs so zhes bya ba yang byin nas lan gsum bskor ba byas te mi snang bar 'gyur ro / /de'i ming bris la gzungs sngags bzlas brjod byed cing/ mchod rten 'bum byas la/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas 98—576

legs par mchod nas/ rgya mtsho chen po'am/ yang na chu klung du btang na/des sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa nas thar bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na de ltar mchod pa hu)byas nas/ mjug tu lam gyi bzhi mdor mchod rten chen po byas te/gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas legs par mchod la/'phags pa'i dge 'dun la yang mchod ston gsol nas/ yon yang phul te legs par mchod nas/ 'di che ge mo zhig gi dge ba'i rtsa bar gyur cig /'di kho nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar gyur cig ces kyang shes par byas na/ des de kho na bzhin du skyes nas lus kyang ston cing / legs so zhes bya ba yang byin nas mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa ②lnga byed byed pa'am / dam pa'i chos spong ba'am/ 'phags pa la skur ba btab pa yang rung ste / 'chi kur rtsig ①pa la gzungs 'di bris pa mthong na yang / de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad zad par 'gyur na/ 'don pa dang / bzlas brjod ⑨byed pa lta ci smos te/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa de nyid byon nas 'di skad du rigs kyi bu tshur nga'i gan du shog ces kyang gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs rdzogs sto// //98—577

༄ga /'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzungs sngags/6)༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sarba an+ta ra saṃ gā sa dhā ra tī man+t+ra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzungs sngags/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ phyag na rdo rje gzungs sngags 'di su 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / bzlas brjod ②byed pa de la ni dug dang / mtshon gyis 'chi ba dang /ltogs pa dang / mtshon brgyab pa dang / gcan gzan ①ma rungs pas za ba dang —/ mes tshig pa dang / chur 'chi ba dang / 'go ba'i rims gzhan ya nga ba dang / mdze'i ④nad dang / gsor mi rung ba'i nad ya nga ba dang / g.yang la lhung ba dang / gzhan gyi byad khyadang / zas kyis brnangs ①pa dang /bdag rang gis gsod pa dang / de ltar gshis ngan du 'chi ba bcu gsum gyis 98—580

rkyen byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje gzungs sngags 'di su 'dzin pa dang ske/ 'chang ba dang / bzlas brjod ①byed pa de la ni sa dang nam mkha' la gnas pa'i bgegs dregs pa can ma rungs pa rnams kyis kyang glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje gzungs sngags 'di su 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang ske/ bzlas brjod ②byed pa de la las kyi sgrib pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag ste/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ②ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la hūṃ phaṭa/ sarba bigha māṃ ④an+ta rā ya khyabi nā dusha ka ra mā ⑦ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ces brgya rtsa brgyad brjod na 'grub pa'o/ /nges par 'grub pa'o zhes gsungs sol/ /'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzungs sngags rdzogs sto // //98—581

bgyi ba'i slad du kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun (1)pa'i mdo / rig (5)sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher 'dzin cing / kun chub par bgyid na legs so legs so zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu la cang mi gsung bas gnang bar mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu rib ma yin pa dang mthun 7pa'i mdo / rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 95ri'agyur ba 'di nyid rgya (po cher gsol to/ /skye bo gang dag gtong phod cing / /phra ma mi mchi ser sna bral/ /gang dag sangs rgyas skyabs mchis pas /mi de rnams kyis 57)rnyed pa lags/ /gang gi 'char la brten nas ni/ /des na nyin mor brjod pa yi/ /nyi ma chen po dkyil 'khor can/ /nyi gdugs gang nas 'char 'gyur ba'i/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /dri za'i bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni yul 'khor srung zhes bgyi / /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /dri za rnams kyis yongs bskor 87cing / /dri za rnams kyis mdun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu 97dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun 'igrags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 11'gyed pa/ /kun du gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod 98—695
