'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi/ /de ltar lho yi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba 0)lags zhes (miskye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /gang zhig nub pa kho na las/ /des na mtshan mor brjod pa yi/ /nyi ma chen po dkyil 'khor can/ /nyi gdugs gang du nub 'gyur ba/ /de na (5)mtsho chen zab mo ni/ /shin tu 'da' bar dka' ba ste/ /de ni chu sngon rgya mtsho zhes/ /skye bos rtogs pa mchis pa yi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /klu yi bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni mig mi bzang zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /klu rnams kyis ni yongs bskor cing / /klu rnams kyis ni mdun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te④/ /brgyad cu (5)dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun rtsigrags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun tu gzhan gyis 97)mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos / /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /gi tam rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi/ /de ltar nub kyi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes duskye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid cing / /rgyal chen 98—697

grags dang ldan pa lags/ /gang na byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /dga' zhing lhun chen lta mdzes dang / /gang na mi rnams tshe lo ni/ /brgya 0)phrag bcu pa skye 'gyur zhing / /de dag mi rmo mi 'debs la/ /gshol yang 'cha' bar mi bgyid cing / /tshe ring mdog dang ldan pa dang / /nges (nasapar yongs su spyod bgyid cing / /zas su sā (kyelu kha dog dang / /dri dang ro dang ldan pa dang / /dri bda' ④me tog tshogs 'dra zhing / /lha yi bdud rtsi 'dra ba 'tshal/ /na li ke ra bskol bgyis (5)nas/ /tshod mar de 'tshal (6sran tshod (7min/ /gang na me (0lce'i rtse 'dra ba'i/ /sman dag 'khrung bar (9)'gyur ba yi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /gnod sbyin bdag po rgyal po ste//ming ni lus ngan po zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye ⑩du lhan cig tu/ /glu (stodang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis yongs bskor cing / /gnod sbyin rnams kyis mdun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu skidang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun sna grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che / /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun du gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /gi getam rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi/ /de ltar byang gi phyogs de ni/ /98—698

bzang ba lags zhes 0)skye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung (mi/ /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhi dag /'jig rten skyong ba grags dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs po che/ /phyogs bzhi dag ni skyong bar bgyid / /rgyal po dag gi mngag gzhug pa/ /gnod sbyin 'dod dgur mchi ba rnams / /de dag glang po che 'tshal zhing / /phyogs phyogs dag tu rnam par rgyu/ /de dag ni chibs rta dang / rnga mo dang / khyu mchog dang / ma he dang / ra dang ske/ lug dang / sbrul dang (mi/ bya dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang /gzhon nu dang / gzhon nu ma la 'tshal zhing phyogs phyogs dag tu yang mchi lags so/ /glang po che gcig gis shing rta drangs shing phyogs phyogs dag tu yang mchi ④lags so/ /chibs rta dang / rnga mo dang / khyu mchog dang / ma he dang ske/ ra dang / lug dang / sbrul dang / bya dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / gzhon nu dang / gzhon nu ma gcig gis shing rta drangs shing phyogs phyogs dag tu yang mchi 5)lags so/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs po che'i/ /gnod sbyin 'dod dgur mchi ba rnams/ /bzhin 967pa de dag 'tshal nas ni/ /phyogs bzhi dag ni skyong bar bgyid/ /rgyal po dag ni grong khyer dag /sna tshogs mkha' la rgyu ba mchis/ /'di lta ste/ kun tu rgyu ba dang kun tu rgyu ba ma lags pa dang / sa la kun du rgyu ba ma lags pa dang / gar bcas sa steng kun tu rgyu ba dang / sbubs can dang / grong khyer sbubs can zhes bgyi ba dag lags so/ /byang phyogs na mtsho (9ka pi bang ka zhes bgyi ba yang mchis lags so//98wa 699

nub phyogs na grong khyer sar pa gser ldan dang / gos can dang / gos mchog can dang / pad+ma can dang / pad+ma bzang po can dang / sa gzhi can zhes bgyi ba dag kyang mchis lags so/ /chab rgyun mang 6)po'i gnas gyur pa/ /'dzin pa zhes bgyi'i mtsho mchis te/ /chab rgyun tha dad de las byung / /de las dgung char 'bab par 'gyur/ /btsun pa grong khyer u shi (mira'i sbubs kyi pha rol na/ lus gnas dang ni gnas yangs dang / /de bas gnas yangs rgyun lugs can/ /rgyun lugs mang dang de bas mang / /bar snang mkha' la bya ltar gda' / /btsun pa grong khyer sbubs can gyi pha rol byang phyogs na mdun sa bya gar can zhes bgyi ba de mchis te/ der ni gnod sbyin rnams 'du zhing gnas lags 55)so/ /rkang mi sdug la mchu 'phyang dang / /'jigs rung lto spu can dag mchis / /de na ljon shing 'bras bu rtag /rma bya khrung khrung sgra snyan dang / /khu byug sgra skad chen po dang / /shang shang te'u dag sgra 'byin cing / /rma bya rnams kyi sgra dag kyang / /go kum bha dang chun lag dang / /bya rnams sna tshogs skad 'byin cing / /me tog sbrang rtsi'i ro la dga'/ /lus ngan po de glu gar gyis/ /pad+ma can dang lhan cig rtse/ /btsun pa grong khyer lcang lo can gyi pha rol na rgyal po dpa' bo zhes bgyi ba yul 'khor mu khyud na mchis lags so/ /bdag gang na mchis pa'i mdun sa de ni khyu mchog can zhes bgyi ste/ bdag gi ming ni rnam thos kyi bu zhes bgyi lags so/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags soske/ /tabya thā/ i li mi li/ i li mi li/ kyis ④mā le/ hi li kirtsi ku myu le/ hu du me/rtsi hu dur du me/ go ri/ garnya ri/ go do ha ni/ o ke mo ke phyag hā / btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag gis dri za rnams dang /98—700

dri za chen po rnams dang / dri za'i sde dpon rnams dang / dmag dpon rnams kyi ming brjod par bgyi lags so/ /'di lta ste/ 'dod myos dga' bas myos pa dang / /glu yis myos pa spun dang ni/ /phreng bas 1)myos dang sbrang rtsis (snyemyos / /me tog myos pa spun rnams dang / /rtag tu myos dang dpal gyis myos/ /nor gyis myos dang dga' byed dang / /ut+pal (5)pad+ma zla ba dang / /lnga 'dzin dang ni khu byug sgra/ /tum bu ru dang gtsug 4lnga dang / /gser spyod bu mo gser can dang / /pa ba sangs dang phur bu dag /'gro gnas ji snyed rgyal po lags//de dag bdag gi spun lags te/ /de dag la bdag dri za 'di ni bdag la 'che'o—/ /dri za 'di ni bdag mi gtong ngo zhes mchi zhing de dag la go bar bgyid lags so/ /bdag la 'tshe ba'i dri za dang / /bdag mi gtong ba'i dri za yis/ /legs par smras pa 'di thos na/ /ardza ka yi dog 95)pa bzhin/ /de'i mgo tshal pa bdun du 'gas/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tabya thā / kun+tu le/ kun+tu le/ kun+tu le/ kun+tu le/ e hi e hi/ sa dā masti ༷ ke/sa dā dhibhaṇ+ḍi (8)ni ke/ tiṣ+ṭha duṣ+ṭa bsgo si swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun 997pa'i mdo/rig kyisngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher lung mnos shing 'don par bgyid pa de la/ gal te dri za'am / dri za mo'am/ dri za rgan po'am/ dri za rgan mo'am/ dri za'i bu pho'am / dri za'i bu mo'am/ dri za'i 'khor pho'am/ dri za'i 'khor mo'am/dri za'i mngag gzhug pa'am/ dri za'i mngag gzhug ma 'tshe bar bgyid pa/98—701

glags lta zhing glags 1)tshol ba la la zhig nye bar mchi zhing / nye bar 'greng ngam/nye bar mchis par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la/ dri za rnams kyi dri za 'du ba'i nang du mchir mi chud cing / rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang gnas mi 'thob ste/ de'i mgo ardza ku'i dog pa bzhin tshal pa bdun du 'gas lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong ngam/dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun 5pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher lung mnos nishing 'don par bgyid pa de la/ gal te sha za'am/ sha za mo'am/sha za rgan po'am/ sha za rgan mo'am/ sha za'i bu pho'am/ sha za'i bu mo'am/sha za'i 'khor pho'am/ sha za'i 'khor mo'am/ sha za'i mngag gzhug pa'am/sha za'i mngag gzhug ma 'tshe bar bgyid pa/ glags lta zhing glags tshol ba la la zhig nye bar mchi zhing / nye bar 'greng ngam/ nye bar mchis par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la/ sha za rnams kyi sha za 'du ba'i nang du mchir mi chud cing / rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang tshunaganas mi 'thob ste/de'i mgo ardza ma'i dog pa bzhin tshal pa bdun du 'gas lags (5)so/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tar+ya thā/ hu me hu me47/ hu mi le / hu mi lā bā ri ci'i ye swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag gis grul bum rnams dang / grul bum chen po rnams dang / grul bum gyi sde dpon rnams dang / dmag dpon rnams kyi ming brjod par bgyi lags rin so/ /'di lta ste/ byin dang nye byin kri mi sha / rtsib logs 5)che dang gsus po che/ /98—702

lag bcu dang ni sa la rgyu/ /g.yon phyogs nag po dmar po dang / /sprin mdog dang ni dri med dang / /rna ba ring dang 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /ral pa can dang stobs bcu dang / /srid sgrub dang ni 'dod dgur mchi/ /'jog po dang ni bya ba sbed/ /la ba bzang ldan gsum po dang / /tshon kun dang ni mig bkra bo/ /'gro gnas ji snyed mchis pa lags/ /de dag ni bdag gi 0kāspun lags te/ de dag la bdag grul bum 'di ni bdag la 'tshe'o/ /grul bum 'di ni bdag mi gtong ngo zhes mchi zhing de dag la go bar (5)bgyid lags so/ /bdag la 'tshe 5ba'i grul bum dang / /bdag mi gtong ba'i grul bum gyis/ /legs par smras pa 'di thos na/ /ardza ka yi dog pa bzhin/ /de'i mgo tshal pa bdun du 'gas / /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tar+ya thā/ si re bi si re4)/ kṛt+ta sgyu tsha ga le (po)/ ka 97)rā ḍi 4)piṅga li dzo9)swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/dge bsnyen tshum gang la la kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun 11 pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher lung mnos shing 'don par bgyid pa de la/gal te grul bum mamatsha/ grul bum mo'am/ grul bum rgan po'am/ grul bum rgan mo'am/ grul bum gyi bu pho'am/ grul bum gyi bu mo'am/ grul bum gyi 'khor pho'am/ grul bum gyi 'khor mo'am/ grul bum gyi mngag gzhug pa'am/grul bum gyi mngag gzhug ma 'tshe bar bgyid pasmin/ glags lta zhing glags skatshol ba la la zhig nye bar mchi zhing / nye bar 'greng ngam/ nye bar mchis par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la/ grul bum rnams kyi grul bum 'du ba'i 98—703

nang du mchir mi chud cing / rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang gnas mi 'thob 0)ste/ de'i mgo ardza ma'i dog pa bzhin tshal pa bdun du 'gas lags so / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun (5)pa'i mdo/ rig ( sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba ri4)'di nyid rgya cher lung mnos shing 'don par bgyid pa de la/ gal te yi dgas sam/ yi dgas mo'am/ yi dgas rgan po'am/ yi dgas rgan mo'am/ yi dgas kyi bu pho'am/ yi dgas kyi bu mo'am / yi dgas kyi 'khor po'am/ yi dgas kyi 'khor mo'am/ yi dgas kyi mngag gzhug pa'am/ yi dgas kyi mngag gzhug ma 'tshe bar bgyid pa/glags lta zhing glags tshol ba la la zhig nye bar mchi zhing nye bar 'greng ngam/ nye bar mchis par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la/ yi dgas rnams kyi yi dgas 'du ba'i nang du mchir mi chud cing / rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang gnas 55)mi 'thob 0ste/ de'i mgo ardza ma'i dog pa bzhin tshal pa bdun du 'gas lags so/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tar+ya thā/ yu mi yu mi5 sku/ yu mi li 58)yu mi la bā ti kyisaye swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag gis klu rnams dang / klu chen po rnams dang la/ klu'i sde dpon rnams dang / dmag dpon rnams kyi ming brjod 7par bgyi lags so/ /'di lta ste/ dga' dang nye dga' kun dga' dang / /nor rgyas dang ni 'dzam bu bzang / /ser po dang ni zho rna dang / /dbang po'i lag dang bkra shis dang / /mya ngan med dang mya ngan bral/ /rab grol dang ni rgyal 98—704

ba'i bdag /ngos yangs po dang ngos bkra dang / /yangs pa can dang bkra 'dud rgyal/ /gdengs ka che dang skar dga' dang / /nag po che dang lag 'gro dang —/ /ra skyong dang ni 'jog po dang / /g.yon phyogs de bzhin nag po dang / /sngo bsangs dkar dang 'grogs pa ni/ /'gro gnas ji snyed mchis pa lags/ /de dag ni bdag gi spun lags te/ de dag la bdag klu 'di ni bdag la 'tshe'o//klu 'di ni bdag mi gtong ngo zhes mchi zhing de dag la go bar bgyid lags so/ /bdag la 'tshe ba'i klu dag dang / /bdag mi gtong ba'i klu rnams kyis6)/ /legs par smras pa 'di thos na/ /ardza ka yi dog pa bzhin/ /de'i mgo tshal pa bdun du 'gas/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tar+ya thā/tsi le bi tsi le/ tsi le ②tha tsi le(gu/ gi ri/ garnya ri/ ma rta gi tsaṇ+ḍa li swā hā/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong ngam(4)/ dge slong ma'am/dge bsnyen (snyenam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun (phyi pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher lung mnos shing 'don par bgyid pa de la/ gal te klu'am/ klu mo'am/ klu rgan po'am/ klu rgan mo'am/klu'i bu pho'amal/ klu'i bu mo'am/ klu'i 'khor pho'am/ klu'i 'khor mo'am/klu'i mngag gzhug pa'am/ klu'i mngag gzhug ma 'tshe bar bgyid pa/ glags lta zhing glags tshol ba la la zhig nye bar mchi zhing nye bar 'greng ngam/ nye bar mchis par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la/ klu rnams kyi klu 'du ba'i nang du mchir mi chud cing / rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang 98)gnas mi 'thob ste/ de'i mgo ardza ku'i dog pa bzhin tshal pa bdun du 'gas lags 98—705

so / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/1nye dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun (kyepa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher lung mnos ①shing 'don par bgyid pa de la/ gal te lus srul po'am/ lus srul mo'am/ lus srul rgan po'am/ lus srul rgan mo'am/ lus srul po'i bu pho'am/ lus srul po'i bu mo'am/ lus srul po'i 'khor pho'am/ lus srul po'i 'khor mo'am/ lus srul po'i mngag gzhug pa'am/ lus srul po'i mngag gzhug ma 'tshe bar bgyid pa / glags lta zhing glags tshol ba la la zhig nye bar mchi zhing nye bar 'greng ngam/nye bar mchis par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la/ lus srul po rnams kyi (3)lus srul po 'du ba'i nang du mchir (gemi chud cing / rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang gnas mi 'thob (6)ste/ de'i mgo ardza ku'i dog pa bzhin tshal pa bdun (7)du 'gas lags so/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tabya thā/ a be/ ba ha ne/ ba ha na ba tī ye swā hā/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag gis gnod sbyin rnams dang /gnod sbyin chen po rnams dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon rnams dang / dmag dpon rnams kyi ming brjod par bgyi lags so/ /'di lta ste/ dbang po zla ba chu lha dang / /ba ra dwa dza 48)skye dgu'i bdag /dbang ldan tsan+dan 'dod gtso dang ske/ /mgrin ngan dang ni mgul nges dang / /stobs ldan nor bu nor spyod dang —/ /sgra rab dang ni nye rnga tsunadang / /ri mnyam gser can gang po dang / /seng 7ldeng pa dang g.yon can dang / /gnod sbyin pa skyong 'brog gnas dang / /98—706

rgyal ba'i khyu 6)mchog mi rgyal po/ /dri za sna tshogs sde dang ni/ /lcags mdud ring dang ma ldan dang / /tshig lnga ser po yid dga' dang / /gnod sbyin ring po 'khor dang bcas/ /'bras bu gsum pa mgul gsum pa/ /'gro gnas ji snyed mchis pa lags/ /de dag ni bdag gi spun lags te/ de dag la bdag gnod sbyin 'di ni bdag la 'tshe'o/ /gnod sbyin 'di ni bdag mi gtong ngo zhes mchi zhing de dag la bdag go bar bgyid lags so/ /bdag la 'tshe ba'i gnod sbyin dang / /bdag mi gtong ba'i gnod sbyin gyis/ /legs par smras pa 'di thos na/ /ardza ka yi dog pa bzhin/ /de'i mgo tshal pa bdun du 'gas / /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags kyiso/ /tabya thā/ hi le mi le/ hi le mi le/ krirti mū li mi/ hi li krirti mū le/ o kum+bi tusbo/ o (gekusba ⑤tusbo/ o ghi mo ghi/ go de (po)gyi( ci/ jiṅgā (nyare/ ṛ (tsho'i sat+ta 7me swā hā/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun /stopa'i mdo/ rig 7sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher lung mnos shing 'don par bgyid pa de la/ gal te gnod sbyin nam12/ gnod sbyin mo'am/ gnod sbyin rgan po'am/ gnod sbyin rgan mo'am/ gnod sbyin gyi bu pho'am/ gnod sbyin gyi bu mo'am/ gnod sbyin gyi 'khor pho'amatsha/ gnod sbyin gyi 'khor mo'am/gnod sbyin gyi mngag gzhug pa'am/ gnod sbyin gyi comangag gzhug ma 'tshe bar bgyid pa/ glags lta zhing glags tshol skyab la la zhig nye bar mchi zhing nye bar 'greng ngam/ nye bar mchis par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la/98—707

gnod sbyin rnams kyi gnod sbyin 'du ba'i nang du mchir mi chud cing / rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang gnas mi 'thob ste/ de'i mgo ardza ku'i dog pa bzhin 6)tshal pa bdun du 'gas lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun ②pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rin rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher lung mnos shing 'don par bgyid pa de la/ gal te srin po'am / srin mo'amal/ srin po (mirgan po'am/ srin po rgan mo'am/ srin po'i bu pho'am/ srin po'i bu mo'am/ srin po'i 'khor pho'am/ srin po'i 'khor mo'am/ srin po'i mngag gzhug pa'am/ srin po'i mngag gzhug ma 'tshe bar bgyid pa/ glags lta zhing glags tshol ba la la zhig nye bar mchi zhing nye bar 'greng ngam/ nye bar mchis 6)par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la/srin po rnams kyi srin po 'du ba'i nang du mchir mi chud cing / rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang gnas (7mi 'thob (0ste/ de'i mgo ardza ku'i dog pa bzhin tshal pa bdun du 'gas lags so/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tabya thā/ hi li hi li/ hu lu hu lu/ yu me yu me (9)le/ yu mi la ba tibhā ye swā hā/ de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun (stopa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher brjod nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 7zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyi mtshan 98—708

rab la mngon par dad pa de dag ni shin tu nyung la/ gnod sbyin dang / mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab la mngon par ma dad pa de dag ni 0)ches mang lags te/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong rnams dang / dge slong ma rnams dang /dge bsnyen rnams dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams 'di ltar bdag nyid bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / bde ba la reg par (5)gnas par bgyid pa dang /gnod sbyin dang mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa mngon par ma dad pa dag mngon par dad par bgyi ba dang / mngon par dad pa rnams kyang slar zhing 'phel bar bgyi ba'i slad du kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun ri )pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher 'dzin cing kun chub par bgyid na legs so legs so zhes gsol pa dang / dge slong dag ngas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu la cang mi gsung bas gnang ( skabar mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus ngas cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas nga'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ nga'i spyan sngar kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun (5༄pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher gsol to/ /skye bo gang dag gtong phod cing —/ /phra ma mi mchi ser sna bral/ /gang dag sangs rgyas skyabs mchis pa /mi de rnams kyis rnyed pa lags/ /gang gi 'char la brten nas ni/ /des na ⑥nyin mor brjod pa yi/ /nyi ma chen po dkyil 'khor can/ /nyi gdugs gang nas 'char 'gyur ba'i/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen 98—710

grags dang ldan pa ni/ /dri za'i bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni yul 'khor srung zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /dri za rnams kyis yongs bskor cing / /dri za rnams kyis mdun 0)gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu (5)dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun (5)grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa / /kun du gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas / /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud / /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol//khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /gau tam rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa ri/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol 55)mchi/ /de ltar shar gyi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes 567skye bo mchi / /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags / /gang na yi dgas zhes bgyi ba/ /rgyab kyi sha 'tshal phra ma 57can/ /srog gcod bgyid pa ma rungs pa/ /'jungs shing mi snyan smra bgyid pa'i/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa(8)/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /grul bum bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni 'phags skyes po zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /grul bum rnams kyis yongs bskor cing / /grul bum rnams kyis mdun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu 37dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun 7grags 98—711

pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun du gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /gau tam rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi5)/ /de ltar lho yi (5)phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes ②skye bo mchi / /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags / /gang zhig nub pa kho na las/ /des na mtshan mor brjod pa yi/ /nyi ma chen po dkyil 'khor can/ /nyi gdugs gang du nub 'gyur ba/ /de na mtsho 6)chen zab mo ni/ /shin tu 'da' bar dka' 95)ba ste/ /de ni chu sngon rgya mtsho zhes / /skye bos rtogs pa mchis pa yi(ye/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /klu yi bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni mig mi bzang zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /klu rnams kyis ni yongs bskor cing / /klu rnams kyis ni mdun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu 4 shedang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun 57grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun du gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes 98—712

khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags0)/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi rdo min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /gi tam rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol ①mchi/ /de ltar nub kyi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes goskye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /gang na byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /dga' zhing lhun chen blta mdzes dang / /gang na mi rnams tshe lo ni/ /brgya phrag bcu pa skye 'gyur zhing ske/ /de dag mi rmo mi 'debs la/ /gshol yang 'cha' bar mi bgyid cing / /tshe ring mdog dang ldan pa dang / /nges par yongs su spyod bgyid cing / /zas su sā ⑤yu kha dog dang / /dri dang ro dang ldan pa dang / /dri bda' 96)me tog tshogs 'dra zhing / /lha yi bdud rtsi 'dra ba 'tshal/ /na li ke ra bskol 7 bgyis nas / /tshod mar de 'tshal sran tshod min/ /gang na me lce'i 98)rtse 'dra ba'i/ /sman dag 'khrung bar (9ri'agyur ba yi7/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ri/ /gnod sbyin bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni lus ngan po zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis 7rtag tu rtse / /gnod sbyin rnams kyis yongs bskor cing / /gnod sbyin rnams kyis mdun gyis 'baltas/ /de tshul bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu skidang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun tshagrags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che / /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun du gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /98—713

de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig / gi tam 6)rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol namachi/ /de ltar byang gi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes (5)skye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung / /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhi dag /'jig rten skyong ba grags dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs po che/ /phyogs bzhi dag ni skyong bar bgyid / /rgyal po dag gi mngag gzhug pa/ /gnod sbyin 'dod dgur mchi ba rnams / /de dag glang po che 'tshal zhing / /phyogs phyogs dag tu rnam par rgyu/ /de dag ni chibs rta dang / rnga mo dang / khyu mchog dang / ma he dang / ra dang / lug dang / sbrul dang / bya dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang /gzhon nu dang / gzhon nu ma la 'tshal zhing phyogs phyogs dag tu yang mchi ④lags so/ /glang po che gcig gis shing rta drangs shing phyogs phyogs dag tu yang mchi lags so/ /chibs rta dang / rnga mo dang / khyu mchog dang / ma he dang /ra dang / lug dang / sbrul dang / bya dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / gzhon nu dang 55ra/ gzhon nu ma gcig gis shing rta drangs shing phyogs 98—714

phyogs dag tu yang mchi lags so/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs po che/ /gnod sbyin 'dod dgur mchi ba rnams/ /bzhon (1 pa de dag 'tshal nas ni/ /phyogs bzhi dag ni skyong bar bgyid/ /rgyal po dag ni grong khyer dag /sna tshogs mkha' la rgyu ba mchis/ /'di lta ste/ kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma lags pa dang / sa la kun du rgyu ba ma lags pa dang / gar bcas sa steng kun du rgyu ba dang / sbubs can dang / grong khyer sbubs can zhes bgyi ba dag lags so/ /byang phyogs na mtsho ka 95)yi bang ka zhes bgyi ba yang mchis lags so/ /nub phyogs na grong khyer sar pa gser ldan dang / gos can dang / gos mchog can dang / pad+ma can dang / pad+ma bzang ( )po can dang / sa gzhi can zhes bgyi ba dag mchis lags so/ /chab rgyun mang po'i gnas gyur pa/ /'dzin pa zhes bgyi'i mtsho mchis te/ /chab rgyun tha dad de las 'byung / /de las dgung char 'bab par 'gyur/ /btsun pa grong khyer u shi 9 cira'i sbubs kyi pha rol na/lus gnas dang ni gnas yangs dang / /de bas gnas yangs rgyun lugs can/ /rgyun lugs mang dang de bas mang / /bar snang mkha' la bya ltar gda'/ /btsun pa grong khyer sbubs can gyi pha rol byang phyogs na 'dun mus bya gar can zhes bgyi ba yang mchis te/ der ni gnod sbyin rnams 'du zhing gnas lags sol/ /rkang mi sdug la mchu 'phyang dang / /'jigs rung lto spu 6can dag mchis/ /de na ljon shing 'bras bu rtag /rma bya khrung khrung sgra snyan dang / /khu byug sgra skad chen po dang / /shang shang te'u medag sgra 'byin cing / /rma bya rnams kyi sgra dag dang ske/ /gau kum bha 98dang chun lag dang / /bya rnams sna tshogs skad 'byin cing —/ /me tog sbrang rtsi'i ro 9ril dga'/ /lus ngan po de glu gar gyis/ /pad+ma 98—715

du mngon par zhugs/ /nub phyogs mngon par skyong byed pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /klu yi bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni mig mi bzang zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /de la bu ni mang yod de / /brgyad cu (1dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun (7grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed ( par/ /kun du gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /byang phyogs mngon par skyong byed pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /gnod sbyin bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni lus ngan po zhes bya / /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams4)/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /de la bu ni mang yod de(she/ /brgyad cu 56)dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun ⑦grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi ③stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed par/ /kun du gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /gang dag de yi tho)'khor rnams tshudang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan 98—736

zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung / /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhi dag6) /'jig rten skyong ba grags dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs po che/ /phyogs bzhi dag ni skyong bar byed/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal (midu mngon par zhugs/ /de dag gi ni khol po rnams/ /mchod rten mang la gnas bcas pa/ /slu byed g.yon can sgyu ma can/ /sgyu ma shes sridang rnam shes dang / /ngan spong khro gnyer lhan cig tu/ /de tshe rdzu 'phrul ston cing lhags/ /gang dag de yi ④'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /gnod sbyin dang / gnod sbyin chen po dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon dang / dmag dpon 'di dag kyang der kun nas lhags te 'di lta ste/ dbang po zla ba chu lha dang / /ba ra dwa dza skye dgu'i bdag /dbang ldan tsan+dan 'dod gtso dang / /mgrin ngan dang ni mgul nges dang / /spobs ldan nor bu nor spyod dang / /sgra rab dang ni nye rnga (snyedang / /ri mnyam gser can gang po dang / /seng ldeng ba dang g.yon can dang / /gnod sbyin ba skyong 'brog gnas dang / /rgyal ba khyu mchog mi'i rgyal po/ /dri za sna tshogs sde dang ni/ /lcags mdung ring dang ma ldan dang / /tshig 3)lnga ser po yid dga' 98—737

dang / /gnod sbyin ring po 'khor dang bcas/ /'bras bu gsum dang mgul gsum pa/ /'gro gnas ji snyed yod pa yin/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan//kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs6)/ /lhan cig 'byung ba'i klu dang ni/ /'jog po dang ni yangs pa'ang 'ongs/ /la ba dang ni mgyogs mchog dag /srung byed 'gro dang lhan cig lhags/ /klu bdag bran bzang bu dang ni/ /yul 'khor sung dang glang po che/ /'jigs byed che dang sa srung bu/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i klu yang 'ongs/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal ②du mngon par zhugs/ /gang zhig klu rgyal zil mnan len/ /stobs ldan mig rnon 'dab chags bya/ /de min 'dab (babazang khra bo yang / /mkha' las tshal du mngon par 'ongs/ /de tshe klu rgyal mi 'jigs byin/ /ston pas 'dab bzang bde mdzad cing ri4)/ /gsung 'jam brjod pa de nyid la/ /sangs rgyas skyabs su nye bar song / /gang dag de yi (5)'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /lag na rdo rjes pham byas shing / /rgya mtshor rten pa'i lha min rnams/ /thams cad nor lhas skrag gyur cing / /mtsho la skyabs su 'du shes pa/ /thags bzangs ri peris dang rab bkra dang / /rab sim byed dang 98—738

btang bzung ①dang / /stobs ldan bu ni brgyad (khupo kun/ /rnam snang byed pa'i bu rnams dang / /stobs ldan sde dang sgra gcan bzang / /dpa' chen khyod kyi dus lags zhes / /dge slong 'dus pa'i nags tshal du/ /go cha bgos te lhags pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /chu lha mo dang bu mo dang / /zla ba mo yang phyi bzhin 'ongs/ /mdza' bshes ma dang chu lha can/ /lha mo grags ldan nyid kyang 'ongs/ /sa dang chu dang rlung gi dang / /mi (4)yi lha mo'ang 'ongs gyur te/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de 6)dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni / /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi (6)'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /khyab 'jug lha dang gshol can lha/ /mtshe ma gnyis kyang lhags par gyur/ /zla la gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /zla ba nyid ni mdun du bdar/ /nyi la gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /nyi ma nyid kyang mdun bdar cing / /char pa (7)'bebs par byed pa dag /rgyu skar rnams kyis mdun bdar lags/ /thams cad bzang po rdo rje can/ /brgya byin khyer 'jig 'ongs gyur te/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi (nya'akhor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 98—739

'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /lha mo tshogs can ma dang ni/ /me lce'i rtse 'dra 'chi ltas can/ /zhi ba mo dang dka' zlog ma/ /me tog gos can 'ongs gyur cing / /rgyu ba mo dang mtshan mchings 0)bzang / /'chi med rnam pa du ma dang / /gang zhig phyogs su char 'bebs pa/ /'dod lha'i dbyangs can ma yang 'ongs/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni / /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi (mi'akhor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /sngo bsangs sngo bsangs chen mo chadang / /mi 'dra mi 'dra dam pa dang / /rtsed mos myos dang de bzhin du/ /yid 'khrug ma yang 54)'ongs gyur cing / /phag mo phag mo chen mo (5)dang / /slong 4)ma des ma lhan cig lhags/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang //gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang (7)/ /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /dkar mo rgyags byed snying rje dang / /gos sngon mo yang 'ongs gyur cing / /skra dkar mo la sogs pa dang / /gos ser mo yang 'ongs par gyur/ /'phrog ma rtag tu myos pa dang / /spel ma rnam pa du ma dang / /dag pa dang ni 'od can 98—740

ma / /lha mo grags ldan rnams kyang lhags/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /bde byed dga' ldan 'thab bral dang / /nag po (3)btab pa du ma dang / /lum+bi ni dang lum+bi mchog /skar (5)ma zhes bya legs smon dang ske/ /'phrul dga' rnams dang de bzhin du/ /dbang sgyur rnams kyang lhags par gyur / /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de (4)dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /lha tshogs drug cu ⑤de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi tshone 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong dag gi⑦/ /tshangs pa chen po zhes bya ba/ /kun 'gyed gzhon nu skar rgyal de / /so sor dbang sgyur dbang phyug bcu/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa de dag dang / /lhan cig 'grogs te der lhags 90pa(97/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /98—741

de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /dbang sgyur byed pa'i 'phrog ①ma mo/ /kha dog gzugs mchog ldan pa yang / /bu rnams kyis ni yongs bskor cing ②/ /de dag rnams kyi (5)phyi bzhin 'ongs/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /dbang por bcas dang dbang ldan bcas/ /skye dgu'i bdag dang bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams de dag der lhags shing / /dge slong rnams kyang der lhags so/ /nag pos smras pa'i tshig (gel ltos/ /'dod chags kyis ni 'di zung la/ /bcing ba gyis dang khyed la legs/ /'di dag kun nas yongs bsdus la/ /'di dag gson por ma btang zhes/ /de na nag po sde bo che/ /sde rnams la ni skul byed cing / /khros shing rang dbang med gyur nas / /rang yang mngon par zhugs gyur te/ /lag (5)pas sa la brdabs (5)nas ni / /shin tu 'jigs pa'i sgra phyung ste/ /ji ( )nas lha yis sprin phreng dang / /glog rin/dang bcas pa'i char yang phab/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni de mkhyen nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pas (9)rnam gzigs te/ /de nas ston pas yobastan dga' ba'i/ /nyan thos rnams la dge slong dag /bdud sde mngon par lhags gyur gyis/ /mngon par rtogs zhes tsho bka' stsal pa/ /brtson par byed pa de dag gis/ /sangs rgyas gsungs pa thos nas ni/ /de dag spu yang mi g.yo bas/ /de dag chags bral yin par rtogs/ /rgyal sras nyan thos de dag ni/ /slob ma rnams 98—742

dang lhan cig dga'/ /de dag g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing / /'jigs bral grags dang ldan pa yin/ /bar gyi sdom ni/ bdun (3)stong gser can ri mnyam dang —/ /de bzhin gnod sbyin chu srin dang / /kun gyi bshes dang rgyal po rnams / /de bzhin khol po gnod sbyin dang / /klu dang 'dab 92)bzangs (7lha min dang / /chu lha mo dang khyab 'jug dang / /tshogs can ma dang sngo bsangs dang —/ /dkar mo bde byed dbang phyug dang / /kun bged (4)gzhon dang 'phrog ma dang / /dbang bcas bdud dang dge slong ngo / /de nas gnas gtsang (5)ma'i lha shin tu dbang che bar grags pa rnams mdo sde bstan pas yi (6)rangs par gyur nas/ de'i tshe tshig 'di dag gis 'dus pa chen po'i mdo bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang tshig 'di dag gis mdo sde 'di yang dag par bsnyad par bgyi zhing / yang dag par brjod par bgyi lags so/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tabya thā/ te dze 977te dza ba ti/tsid tre tsid tra (8chib ti/ la te la ta ba ti/ kha me kha ma ba ti/ k+ṣe me k+ṣe ma ba ti/bha dre bha dra ba ti/ ya she ya sha ba ti/ dru te dru ta ba ti/ tsa pa le tsa pa la ba ti/kha tse kha tsa ba ti ti/ bcom ldan 'das 'di dag ni gnas gtsang ma pa (9 rnams kyi ⑩gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams lags te/ bcom ldan 'das gang zhig mdo sde 'di dang / gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag rmongs pa ma mchis par 'dzin par bgyid na/ de /77ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'byung po thams cad las bsrung ba bgyis par 'gyur lags so/ /'byung po thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur lags so/ /de la bro nad thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur lags so/ /gang du klog ⑩pa der dge bar (8'gyur zhing / de dag la dgung lo bdun du 98—743

phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas smon lam rnams btab pa / lus rgya mtsho'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyis sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam 0)rgya mtsho thams cad dang / sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul rnams dang / gzugs su snang ba thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul rnams las rdul phra rab kyi rdul re re la yang lus kyi sprin rgya mtsho bgrang (5)ba'i rgya mtsho thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ grangs med/ dpag tu med/bsam gyis mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med/ gzhal du med/ brjod du med pa las yang dag par 'das pa dag dang / lus re re la yang lag pa rgya mtsho'i ④sprin phyogs kun gyi rgyun du mngon par phyogs pa dpag tu med/ grangs med pa dag byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdul phra rab kyi rdul gyi 54)cha re re las kyang mchod pa thams cad kyi sprin rgya mtsho phyogs kun gyi gzhi rgyas par 'gengs pa ma 'dres pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod pa bya'o snyam pa 'di lta ste/ kun tu spyod pa'i lus rgya mtsho sprin ma 'dres pa dpag tu med/ grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ gzhal du med/ tshad med / brjod du med pa dag gis nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs par byin gyis brlabs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus (gergya mtsho sprin rnams kyis ji lta ba de bzhin du rin po che thams 56༄cad kyi kha dog (7)dang 'od zer stug po dang / nyi (8)ma dang / zla ba thams cad lta bu'i lus kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che thams cad kyi phreng ba dang / me tog gi rgya mtsho 98—758

sprin rnams dang / rin po che thams cad kyi snang ba chen po'i (1)snying po khang pa brtsegs pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / phye ma dang / shing ljon pa thams cad kyi mdzod rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / spos dang / bdug ri pa thams cad kyi gzugs kun tu ston pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sgra thams cad sgrogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra rgya mtsho'i 5)sprin rnams dang / spos thams cad kyi shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs (cadapar byin gyis brlabs nas / de la sogs pa mchod pa thams cad kyi sprin rgya mtsho dpag tu med/grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ gzhal du med/ tshad med/ brjod du med pa/ ma 'dres pa rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bsti ri nistang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /yul thams cad du bkod pa rnam par snang bar byas pa'i snying po can gyi nor bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs par byin gyis brlabs te/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bsti 6)stang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /thams cad kun du snang ba'i nor bu rin po che'i 7char 'bab pa bkod pa'i nor bu'i rgyal po'i rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba 'bar ba dang ldan pa sangs rgyas la nges par gyur pa'i dbyangs kyi nor bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / kun tu sgras 'gengs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi dbyangs can nor bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / kun nas sgo rin po che 'od zer gyis 98 sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa snang bar byed pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ma 'dres pa 98—759

rnams su bkod pa thams cad snang ba kun tu ston pa'i nor bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / 'od 'phro ba sgron ma sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug (1)pa'i nor bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang (gyi/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzhal med khang snang ba kun tu ston pa'i nor bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi rdul la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi sku snang ba rnam par snang bar byed pa'i nor bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis 55)nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs par byin gyis brlabs te/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bsti 4)stang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o(5)/ /mchod par bya'o/ /rin po che dang / spos dang / me tog sna tshogs thams cad kyi khang pa brtsegs pa ma 'dres pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po kha dog mtha' yas pa thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa khang pa brtsegs pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che'i sgron ma dang / spos kyi 'od 'phro ba can gyi khang pa brtsegs pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / mu tig thams cad kyis rnam par spras pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa rgya 4)mtsho sprin rnams dang / me tog thams cad kyi ze ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che'i phreng ba mtha' yas pas legs par brgyan pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs par byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyogs bcu kun tu 'od zer snang ba'i snying po can bkod pa thams cad yang dag par 'du ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che thams cad kyi rdul gyis rab tu brgyan pa bkod pa du ma kun tu ston pa khang pa brtsegs pa ⑦rgya mtsho sprin rnams 98—760

dang —/ bkod pa thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa kun tu rgyas par 'gengs pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sgo kun tu me tog gi rta babs dril bu'i dra ba dpyangs zhi)pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs par byin gyis brlabs te sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bsti (bstang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /gser dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi tshong tshong dang / phreng ba dang —/ rin po che'i mgul gdub kyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / me tog snang ba ltar sna tshogs kyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / an da rnyil dang 'dzam bu chu bo'i (5)gser gyi pad+ma sna tshogs kyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nor bu rin po che'i sgron ma'i pad+ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nor bu rin po che snang gsal rgyal mtshan gyi pad+ma sna tshogs kyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po ches brgyan pa'i pad+ma sna tshogs kyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / an da rnyil mdzes par 'bar ba'i 'od zer ldan gyi pad+ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /'od zer 'bar ba zad mi shes pa'i gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i pad+ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che 'bar bar thams cad byung ba'i pad+ma'i ④snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che 'bar ba mchog dam pa thams cad byung ba'i pad+ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin ⑤rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi gsung sgra'i 'od zer dang ldan pa'i pad+ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin ma 'dres ⑥pa rnams kyis 98—761

nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs par byin gyis brlabs te/ sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bsti 6)stang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /spos dang / nor bu sna tshogs thams cad kyi shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / kun nas sgo lo ma las thal mo sbyar ba'i sprin 'byung ba'i spos kyi shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / shing ljon pa thams cad kyi gzugs mtha' yas pa bkod pa kun tu ston pa'i shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / me tog thams cad kyi sprin rab tu 'phyang ba'i shing ljon pa lta bu rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / bkod pa thams cad 'byung ba'i mdzod mtha' yas pa dang ldan pa'i shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che 'od 'phro ba thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor kyirnam par snang bar (gebyed pa'i shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lus phyed tsan+dan thams cad kyi phye tsho rimar kun tu ston pa'i shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / byang chub kyi snying po thams cad kyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'od can gyi shing ljon pa'i rin po che'i gos thams cad kyi mdzod nyi ma ltar snang bar byas pa dang ldan pa'i shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sgra dbyangs thams cad sgrogs pa yid du 'ong ba'i dbyangs kun tu gtong ba'i shing ljon pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /rin po che kha dog mtha' yas pa'i pad+ma'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / kun tu mngon par phyogs pa'i nor bu'i rgyal po snang bar byed pa'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rgyan bkod pa thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya nyanamatsho sprin rnams dang /rin po che sna tshogs 'od 'phro ba'i sgron ma'i phreng di ba'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri 98—762

rgya 6)mtsho sprin rnams dang / kun nas sgra rin po che'i shing ljon pa 'byung ba'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / spos dang / me tog dang / pad+ma thams cad kyi phreng ba rin po che'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri ( rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gdan bkod pa kun tu ston pa'i nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / bkod pa thams cad kyi phreng ba rab tu dpyangs 98)pa'i rta babs stegs bus rab tu brgyan pa ④rin po che'i sprin gyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nor bu rin po che'i yal ga 55)dang / phye ma'i mdzod yod pa'i sdong po thams cad kyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /spos sna tshogs dang / rin po che'i dril bu g.yer ku'i (6)dra ba kun nas rgyan nyi ma snang bar byed pa'i snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs par byin gyis brlabs te/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bsti 7 stang du 8)bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /yid bzhin (9gyi nor bu'i rgyal po thams cad kyi gzhal med khang rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / an da rnyil gyi ze ba can gyi me tog bkod pa thams cad kyi bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / spos dang / nor bu thams cad kyi bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che'i 'od 'phro ba'i sgron ma'i gzugs kyi bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul rnam par ston par snang ba'i dbyangs kyi nor bu'i rgyal po bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang —/ nor bu sna tshogs kyi gos bkod pa thams cad snang ba kun tu ston 7pa'i bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / me tog thams cad kyi chu bo 'bar bar snang ba'i 98—763

rin po che'i bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / dril bu sna tshogs kyi sgras kun tu rgyas par 'gengs pa'i dra ba'i bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / pad+ma 'bar ba kha dog mtha' yas pa sna tshogs su snang ba'i nor bu'i snying po can gyi pad+ma'i dra ba'i bla 0)re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / gser gyi dra ba can gyi 'od zer snang ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par snang ba'i 'od mtha' yas pa bkod pa thams cad kyi rgyan bla re rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs par byin gyis brlabs te/ sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' gang (michen mtsho sprin rgya mtsho thams cad la bste ①stang du ④bya'o / /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /nor bu rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs par byin gyis brlabs la/ rin po che bcu'i 'od snang ba bkod pa'i me tog gi gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / mu tig kha dog mtha' yas pa'i mdzod kyi gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi snying rje'i sgo'i sgra'i nor bu'i rgyal po'i gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'od 'phro ba'i phreng ba'i gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che rdul kun tu snang bas rab tu brgyan pa'i dril bu'i dra ba dpyangs 45)pa'i gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nor bu thams cad kyi sdong po yal ga'i rgyan gyi gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nyi ma rnam par snang bar byed pa'i 'od 'phro ba'i nor bu'i rgyal po dang / spos dang /bdug 55)pa thams cad kyi gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / tsan+dan gyi phye ma'i mdzod kun tu rgyas par 'gengs pa'i gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs 98—764

rgyas kyi yul chen po snang bar byed pa'i kun tu bkod pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i gdugs rgya mtsho sprin ma 'dres pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems 1)dpa' ②rgya mtsho thams cad la bsti ( ristang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o / /mchod par bya'o/ /rin po che thams cad snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che 'od 'phro ba thams cad kyi gzugs kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin ma 'dres pa rnams dang / me tog gi sprin snang bar byed pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che thams cad kyi 'od zer sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad snang bar gtogs pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / kun nas sgo sangs rgyas kyi yul sgrogs pa rin po che'i yal ga'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho 4)sprin rnams dang / bai ḍūr+ya (snyedang / rin po che'i rigs dang / nor bu rin po che'i rigs dang / nor bu'i yirgyal po thams cad kyi 'od zer gyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sems can gyi gzugs mtha' yas pa dag sems kyi skad cig la kun tu ston pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam las byung ba yid du 'ong ba'i sgra rab tu 'byin pa dang ldan pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du sems can 'dul ba'i dbyangs can nor bu'i rgyal po 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad la bsti tsho stang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /nor bu thams cad kyi mdzod kyi 'od zer rgya mtsho (8mosprin 98wa 765

rnams dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang /ro dang / reg bya'i 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba 0)rgya mtsho (shesprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos sgrogs pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing bkod pa thams cad snang bar byed pa'i 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /me tog gi khang pa brtsegs pa thams cad kyi 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /rin po che thams cad kyi rdul gyi 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / bskal pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad du sangs rgyas 'byung bas sems can yongs su smin par byed pa sgrogs pa can gyi 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /rin po riXche mi 4)zad pa thams cad bstan pa dang / me tog thams cad kyi ze ba'i 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / khri stan 55)bkod pa thams cad kun tu ston pa'i 'od zer rgya mtsho sprin ma 'dres pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams (ne cad la bsti 7)stang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /rin po che'i 'od 'phro ba'i kha dog mtha' yas pa rgya mtsho sprin ma 'dres pa rnams dang / kun tu 'od kyi nor bu'i rgyal po'i 'od 8༄'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing rgya chen po bkod pa snang bar byed pa'i 'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / spos thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / bkod pa thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa'i 'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che nyu༄sna tshogs kyi shing gi ze ba'i bya'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / gos thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin 98—766

rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas pa'i spyod pa dbyangs can nor bu'i rgyal po'i 'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / mu tig gi sgron ma thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba rgya mtsho sprin ma 'dres pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang (1)chen mtsho'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho (5sprin thams cad la bsti ( swāstang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /spos dang /me tog sna tshogs thams cad kyi rgya mtsho sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams dang /rin po che 'od 'phro ba thams cad kyi pad mo'i dra ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /nor bu ④rin po che kha dog mtha' yas pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che 55thams cad kyi kha dog dang ldan pa'i mu tig gi mdzod rgya mtsho (6)sprin rnams dang / rin po che dang / spos dang / tsan+dan thams cad kyi phye ma rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che thams cad kyi gdugs rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nor bu'i rgyal po yid du 'ong zhing sdug pa mdzes pa'i dbyangs can rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / nyi ma'i 'od kyi nor bu'i tshogs kyi phreng ba rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang / rin po che'i mdzod mtha' yas pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams dang /thams cad kun tu bzang po'i lus ma 'dres pa rgya mtsho sprin rnams kyis 7tshosangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang na chen mtsho'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho thams cad la bste 1)stang du bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /zhes de lta bu'i smon lam btab nas/ klu'i rgyal po de dag gis yang bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas rang rang gi stan la 'khod do/ /de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i klu'i yobadag po chen po phyir mi ldog pa'i smon lam gyi stobs can 98—767

g.yog mtha' yas rgya mtsho sprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal po zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang / phyag bya ba dang /bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir 'ongs so / /de nas klu'i bdag po g.yog mtha' yas rgya mtsho sprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal po stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i bdag po g.yog mtha' yas rgya mtsho 0)sprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /klu'i bdag po ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang / ngas (sadris pa de dang de'i lung bstan pas khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o / /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la klu'i bdag po g.yog mtha' yas rgya mtsho sprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na klu thams cad kyi klu'i sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad par 'gyur/ bde ba thams cad dang ldan pa dang rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir dus dus su char gyi rgyun 'bebs par 'gyur/ rtswa dang shing gel pa dang sman dang nags tshal ②thams cad 'khrung bar la'agyur/ 'bru thams cad skye bar 'gyur/ bcud 98—768

thams cad yang dag par skye bar 'gyur/ gang gis 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i bdag po g.yog mtha' yas rgya mtsho sprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /klu'i bdag po khyod sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zhugs te/de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di yongs su 'dri bar sems pa/ legs so/ /legs so/ /klu'i bdag po de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung ①shig dang ngas khyod la bshad do/ /klu'i bdag po chos gcig dang ldan na klu thams cad kyi klu'i sdug bsngal thams cad ( rgyun chad par 'gyur ( )bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /chos gcig po gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste byams pa'o/ /klu'i bdag po byams pa de la gnas pa'i lha dang mi rnams ni mes mi tshig /mtshon gyis mi tshugs/ chus mi khyer/ dug gis mi tshugs/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis zil gyis mi non/ bde bar gnyid kyis log (47par 'gyur/ bde bar sad par 'gyur/ rang gi bsod nams kyis yongs su bsrung bar (57'gyur/bsod nams chen po'i shu rigazi brjid kyis gzi can (7)du 'gyur/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mi rdzi bar (8)'gyur/ mdzes pa dang mthong na dga' bar 'gyur / 'gro ba thams cad du thags thogs med par 'gyur/ sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun 'chad 6)pa dang / berab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ bde ba thams cad dang ldan pa dang / mi'i chos bla ma 17rtogs nas lus zhig pa'i 'og tu tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur te/ klu'i bdag po lha dang mi byams pa la gnas pa rnams kyi phan yon ni me'adi dag go/ /klu'i bdag po de bas na 98—769

byams pa'i lus kyi las dang / byams pa'i ngag gi las dang / byams pa'i yid kyi las kyis gnas par bya'o/ /klu'i bdag po gzhan yang bde ba thams cad sbyin zhi)pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs brjod par bya ste/ des klu thams cad kyi klu'i sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun gcod par byed bde ba thams cad sbyin par byed de/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir dus dus su char gyi rgyun 'bebs par byed/rtswa (snyedang shing gel pa dang sman dang nags tshal dang lo tog thams cad skye bar byed do/ /klu'i bdag po de la bde ba thams cad sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs gang zhe na/ tabya thā/ dhā ra tī dhā ra tī/ ut+na char ṇ+ḍali/ sam pra tiṣ+ṭha te(nya/bi (6)dza ya bar+ṇa/7)/ sat+ya pra tidz+nyā (8dis ra ha/ dz+nyā na ba ti/ ud de pā da ni bi nā ma ni/ a bhi ṣe (9)tsa ni/ a bhi byā 7tā ra/ shu bha ba ti/ a dzi ma tu/ e hi kum ba la ni/ ba ha /1hā ra kli sha tson/ dhu na pā paṃ/ sho dha ya marga ṇa'/ni ra ti ka /dharma ta shud+dha/ lo ka bi ti mi ra ra tsa sa/ duḥkha sha ma na sarba tso bud+dha / a ba lo ka na a dhikhyi bte/ pradz+nyā dzadz+nyā na bhe swā hā/ klu'i bdag po gzungs kyi tshig don thams cad sgrub par byed pa chos kyi sku la 'jug pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ bde ba thams cad sbyin pa 'di dag gzung bar bya brjod par bya'o/ /klu'i bdag po gzhan yang sprin gyi rigs las 'byung ba'i byin gyi brlabs tsobakod pa gzi brjid kyi snying po sprul pa snang bar byed pa/ ye shes kyi tog gi chu'i rgyun gyi sprin gyi dkyil 'khor dpal dang ldan pa gser gyi 'od zer rnam par snang bar byed pa/ skra'i rtse mo'i cha shas gcig las byung ba'i rus dang / rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan gzung bar bya yid la bya'o/ /de dag gis klu thams cad dang / klu'i rigs thams cad 98—770

dang ske/ klu'i rus thams cad dang / klu'i cho rigs thams cad dang / klu'i 'byung ba thams cad dang / klu'i skye gnas thams cad dang / klu'i rgyal po thams cad dang / klu'i bu mo thams cad dang / klu'i g.yog thams cad kyi klu'i sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun gcod par byed pa bde ba'i yo byad thams cad sgrub ①par byed do/ /klu'i bdag po de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan de dag gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad snying po can gyi sprin chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i rigs las byung ba'i sprin gyis rnam par mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi chu 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dpal ldan sprin gyi gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa klung gi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam 90par 'joms pa'i sprin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen po'i glog 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen mthu rtsal dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin sdud chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi dkyil 'khor chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen seng ge la phyag 98—771

'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen gdugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa blta sdug sprin 6)chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen pos khebs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das (kyede bzhin gshegs pa sprin las byung ②ba snang bar byed pa'i dkyil 'khor phyogs bcu mtho 'gebs rnga'i sgra dbyangs shin tu rab sgrogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bco ma ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen bsil 'byung mi dga' rab 'joms sgra zab sgrogs la phyag 'tshal lo bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i chu sprin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rtsal gyi sprin ltar dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra bsgrags bul phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen kun du ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin rgya chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin 'dzag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin ltar rnam par sgrogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin ltar 'phags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin lta bu'i na bza' mnabs (snyepa la phyag 'tshal lo / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyis lo tog skyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi gnas la gnas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa char sprin gyi sprin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin 'du bar mdzad la 98—772

phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin rnam par rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen ut+pa la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen spos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'phags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'od mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen byin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu rin po che chen po'i sprin lta bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin ltar rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi chu bo ①la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dus ma yin pa'i sprin dang lce 'bab pa rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen po ltar nam mkha' mtho nas bsgrags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen sgra 'byin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen char bu skyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa snyems pa'i gzi brjid sgrub pa'i sprin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ro bro ba drug dang ldan ba'i chu chen po'i sprin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chu 'thor sprin chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa (gyisprin chen rgya mtsho 'gengs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /98—773

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa char mi 'bab pa na sprin gyis kun tu 'gebs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gzugs mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshe gas pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin chen po thams cad rnam par sgrub pa 'dzam bu'i sprin gyi dpal gyi gzi brjid 'od mdzad pa sprin gyi 'od zer can rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i bdag po de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan 'di dag brjod pas klu thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun 'chad pa dang /bde ba thams cad dang ldan pa dang / 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir dus dus su char pa'i rgyun 'bab pa dang rtswa dang shing gel pa dang / sman dang / nags tshal dang / lo tog thams cad skyed par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i klu'i bdag po g.yog mtha' yas rgya mtsho dhisprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal pos gsol ba btab pa/bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus na/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char mi 'bab pa'i tshe gang dag brjod na char gyi rgyun chen po 'bab par bgyid pa dang /mi bzad pa'i (2)dus kyi tshe dang / gnod pa 'byung ba'i dus kyi tshe dang / chos ma lags pas skye bo 'thab pa'i dus kyi tshe dang / yams kyi nad dang gnod pa 'byung ba'i dus kyi tshe dang / nad dang 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe dang / skar ma ma rungs pa gnas pa'i dus kyi tshe dang / yams kyi nad dang 'tshe ba dang gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa dang / de lta bu'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi rnams bshad (5)du gsol/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs ④kyis byin gyis brlab par gsol/ gang dag klu thams cad la skul ma 'debs par 98—774

'gyur ba dang / lha thams cad rab tu dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / bdud thams cad rnam par 'joms par 'gyur ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi 'jigs pa thams cad 'jig par 'gyur ba dang / gnod pa thams cad zlog par 'gyur ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyid pa dang /rgyu skar ma rungs pas bgyis pa rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis char pa'i bar chad lnga gsungs pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad sel bar 'gyur ba dang / 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char pa'i rgyun legs par 'bab par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi 6)gzhi rnams bcom ldan 'das mchog tu thugs rje dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad la phan par thugs brtse ba dang ldan pas bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba 'tshal lo/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i rgyal po g.yog mtha' yas rgya mtsho sprin bkod pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor gdugs lta bu'i rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /klu'i bdag po khyod (gesems can thams cad kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba 'debs pa legs so legs so/ /klu'i bdag po de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung (57shig dang / snying rje chen po las byung ba 'brug chen po'i sgra can bsgyings pa dpa' ba'i 94)tog ces bya ba'i gzungs sems can thams cad kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa byin gyis brlabs pa rjes su yi rang ba bshad par bya ste/ de ni char med pa'i tshe char 'bab par byed/ char ches pa gcod/ 'chi ba'i gnod pa rab tu zhi bar byed/ klu thams cad skul bar 98—775

de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' bo la gzungs sngags 'di bka' stsal to/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta 6)a ba lo ki (mite/ o sam+bha ra sam+bha (lde)ra hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig tshe ring bar 'dod dam/ bsod nams che zhing 'phel ba dang /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myur du yongs su rdzogs par 'dod na ni/ rtag tu snga dro'i dus sam/ yang na dus thams cad du byas kyang bar chad du 'gyur ba med dol/ /snod gtsang ma'i nang du chu gtsang ma blugs la/ chan nam/ phye'am/khur ( rib la sogs pa cung zad cig btab ste/ lag pa g.yas pa snod kyi steng du bzhag la/ gzungs 'di 55lan bdun bsngags nas de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan nas brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang gi mtshan nas brjod pa'i byin gyis ⑥brlabs kyis yi dgas thams cad kyi skye ba mang po'i ser sna byas pa'i mi dge ba'i las bcom zhing bsod nams yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa'i mtshan nas brjod pa'i byin gyis brlabs (7)kyis yi dgas mang po byad gzugs mi sdug pa bcom zhing gzugs dang mtshan phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro / /de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byam klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byam klas kyi mtshan nas brjod pa'i byin gyis brlabs ri kyis yi dgas mang po'i skom pa spangs shing tshim par 'gyur 59)te/ sbyin pa'i gnas yid bzhin du za ba dang chog cing 'grangs bopar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa 98—846

dang bral ba'i mtshan nas brjod pa'i byin gyis brlabs (1)kyis yi dgas mang po'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral te/ yi dgas kyi khams thams cad ②zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu la sogs pas de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan nas brjod de byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'og tu se gol lan gsum byas te/ gtor ma'i snod blangs nas lag pa brkyang ste/ sa gtsang mar blug dzod par bya'o/ /de ltar gtor ma sbyin par byas na phyogs bzhi nas lhags pa'i yi dgas gang gā'i klung 4gi bye ma (5nikhrag khrig brgya stong snyed so 01so nas yul dbus 'gyur tshal gyi bre tshad mas bcal 7)ba'i bre bdun bdun thob par 'gyur ro/ /kha zas de dag yi dgas kyis yid bzhin du za ba dang / chog 'grangs 987pa dang / yi dgas kyi khams spong ba dang / mtho ris kyi lhar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dga' bo gal te dge slong pha dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang zhig rtag (9tu gzungs 'dis kha zas la bsngags 1rtate yi dgas la sbyin pa 11byin na bsod nams tshad med pa snyed yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhing / de nas sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong snyed la mchod pa byas pa'i bsod nams dang khyad nya par med de/ tshe ring ba dang / bsod nams dang / mdangs dang / stobs skye zhing 'phel ba dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs pa dang / mi dang /nyi mi ma yin pa dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dgas ma rungs pa thams cad kyis gtse zhing gnod par byed mi nus pa dang / gzhan la gzi brjid tshad med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gal te gang zhig bram ze dang drang srong la sbyin pa byed 'dod na kha zas yongs su dag pa snod gcig gi nang du bkang ste/ gzungs 98—847
