par 'ong ngo zhes bya ba dang / de tsam ches kyis phri 91)la byin zhes bya ba dang lnga brjod pa/ skyi zing byed pa cig dang phrad pa las/ der gang zag gnyis po des bsams pa/ dgon pa bas grong yul thag nye la zas mod dunadapas grong khyer du phyin te bslangs pas dkar gsum dang / mngar gsum dang / 'bras dang /nas kyi zan la sogs pa bza' ba dang / btung ba mang du rnyed nas yi dgas kyi drung du khyer te phyin nas bstabs pas mi len par gong gi (0sgra rnam pa lnga sgrogs shing bros so/ /der gang zag gnyis po des shin tu ma dga' nas yi dgas mo de'i sems su song nas gzhan yid la ma dran te/ bcom ldan 'das 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs pa can du de ma thag phyin te/ zhabs la phyag btsal 4)bas (5)'khangs (7nas thang chad de dri (7)ba ma spobs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod (3)ci nyes/ dri ba yod na dbugs phyung la dris shig ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das lags bdag cag ni shin tu ma dga' ste/nyid la khong yus 59)che nas 'khams pa lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ ci las gyur smras pa/ bdag cag gnyis ni bas mtha' nyu )zhig na bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas gsungs pa so sor rtog pa yid la byed pa las rgyang ring por 'chag tu phyin pa las/ yi dgas mo lus po sngo la skam pa/ khog khog zer ba/ skra 'dzings pa / mig dmar la g.yon du yo ba/ ma mchu ring la zhunyagayas su yo ba/ ske tunyedang rkang lag shin tu phra la ring ba/ lag pas khu tshur bsdams pa'i sen mos thad kur phug nas sngo zang nge nyu)ba/ kha nas sgra rnam pa lnga 8sgrogs pa 'di lta ste/dgos na zhes bya ba dang / med na zhes bya ba dang / ma sbyin 7cig ces bya ba dang / ster na yang ma che ches par 'ong ngo zhes bya ba dang / de tsam ches kyis 98—852

phri la byin ces bya ba dang lnga brjod pa/ skyi zing byed 0)pa cig dang phrad nas/bdag cag gnyis kyis bsams pas dgon pa bas grong yul thag nye la zas mod pas grong khyer du phyin te/ bslangs pas dkar gsum dang / mngar gsum dang —/ 'bras dang / nas kyi zan la sogs pa bza' ba dang / btung ba mang du rnyed nas yi dgas mo de'i drung du khyer nas bstabs pas/ kha nas gong gi sgra rnam pa lnga brjod cing gang byin pa mi len par bros te thal na 'di ci las (migyur pa dang / 'di la sman pa'i thabs ci mchis zhu ru mchis pa 5)lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag de ni shin tu yang legs so/ /ngas bshad kyis legs par nyon la yid la zung (47shig /de ci las gyur na lus sngo la skam pa ni rang gis za ma phod pa las gyur to/ /ske phra ba ni gzhan za zhing spyod pa la bdag gis ser sna byas pa las gyur to/ /yan lag phra la sor mos thad kur (5)phug pa ni gzhan la sbyin pa dag la ches 56)kyis phri la byin ces byas pa dang /rang gis kyang spyod mi phod pa las gyur to/ /skra 'dzings pa ni kun gyi yid du mi 'ong ba byas pa las gyur to/ /mig dmar ba ni 'dod chags kyis yongs su rgyas pa las gyur to/ /g.yon du yo ba ni mig mi legs par gzhan la bltas (77pa las gyur to/ /ma mchu ring la g.yas su yo ba ni ster na yang ches par 'ong ngo zhes byas (kyepa tho)las gyur to/ /kha nas sgra rnam pa lnga sgrogs pa ni byed pa rgyu mthun (rtepa'i 'bras bu ste/ sngon brjod pa'i bag chags brtas 17pa las gyur to/ /de lta bu'i las kyi dbang gis gzhan ci byin yang phan par mi 'gyur te/ chu gcig pu las rang gis sbyin nus pa ma yin te/ gzhan gyi chu la 'jur 'gegs lom byas pas da lta yang chu gtsang ma rtsam 1 pas ma reg pa la sngags lan cig btab ste/98—853

se gol lan cig gtogs te byin na de'i rgyud grol zhing 'dod pa tshim par 'gyur rol/ /de 'di lta ste/ oṃ dz+wa la mi 4)rda sarba pre ta ( bh+yaḥswā hā/ gsol pa/ de'i 'bru don bshad du gsol/ bka' stsal pa/ oṃ ni ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin te don dam pa'o/ /dz+wa la (mi'adod pa me ltar 'bar ba'o/ /mi gorda (snyeni mi'i rgyud kyis ser sna dang 'jur 'gegs (7byas pa'o/ /sarba ni de lta bu'i las las gyur pa thams cad do/ /pre ta ⑦ni yi dgas kyi zhu)snying po ste las kyi rgyud smin pa'i don to / /bh+yaḥni las dang sdug bsngal byang bar bya ba'i don to/ /swā hā ni las dang sdug bsngal bkres skom byang bar gyur cig pa'o/ /da myur du song la de ltar gsos cig kyi)ces gsungs pas/ de nas gnyis kyis myur du phyin nas/ de bzhin du bgyis pas gzod tshudaga' nas longs spyod cing lus bag glan no/ /de nas chos ston la bab nas gnyis po re yonyemos byas te/ shā ri'i bus bshos ⑫gsol nas gcig 42gsol du stsal te7/ chab byin pas yang gong bzhin brjod de bros so/ /yang gnyis kyis yid ma ches nas bcom ldan 'das la zhu ru mchis so / /bcom ldan 'das lags/ bdag cag gis gsungs pa bzhin bgyis lags pas gso ru btub 7par gda' chub la chos ston yol du dogs nas 'tshal nas yang sngar bzhin brjod cing bros nas yang zhu ru mchis so/ /bka' stsal pa/de ni khyod kyi sen bar du rtsam tu pa lag tunyepas len 4)pa yin gyis/ lag pa khrus la gzod ( )byin cigasalha /de'i drung du 'gro mi dgos te 'di nyid kyis btub po zhes gsungs so/ /de gnyis kyis khrus bgyis te/ chu sbyin stsal bas yi dgas mo de nyid du 'ongs nas cung zad na mdangs dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di lta bu'i chu sbyin 'di ni 'dir 98—854

ma zad de dus thams cad du yang yi dam du gyis la thong cig6) /gzhan la yang rgya cher spel cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di'i phan yon ni dpag tu med de tshad las 'das so/ /mdo tsam brjod na 'di lta ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mi chaphyug po rnams la sbyin pa byas pa bas dbul po 'ga' zhig la sbyin pa byas na de'i bsod nams brgya'i char yang mi nye ste/ de ci ste zhe na/ phyug po rnams ni nga rgyal te dregs pa dang rgyags pas gnas ngan len spro bar byed do(9/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi dbul po rnams la sbyin pa byas pa bas yi dgas 'ga' zhig la sbyin pa byas na de'i bsod nams brgya'i char yang mi nye'o/ /de ci ste zhe na/dbul po rnams la ni 'bad du yod/ btsal du yod/ bslang du yod do/ /yi dgas las kyis de lta bu dag ma yin gyi/ ma bsngos na kha ru chud kyang dug chen por 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi yi dgas la sbyin pa byas pa bas 'jur 'gegs (gekyi yi dgas gcig la chu byin na de'i bsod nams brgya'i char yang mi nye'o / /de ci ste zhe na/ yi dgas de dag la ni dmigs pas tshim pa dang /bshams pas tshim pa dang / bsngos pas tshim pa dang / reg pas tshim pa dang /rjes kyis tshim pa dang / bshal bas tshim pa yang (geyod de/ las kyi rim pa bzhin no/ /'jur 'gegs 9kyisani gzhan bkag pa'i 3)las kyis sngags dang /phyag rgya dang dmigs pa gzhan gyis mi thob/ rdzas thams cad la 'thams te bkag pas rdzas gzhan mi myong / gzhan gyi chu gcig bu ma bkag pas chu gtsang rtsam (kyepas ma reg pa las dbang med/ rang gi rgyud zhi bar byed pa'i sngags dang / phyag rgya se gol gcig min pa gzhan gang gis kyang thob par mi nus so/ /se gol gcig tu gzhag pa ci zhe na gnyis su gyur na gzhan gyi sgrar gyur nas mi 98—855

zhes bya ba'i gzungs/tsa)༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sabha 90be tā ḍa (8)ka nā ma dhā ra hā/thu/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa ro langs bdun pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig (5)tu bzhugs te/ phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang yang thabs cig yidago/ /de'i tshe na mu stegs can kun tu rgyu ba rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gnod pa bya ba'i phyir/ ro langs chen po bdun btang bar gyur to/ /de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ba las de dag gis glags ma rnyed/ dmigs pa ma rnyed do/ /de dag gis glags ma rnyed/dmigs pa ma rnyed nas de dag tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ga la ba der song ste 98—860

brgya rtsa brgyad pa/17༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ shrī de bī 'on kā 95)phri (4)nā ma aṣ+ṭa sha ta ka /bod skad du/ dpal lha mo nag mo'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la bzhugs te/rgyu dang 'bras bu'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bden pa'i mtshan rnams ston par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe dpal lha mo nag mo chen mo yang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ste/ lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' seng ge brtson 'grus kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' srin mo'i cha lugs kyis 'jig rten pa'i don mdzad pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs ji lta bu lags zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 98—885

kyis byang chub sems dpa' seng ge brtson 'grus la dgongs nas dpal lha mo nag mo la gzigs te 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /thos bsam bsgom la cher ①gnas pa'i/ /rgyu 'bras rkyen gyi (5)bdag nyid can/ /'gro la phan mdzad mkhas pa'i mchog /dpal ldan lha mo nag mo 'phags/ /byang chub sems dpa' ①sprul pa ste/ /sa ltar brten ④pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ /yon tan sdud byed chu dang 'dra / /byang chub smin byed me lta bu/ /dge ba'i 'du byed rlung ltar g.yo/ /shes rab rnam dag nam mkha' ste/ /khyod ni 'byung ba chen po 'dra/ /'byung po phal chen rnams kyis bstod/ /bsod nams ye shes rab bsags pa'i/ /las dang rnam smin dag la mkhas/ /nga rgyal gzugs kyis (de'adul ba goms/ /shes rab snying rje'i lam du 'gro/ /khyod ni bum pa bzang lta bu/ /dper na yid bzhin nor bu'i chu/ /kun la phan pa'i dpag bsam zhi)shing / /nyi ma 'dra bar khyod la gsal/ /zla ltar gsal ba'i thugs mnga' zhing / /ming ni ri bong rwa dang 'dra/ /rang gi rgyud ni 'khor lo 'dra/ /u dum bār 57)ltar khyod dkon yang / /bdud rtsi lta bur yongs tshim mdzad/ /'gro ba kun gyi bdag mo lags//rang bzhin med pa'i chos kyang ston/ /chu dang nam mkha'i tshub ma ltar/ /gdul bya'i srid gsum cis kyang 'dul/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa skyong / /dam pa rnams dang yang dag gcig /dam pa rnams kyi lam du 'gro/ /lha mo ma mo gnod sbyin mo/ /srin mo klu mo sha za mo/ /gdug mo 'byung mo grul bum mo/ /drag mo rngam tshul glog nasa'agyu ma/ /rlung mo nag mo 'jigs byed ma/ /mkha' 'gro gtum mo zhing sgrol ma/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag pos 'dul/ /dkar ser ljang nag dmar yang ston/ /rnam pa brgyad kyi dbyibs kyang 'byung / /98—886

'gro ba drug po'i tshul yang ston/ /phung po lnga yang brjod par nus/ /dbang po tshim byed yul lnga'ang ston/ /rten cing 'brel pa'i spyod pa mkhas/ /yul can rnams ni gsod la mkhas/ /de bzhin ngag 6)rnams gsod pa dang / /lus can rnams ni gsod la brtson/ /sems ni gsod pa med la mkhas/ /'khor ba las ni ring du song / /de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan te/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong mdzad dpal ldan ma/ /dam chos 'dzin pa rnams la byams/ /oṃ āḥs/ shrī de bi kā li sa ma ya dzaḥl/ḍā ①gi ④ nī ḍā 9geya sa ma ya swā hā/ ming brgya rtsa brgyad gang 'dzin pa/ /yon tan brgya rtsa brgyad kyang 'thob(ne / /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong mi 'gyur/ /yi dgas gnas su mi skye zhing / /byol song skye bas thogs med (7༄'gyur/ /lus 'phags gnas su skyes pa na/ /thog la sogs pa mi 'bab cing / /sgra mi snyan du rlung gis min/ /de bzhin ba lang ⑧spyod du yang / /chu dang rlabs kyis khyer mi nus/ /'dzam bu'i (7gling du gang skyes pa/ /sna tshogs gnod pas nyen mi ⑩'gyur / /'dod pa'i lha rnams gnas su yang / /skyes nas chos la dga' bar 'gyur / /bsam gtan bzhi yi skye gnas su/ /tshad med bzhi ni 'phel bar 'gyur / /gzugs med gnas ni bzhi por yang / /don med na ni mi skye ste/ /'du shes med par nam yang min/ /'phags pa bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su/ /khams gsum tshul gyis bdag don spyod/ /rtag tu yul la chags mi 'gyur/ /sems la 'dzin par mi byed de/ /nyon mongs rtsa ba drug po dang / /de bzhin nye ba nyi shu dang / /mtshams med lnga yang byang bar 'gyur/ /bskal pa grangs med mang por yang / /mi khom brgyad du skye mi 'gyur/ /mu stegs rtsod pa bzlog 98—887

sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba de bzhin du bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis kyang sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bgyid pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid par gyur cig /ji ltar dus gsum gyi 0)sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rjes su dran pa dang mtshan nas brjod pas / dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi mtshan nas brjod cing bsnyen bkur bgyis par gyur cig /ji ltar dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi (mithugs rje'i rang bzhin 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de rjes su dran pa dang mtshan nas brjod cing / mchod pa bgyis pas / thugs rje chen po'i yul du gyur pa sems can thams cad la yang snying rje chen po'i thabs kyi (0sbyor ba rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung bar gyur cig /ji srid bdag ni 'khor ba'i tshe/ /de snyed bdag ni lus skyes par/ /de srid mgon po mchod bgyid cing / /de snyed lus sbyor tshogs bgyid shog /ji srid bdag ni 'khor ba'i tshe/ /ji skad bdag gi (4)ngag skyes par/ /de srid mgon po'i ( 5)mtshan brjod cing / /ngag gis 56)sbyor ba tshogs bgyid shog /ji srid bdag ni 'khor ba na/ /de snyed bdag gi yid 'byung ba/ /de snyed mgon po rjes dran zhing ske/ /yid sbyor tshogs par bgyid gyur cig /de ltar lus dang ngag yid kyis / /thugs rje'i dbang phyug rten bgyis pas/ /lus dang ngag yid skyon bral zhing glu/ /yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur cig /de ltar lus ngag yid kyis su/ /98—917

thugs rje'i dbang phyug sku gsung thugs/ /rtag tu sbyor bar bgyid pas na/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs/ /srid gsum re ba'i gnas gcig po// yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /①de 'drar bdag kyang grub gyur te/ /srid gsum re rdzogs bgyid gyur cig /na mo rat+na ③tra yā ya/ na ma 0ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā yadhi/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā (snyen ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā /4) o tsakra brti/ tsin+ta stim ṇi ma hā pad+me ⑧na ru tiṣ+ṭhayi)/ dz+wa la ā kur+sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags rdzogs stoX// //oṃ pad+me tsin+ta skyem ṇi dz+wa tsol t+t+waṃ/ snying po'o/ /oṃ bha ra da pad+me tso / nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ma ṇi badz+re ṇi 8rgyu/ gsang ba'i snying po'o/ /sngags snying bzhi 'byung ba dang ⑫/ smon lam dang tshigs su bcad pa dang sngags su bcas pa rdzogs sgom// //

rog /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/(1)༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bha dra tsār+ya pra ṇi dhā na rā dzā(gyi/ bod skad dul/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun/ /bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa/ /thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos/ /de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag 5gergya mtsho'i (4)sgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba 98—921

kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing / /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ /me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang / /sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang / /mar me mchog dang bdug pa dam pa yis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang / /phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang / /bkod pa'i khyad 6)par 'phags pa (mimachog kun gyis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyida'aswā/ /mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis na/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang / /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras / /rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang / /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang / /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang / /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes / /mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la/ /'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan 'das ston gang bzhed de dag la/ /'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang / /bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yis/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten dag na gang 98—922

bzhugs mchod par gyur/ /gang yang ma byon de dag rab myur bar/ /bsam rdzogs byang chub rim par sangs rgyas spyon/ /phyogs bcu ga la'i 6)zhing rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rgya cher yongs su dag par gyur/ /byang chub shing dbang drung gshegs rgyal ba dang / /sangs rgyas sras kyis rab tu gang bar shog /phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar 'gyur② / /'gro ba kun gyi chos kyis sa)don rnams ni/ /mthun ④par gyur cing re ba'ang 'grub par shog /byang chub spyod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing / /'gro ba kun tu skye ba dran par 'gyur(ge/ /tshe rabs 6)kun tu 'chi 'pho skye ba na/ /rtag tu bdag ni rab tu 'byung bar shog /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te/ /bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag par/ /rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog /lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang / /'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji tsam par/ /thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan to/ /des shing pha rol phyin la rab brtson te/ /byang chub sems ni nam yang brjed ma ⑦gyur / /sdig pa gang rnams sgrib par gyur pa dag /de dag ma lus yongs su byang bar shog /las dang nyon mongs bdud kyi las rnams las/ /grol zhing 'jig rten 'gro ba rnams su yang / /ji ltar pad+ma chus mi chags pa bzhin/ /nyi zla nam mkha' 6)thogs pa med ltar spyadapo)/ /zhing gi khyon dang phyogs rnams ji tsam par/ /ngan song sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed/ /bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'god cing / /'gro ba thams cad la ni phan par spyad/ /byang chub spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /sems can rnams kyi spyod dang mthun ⑩par 98—923

'jug /bzang po spyod pa dag ni rab ston cing / /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyod par gyur/ /bdag gis spyod dang mthun 6)par gang spyod pa/ /de dag dang ni rtag tu 'grogs par shog /lus dang ngag rnams dang ni sems kyis kyang / /spyod pa dag dang smon lam gcig tu spyad/ /bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs po dag /bzang po spyod pa rab tu ston pa rnams/ /de dag dang yang rtag tu phrad par shog /de dag bdag gis nam yang yid mi dbyung / /sangs rgyas sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po rnams/ /mngon sum rtag tu bdag gis rgyal ba blta/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar/ /de dag la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /byang chub spyod pa kun tu snang bar byed/ /bzang po (0spyod pa rnam par spyad pa yang / /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyad par bgyi/ /srid pa thams cad du ni 'khor ba na/ /bsod nams ye shes dag ni mi zad rnyed/ /thabs dang shes rab gting 'dzin rnam thar dang / /yon tan kun gyi mi zad mdzod du gyur/ /rdul gcig ④steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te/ /zhing der bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa la/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod cing blta bar bgyi/ /de ltar ma lus thams cad phyogs su yang / /skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyis(ge/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang / /bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod cing rab tu 'jug /gsung gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i ①sgra skad kyis / /rgyal ba kun dbyangs yan lag rnam dag pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa ji bzhin dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas gsung la rtag tu 'jug par bgyi/ /dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba thams cad dag /'khor lo'i nyatshul rnams rab tu 98—924

bskor ba yi/ /de dag gi yang gsung dbyangs mi zad la/ /blo yi stobs kyis bdag kyang rab tu 'jug /ma 'ongs bskal pa thams cad 'jug par yang / /skad cig gcig gis bdag kyang 'jug par bgyi/ /gang yang bskal pa dus gsum tshad de dag /skad cig cha shas kyis ni zhugs par spyad/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge gang / /de dag skad cig gcig la bdag gis blta/ /rtag tu de dag gi ni spyod yul la/ /sgyu mar gyur pa'i rnam thar stobs kyis 'jug /gang yang dus gsum dag gi zhing bkod pa/ /de dag rdul gcig steng du mngon par bsgrub/ /de ltar ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rgyal ba dag gi zhing rnams bkod la 'jug /gang yang ma byon 'jig rten sgron ma rnams / /de dag 6)rim par 'tshang rgya 'khor lo bskor/ /mya ngan 'das pa rab tu zhi mtha' ston/ /mgon po kun gyi drung du bdag mchi'o/ /kun tu myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang / /kun nas sgo yi ( theg pa'i stobs dag dang / /kun tu yon tan spyod pa'i stobs rnams dang / /kun tu khyab (5)pa byams pa dag gi stobs/ /kun nas dge ba'i bsod nams stobs rnams dang / /chags pa med par gyur pa'i ye shes stobs/ /shes rab thabs dang ting 'dzin stobs dag gis / /byang chub stobs rnams yang dag sgrub par byed/ /las kyi stobs rnams yongs su dag byed cing / /nyon mongs stobs rnams kun tu 'joms par byed/ /bdud kyi stobs rnams stobs med rab byed cing / /bzang po spyod pa'i stobs ni rdzogs par bgyi/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing / /sems can rgya mtsho dag ni rnam par 'grol/ /chos rnams rgya mtsho rab tu mthong byed cing / /ye shes rgya mtsho rab tu rtogs par byed/ /spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam par 98—925

dag byed cing / /smon lam rgya mtsho rab tu rdzogs par byed/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rab tu mchod byed cing / /bskal pa rgya mtshor mi skyo spyad par bgyi/ /gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba yi/ /byang chub 0)spyod pa'i smon lam bye brag rnams / /bzang po spyod pas byang chub sangs rgyas nas/ /de kun ma lus bdag gis rdzogs par bgyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo pa/ /gang gi ming ni kun tu bzang zhes bya/ /mkhas pa de dang mtshungs par spyod (mipa'i phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rnam dag cing / /spyod pa rnam dag zhing rnams yongs dag dang / /bsngo ba'ang ②bzang po mkhas pa ci 'dra bar/ /de 'drar bdag kyang de dang mtshungs par shog /kun nas dge ba bzang po spyad ④pa'i phyir/ /'jam dpal gyi ni smon lam spyad par bgyi/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar/ /de yi bya ba ma lus rdzogs par bgyi/ /spyod pa dag ni tshad yod ma gyur cig /yon tan rnams kyang tshad gzung med par shog /spyod pa tshad med pa la gnas nas kyang //de dag 'phrul pa thams cad 'tshal bar bgyi/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam par/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /gang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams mtha' yas pa/ /rin chen brgyan te rgyal ba rnams la phul/ /lha dang mi yi bde ba mchog rnams kyang / /zhing gi rdul snyed bskal par ⑤phul ba bas/ /gang gis bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di thos nas/ /byang chub mchog gis ༅rjes su rab mos shing / /lan cig tsam yang dad pa skyed pa ⑦ni/ /bsod nams dam pa'i mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /gang gis bzang spyod smon lam 98—926

'di btab pa/ /des ni ngan song thams cad spangs par 'gyur/ /des ni grogs po ngan pa spangs pa yin/ /snang ba mtha' yas de yang des myur mthong / /de dag rnyed pa rab rnyed bde bar 'tsho/ /mi tshe 'dir yang de dag legs par 'ongasal/ /kun tu bzang po de yang ci 'dra bar/ /de dag ring por mi thogs de bzhin 'gyur/ /mtshams 0)med lnga po dag gi ②sdig pa rnams/ /gang gis mi shes dbang gis byas pa dag /de yis bzang po spyod pa 'di brjod na/ /myur du ma lus yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ /ye shes dang ni gzugs dang mtshan rnams dang / /rigs dang kha dog rnams dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bdud dang mu stegs mang pos de mi thub/ /'jig rten gsum po kun la'ang (5)mchod par 'gyur / /byang chub shing dbang drung du de myur 'gro/ /song nas sems can phan phyir der 'dug ste/ /byang chub sangs rgyas 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud rnams sde ④dang bcas pa thams cad 'dul/ /gang yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam 'di/ /'chang ba dang ni ston tam klog pa yi/ /de yi rnam par smin pa sangs rgyas mkhyen/ /byang chub mchog la som nyi ma byed cig /'jam dpal ji ltar mkhyen cing dpa' ba 95nodang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te / /de dag gi ni rjes su bdag slob cing / /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /bdag gi 6)dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na / /sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal te/ /mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthong nas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro/ /des (7)song nas (8)98—927

ni smon lam 'di dag kyang / /thams cad ma lus mngon sum 'gyur bar shog /de dag ma lus bdag gis yongs su bkang hu)/ /'jig rten ji srid sems can phan par bgyi/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /pad+ma dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal las (mimangon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /der ni bdag gis lung bstan rab thob nas/ /sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /blo yi stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang / /sems can rnams la phan pa mang po bgyi/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam btab pa yis/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /des ni 'gro ba'i dge ba'i smon lam rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis ②thams cad 'byor par shog /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam bsngos pa yis/ /bsod nams dam pa mtha' yas gang thob des/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal chu bor bying ba rnams/ /'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab thob par shog /smon lam rgyal po 'di mchog gtso des ni'atsho/ /'gro ba mtha' yas kun la phan byed cing / /kun tu bzang pos brgyan pa'i gzhung grub cing / /ngan song rgyud gsum ma lus stongs par shog /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po rdzogs sto// //98—928

༄༅gi /'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam/ sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong lha mig ldan pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang yang ske/ /nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan 'gro thams cad zlog bgyid cing ske/ /mtho ris lam 90ni rab ston la/ /rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems kyi dbang du gyur pas na/ /bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar ②mchis nas su/ /bdag gis de dag bshags par bgyi/ /bdag las rnam pa gsum gang gis/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bskyed pa de/ /bdag gi kun mkhyen sa bon te/ /bdag gi ④byang chub mi zad shog /phyogs bcu dag gi (gezhing rnams su/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa gang byung ba/ /sangs rgyas mkhyen pa'i yi rang bas/ /de la bdag ni yi rang ngo / /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /bsod nams kun la yi 98—931

rang ngo / /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni ye shes mchog thob shog /phyogs bcu dag gi phyogs rnams na/ /sa bcu dag la gnas pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mchog /'tshang rgya bgyid par skul ma 'debs/ /byang chub dam par sangs rgyas shing / /sde dang bcas pa'i bdud btul nas/ /srog chags kun la sman slad du/ /chos kyi 'khor (17lo skor (migyur cig /chos rnga chen po'i sgra yis ni/ /sdug bsngal sems can thar bgyid shog /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /chos ston mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig /'dod pa'i 'dam du bying gyur cing / /srid (8)pa'i srad bus dam bcings pa 'ching ba kun gyis bcings bdag la/ /rkang gnyis mchog rnams gzigs su gsol/ /sems kyis (4)dri mar bgyis pa la/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni dmod 5)mi mdzad/ /sems can rnams la byams thugs ldan/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs dang / /gang dag 'das dang ma byon pa/ /de dag rjes su bdag slob cing / /byang chub spyad pa spyod gyur cig /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis nas/ /'gro drug sems can thar bgyid shog /mngon shes drug po mngon bgyis nas/ /bla med byang chub reg gyur cig /ma skyes pa dang mi 'byung dang / /rang bzhin ma mchis gnas ma mchis/ /rnam rig ma mchis dngos ma mchis/ /stong pa'i chos ni rtogs par shog /sangs rgyas drang srong chen po ltar/ /sems can ma mchis srog ma mchis/ /gang zag ma mchis gso ma mchis/ /bdag ma mchis pa'i chos rtogs shog /bdag 'dzin bdag gir 'dzin par ni/ /dngos po kun la mi gnas par/ /sems can kun la bde slad du/ /ser sna ma mchis sbyin gtong shog /dngos po dngos po ma 98—932

mchis pas/ /bdag gi longs spyod lhun grub shog /dngos po thams cad rnam 'jig pas/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing / /tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan/ /rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sa 'am yang na chu 'am me/ /rlung gi khams ltar mi gnas shing / /bzod pa'am khro ba ma mchis par / /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /brtson 'grus brtsams 1)pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /brtan spro le lo ma mchis shing / /stobs dang ldan pa'i lus sems kyis/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang / /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang / /dus gsum mnyam pa nyid dang yang / /rig gsum mngon sum bgyis pa yis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa dang / /'od dang gzi brjid 'bar ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs gyur cig /de ltar spyad pa spyod byed cing / /byams pa grags dang ldan pa yis/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs byas nas/ /sa bcu po la rab tu gnas/ /'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam rdzogs sto(ge// //98—933

༄ga /mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam/6)༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ a gra tsār+ya pra ṇi dhā (shen/ bod skad du/mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye dgu kun la sman dang bde slad du/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sangs rgyas rnams la 'dud/ /de dag la ni rjed ③cing mchod par bgyi / /'gro kun byang chub mchog la reg gyur cig /byams pa dang ni 'jam dpal mnga' bdag rtog /chos kyi blo gros dpa' bo bdud rtsi gsung / /dpa' bo de dag phyag 'tshal mkhyen pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang mi dbang rnams la 'dud / /thugs rje ldan zhing 'jig rten don mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba mi mkhyen mi gzigs mi mnga' ba/ /mi dbang thugs brtse byams la gnas pa yi/ /rgyal ba de kun bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sngon gyi srid pa dag tu bdag nyid kyis//sdig pa'i las rnams gang bgyis bdag gis bshags/ /de bzhin lus ngag yid 98—935

kyis bgyis pa rnams/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /shākya thub dang mi 'khrugs 'od dpag med/ /de dag gis ni phrin las yongs sbyangs dang / /'chags dang bshags pa mkhyen cing rtogs gyur ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis sdig pa bshags par bgyi/ /thams cad dga' mdzad skyes bu dam pa gang / /byang chub zhugs pa kun la gsol ba dang / /ngan song bzhi po myur du zhi gyur cig /mi khom 'joms par bgyid cing rgyu bar shog /sangs rgyas bzang spyod dri med mnga' bdag dang / /de bzhin lhun po'i dpal dang nyi ma'i sgron / /de dag bsod nams yi rang mkhyen pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang bsod nams rjes yi rang / /phyogs bcu dag na sbyin pa spyod pa 15)gang / /de bzhin tshul khrims ting 'dzin spyod rnams dang / /shes rab sgom dang bsod nams stobs kun la/ /byang chub yon tan don du yi rang ngo / /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan mtha' yas dang / /chos bstan byang chub 'jog bgyid thams cad la / /byang chub yon tan don du yi (b.rang ngo / /'gro kun byang chub mchog la reg gyur cig /'jig rten rgyal ba gang bzhugs kun la bskul/ /phyogs bcu dag na byang chub brnyes pa gang / /de dag tshangs pas ji ltar gsol ba ltar/ /rgyal rnams bzhugs shing chos mchog ston gyur cig /rgyal kun bskal pa mang por bzhugs par shog /'gro kun byang chub mchog la reg gyur cig /mi rnams thams cad mchog dang bla med pa/ /'jig rten sgron ma bde gshegs myur gyur cig /sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal mchod gang dang / /las dge rnams la yi rang gang lags dang / /sdig pa'i las rnams bshags pa gang lags dang / /rgyal ba rkang gnyis dbang rnams mthong gang dag(mi /bdag 98—936

gis dge ba cung zad ci bgyis pa/ /lus dang ngag dang sems las byung yang rung / /bdag gis bgyis dang bgyid dang bgyid 'gyur gang / /thams cad skye dgu sman slad stsal bar bgyi/ /ji ltar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams mkhyen nas / /stsal ba legs par stsal cing legs rgyas pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis skye dgu sman slad stsal/ /'gro kun byang chub mchog la reg gyur cig /bdag gis 'gro la stsal pa gang lags pa'i/ /bsod nams 'bras bu bla med ci mchis pa /theg pa chen por yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag la byang chub 'bras bu grub par shog /mtshungs pa ma mchis kun nas sgo mo rnams/ /'gro ba'i don du bdag la mngon sum shog /'jam dpal gyi ni rjes su slob bgyid cing / /byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam gdab par bgyi/ /mi gcig tsam gyi ched du'ang mnar med pa'i/ /tshor ba thams cad bdag gis myong 'gyur bar/ /bskal pa du mar bdag ni spro bar bgyi/ /'gro ba thams cad mya ngan med par shog /sems dmyal gshin rje'i 'jig rten sdug bsngal dang / /dud 'gro rnams dang mi yi sdug bsngal dang / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phung po mtha' yas dag /bdag la bab gyur 'gro ba bde bar shog /rgyal ba rnams kyi zhing ni rnam dag dang / /sems can rnam dag ye shes rnam dag dang / /rgyal ba rnams kyi smon lam mtha' yas gang / /smon lam de kun bdag la grub par shog /bdag gi smon lam nyams par ma gyur cig /bdag ni nam yang skyo bar mi 'gyur shog /byang chub mchog ni bdag gis thob bar du/ /bskal pa du mar bdag ni spro bar shog /mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam rdzogs sto// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā wasmra (1)dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de (7ye shes sde la 98—937

tshog /stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa las gsungs pa'i smon lam/1)༄zag /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'di 'am gang ②dag 'das pa dang / /mtho ris dag na rin chen mchog yod pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /mi yi mchog dang 'dir ni mtshungs pa med / /de bas 'di ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /zad pa chags bral bdud rtsi 'dus ma byas/ /shes pas shākya thub des rab tu phye/ /bdud rtsi zhi ba 'dus byas ma yin pa/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa gang yang med/ /de bas 'di ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /mchog tu gang 'dod tshul bzhin rab bstan pa/ /ston pa'i rnal 'byor bla med rtag sgrub pa/ /rdo rje lta bu'i mig gnyis lam mthong ba/ /ting 'dzin de dang mnyam pa yod ma yin/ /de bas 'di ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /98—939

༄ga /bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/917khudzi /rgya gar skad du/ swa s+t+ya ya na gā thā/ bod skad du/ bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /'jig rten 'dren pa'i drung du ni/ /lha zhig nye bar song nas su/ /gang gis rtag tu bde legs pa/ /bdag gis zhu yis bcom ldan gsungs/ /dam pas de dag gsan pa dang / /'jig rten 'dren pas lung bstan pa/ /gang gis kun tu bde legs su/ /'gyur ba lha khyod legs par nyon/ /gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa la/ /dad pa mi g.yo legs rab brtan/ /gang zhig dge ba tshul khrims can/ /de dag kun tu bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig pha dang ma dag dang / /bu dang bu mo bran dag la/ /rtag tu legs par bsnyen bkur ba/ /de dag kun tu bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig dgra bcom grags pa la/ /legs par rab dad yon 'bul dang / /lha yi bka' bzhin byed pa dag /de 98—956

dag kun tu bde legs 'gyur/ /gang gis lus dang ngag dang ni/ /yid la nyes byas med pa dang / /gang zhig rnam gsum rab bsdams pa/ /de dag kun tu bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'byung po thams cad la/ /tshad med kun tu mi 'khrugs pa/ /byams pa'i sems ni sgom byed pa/ /de dag kun tu bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig sdug bsngal kun spangs 6)phyir/ /'phags pa'i lam gyi yan lag brgyad/ /bde ba 'dren pa legs bsgom pa/ /de dag kun tu bde legs 'gyur/ /gang gis 'dus byas thams cad kyi/ /stong nyid rtag tu legs mthong zhing / /de ni sems la gnas gyur pa/ /de dag kun tu bde legs 'gyur② / /gang gis lus kyi dri med chos/ /mngon sum byas nas rgyu ba dang / /dgra bcom rnam grol sems ldan pa/ /de dag kun tu bde legs 'gyur/ /gang gis 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /gti mug rnams dang chags bral zhing / /ye shes 'khrug phyimed skyes gyur pa/ /de dag kun tu bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi/ /mgon po yang srid spangs pa yi sangs rgyas khong du chud gyur pa/ /de dag kun tu bde legs 'gyur/ /bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs sto// //98—957

bsdur mchan/956 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/957 7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉spang / ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gyur/ ③〈〈co 〉〉'khrugs/bsdur 'bras re'u migagazungs 'dus/ (725) 98wa 958

༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ rma ga la gā thā/ bod skad du/ bkra shis kyi (mitshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa'i 'dab (mi'adra'i spyan mnga' ba /bkra shis des ni skye dgu zhi byed dang po'o/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing ④lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o / /dge 'dun dam pa'i chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /sems can kun la phan phyir byang chub mnga' ba po/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub 98—959

par brtul ba yongs ldan pa/ /tshogs kyi lam dgyes thub pa'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /dbang bcas lha yis bskor ba'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' lum bī'i 0)tshal/ /lha mang dag gis bstan ②par mgon po bltams ①pa na / /srid pa'i mthar phyin pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer ser skya'i gnas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du/ /lhums nas bltams 54pa ston pa bde (5nigashegs zas gtsang (6༄sras/ /myur bskrun bdud rtsi'i chus gtor ba yi merabakra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer dam pa ser skya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni/ /rmad du grags pa che ba'i lha yis mngon bstod pa/ /bsam yas dge bsgrubs bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /dgyes shing nam phyed grong khyer mchog nas (nyamangon byung ste/ /dka' thub tshal du mngon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /bai ḍūr+ya yo)ltar sngo ba'i rtswa bting steng bzhugs te/ /skyil 7mo krung hunyebacas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /chu bo'i 'gram na tsa sha'i phreng gis yongs bskor ba/ /shin tu rmad du byung ba'i srid pa sel mdzad pa / /klu yi rgyal pos phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu 98—960

rnams la zhi byed shog /shing rgyal drung gshegs byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs / /mang po btul te sa steng dang ni nam mkha' la/ /bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs te/ /nam gyi tho rangs bdud bzhi po dag rnam btul ba/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shes des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr 91)drang srong mchog bzhugs nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mchog bstan pa yi bkra shis gang / /lha yul dang 'dir shin tu rmad du byung gyur pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa dag byed pa/ /bsod nams bya byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa / /bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i seng ges gang gsungs pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /mu stegs byed pa kun gyi nga rgyal gzhom pa dang / /'gro la bde ba bskyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag /nye bar ston pa rgyal ba'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir mtho ris nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs/ /sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba mchog tu nyer gshegs pa/ /man dā ra ba'i me tog mang pos mngon mchod pa / /lha mchog rnams kyis mngon par bstod pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lha dbang klu dang mi yi dbang pos phyag byas pa/ /mkha' lding 3riganod sbyin dri za'i dbang pos mchod gyur pa/ /de 98—961

bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ldan pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /dkon mchog gsum dang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs sto// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi ①na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ②ye shes sdes ⑧bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa④//bsdur mchan/959 6)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gekyil/ (0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉mdab/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉grags ging / 〈〈pe 〉〉bkra shis/96 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bi'i/ ⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bsten/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bltam/ rgya〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bltam/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉 ba/ ⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉btsang /(7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉yis/ (2)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gnas/ 6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉drur+ya/ 〈〈khu 〉〉ḍūr+ya/⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉dkyil/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉dkrung / 〈〈khu 〉〉grung /961 (1)〈〈pe 〉〉srin/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉snying /962 6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉'dzi/ 〈〈li 〉〉'dzin/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ban dhe/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉 sdes/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉po/98wa 962
bsdur 'bras re'u migagazungs 'dus/ (726)

༄ga /sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/①༄tshog /(gedakon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan rnam par gzigs ni rgyal rigs gzi brjid can/ /tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus na grong khyer mdzes ldan du/ /shi ri sha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /deng 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /bde gshegs gtsug tor mnga' ba rgyal rigs rdzu 'phrul can/ /tshe lo bdun khri'i dus na su ma'i grong khyer du / /shing mchog sun dha'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /deng ②'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /rgyal ba thams cad skyob pa rgyal rigs blo gros can/ /tshe lo drug khri'i dus na grong khyer mnyam med du/ /shing mchog sā (gela'i drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /(snyedeng ⑥'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /thub pa 'khor ba 'jig ni stobs ⑦ldan bram ze'i rigs/ /tshe lo bzhi khri'i dus na grong khyer mdzes ldan du/ /shi ri 98wa 964

sha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /deng 1)'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /'dren pa gser thub bslab pa mchog ldan bram ze'i rigs / /tshe lo sum khri'i dus na grong khyer bde ldan du/ /u dum bā (gera'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /deng ①'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /skyob pa 'od srung rgyal rigs bla med yon tan can/ /tshe lo nyi khri'i dus na bā rā ṇa sī ru/ /n+ya gro dha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /deng du'adir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /'gro mgon shākya thub pa rgyal rigs brtson 'grus can/ /tshe lo brgya pa'i dus na ser skya'i grong khyer du/ /a shwat+tha ⑤yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /deng 6)'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /sangs rgyas rabs bdun bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa gang / /phyogs dus kun gyi bde gshegs byin brlabs rmad byung ba/ /chos dbyings rnam dag rten 'brel stobs ldan mi 'gyur ba / /deng ⑦'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /sangs rgyas rabs ⑧bdun gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs sto// //98—965

bsdur mchan/964 6)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mjug byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 rgya gar skad du / bud dha ka ma la sam mi ga la hā thā/ bod skad du/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa / 〈〈pe 〉〉 rgya gar skad du/ bud dha ka ma la sa bha ma ga la hā thā/ bod skad du/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ding / ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sa du〈〈li 〉〉/shing mchog sa'i drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ ⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ding / ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bcom/965 6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ding / ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ba/ ⑧④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ding /⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉shatha/ 〈〈khu 〉〉shwat+tha/ ⑥du〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ding / ⑧〈〈khu 〉〉rab/bsdur 'bras re'u migagazungs 'dus/ (727)98wa 966

khug /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/6)༄༅ga /rgya gar skad du/ pañtsa ta thā ga ta yaṃ ga la gā thā/ bod skad du/de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad ye shes dam pa mtsho chen ldan/ /zla ba nya 'dra'i sku mnga' srid pa'i mthar phyin pa/ /dgongs pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /mi 'khrugs rgyal po srid dang gti mug rnam sbyong ba/ /mgon po yon tan thams cad rdzogs pas bkra shis pa/ /dge mnyam bsam sems ldan pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi rgyan gyis brgyan mdzad cing / /yang dag bden pa'i 'byor pa sbyin mdzad mi slu ba/ /rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya'i bkra shis gang yin nga// /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /bsam gtan ting 'dzin ye shes 98—967

dam pa pha rol phyin pa'i gnas/ /ye shes pad+ma'i steng bzhugs dpag med tshe ldan zhing / /tshe grangs med par byin gyis rlob pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /sems can don gyi las la thugs ni sbyor mdzad cing / /'gro ba kun gyi 'ching bas bcings las grol mdzad pa/ /thub mchog don yod grub pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs sto// //bsdur mchan/967 1)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/bsdur 'bras re'u migagazungs 'dus/ (728)98wa 968

༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ tri ku la rma ga la/ bod skad du/ rigs gsum gyi bkra shis/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan gser mdog ri yi rgyal po 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum mgon 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i sku/ /bde gshegs sku yi bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni deng (mi'adir bde legs shog /bcom ldan dung mdog ri yi rgyal po 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum mgon spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / /bde gshegs gsung gi bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni deng (5)'dir bde legs shog /bcom ldan ljang ser ri yi rgyal po 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum mgon phyag na rdo rje ste/ /bde gshegs thugs kyi bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni deng ④'dir bde legs shog /dpal rigs gsum gyi bkra shis rdzogs sto//98—969
bsdur mchan/ 969 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②du0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉deng /bsdur 'bras re'u migagazungs 'dus/ (729)98wa 970

tshog /'phags pa rgya cher rol pa'i mdo'i tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang po'i le'u las 'byung ba shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/6)༄zag /shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi bkra shis don sgrub cing / /phyogs (mirnams bkra shis byed pa des/ /khyod ( nyekyi don rnams grub gyur cig /thams cad myur du mthun ④par shog /phreng ba mgo la 'dug pa ltar/ /lag pa g.yas na dpal yod shog /g.yon na'ang dpal ni gnas gyur cig /yan lag kun na'ang dpal yod shog /tshong pa dag ni nor tshol zhing / /phyogs bcu dag tu 'gro ba rnams/ /rnyed pa chen po rnyed gyur cing / /de dag bde ba skyid par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir/ /shar phyogs su ni 'gro ba na/ /gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi/ /rgyu skar khyed la skyong gyur cig /smin drug dang ni snar ma dang / /mgo dang lag dang nam so dang / /rgyal dang skag ces bya ba ste/ /de dag rnams ni shar phyogs pa/ /rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa/ /98—971

shar phyogs logs na yod ces bstan/ /de dag khyod (1)la kun tu srungs/ /de dag bdag po rgyal po ni/ /yul 'khor srung zhes grags pa ste/ /de ni dri za kun gyi bdag /nyi ma lhan cig srung bar shog /de la bu ni mang yod la/ /mkhas shing ming yang mthun (7pa ste/ /dgu bcu rtsa gcig zad ⑧par yang / /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /de rnams khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /shar phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /lha mo gzhon nu brgyad yod de/ /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ma dang / /don grub ma dang mi pham dang / /dga' mchog ma dang dga' sde dang / /dga' can ma dang dga' 'phel ma/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong bar shog /shar phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /gzhi 'dzin ces bya'i mchod rten yod / /rgyal ba skyob pa dgra bcom pa/ /de rnams kyis ni bzhugs shing mkhyen/ /de yang khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun gyis rab bsrungs nas/ /nor rnams rnyed de ldog par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir/ /lho phyogs su ni 'gro ba na/ /gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi/ /rgyu skar khyed la skyong gyur cig /mchu dang gre dang dbo (4)dang ni/ /me bzhi nag pa lnga pa yin/ /sa ri dang ni sa (5skug ste/ /de dag rnams ni lho phyogs pa/ /rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa/ /lho phyogs logs na yod ces bstan/ /de dag khyed la kun tu srungs/ /de dag bdag po rgyal po ni/ /'phags skyes po zhes bya bar brjod/ /de ni grul bum kun gyi bdag /gshin rje lhan cig srung bar shog /de la bu ni mang yod la/ /mkhas 98—972

shing ming yang mthun ①pa ste/ /dgu bcu rtsa gcig (bzad par yang / /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /de rnams khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /lho phyogs logs ②kyi phyogs cha na/ /lha mo gzhin nu brgyad yod de/ /dpal ldan ma dang grags ldan ma/ /grags pa thob dang grags 'dzin dang / /legs par langs dang rab snga dang / /legs par sad dang bde sgrub ma/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong bar shog /lho phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /pad+ma zhes bya'i mchod rten yod/ /rtag tu gzi brjid ④kyis kyang 'bar/ /rtag tu thams cad gsal byed pa/ /de yang khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun gyis rab bsrungs nas/ /nor rnams rnyed de ldog par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir⑤/ /nub phyogs su ni 'gro ba na/ /gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi/ /rgyu skar khyed la skyong gyur cig /lha mtshams dang ni snron (6)dang yang / /brtson 'grus brtan ldan sgrubs ⑦dang ni/ /chu stod chu smad byi bzhin 6)dang / /gro bzhin de ni bdun pa yin/ /rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa/ /nub phyogs logs na yod ces bstan/ /de dag khyed la kun tu srungs/ /de dag bdag po rgyal po ni/ /mig mi bzang zhes bya bar shes/ /de ni klu rnams kun gyi bdag /chu lha 4)lhan cig srung bar shog /de la bu ni mang yod la/ /mkhas shing ming yang mthun 7pa ste/ /dgu bcu rtsa gcig zad par yang / /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /nub phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /lha mo 98—973

gzhon nu brgyad yod de/ /rna cha skra 'dres ma dang ni/ /pad+ma dkar dang skya reng ①dang / /cha med gcig dang dgu pa dang / /rol dang gnag ⑧dang stabs zhumyur srid / /de dag khyed la nad med cing ④/ /shis par lhag par skyong bar shog /nub phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /nub ces bya ba'i ri bo yod/ /nyi ma zla ba gnyis ku'ang ⑤nub/ /nub pa'ang khyed la nor sbyin 'gyur/ /de yang khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun gyis rab bsrungs nas / /nor rnams rnyed de ldog par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir/ /byang phyogs su ni 'gro ba na/ /gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi/ /rgyu skar khyed la skyong gyur cig /mon gru yidang ni mon gre dang / /khrums stod dang ni khrums smad dang / /nam gru dang ni tha skar dang / /bra nye ste ni bdun pa yin/ /rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa/ /byang phyogs logs na yod ces bstan/ /de dag khyed la kun tu srungs/ /de dag bdag po rgyal po ni/ /mi la zhon pa lus ngan po/ /gnod sbyin kun gyi bdag po ste/ /nor bzangs kla lhan cig srung (shebar shog /de la bu ni mang yod la/ /mkhas shing ming po)yang mthun spre )pa ste/ /dgu bcu rtsa gcig zad par yang / /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /byang phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /lha mo gzhon nu brgyad yod de/ /rab chags lha mo gtong lha mo/ /sa dang de bzhin pad+ma can/ /rgyal po che la nyer gnas dang / /re tunyedang khrel yod dpal ldan ma/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong bar shog /byang phyogs logs kyi 98—974
